        public static bool validarOcupacionRecurso(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string StrPath, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string recurso, ref string nroDoc)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            string docEntry = string.Empty;
            string fechIni = string.Empty;
            int horaIni = 0;
            string fechFin = string.Empty;
            int horaFin = 0;
            string simultaneo = string.Empty;
            string dato = string.Empty;
            string strQry = string.Empty;
            nroDoc = string.Empty;
            bool ocupado = false;

            try
            {
                docEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim();
                docEntry = string.IsNullOrEmpty(docEntry) ? "0" : docEntry;
                fechIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                horaIni = Convert.ToInt16(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horIniProgra", 0).Trim());
                fechFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecFinProgra", 0).Trim();
                horaFin = Convert.ToInt16(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horFinProgra", 0).Trim());
                simultaneo = string.IsNullOrEmpty(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_simultaneo", 0).Trim()) ? "N" : oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_simultaneo", 0).Trim();

                fechIni = fechaFormato(fechIni, horaIni, sapApplication);
                fechFin = fechaFormato(fechFin, horaFin, sapApplication);

                oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "verificarDispoRecursoSimul", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", recurso);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", fechIni);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", fechFin);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", docEntry);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                while (!oRS.EoF)
                {
                    dato = oRS.Fields.Item("U_dispo").Value.ToString();
                    nroDoc = oRS.Fields.Item("U_nroDoc").Value.ToString();
                    if (dato.Equals("N"))
                    {
                        ocupado = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (dato.Equals(""))
                        {
                            if (!simultaneo.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                ocupado = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    oRS.MoveNext();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "validarOcupacionRecurso", sapCompany);
            }
            return ocupado;
        }

        public static bool ExistenDocumentoMarketingCreadosMatrizElementos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool error = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;

            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                while (indice <= omtx.RowCount && !salir)
                {
                    if (existen_DocumentosCreadosOSLinea(oForm, ocmp, ref  mensaje, indice))
                    {
                        error = true;
                        salir = true;
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExistenDocumentosCreadosMatrizElementos", ocmp);
            }
            return error;
        }

        public static bool existen_DocumentosCreadosOSLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, int fila)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            string OrdenGenerada = "";
            string DocumentoOrden = "";
            string Documento = "";
            string NoDoc = "";
            string nroTrasArt = "";


            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();

                NoDoc = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", fila).Trim();
                Documento = oDBS1.GetValue("U_DescDoc", fila).Trim();
                DocumentoOrden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docOrd", fila).Trim();
                OrdenGenerada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ordCom", fila).Trim();
                nroTrasArt = oDBS1.GetValue("U_nroTrasArt", fila).Trim();


                if (!NoDoc.Equals(""))
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = NoDoc;
                }
                if (!Documento.Equals("") && !existe)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = Documento;
                }
                if (!OrdenGenerada.Equals("NO") && (!OrdenGenerada.Equals("") && !existe))
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = DocumentoOrden;
                }
                if (!DocumentoOrden.Equals("") && !existe)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = DocumentoOrden;
                }
                if (!nroTrasArt.Equals(string.Empty) && !existe)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = nroTrasArt;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_DocumentosCreadosOSLinea", ocmp);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        #region estadosOT estados de la orden de traslado
        public static string estadosOT(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).Trim();
            string nroSolTras = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_numSolTras", 0).Trim();
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbEstOT = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;

            string resp = "Abierto";

            string cancelado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cancelar", 0).Trim();
            string anular = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_anular", 0).Trim();
            if (cancelado.Equals("Y"))
            {
                resp = "Cancelado";
                return resp;
            }
            if (anular.Equals("Y"))
            {
                resp = "Anulado";
                return resp;
            }


            string tipoVehi = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoVehi", 0).Trim();
            string Vehi = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehiAsig", 0).Trim();
            string tipoCond = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoCond", 0).Trim();
            string cond = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_condAsig", 0).Trim();
            string fechaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecIniProgra", 0).Trim();
            string horaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horIniProgra", 0).Trim();
            string fechaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecFinProgra", 0).Trim();
            string horaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horFinProgra", 0).Trim();


            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoVehi) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Vehi) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoCond) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cond)
                && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaIni) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaIni) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaFin) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaFin))
            {
                resp = "Programado";
            }
            else
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSolTras))
                    return resp;
            }

            string kmInicial = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_kmInicial", 0).Trim();
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(kmInicial))
            {
                resp = "En Proceso";
            }
            else
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSolTras))
                    return resp;
            }

            string kmFinal = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_kmFinal", 0).Trim();
            string liberar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar", 0).Trim();
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(kmFinal) && liberar.Equals("Y"))
            {
                resp = "Ejecutado";
            }
            else
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSolTras))
                    return resp;
            }

            SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox chItem;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
            int rowCount = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
            {
                chItem = (SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("uso", i);
                if (chItem.Checked)
                {
                    rowCount++;
                }
            }

            if (rowCount == oMatrix.RowCount)
            {
                resp = "Cerrado";
            }
            else
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSolTras))
                    return resp;
            }

            return resp;
        }
        #endregion

            string query = string.Empty;
            string serie = string.Empty;

                mensaje = serie + " - Nro " + docNum + " - No. Orden servicio Funerario: " + idservicioFunerario + " - Asunto: " + asunto;

        public static bool enviarAlerta(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta tipoAlerta, ref  string mensaje, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSUsuarios = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService oMS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Message oMsg = null;
            //Consultas cons = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string IdAlerta = string.Empty;

            bool exito = false;
            string userCode = string.Empty;

            try
            {
                oRSUsuarios = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                //determinar cuales usuarios deben ser notificados
                switch (tipoAlerta)
                {

                    case ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.KilometrajeAdicional:
                        {
                            //cons.getUsuariosDeAlerta("12", oRSUsuarios);

                            IdAlerta = "17";

                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarMensajeUsuarioAlerta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%IdAlerta%", IdAlerta.Trim());
                            ors.DoQuery(query);
                        }
                        break;
                }

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    int i = 0;
                    oCS = sapCompany.GetCompanyService();
                    oMS = (SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService)oCS.GetBusinessService(ServiceTypes.MessagesService);
                    oMsg = (SAPbobsCOM.Message)oMS.GetDataInterface(MessagesServiceDataInterfaces.msdiMessage);
                    oMsg.Subject = "Alerta Servicio Funerario";
                    //oMsg.Text = ors.Fields.Item("U_Mensaje").Value.ToString() + " - No. DocSF: " + idOT + " - No. SolLab: " + numeroSolicitud + " - Asunto: " + asunto + " -Tipo: " + Tipo + " -Actividad: " + actividad;
                    oMsg.Text = ors.Fields.Item("U_Mensaje").Value.ToString() + mensaje;


                    oMsg.Priority = BoMsgPriorities.pr_High;

                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Add();
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).SendInternal = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                        // oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).EmailAddress = "";
                        userCode = ors.Fields.Item("U_Usuario").Value.ToString();

                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).UserCode = DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", userCode, sapCompany);
                        i++;
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }

                    //if (!UserNotificar.Equals(string.Empty))
                    //{
                    //    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Add();
                    //    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).SendInternal = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                    //    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).UserCode = UserNotificar;
                    //    //DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", UserNotificar, sapCompany);
                    //    i++;
                    //}
                    oMS.SendMessage(oMsg);
                    exito = true; ;
                }

            }



            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "enviarAlerta", sapCompany);
                mensaje = e.Message;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSUsuarios != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSUsuarios);
                if (ors != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }

            return exito;
        }

        public static string DevolverItemEnTabla(string TableName, string FieldCodeName, string FieldName, string value, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {
            string item = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                string query = "SELECT \"" + FieldCodeName + "\" FROM \"" + TableName + "\" WHERE \"" + FieldName + "\"  = '" + value + "'";
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    item = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "DevolverItemEnTabla", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return item;

        }

        #region bloquear campos deacuerdo al estado
        public static bool bloquearCampos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany)
        {
            //string estado = estadosOT(oForm);
            oForm.Items.Item("15").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
            string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).ToString();

            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_estOT", 0, estado);
            if (estado.Equals("Cancelado") || estado.Equals("Anulado") || estado.Equals("Cerrado"))
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("txtKmIni").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("txtKmFin").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("docEntry").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cbTipoOrd").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("nroST").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("OTCance").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cbTipoTras").Enabled = false;
                //DOCNUM CAB 18-12-2020
                oForm.Items.Item("docnumSF").Enabled = false;
                //DOCNUM CAB 18-12-2020 
                oForm.Items.Item("txtNroOSF").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("txtLCH").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("txtIdFall").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("txtNomFall").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cbSeries").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("series").Enabled = false;

                 oForm.Items.Item("cbSeries").Enabled = false;

                oForm.Items.Item("txtFecCoor").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("txtHorCoor").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("btTrasStoc").Enabled = true;
                oForm.Items.Item("btnSalMe").Enabled = true;
                oForm.Items.Item("1").Enabled = true;

                #region bloquear celdas de elemntos

                oForm.Items.Item("horIniPro").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("fecFinPro").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("horFinPro").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cbTipCond").Enabled = false;

                oForm.Items.Item("cflCondAsi").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cbTipVehi").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cflvehiAsi").Enabled = false;

                #region segundo vehiculo
                oForm.Items.Item("TipCond2").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("CondAsi2").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("TipVehi2").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("vehiAsi2").Enabled = false;
                #endregion

                oForm.Items.Item("chSimul").Enabled = false;
            }
            if (nivelEstado >= 3)
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("txtKmIni").Enabled = false;
            }
            if (nivelEstado >= 4)
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("txtKmFin").Enabled = false;

                #region liberar1

                oForm.Items.Item("fecLiber2").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("horLiber2").Enabled = false;
                #endregion
            }
            return true;
        }

        public static string actualizarRecursoSQL(SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application SapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string docEntry, string codeRecurso, string tipoRecurso, string consulta, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string strQry = string.Empty;
            string fechaIni = string.Empty;
            string horaIni = string.Empty;
            string fechaFin = string.Empty;
            string horaFin = string.Empty;
            string simultaneo = string.Empty;

            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                fechaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                horaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                fechaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecFinProgra", 0).Trim();
                horaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horFinProgra", 0).Trim();
                simultaneo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_simultaneo", 0).Trim();

                fechaIni = fechaFormato(fechaIni, Convert.ToInt32(horaIni), SapApplication);
                fechaFin = fechaFormato(fechaFin, Convert.ToInt32(horaFin), SapApplication);

                if (consulta.Equals("liberarRecurso"))
                {

                    strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "liberarRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", docEntry);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", codeRecurso);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", tipoRecurso);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", "Y");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", "liberarRecurso");
                    ors.DoQuery(strQry);
                }
                else if (consulta.Equals("guardarDispoRecurso"))
                {

                    strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "guardarDispoRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", docEntry);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", codeRecurso);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", fechaIni);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", horaIni);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", fechaFin);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", horaFin);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", tipoRecurso);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", simultaneo.Equals("Y") ? "" : "N");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", "guardarDispoRecurso");
                    ors.DoQuery(strQry);
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "actualizarRecursoSQL", SapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return strQry;
        }

        #region actualizarDisponibilidad
        public static bool actualizarDisponibilidad(SAPbobsCOM.Company oCom, SAPbouiCOM.Application SBO_Application, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string strPath, string docEntry)
        {
            bool actualizo = false;
            string strQry = string.Empty;
            string liberar = string.Empty;
            string liberar2 = string.Empty;
            string cancelado = string.Empty;
            string anular = string.Empty;
            bool liberarRecurso = false;
            string recurso = string.Empty;
            string codeRecurso = string.Empty;
            string tipoRecurso = string.Empty;
            string consulta = string.Empty;
            string fechaIni = string.Empty;
            string horaIni = string.Empty;
            string fechaFin = string.Empty;
            string horaFin = string.Empty;
            string simultaneo = string.Empty;

            string tipoVehi = string.Empty;
            string Vehi = string.Empty;
            string tipoVehi2 = string.Empty;
            string Vehi2 = string.Empty;
            string tipoCond = string.Empty;
            string cond = string.Empty;
            string tipoCond2 = string.Empty;
            string cond2 = string.Empty;


            bool asignacion1 = false;
            bool asignacion2 = false;
            bool asignacionfecha = false;

            bool datosOK = false;

            try
            {
                strQry = string.Empty;

                #region informacion del estado de recurso

                liberar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar", 0).Trim();
                liberar2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_Liberar2", 0).Trim();
                cancelado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cancelar", 0).Trim();
                anular = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_anular", 0).Trim();

                if (cancelado.Equals("Y") || anular.Equals("Y"))
                    recurso = "T";
                else if (liberar.Equals("Y") && liberar2.Equals("Y"))
                    recurso = "T";
                else if (liberar.Equals("Y"))
                    recurso = "1";
                else if (liberar2.Equals("Y"))
                    recurso = "2";
                else
                    recurso = "G";

                liberarRecurso = liberar.Equals("Y") || liberar2.Equals("Y");

                #endregion
                #region informacion de recursos

                #region primer vehiculo
                tipoVehi = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoVehi", 0).Trim();
                Vehi = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehiAsig", 0).Trim();
                #endregion

                #region segundo vehiculo
                tipoVehi2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoVehi2", 0).Trim();
                Vehi2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehi2Asig", 0).Trim();
                #endregion

                #region primer conductor
                tipoCond = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoCond", 0).Trim();
                cond = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_condAsig", 0).Trim();
                #endregion

                #region segundo conductor
                tipoCond2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoCond2", 0).Trim();
                cond2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cond2Asig", 0).Trim();
                #endregion

                #region fechas -horas - simultaneo
                fechaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                horaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                fechaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecFinProgra", 0).Trim();
                horaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horFinProgra", 0).Trim();
                simultaneo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_simultaneo", 0).Trim();
                #endregion

                #region validar datos

                if (
                    !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoVehi) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Vehi) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoCond) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cond))
                    asignacion1 = true;

                if (
                   !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoVehi2) &&
                   !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Vehi2) &&
                   !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoCond2) &&
                   !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cond2))
                    asignacion2 = true;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaIni) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaIni) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaFin) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaFin))
                    asignacionfecha = true;


                datosOK = (asignacion1 || asignacion2) && asignacionfecha;
                #endregion

                #endregion

                if (datosOK)
                {
                    if (liberarRecurso || cancelado.Equals("Y") || anular.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        #region liberar anular o cancelar
                        consulta = "liberarRecurso";
                        switch (recurso)
                        {
                            case "1":
                                #region liberar vehiculo 1
                                codeRecurso = Vehi;
                                tipoRecurso = "2";
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, codeRecurso, tipoRecurso, consulta, strPath);
                                #endregion

                                #region liberar conductor 1
                                codeRecurso = cond;
                                tipoRecurso = "1";
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, codeRecurso, tipoRecurso, consulta, strPath);
                                #endregion

                                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText(" liberacion de la asignacion de recursos uno de la orden de transporte. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                break;
                            case "2":
                                #region liberar vehiculo 2
                                codeRecurso = Vehi2;
                                tipoRecurso = "2";
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, codeRecurso, tipoRecurso, consulta, strPath);
                                #endregion

                                #region liberar conductor 2
                                codeRecurso = cond2;
                                tipoRecurso = "1";
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, codeRecurso, tipoRecurso, consulta, strPath);
                                #endregion
                                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText(" liberacion de la asignacion de recursos dos de la orden de transporte. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                break;
                            case "T":

                                #region liberar vehiculo 1
                                codeRecurso = Vehi;
                                tipoRecurso = "2";
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, codeRecurso, tipoRecurso, consulta, strPath);
                                #endregion

                                #region liberar conductor 1
                                codeRecurso = cond;
                                tipoRecurso = "1";
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, codeRecurso, tipoRecurso, consulta, strPath);
                                #endregion

                                #region liberar vehiculo 2
                                codeRecurso = Vehi2;
                                tipoRecurso = "2";
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, codeRecurso, tipoRecurso, consulta, strPath);
                                #endregion

                                #region liberar conductor 2
                                codeRecurso = cond2;
                                tipoRecurso = "1";
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, codeRecurso, tipoRecurso, consulta, strPath);
                                #endregion

                                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText(" liberacion de la asignacion de recursos dos de la orden de transporte. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                break;
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        #region guardar comprometer recurso
                        if (recurso.Equals("G"))
                        {
                            consulta = "guardarDispoRecurso";

                            if (asignacion1)
                            {
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, cond, "1", consulta, strPath);
                                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Asignacion de recursos conductor :" + cond + " la orden de transporte. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, Vehi, "2", consulta, strPath);
                                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Asignacion de recursos vehiculo :" + Vehi + " la orden de transporte. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            }
                            if (asignacion2)
                            {
                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, cond2, "1", consulta, strPath);
                                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Asignacion de recursos conductor :" + cond2 + " la orden de transporte. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                                actualizarRecursoSQL(oCom, SBO_Application, oForm, docEntry, Vehi2, "2", consulta, strPath);
                                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Asignacion de recursos vehiculo :" + Vehi2 + " la orden de transporte. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            }
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!asignacion1)
                        SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Excepción al guardar disponibilidad o liberar asignacion 1, existen datos nulos", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    if (!asignacion2)
                        SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Excepción al guardar disponibilidad o liberar  asignacion 2, existen datos nulos", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    if (!asignacionfecha)
                        SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Excepción al guardar disponibilidad o liberar, existen datos fechas nulos", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Excepción al guardar disponibilidad o liberar el vehiculo. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "1", oCom, SBO_Application.Company);
            }
            return true;
        }
        #endregion

        #region actualizarDisponibilidad OLD METODO
        public static bool actualizarDisponibilidad_OLD(SAPbobsCOM.Company oCom, SAPbouiCOM.Application SBO_Application, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string strPath, string docEntry)
        {

            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(oCom.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
            try
            {
                string strQry = string.Empty;


                //guardar en caso de que se haya almacenado la información

                string liberar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar", 0).Trim();
                string liberar2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar2", 0).Trim();
                string cancelado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cancelar", 0).Trim();
                string anular = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_anular", 0).Trim();

                //liberar el vehiculo y el conductor
                if (liberar.Equals("Y") || cancelado.Equals("Y") || anular.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "liberarRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", docEntry);
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", "");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", "1");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", "Y");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", "liberarRecurso");
                    oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                }
                else
                {


                    string tipoVehi = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoVehi", 0).Trim();
                    string Vehi = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehiAsig", 0).Trim();
                    string tipoCond = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoCond", 0).Trim();
                    string cond = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_condAsig", 0).Trim();

                    #region segundo vehiculo
                    string tipoVehi2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoVehi2", 0).Trim();
                    string Vehi2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehi2Asig", 0).Trim();
                    string tipoCond2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoCond2", 0).Trim();
                    string cond2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cond2Asig", 0).Trim();
                    #endregion

                    string fechaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                    string horaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                    string fechaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecFinProgra", 0).Trim();
                    string horaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horFinProgra", 0).Trim();
                    string simultaneo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_simultaneo", 0).Trim();


                    #region conductor nro1
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoVehi) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Vehi) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoCond) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cond)
                        && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaIni) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaIni) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaFin) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaFin))
                    {
                        fechaIni = fechaFormato(fechaIni, Convert.ToInt32(horaIni), SBO_Application);
                        fechaFin = fechaFormato(fechaFin, Convert.ToInt32(horaFin), SBO_Application);

                        strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "guardarDispoRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", docEntry);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", cond);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", fechaIni);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", horaIni);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", fechaFin);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", horaFin);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", "1");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", simultaneo.Equals("Y") ? "" : "N");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", "guardarDispoRecurso");
                        oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                        strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "guardarDispoRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", docEntry);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", Vehi);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", fechaIni);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", horaIni);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", fechaFin);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", horaFin);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", "2");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", simultaneo.Equals("Y") ? "" : "N");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", "guardarDispoRecurso");
                        oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                    }
                    #endregion

                    #region conductor 2
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoVehi2) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Vehi2) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoCond2) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cond2)
                       && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaIni) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaIni) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaFin) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaFin))
                    {
                        //fechaIni = fechaFormato(fechaIni, Convert.ToInt32(horaIni), SBO_Application);
                        //fechaFin = fechaFormato(fechaFin, Convert.ToInt32(horaFin), SBO_Application);

                        strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "guardarDispoRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", docEntry);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", cond2);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", fechaIni);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", horaIni);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", fechaFin);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", horaFin);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", "1");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", simultaneo.Equals("Y") ? "" : "N");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", "guardarDispoRecurso");
                        oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                        strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "guardarDispoRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", docEntry);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", Vehi2);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", fechaIni);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", horaIni);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", fechaFin);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", horaFin);
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", "2");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", simultaneo.Equals("Y") ? "" : "N");
                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", "guardarDispoRecurso");
                        oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                    }
                    #endregion

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBO_Application.StatusBar.SetText("Excepción al guardar disponibilidad o liberar el vehiculo. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addinSrvFun", "1", oCom, SBO_Application.Company);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
            return true;

        }

        #region cargar series deacuerdo a una sede
        public static void loadSeriesporDefecto(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string strPath, string Sede)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            string strQry = string.Empty;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSeries").Specific;
            //SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboSede = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Specific;
            while (oCombo.ValidValues.Count > 0)
                oCombo.ValidValues.Remove(0, SAPbouiCOM.BoSearchKey.psk_Index);


            oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            try
            {
                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "serieXSede", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%sede%", Sede);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    oCombo.ValidValues.Add(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString(), oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                    oCombo.Select("0", BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
                }

            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                oCombo.Select(0, BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
            }
            if (oCombo.ValidValues.Count > 0)
                ((EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docNum").Specific).Value = oForm.BusinessObject.GetNextSerialNumber(((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSeries").Specific).Selected.Value, "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").ToString();

        }

        public void loadSeriesOrdenTras(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            ((EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docEntry").Specific).Value = oForm.BusinessObject.GetNextSerialNumber(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("serial").Specific).Value, "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").ToString();
        }

        #region populateComboBox: llenar un combobox con una tabla y una condición
        public static void populateComboBox(ref SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboBox, SAPbobsCOM.Company oCompany, string strTable, string strNameField, string strDescriptionField, string strFieldCond, string strCondition)
        {
            string strQuery = "";
            string tipoServer = string.Empty;
            //tipoServer = tipoMotorBD(oCompany);
            string sql = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)oCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            strQuery = "SELECT \"" + strNameField + "\",\"" + strDescriptionField + "\" FROM \"" + strTable + "\" WHERE \"" + strFieldCond + "\" = '" + strCondition + "'";

            try
            {
                oRecordSet.DoQuery(strQuery);

                oRecordSet.MoveFirst();

                string strCode = "";
                string strName = "";

                while (!oRecordSet.EoF)
                {
                    strCode = oRecordSet.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    strName = oRecordSet.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString();

                    oComboBox.ValidValues.Add(strCode, strName);
                    oRecordSet.MoveNext();
                }
            }
            catch
            {

            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRecordSet);
                }
                catch
                {

                }
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region limpiar combobox
        /// <summary>
        /// Eliminia todos los items de un combobox
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oComboBox"></param>
        public static void LimpiarComboBox(SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboBox)
        {
            do
            {
                oComboBox.ValidValues.Remove(0, SAPbouiCOM.BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
            } while (oComboBox.ValidValues.Count > 0);
        }

        #region adicionar lineas a las matrices y ordenar los numeros
        /// <summary>
        /// Metodo que agrega una nueva fila a la matriz en la ultima posición
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication"></param>
        /// <param name="sapCompany"></param>
        /// <param name="nomtabla"></param>
        /// <param name="matriz"></param>
        public static void Agregar_linea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string nomtabla, string matriz)
        {

            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Item oItem = oForm.Items.Item(matriz);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oItem.Specific;
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla).Clear();
                oMtx.SelectionMode = SAPbouiCOM.BoMatrixSelect.ms_Auto;
                // Añade la línea
                int rowCount = oMtx.RowCount;
                oMtx.AddRow(1, rowCount);

                //Selecciona la fila añadida
                oMtx.SelectRow(1 + rowCount, true, false);

                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.AddLineNew(oForm);
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.AddLineNew(oForm, "mtx0", "@OK1_ASIS_SERVLINEAS");
                NumerarLineas(oForm, sapCompany, nomtabla, matriz);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Borrar_linea", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Numera lineas de una matriz
        /// /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="sapCompany"></param>
        /// <param name="nomtabla"></param>
        /// <param name="matriz"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public static void NumerarLineas(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string nomtabla, string matriz)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;

            try
            {
                //oForm.Freeze(true);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla);

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;

                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                for (int i = 0; i < dslineas.Size; i++)
                {
                    dslineas.SetValue("LineId", i, Convert.ToString(i + 1));
                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "NumerarLineas", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }
        #endregion

        #region eliminar linea de una matriz
        //Codigo para borrar linea
        private static void Borrar_linea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string matriz)
        {
            if (oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_FIND_MODE)
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);

                SAPbouiCOM.Item oItem = oForm.Items.Item(matriz);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oItem.Specific;

                //Obtiene el número de la fila seleccionada
                int selRow = oMtx.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                if (selRow == -1)
                {
                    oForm.Freeze(false);
                    return;
                }

                //Borra la fila seleccionada
                oMtx.DeleteRow(selRow);
                oMtx.FlushToDataSource();
                //Pone el número de la fila en la columna #
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.UpdateNumberColumn(oMtx);

                //if (oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                //    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;

                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Reordena el número de lineas despues de borrar
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="nomtabla"></param>
        /// <param name="matriz"></param>
        public static void NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string nomtabla, string matriz)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla);

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;
                if (oMatrix.RowCount > 0)
                {
                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                    for (int i = 0; i < dslineas.Size; i++)
                    {
                        dslineas.SetValue("LineId", i, Convert.ToString(i + 1));

                    }
                    //dslineas.RemoveRecord(dslineas.Size - 1);
                    oMatrix.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                }
                // Erick: Borra la última línea ya que siempre quedan dos líneas vacias al cargar nuevamente la numeración.
                //oMatrix.DeleteRow(dslineas.Size);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            { throw e; }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static void adicionarLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapComapny, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.MenuEvent pVal)
        {
            if (!pVal.BeforeAction)
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;
                switch (oForm.PaneLevel)
                {
                    case 3:

                        Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapComapny, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                        //oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                        //oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrix.RowCount, 1, true);
                        //oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrix.RowCount, 4, true);
                        //oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrix.RowCount, 5, true);
                        //oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrix.RowCount, 7, true);

                        //cab feb 2019
                        oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;

                        string lineId = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("LineId").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value = lineId;

                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_11", "NO");
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_tipOrd", "OC");

                        //

                        break;
                    case 4:

                        Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapComapny, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM", "mtxComen");
                        oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxComen").Specific;
                        DateTime localDate = DateTime.Now;
                        string fechaActual = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(localDate, sapApplication);
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "fecComen", fechaActual);
                        string user = sapComapny.UserName;
                        string idUser = sapComapny.UserSignature.ToString();
                        SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboBox = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("usuComen").Cells.Item(1).Specific;
                        if (oComboBox.ValidValues.Count <= 0)
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapComapny, sapApplication, oComboBox, "SELECT \"USERID\", \"U_NAME\" FROM \"OUSR\" WHERE \"Locked\" = 'N' ORDER BY \"U_NAME\"");
                        //oComboBox.ValidValues.Add(idUser, user);
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "usuComen", idUser);
                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        #region eliminarLinea coloca menus en el clic derehco
        public static void eliminarLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapComapny, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.MenuEvent pVal)
        {
            if (!pVal.BeforeAction)
            {
                switch (oForm.PaneLevel)
                {
                    case 3:
                        SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;

                        int selRow = oMatrix.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                        Hashtable hTElem = new Hashtable();
                        hTElem.Add(1, true);
                        hTElem.Add(2, false);
                        hTElem.Add(3, true);
                        hTElem.Add(4, false);
                        hTElem.Add(5, false);
                        hTElem.Add(6, true);
                        hTElem.Add(7, true);
                        hTElem.Add(8, true);
                        hTElem.Add(9, false);
                        hTElem.Add(10, false);
                        hTElem.Add(11, true);
                        hTElem.Add(12, false);
                        hTElem.Add(13, false);
                        hTElem.Add(14, false);
                        hTElem.Add(15, true);
                        hTElem.Add(16, false);
                        hTElem.Add(17, true);
                        hTElem.Add(18, false);

                        string nroTras = string.Empty;
                        if (selRow != -1)
                        {

                            string tipoElem = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_TipELM", selRow)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                            if (tipoElem.Equals("P"))
                            {
                                bool otroEle = true;
                                bool tieneDocumento = false;
                                int i = selRow;
                                int cantRow = oMatrix.RowCount;
                                while (otroEle && (i <= cantRow))
                                {
                                    if ((i < cantRow))
                                    {
                                        string tmpTipoElem = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_TipELM", i + 1)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                        if (!tmpTipoElem.Equals("H"))
                                        {
                                            otroEle = false;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    nroTras = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("nroTras", i)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroTras))
                                    {
                                        tieneDocumento = true;
                                    }
                                    i++;
                                }

                                if (!tieneDocumento)
                                {
                                    int j = selRow;
                                    //SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrix.CommonSetting;
                                    //setting.SetRowEditable(selRow, true);                                    
                                    while (j < i)
                                    {
                                        restablecerColumnasEle(oMatrix, selRow, hTElem);
                                        Borrar_linea(oForm, "mtxElemen", selRow);
                                        NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                                        j++;
                                    }

                                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                                    {
                                        oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                nroTras = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("nroTras", selRow)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroTras))
                                {
                                    restablecerColumnasEle(oMatrix, selRow, hTElem);
                                    Borrar_linea(oForm, "mtxElemen");
                                    NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                                    {
                                        oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede eliminar la linea porque tiene asignado un documento de transferencia. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                }
                                //Recorro la matriz para que si es padre bloquear la  matriz
                                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                {
                                    string TipoElem = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_TipELM", i)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                    if (TipoElem.Equals("P"))
                                    {
                                        SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrix.CommonSetting;
                                        setting.SetRowEditable(i, false);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        break;
                    case 4:

                        SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxComen").Specific;

                        //Obtiene el número de la fila seleccionada
                        selRow = omtx.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                        if (selRow != -1)
                        {

                            string user = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").GetValue("U_usuComen", selRow - 1).ToString().Trim();
                            string fecha = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").GetValue("U_fecComen", selRow - 1).ToString().Trim();
                            string comentario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").GetValue("U_comentario", selRow - 1).ToString().Trim();
                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(comentario))
                            {

                                Borrar_linea(oForm, "mtxComen");
                                NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM", "mtxComen");
                                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                                {
                                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                }

                            }
                            else
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede eliminar un comentario.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        }
                        #region old borrar linea comentarios
                        //Borrar_linea(oForm, "mtxComen");
                        //NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM", "mtxComen");
                        //if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                        //{
                        //    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                        //}
                        #endregion

                        break;
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region funciones tipo origen y destino
        /// <summary>
        /// Cargar Información según el Tipo de Traslado
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="tipoTraslado"></param>
        #region tipo Traslado
        public static void CargarInfoTipoTraslado(Form oFormActividad, string tipoTraslado, string dir, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany,SAPbouiCOM.Application SBOApplication, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Item oitm = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

            oFormActividad.Freeze(true);

            #region Inhabilitar Campos
            if (dir.Equals("O") || dir.Equals(""))
            {
                ocultarCamposOrigen(oFormActividad);
            }
            else if (dir.Equals("D") || dir.Equals(""))
            {
                ocultarCamposDestino(oFormActividad);
            }
            #endregion

            #region Consulta Datos Servicio
            string strQuery = "";
            string idSOF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtNroOSF").Specific).Value;
            strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetDatosOrdenServicioOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSolicitud%", string.IsNullOrEmpty(idSOF) ? "0" : idSOF);
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
            #endregion


            if (dir.Equals("O") || dir.Equals(""))
            {
                if (dir.Equals(""))
                {
                    tipoTraslado = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Specific).Value.Trim();
                    oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Enabled = false;
                }

                switch (tipoTraslado)
                {
                    case "AutPatol":
                    case "lugDefun":
                        #region lugar de defuncion
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_OrgCu").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbOrgCu").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_UbOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbUbOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labPaisOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbPaisOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labSedFOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtSedFOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labTelFOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg").Visible = true;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_depOr");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 15;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 15;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_munOr");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 30;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 30;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_dirOrg");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 45;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtDirOrg");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 45;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_depOr").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_munOr").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_dirOrg").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtDirOrg").Visible = true;

                        if (!dir.Equals(""))
                        {
                            #region comentado
                            //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_LugDefunc").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                            //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbOrgCu").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_LugDefunc").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                            //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_UbicLoc").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                            //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbUbOrg").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_UbicLoc").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                            //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_paisFa").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                            //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbPaisOrg").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_paisFa").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                            //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_DptoFa").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                            //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_DptoFa").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                            //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_CiudadFa").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                            //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_CiudadFa").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                            //((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtSedFOrg").Specific).Value = ors.Fields.Item("U_sedBarr").Value.ToString().Trim();
                            //((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtDirOrg").Specific).Value = ors.Fields.Item("U_Ubicacio").Value.ToString().Trim();
                            //((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg").Specific).Value = ors.Fields.Item("U_Telf").Value.ToString().Trim();
                            #endregion
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbOrgCu").Specific;
                            string orgCuerpo = oCombo.Value;
                            if (!orgCuerpo.Equals("CSA"))
                            {
                                oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbUbOrg").Specific;
                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ORIGCUERPO\" WHERE  \"U_origen\" = '" + orgCuerpo + "'ORDER BY \"Name\"");

                            }
                        }
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("15").Click();

                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbOrgCu").Enabled = false;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbUbOrg").Enabled = false;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbPaisOrg").Enabled = false;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtSedFOrg").Enabled = false;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg").Enabled = false;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Enabled = false;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Enabled = false;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtDirOrg").Enabled = false;
                        #endregion
                        break;
                    case "Aereo":
                        #region aereo
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labAeroPuO").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbAeroPuO").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labAeroliO").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbAeroliO").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labservPuO").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtservPuO").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labnumVuOr").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumVuOr").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labhorVuOr").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txthorVuOr").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("labnumGuOr").Visible = true;
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumGuOr").Visible = true;

                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("labservPuO");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("labAeroliO")).Top + 15;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtservPuO");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("labAeroliO")).Top + 15;

                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_depOr");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumGuOr")).Top + 15;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumGuOr")).Top + 15;
                        oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_munOr");
                        oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumGuOr")).Top + 30;
