        /// <summary>
        /// Consulta la información de la funeraria.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="funer"></param>
        /// <param name="dep"></param>
        /// <param name="mun"></param>
        /// <param name="dir"></param>
        public static void consultarDatosFuneraria(string funer, ref string dep, ref string mun, ref string dir, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_dep\",\"U_mun\",\"U_dir\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_FUNERARIAS\" WHERE \"Code\" ='" + funer + "' AND \"U_act\" = 'Y'");
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    dep = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    mun = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    dir = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Consulta los datos del aeropuerto
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="aeroPu"></param>
        /// <param name="dep"></param>
        /// <param name="mun"></param>
        /// <param name="dir"></param>
        /// <param name="servMart"></param>
        public static void consultarDatosAeroPu(string aeroPu, ref string dep, ref string mun, ref string dir, ref string servMart, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_dep\",\"U_mun\",\"U_dir\",\"U_serMarit\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_AEROPUERTOS\" WHERE \"Code\" ='" + aeroPu + "'");
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    dep = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    mun = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    dir = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    servMart = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
        }

        #region otras funciones
        public static string fechaFormato(string fecha, int time, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            string hr, min, hora;
            min = Convert.ToString(time % 100);
            hr = Convert.ToString(time / 100);
            if (hr.Length == 1) hr = "0" + hr;
            if (min.Length == 1) min = "0" + min;
            hora = hr + ":" + min;

            DateTime dtFecha = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsDateTime(fecha, sapApplication);
            return dtFecha.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd") + " " + hora;
        }

        public static string validarCamposObligatorios(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, Hashtable hT)
        {
            string mensaje = string.Empty;
            foreach (string key in hT.Keys)
            {
                string dato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue(key, 0).Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dato))
                    mensaje += hT[key].ToString() + ", ";
            }
            return mensaje;
        }

        public static void bloquearDesbloCampos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, ArrayList aLCampos, bool enabled)
        {
            foreach (string campo in aLCampos)
            {
                try
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item(campo).Enabled = enabled;
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(e);
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Abrir Browser
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="p"></param>
        public static void AbrirBrowser(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string url)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Item oItem = oForm.Items.Add("WebBrowser", SAPbouiCOM.BoFormItemTypes.it_WEB_BROWSER);
            SAPbouiCOM.WebBrowser oWebBrowser = (SAPbouiCOM.WebBrowser)oItem.Specific;
            oItem.Width = oForm.Width - 20;
            oItem.Height = oForm.Height - 30;

            //Open the WebPage 
            oWebBrowser.Url = url;
        }

        #region Retornar nombre del elemento
        public static string Retornar_nombreElemento(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string codeElemento, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "Retornar_nombreElemento", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%Code%", codeElemento.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    nombreElemento = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Retornar_nombreElemento", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return nombreElemento;
        }
        #endregion

        #region verificar si es articulo
        public static bool EsArticulo(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string ItemCode, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string tipo = string.Empty;
            bool existe = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "RetornarTipoArticulo", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", ItemCode.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    tipo = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    if (tipo.Equals("N"))
                        existe = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EsArticulo", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        #region cargar Elemento de la matriz
        public static bool CargarElementosMatrizOrden(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string strpath, int filaActual)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            string elemento = string.Empty;
            string tipodeorden = string.Empty;
            string tipoArticulo = string.Empty;
            string sede = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            bool exito = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_sede", 0).Trim();
                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    almacen = Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);
                }
                else
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" la sede esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "elementosOrdenLaboratorioListaMateriales", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", articulo.Trim());
                oRSElementos.DoQuery(query);

                fila = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;
                //if (fila == 0)
                //  fila = 1;
                // else
                // fila = fila - 1;

                //elemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila).Trim();
                elemento = ((EditText)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_CElem", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                //nombreElemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_Nombre", fila).Trim();
                nombreElemento = ((EditText)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_NElem", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                //tipodeorden = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_tipOrden", fila).Trim();
                //tipoArticulo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila).Trim();
                tipoArticulo = ((ComboBox)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_TipArt", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();


                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    filaActual = fila;
                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {

                        if (fila != filaActual)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                            }
                            catch { }

                            if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))
                            {
                                Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                                // oMatrixElementos.AddRow(1, oMatrixElementos.RowCount);
                                //Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtxElemen", "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_CElem", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_NElem", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "cantidad", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                                // oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipArt", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("tipoArticulo").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Item", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "desc", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "almOri", almacen);
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Prov", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipELM", "H");
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "invent", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                                if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                                {
                                    oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, 17, false);
                                }
                                oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, 1, false);
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Cofre", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("cofre").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipArt", "A");


                                if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("cofre").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                                {
                                    medidasCofre(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, strpath, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString().Trim());
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {

                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "cantidad", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());

                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Item", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "desc", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "almOri", almacen);
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Prov", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipELM", "P");
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "invent", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                            if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, 17, false);
                            }
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "uso", "Y");
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Cofre", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("cofre").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipArt", "A");



                            SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting;
                            setting.SetRowEditable(fila, false);
                        }
                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarElementosMatrizOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return exito;
        }

            string tipoArticulo = string.Empty;

                        {

                        if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))

                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_cantArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_nomArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_descArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, "A");
                            ////oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("WhsCode").Value.ToString());

        #region almacen por sede
        public static string Retornar_AlmacenXSede(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Sede, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "Retornar_AlmacenXSede", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%Sede%", Sede.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    almacen = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Retornar_AlmacenXSede", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return almacen;
        }
        #endregion

        #region llenar datos de traslado destino al seleccionar la solicitud de traslado
        private static void llenarDatosTras(SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string StrPath, string dato, string id, string lugar)
        {
            //RecordSet
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
            try
            {
                string strQry = string.Empty;

                //strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "validarNameBanco", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                //strQry = strQry.Replace("%name%", id.Trim());

                //oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                string select = string.Empty;
                string from = " FROM OCLG WHERE \"ClgCode\" = " + id + "";
                if (lugar.Equals("O"))
                {
                    #region origen
                    select = " SELECT \"U_depOrigen\", \"U_munOrigen\", \"U_direcOrg\" ";
                    switch (dato)
                    {
                        case "AutPatol":
                        case "lugDefun":
                            select += ", \"U_orgCuerpo\", \"U_orgUbicLoc\", \"U_orgPais\", \"U_orgSedBarr\", \"U_orgTelf\" ";
                            strQry = select + from;
                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString()))
                            {
                                //   oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_depDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());

                                ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)(oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Specific)).Select(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());


                            }
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_munOrigen", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_direcOrg", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString());

                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_orgCuerpo", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_orgUbicLoc", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(5).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_orgPais", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(5).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(6).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_orgSedBarr", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(6).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(7).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_orgTelf", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(7).Value.ToString());
                            break;
                        case "Exeq":
                            select += ", \"U_orgSedeExe\", \"U_orgNomSedeExe\", \"U_orgLugExe\" ";
                            strQry = select + from;
                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString()))
                            {
                                //   oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_depDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());                                
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)(oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Specific)).Select(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                            }
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_munOrigen", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_direcOrg", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString());

                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_orgSedeExe", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_orgNomSedeExe", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(5).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_orgLugExe", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(5).Value.ToString());
                            break;
                        case "Velac":
                            select += ", \"U_orgSedeVel\", \"U_orgNomSedeVel\", \"U_orgSalaVel\" ";
                            strQry = select + from;
                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_munDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_direcDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString());

                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_tipoLabDes", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_laboratorioDes", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString());
                            break;
                        case "Otro":
                            select += ", \"U_desSedeFun\", \"U_desNomSede\", \"U_desNomFuner\"";
                            strQry = select + from;
                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString()))
                            {
                                //   oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_depDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)(oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepDes").Specific)).Select(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                            }
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_munDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_direcDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString());

                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_desSedeFun", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_desNomSede", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(5).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_desNomFuner", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(5).Value.ToString());
                            break;
                        default:
                            strQry = select + from;
                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString()))
                            {
                                //   oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_depDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());                                
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)(oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepDes").Specific)).Select(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                            }
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_munDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString()))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_direcDest", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString());
                            break;
                    }
                    #endregion
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error al obtener los datos de origen. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
        }
        #endregion

        public static int retornarIndiceColumn(SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix, string columna)
        {
            Columns columns = (Columns)oMatrix.Columns;
            int indexFound = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < columns.Count; j++)
            {
                string dato = columns.Item(j).UniqueID;
                if (columns.Item(j).UniqueID == columna)
                {
                    indexFound = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            return indexFound;
        }

        private static void medidasCofre(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string strPath, string Articulo)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
            try
            {

                string strQry = string.Empty;

                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "volumenCofre", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%itemcode%", Articulo);

                oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                string vol = oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(vol))
                {
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_medCofre", 0, vol);

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error al actualizar la solicitud de traslado" + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addinSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
        }

        private static void restablecerColumnasEle(SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix, int fila, Hashtable hT)
        {
            foreach (int item in hT.Keys)
                oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, item, Convert.ToBoolean(hT[item]));
        }

        private static void ordenCancelada(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string StrPath, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)

                try

                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)

                        string estado = oRS.Fields.Item("U_estOT").Value.ToString();

                        Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ANE", "mtxAnexo");

                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_nomAnex").Value.ToString())) oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "nomAnex", oRS.Fields.Item("U_nomAnex").Value.ToString());
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_rutaAnex").Value.ToString())) oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "rutaAnex", oRS.Fields.Item("U_rutaAnex").Value.ToString());
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_fecAnex").Value.ToString()))
                        {
                            DateTime localDate = Convert.ToDateTime(oRS.Fields.Item("U_fecAnex").Value.ToString());
                            //string fechaActual = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(localDate, sapApplication);
                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "fecAnex", localDate.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy"));

                        }
                        oRS.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }

                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Excepción al ingresar los datos a la matriz. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                }
                finally
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                }

            }
        }

        public static void NumerarLineas(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string nomtabla, string matriz, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla);

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                for (int i = 0; i < dslineas.Size; i++)
                {
                    dslineas.SetValue("LineId", i, Convert.ToString(i + 1));
                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "NumerarLineas", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static void Agregar_lineaMatriz(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string matrix, string DBdatsource)
        {
            try
            {
                Item oItem = oForm.Items.Item(matrix);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matrix).Specific;
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(DBdatsource).Clear();

                // Añade la línea
                int rowCount = oMtx.RowCount;
                oMtx.AddRow(1, rowCount);

                //Selecciona la fila añadida
                oMtx.SelectRow(1 + rowCount, true, false);
                NumerarLineas(oForm, DBdatsource, matrix, sapCompany);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Agregar_lineaMatriz", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        public static bool ExisteSalidaMercancia(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string docEntrysolicitudServicio, string lineID, string itemCode, ref string DocNumSalidaMercancia)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool existe = false;
            string strQuery = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = strQuery + " SELECT T0.\"DocNum\" as \"DocNum\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " FROM \"OIGE\" T0 " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " INNER JOIN \"IGE1\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" = T1.\"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " WHERE T0.\"U_OK1_SF_NSOL\" = '" + docEntrysolicitudServicio + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T1.\"U_linea\" ='" + lineID + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T1.\"ItemCode\" ='" + itemCode + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T0.\"DocEntry\" NOT IN " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " ( " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " SELECT  T0.\"U_OK1_SF_EntrySM\" as \"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " FROM \"OIGN\" T0 INNER JOIN \"IGN1\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" =  T1.\"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " WHERE  T0.\"U_OK1_SF_NSOL\" = '" + docEntrysolicitudServicio + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   T1.\"U_linea\" ='" + lineID + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   T1.\"ItemCode\" ='" + itemCode + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   IFNULL(T0.\"U_OK1_SF_EntrySM\",'') <> '')";
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    DocNumSalidaMercancia = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteSalidaMercancia", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static bool elemPermiteGenerarDoc(string idElem, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, string StrPath)
        {
            bool permite = true;
            string strQuery = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

            try
            {
                ors = (Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetPermisoElemento", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idElemento%", idElem);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_destFinal").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_traslado").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_laboratorio").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                        permite = false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw e;
            }
            finally
            { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors); }


            return permite;
        }

        public static string RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntry, int indice)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string LineId = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT \"LineId\" FROM (select  \"LineId\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "'" + " ORDER BY \"LineId\"  LIMIT " + indice.ToString().Trim() + ") ";
                query = query + " ORDER BY \"LineId\" DESC LIMIT 1 ";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    LineId = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return LineId;
        }

        public static string validarCantidadesFila(SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, Form oForm, int Fila, string strPath, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            string mensaje = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            string docEntry = "";


            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
            docEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0);

            try
            {

                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                string itemCode = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_nomArt", Fila).Trim();
                //string itemName = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_ItemName", Fila).Trim();
                string itemName = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_descArt", Fila).Trim();

                string almacen = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_almacenOri", Fila).Trim();
                double disponible = Convert.ToDouble(calcularCantidadDisponible(oForm, itemCode, almacen, strPath, sapApplication, SapCompany));

                // se valida que no existe una salida de mercancia
                string NroDocumentoSM = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_Documento", Fila).Trim();
                if (NroDocumentoSM.Equals(""))
                {
                    if (oItem.GetByKey(itemCode))
                    {
                        if (oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES)
                        {
                            double cantidad = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SapCompany, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_cantArt", Fila));
                            string InventoryNumber = oItem.InventoryNumber.ToString();
                            if (!oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_nomArt", Fila).Trim().Equals("") && (cantidad > disponible))
                            {
                                mensaje = " La cantidad a pedir supera a la cantidad disponible del articulo: " + ".\n";
                                mensaje = mensaje + itemName + ". \n";
                                mensaje = mensaje + " Disponible :  " + Convert.ToString(disponible) + "  en el almacen: " + almacen + ".\n";
                                mensaje = mensaje + ServicioFunerario.MensajeArticulosComprometidos(SapCompany, itemCode, strPath, itemName, docEntry, almacen);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    mensaje = "Ya existe la salida de mercancia  Nro " + NroDocumentoSM;
                }


            }
            catch { }
            finally { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oItem); }
            return mensaje;
        }

        public static int RetornarCantidadDisponible(string ItemCode, string almacen, string docEntry, string strPath, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany)
        {
            int cantidad = 0;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            StringBuilder Query = new StringBuilder();
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            string strQuery = "";

            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                if (oItem.GetByKey(ItemCode))
                {
                    if (oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES)
                    {
                        oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                        strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ArticulosDisponiblesOrdenTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%itemCode%", ItemCode);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docEntry%", docEntry);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%almacen%", almacen);
                        oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                        if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                        {
                            cantidad =  Convert.ToInt32(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                            if (cantidad < 0)
                                cantidad = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarCantidadDisponible", SapCompany);
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrió una excepción en On RetornarCantidadDisponible. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oItem);
            }
            return cantidad;
        }

        public static string calcularCantidadDisponible(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string itemCode, string almacen, string strPath, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany)
        {
            string docEntry = "0";
            int cantidad = 0;
            docEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0);
            if (docEntry.Equals(""))
                docEntry = "0";
            if (!itemCode.Equals("") && !almacen.Equals("") && !docEntry.Equals(""))
                cantidad = RetornarCantidadDisponible(itemCode, almacen, docEntry, strPath, sapApplication, SapCompany);
            return cantidad.ToString();
        }

        public static bool existen_ArticulosNoSeleccionadoBasicos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref bool lineasSinArticulo, ref   bool LineaSeleccionadaNoInventariable, ref int linea)
        {
            bool encontradoError = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string tipolinea = "";
            string itemcode = "";
            bool seleccionada = false;

            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {

                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                    if (seleccionada)
                    {
                        itemcode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_nomArt", indice).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemcode))
                        {
                            oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("C_Item").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                            if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                            {
                                encontradoError = true;
                                LineaSeleccionadaNoInventariable = true;
                                salir = true;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            encontradoError = true;
                            lineasSinArticulo = true;
                            salir = true;
                        }
                    }

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_ArticulosNoSeleccionadoBasicos", ocmp);
            }
            return encontradoError;
        }

        public static void inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos_old(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string SalidaMercancia = "";
            string Uso = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = omtx.CommonSetting;
                while (indice < tope)
                {

                    SalidaMercancia = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", indice).Trim();
                    Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_usoArt", indice).Trim();

                    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    if (!SalidaMercancia.Equals("") && Uso.Equals("Y"))
                    {

                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 6, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 7, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 15, false);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 6, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 7, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 15, true);
                    }

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch { oForm.Freeze(false); }
            finally { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static void inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string SalidaMercancia = string.Empty;
            string Uso = string.Empty;
            string nroTras = string.Empty;
            string ordencompra = string.Empty;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = omtx.CommonSetting;

                omtx.Columns.Item("C_Prov").Editable = true;  // proveedor
                omtx.Columns.Item("col_VlCom").Editable = false;  // valor compra

                omtx.Columns.Item("C_NElem").Editable = false;
                omtx.Columns.Item("col_tipOrd").Editable = true;
                omtx.Columns.Item("cantidad").Editable = false; //cantidad
                omtx.Columns.Item("desc").Editable = false;  // descripcion articulo
                omtx.Columns.Item("C_TipArt").Editable = false; // tipo de articulo
                omtx.Columns.Item("C_TipELM").Editable = false; // tipo de lista
                omtx.Columns.Item("desiste").Editable = false; // tipo de lista
                omtx.Columns.Item("nroTras").Editable = false;  // numero traslado

                omtx.Columns.Item("invent").Editable = false;
                omtx.Columns.Item("col_11").Editable = false;


                while (indice < tope)
                {
                    //cab feb 2019
                    SalidaMercancia = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", indice).Trim();
                    Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_usoArt", indice).Trim();
                    nroTras = oDBS1.GetValue("U_nroTrasArt", indice).Trim();
                    ordencompra = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docOrd", indice).Trim();
                    string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).ToString().Trim();

                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, true);  // codigo elemento
                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, true);  //tipo orden
                    // omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 4, true);  // articulo
                    // omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, true);  // articulo
                    // omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 6, true); // cantidad
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 7, true); // valor compra
                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, true); // almacen origen
                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 9, true);// almacen destino
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, true); // tipo articulo
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, true); // tipo lista materiales

                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 12, true); // proveedor
                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 13, true); // serie
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 14, true); // desiste
                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 17, true); // cantidad usada


                    if (!SalidaMercancia.Equals(string.Empty) || !nroTras.Equals(string.Empty))
                    {


                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);  // codigo elemento
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, false);  // ARTICULO elemento
                        //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, false);  // 
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false); // almacen origen
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 9, false);// almacen destino
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 13, false); // serie
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 17, false); // cantidad usada

                        if (!ordencompra.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, false);  // 
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 12, false); // proveedor

                        }

                    }
                    else
                        if (!ordencompra.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {

                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);  // codigo elemento
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, false);  //ARTICULO

                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, false);  // 

                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, false); // tipo articulo
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, false); // tipo lista materiales
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 12, false); // proveedor
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 13, false); // serie


                            if (!SalidaMercancia.Equals(string.Empty) || !nroTras.Equals(string.Empty))
                            {
                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false); // almacen origen
                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 9, false);// almacen destino
                            }

                        }
                        else
                            if (Uso.Equals("Y"))
                            {

                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);  // codigo elemento
                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, false);  //tipo orden
                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 6, false); // cantidad

                            }
                    if (estado.Equals("Cancelado") || estado.Equals("Anulado") || estado.Equals("Cerrado"))
                        setting.SetRowEditable(indice, false);


                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch { oForm.Freeze(false); }
            finally { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static bool existen_PrenecesidadesLineaLineaSeleccionada(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string NroContratoPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            bool seleccionada = false;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !existe)
                {
                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                    if (seleccionada)
                    {
                        NroContratoPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", indice).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NroContratoPrenecesidad))
                            existe = true;
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_PrenecesidadesLineaLineaSeleccionada", ocmp);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static bool ValidarCantidades_ElementosCedidosSFMatrizLineaSeleccionada(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, ref string mensaje, string mystrPath)
        {
            bool ErrorValidarCantidad = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string NroContratoPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            string lineaPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            string elemento = string.Empty;
            string itemcode = string.Empty;
            string Facturada = string.Empty;
            string DocEntrySF = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            bool PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad = false;
            bool seleccionada = false;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication);
            double cantidadDisponible = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            double cantidadLinea = 0;

            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                DocEntrySF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docEntry").Specific).Value.ToString();
                while (indice < tope)
                {

                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                    if (seleccionada)
                    {
                        oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("C_Item").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                        if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES))
                        {
                            string Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_usoArt", indice).Trim();
                            if (!Uso.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                bool eshijo = false;
                                string TipoLinea = string.Empty;
                                TipoLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                                eshijo = TipoLinea.Equals("H") || TipoLinea.Equals("C");

                                if (!eshijo)
                                {
                                    NroContratoPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", indice).Trim();
                                    Facturada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_LPagadaPrenec", indice).Trim();
                                    lineaPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLineaPF", indice).Trim();
                                    elemento = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Codigo", indice).Trim();
                                    cantidadLinea = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(sapCompany, oDBS1.GetValue("U_cantArt", indice));

                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NroContratoPrenecesidad) && ((Facturada.Equals("N") || Facturada.Equals("")) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineaPrenecesidad)))
                                    {
                                        cantidadDisponible = 0;
                                        PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad = serfun.PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad(sapCompany, mystrPath, lineaPrenecesidad, NroContratoPrenecesidad, elemento, ref cantidadDisponible);
                                        if (cantidadLinea > cantidadDisponible)
                                        {
                                            mensaje = " La cantidad supera a la cantidad disponible del elemento: " + ".\n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + elemento + ". \n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + " Disponible :  " + Convert.ToString(cantidadDisponible) + "  en prenecesidad: " + NroContratoPrenecesidad + ".\n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + ServicioFunerario.MensajeElementosComprometidosCedidosSF(sapCompany, elemento, mystrPath, NroContratoPrenecesidad, DocEntrySF);
                                            ErrorValidarCantidad = true;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ValidarCantidades_ElementosCedidosSFMatriz", sapCompany);
            }
            return ErrorValidarCantidad;
        }

        public static bool existePermisoUsuarioSede(SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, string Strpath, string sSede, string sUsuario)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool existe = false;
            string strQuery = "";
            try
            {

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                if (!sSede.Equals(""))
                {
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(Strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ExistePermisoUsuarioSede", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSede%", sSede);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idUsuario%", sUsuario);
                    ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }

            return existe;
        }

        public static void CamposUsuario(SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, int usuario, ref string almacen, ref string codMun, ref string nomMun, ref string sucursal, ref string nomSucursal)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            almacen = "";
            codMun = "";
            nomMun = "";
            sucursal = "";
            nomSucursal = "";

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_almacen\", \"U_Municipio\", (SELECT \"U_Municip\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_MUN\" WHERE \"U_codMun\" = \"U_Municipio\") AS \"Nombre Municipio\", \"Branch\" AS \"Sucursal\",(SELECT \"Name\" FROM OUBR WHERE \"Code\" = \"Branch\") AS \"Nombre Sucursal\"  FROM OUSR WHERE \"USERID\" = " + usuario + "");

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    almacen = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    codMun = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    nomMun = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    sucursal = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    nomSucursal = ors.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Campos Usuario", SapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
        }

        public static string getSerieDocumento(SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, string strPath, string idSede, string campo)
        {
            string strQuery = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string idSerie = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "LoadSeriesporDoc", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSede%", idSede);
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%campo%", campo);

                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    idSerie = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw e;
            }
            finally
            { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors); }

        public static double ConsultarCostoArticuloSalida(SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, string docSalida, string itemCode)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            double costo = 0;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT \"StockPrice\" FROM IGE1 WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + docSalida + " AND \"ItemCode\" = '" + itemCode + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    costo = Convert.ToDouble(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim());
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ConsultarCostoArticuloSalida", SapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return costo;
        }

                query = query.Replace("%NroPrenecesidad%", NoPrecenecidad);

        public static bool CederElementosPrenecesidad(string strpath, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string NoOP, string linea, string NoPrecenecidad, string elemento, string articulo, string cant, string DocEntrySF)
        {
            bool error = false;
            bool ErrordescontarCantidadPrenecesidad = false;
            bool ErrorMarcarUsoElemento = false;

            try
            {
                ErrordescontarCantidadPrenecesidad = DescontarElementodisponiblePrenecesidad(ocmp, linea, NoPrecenecidad, elemento, strpath, DocEntrySF, Convert.ToInt32(cant));
                if (ErrordescontarCantidadPrenecesidad)
                    error = true;

                ErrorMarcarUsoElemento = MarcarUsoElementoInPrenecesidad(ocmp, linea, NoPrecenecidad, elemento, strpath);
                if (ErrorMarcarUsoElemento)
                    error = true;

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                error = true;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CederElementosPrenecesidad", ocmp);
            }

            return error;
        }

        public static string RetornarMaxLineIdPrenec(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntry)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string LineId = "";
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                if (!DocEntry.Equals(string.Empty))
                {

                    query = "SELECT MAX(\"LineId\") +1 FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "'";
                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        LineId = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    }
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarMaxLineIdPrenec", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return LineId;
        }

                string fecha = System.DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd");

                query = "INSERT INTO \"@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST\"  VALUES(" + NoPrenecesidad + "," + lineid + "," + lineid + ",'OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST',0,'" + UDO + "'," + NoOP + ",'" + fecha + "'," + ocmp.UserSignature + ",'" + elemento + "','" + articulo + "',1);";

                ors.DoQuery(query);

            }
            catch (Exception e)

                error = true;

        public static bool cancelarSalidaInventario(SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string StrPath, Form oForm, int fila, string entrySalidaMercancia)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
            SAPbobsCOM.Documents salidaInv = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Documents entradaInv = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;
            string docEntrysolicitudServicio = "";
            string lineID = "";
            bool error = false;
            int LineaDocumento = 0;

            try
            {

                if ((fila >= 0) && (fila <= oMatrix.RowCount))
                {
                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                    string docSalida = oDBS.GetValue("U_Documento", fila - 1).Trim();
                    string docEntry = oDBS.GetValue("docEntry", fila - 1).Trim();
                    string articulo = oDBS.GetValue("U_nomArt", fila - 1).Trim();
                    oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                    if (!docSalida.Equals(""))
                    {
                        salidaInv = (SAPbobsCOM.Documents)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oInventoryGenExit);
                        entradaInv = (SAPbobsCOM.Documents)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oInventoryGenEntry);

                        salidaInv.GetByKey(int.Parse(docSalida));

                        entradaInv.DocDate = DateTime.Now;
                        entradaInv.TaxDate = DateTime.Now;
                        entradaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value = salidaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value;
                        entradaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_idFallec").Value = salidaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_idFallec").Value;
                        entradaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_NomFallec").Value = salidaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_NomFallec").Value;
                        entradaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_mun").Value = salidaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_mun").Value;
                        entradaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_sucur").Value = salidaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_sucur").Value;
                        entradaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_EntrySM").Value = docSalida;
                        docEntrysolicitudServicio = salidaInv.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value.ToString().Trim();

                        for (int i = 0; i < salidaInv.Lines.Count; i++)
                        {
                            //existeEntradaMercancia = ExisteEntradaMercancia(SBOCompany, docEntrysolicitudServicio, lineID, itemCode, entrySalidaMercancia);
                            //if (!existeEntradaMercancia)
                            //{
                            salidaInv.Lines.SetCurrentLine(i);
                            //if (salidaInv.Lines.ItemCode.Equals(articulo))
                            //{
                            lineID = salidaInv.Lines.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_linea").Value.ToString().Trim();

                            try
                            {
                                LineaDocumento = Convert.ToInt32(lineID);
                            }
                            catch { LineaDocumento = -1; }
                               

                            entradaInv.Lines.ItemCode = salidaInv.Lines.ItemCode;
                            entradaInv.Lines.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_linea").Value = lineID;
                            entradaInv.Lines.ItemDescription = salidaInv.Lines.ItemDescription;
                            entradaInv.Lines.Quantity = salidaInv.Lines.Quantity;
                            entradaInv.Lines.WarehouseCode = salidaInv.Lines.WarehouseCode;
                            entradaInv.Lines.UnitPrice = ConsultarCostoArticuloSalida(SapCompany, docSalida, salidaInv.Lines.ItemCode);
                            entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode = salidaInv.Lines.CostingCode;
                            entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode2 = salidaInv.Lines.CostingCode2;
                            entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode3 = salidaInv.Lines.CostingCode3;
                            entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode4 = salidaInv.Lines.CostingCode4;
                            entradaInv.Lines.Add();

                            //}
                            //}
                        }

                        // retornar el DocNum de la salida que esta cancelando par que el usuario tenga la trazabilidad de los documentos
                        string DocNum = "";
                        if (!docSalida.Equals(""))
                            DocNum = ServicioFunerario.RetornarDocNumSalidaMercancia(SapCompany, docSalida);
                        if (!DocNum.Equals(""))
                            entradaInv.Comments = "Cancelación de la salida de mercancía N°: " + DocNum + "";
                        else
                            entradaInv.Comments = "Cancelación de la salida de mercancía N°: " + docSalida + "";


                        if (entradaInv.Add() != 0)
                        {
                            sapApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la salida de mercancía. Error: " + SapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "OK", "", "");
                            error = true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            sapApplication.MessageBox("Se ha cancelado la salida de mercancía. N°: " + DocNum, 1, "OK", "", "");
                            for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                            {
                                if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_7").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value.Equals(docSalida))
                                {
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Documento", i - 1, "");
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_DescDoc", i - 1, "");
                                }
                            }
                            oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();

                            oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                            oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                        }

                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC030", SapCompany);

            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
            return error;

        }
