        public static void AgregarFechaHoraRecibeCuerpo(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string strpath)
        {
            /* Formatear la fechaHora Actual */
            DateTime Hoy = DateTime.Today;
            DateTime HoraIni = DateTime.Now;
            string FechaRecepcionCuerpo = string.Empty;
            string HoraRecepcionCuerpo = string.Empty;
            string Nro_ControlRecepcionCuerpo = string.Empty;
            string laboratorio = string.Empty;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                FechaRecepcionCuerpo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_fecReceCue", 0).ToString().Trim();
                HoraRecepcionCuerpo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_horReceCuer", 0).ToString().Trim();
                laboratorio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_NombreLaboratorio", 0).ToString().Trim();

                if (FechaRecepcionCuerpo.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    FechaRecepcionCuerpo = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Hoy, sapApplication);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_fecReceCue", 0, FechaRecepcionCuerpo);
                }
                if (HoraRecepcionCuerpo.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    HoraRecepcionCuerpo = HoraIni.ToString("HHmm");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_horReceCuer", 0, HoraRecepcionCuerpo);
                }

                if (!FechaRecepcionCuerpo.Equals(string.Empty) && !HoraRecepcionCuerpo.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    Nro_ControlRecepcionCuerpo = Retornar_Nro_ControlRecepcionCuerpo(sapCompany, sapApplication, FechaRecepcionCuerpo, laboratorio, strpath);
                    if (!Nro_ControlRecepcionCuerpo.Equals(string.Empty))
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_numContrReceCue", 0, Nro_ControlRecepcionCuerpo);

                    //((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Ed_Val").Specific).Active = true;
                    //OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ENReCup", false);
                    //OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EFecRC", false);
                    //OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EHorRC", false);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "AgregarFechaHoraRecibeCuerpo", sapCompany);
            }
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static string RetornarUltimoTanatologoLineasOrdenLaboratorio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string tanatologo = string.Empty;
            bool existe = false;
            bool Salir = false;
            int indice = 1;
            try
            {
                if (oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                {
                    oForm.Freeze(true);
                    string DocEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString().Trim();
                    //if (!DocEntry.Equals(string.Empty))
                    //{
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "Retornar_Ultimo_Tanatologo", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    query = query.Replace("%DocEntry%", DocEntry.Trim());
                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        tanatologo = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_3").Specific;
                    oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_TANATOPRALAB");
                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

                    while (indice < oMatrix.RowCount && !Salir)
                    {
                        tanatologo = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Tanatologo", indice);
                        if (!tanatologo.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            Salir = true;
                        }
                        indice++;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarUltimoTanatologoLineasOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                }
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
            return tanatologo;
        }

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_HomenajeEspecial", 0, U_HomenajeEspecial);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_Tanatopraxia", 0, U_Tanatopraxia);

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_TipoLaboratorio", 0, U_TipoLaboratorio);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_NombreLaboratorio", 0, U_NombreLaboratorio);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_DeptoLaboratorio", 0, U_DeptoLaboratorio);

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_DeptoLaboratorio", 0, NroControlCuerpo);

                    {
                        try
                        {
                            string serie = Retornar_SerieXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, U_sedeSol, strpath);

                            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("92").Specific;
                            oCombo.Select(serie, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                        }
                        catch (Exception e) { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Retornar_InfoOrdenLaboratorioAnterior", sapCompany); }
                    }

                    #region cargar los elementos del servicio del servicio funerario a orden laboratorio
                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                    {
                        Retornar_ElementosOrdenLaboratorio_From_SF(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication, U_numSolSF, strpath, ref mensaje);
                        if (!U_numSolSF.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {
                            string OrdenLaboratorio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString().Trim();

                            //{
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("limpiando elementos de orden de servicio anterior", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                            errorRetornar = Retornar_ElementosOrdenLaboratorio_From_SF(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication, U_numSolSF, strpath, ref mensaje);
                            if (errorRetornar)
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" Debe validar información:  " + mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                mensaje = " Debe validar información:  " + mensaje + " " + mensaje;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" Finaliza Proceso cargue elementos", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                exito = true;
                            }
                            //}
                        }
                    }
                    #endregion
                    if (!exito)
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Se encontaron algunos errores durante el cargue de los elemengtos, Debe validar información:  " + mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    //exito = true;
                }
                else { mensaje = "no se encontro información de esta orden de laboratorio, es posible que ya se ha usuado en ona orden de laboratorio."; }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Retornar_InfoOrdenLaboratorioAnterior", sapCompany);
                mensaje = e.Message;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static bool Retornar_InfoSolicitudLaboratorio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string strpath, ref string mensaje)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = null;
            string query = "";
            string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            bool exito = false;
            try
            {
                string NumSolicitudLab = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_solicLab", 0).ToString().Trim();

                    ors.DoQuery(query);

                    }
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_DirDestino", 0, dirVel);


                    #region  series x sede
                    string sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedeSol", 0).ToString().Trim();
                    if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                    {
                        try

                    }
                    #endregion

                    #region agrega comentarios lineas

                    string DocEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString().Trim();
                    string SolicitudLaboratorio_old = Retornar_solicitudLaboratorioDB(sapCompany, DocEntry, strpath);
                    string SolicitudLaboratorio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("ENSolLab").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    if (!SolicitudLaboratorio.Equals(SolicitudLaboratorio_old))
                    {
                        if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                        {
                            bool Exito = BorrarMatrizComentarios(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication);
                        }
                        Agregar_lineaMatriz(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtx_4", "@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB");
                        SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_4").Specific;
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").Clear();

                        oMtx.FlushToDataSource();
                        string USERCODE = Retornar_USER_CODE_From_USER(sapCompany, AssignedBy, strpath);
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(USERCODE))
                        {
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").SetValue("U_usuer", oMtx.RowCount - 1, USERCODE);
                        }
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").SetValue("U_fecha", oMtx.RowCount - 1, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(DateTime.Now, sapApplication));
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").SetValue("U_hora", oMtx.RowCount - 1, DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm"));
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").SetValue("U_coment", oMtx.RowCount - 1, Comentario);
                        oMtx.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                    }
                    else
                    {

                        Agregar_lineaMatriz(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtx_4", "@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB");
                        SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_4").Specific;
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").Clear();
                        oMtx.FlushToDataSource();
                        string USERCODE = Retornar_USER_CODE_From_USER(sapCompany, AttendUser, strpath);
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(USERCODE))
                        {
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").SetValue("U_usuer", oMtx.RowCount - 1, USERCODE);
                        }
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").SetValue("U_fecha", oMtx.RowCount - 1, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(DateTime.Now, sapApplication));
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").SetValue("U_hora", oMtx.RowCount - 1, DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm"));
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_HISTORPLANLB").SetValue("U_coment", oMtx.RowCount - 1, Comentario);
                        oMtx.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                    }


                    #endregion

                    #region cargar los elementos del servicio del servicio funerario a orden laboratorio
                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                    {

                        if (!NumeroIntSF.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {
                            string OrdenLaboratorio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString().Trim();
                            bool error = BorrarElementosDefectoMatrizFrom_SF(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication);

                            error = Retornar_ElementosOrdenLaboratorio_From_SF(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication, NumeroIntSF, strpath, ref mensaje);
                            if (!error)
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Finaliza Proceso cargue elementos", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                exito = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    #endregion
                    #endregion


                    #region CARGAR Y SETEAR EL COMBO AsuntoSolicitud
                    string AsuntoSolicitud = ors.Fields.Item("CntctSbjct").Value.ToString().Trim();
                    try
                    {

                        SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboA = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("CAsunto").Specific;
                        string code = AsuntoSolicitud;
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oComboA);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oComboA, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"OCLS\" ");
                        oComboA.Select(code, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_AsuntoSol", 0, AsuntoSolicitud);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").SetValue("U_AsuntoSol", 0, AsuntoSolicitud);
                    }
                    #endregion
                    exito = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("ENSolLab").Specific).Value = string.Empty;
                    mensaje = "La solicitud ingresada con Nro. " + NumSolicitudLab + " No encontro  en la base de datos";
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    exito = true;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Retornar_InfoSolicitudLaboratorio", sapCompany);
                mensaje = e.Message;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return exito;
        }

            int LineId = 0;
            string U_objeto = string.Empty;
            string U_IdOrden = string.Empty;
            string U_IdUsuario = string.Empty;
            string U_Codigo = string.Empty;
            string U_ItemCode = string.Empty;
            string U_fecRegisto = string.Empty;
            string horaIni_Actual = string.Empty;
            string NroSF = string.Empty;
            string NroOL = string.Empty;
            DateTime Hoy = DateTime.Today;
            DateTime HoraIni = DateTime.Now;
            double cant = 0;

            try
            {
                // usuario Actual
                U_IdUsuario = sapCompany.UserName.Trim();

                /* Formatear la fechaHora Actual */
                horaIni_Actual = HoraIni.ToString("HHmm");

                NroSF = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_numSolSF", 0).Trim();
                NroOL = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim();

                DocEntry = RetornarDocEntryTabla(sapCompany, "OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST");
                LineId = RetornarLineIdTabla(sapCompany, Convert.ToString(DocEntry), "@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST", strpath);
                U_objeto = "OK1_SF_ORDENLAB";
                U_IdOrden = NroOL;
                string IdUsuario = DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USERID", "USER_CODE", U_IdUsuario, sapCompany);
                U_Codigo = Codigoelemento;
                U_ItemCode = Itemcode;
                U_fecRegisto = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Hoy, sapApplication);
                cant = cantidad;

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "Insertar_Registro_OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%DocEntry%", Convert.ToString(DocEntry));
                query = query.Replace("%LineId%", Convert.ToString(LineId));
                query = query.Replace("%U_objeto%", U_objeto);
                query = query.Replace("%U_IdOrden%", U_IdOrden);
                query = query.Replace("%U_fecRegisto%", U_fecRegisto);
                query = query.Replace("%U_IdUsuario%", IdUsuario);
                query = query.Replace("%U_Codigo%", U_Codigo);
                query = query.Replace("%U_ItemCode%", U_ItemCode);
                query = query.Replace("%U_Cant%", OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(sapCompany, cant, false, "", 2));
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                exito = true;

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Insertar_Registro_OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static bool BorrarElementosDefectoMatrizFrom_SF(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            bool error = false;
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;

                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                if (oMatrixElementos.RowCount > 0)
                {
                    //sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" se van a cargar los elementos del servicio funerario eleccionada a la orden de laboratorio, por tanto se limpia la matrix de elementos ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    //sapApplication.MessageBox("se van a cargar los elementos del servicio funerario eleccionada a la orden de laboratorio, por tanto se limpia la matrix de elementos");
                    oMatrixElementos.Clear();
                    // if (sapApplication.MessageBox("Se cumplen todas la condiciones para cerrar la orden de laboratorio. Esta seguro que desea Cerrar ", 2, "Si", "No", "") == 1)
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "BorrarElementosDefectoMatrizFrom_SF", sapCompany);
                error = true;
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
            return error;
        }

        public static string Retornar_AlmacenXUsuario(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Usuario, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "Retornar_SedeXUsuario", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%User%", Usuario.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    almacen = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Retornar_SedeXUsuario", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return almacen;
        }

        public static bool EsArticulo(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string ItemCode, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string tipo = string.Empty;
            bool existe = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarTipoArticulo", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", ItemCode.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    tipo = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    if (tipo.Equals("N"))
                        existe = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EsArticulo", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static bool CargarElementosMatrizOrdenLaboratorio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string strpath, int filaActual)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            string elemento = string.Empty;
            string tipodeorden = string.Empty;
            string tipoArticulo = string.Empty;
            string sede = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            bool exito = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;

            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");
                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedeSol", 0).Trim();
                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    almacen = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LABORATORIOS", "U_Almacen", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedReciCuer", 0).Trim(), sapCompany);//Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);
                }
                else
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" la sede esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "elementosOrdenLaboratorioListaMateriales", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", articulo.Trim());
                oRSElementos.DoQuery(query);

                fila = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;
                if (fila == 1)
                    fila = 0;
                else
                    fila = fila - 1;

                elemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila).Trim();
                nombreElemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_Nombre", fila).Trim();
                tipodeorden = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_tipOrden", fila).Trim();
                tipoArticulo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila).Trim();


                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                {

                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {

                        if (fila != filaActual)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                            }
                            catch { }

                            if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))
                            {

                                // oMatrixElementos.AddRow(1, oMatrixElementos.RowCount);
                                Agregar_lineaMatrix(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtx_0", "@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_tipOrden", fila, tipodeorden);

                                //if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE || oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE)
                                //{
                                //    string serfun = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_NroSF", fila);
                                //    string linea = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_ID_Linea", fila);
                                //    string ItemCode = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_ItemCode", fila);
                                //    double cantidad = 0;

                                //    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(serfun))
                                //        cantidad = RetornarCantidadArticuloServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication, ItemCode, serfun, strpath);
                                //    else
                                //        cantidad = RetornarCantidadArticuloHijoListaMateriales(sapCompany, sapApplication, ItemCode, strpath);
                                //    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, Convert.ToString(cantidad));
                                //    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, Convert.ToString(cantidad));
                                //}

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                                string esCofre = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_ELEPROTECC", "U_cofre", "Code", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString(), sapCompany);
                                if (esCofre.Equals("Y"))
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, "1");
                                else
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, tipoArticulo);
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                                //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("WhsCode").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, almacen);
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), strpath).ToString());

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "H");

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_LineaAdicional", fila, "Y");
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());

                            //if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE || oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE)
                            //{
                            //    string serfun = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_NroSF", fila);
                            //    string linea = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_ID_Linea", fila);
                            //    string ItemCode = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_ItemCode", fila);
                            //    double cantidad = 0;

                            //    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(serfun))
                            //        cantidad = RetornarCantidadArticuloServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication, ItemCode, serfun, strpath);
                            //    else
                            //        cantidad = RetornarCantidadArticuloPadreListaMateriales(sapCompany, sapApplication, ItemCode, strpath);
                            //    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, Convert.ToString(cantidad));
                            //    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, Convert.ToString(cantidad));
                            //}
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                            // oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, tipoArticulo);
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, almacen);
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), strpath).ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "P");

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_LineaAdicional", fila, "Y");

                            SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting;
                            setting.SetRowEditable(fila + 1, false);
                        }
                        oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();
                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarElementosMatrizOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static bool CargarArticuloElemMatrizOrdenLaboratorio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string strpath, int filaActual)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            string elemento = string.Empty;
            string tipodeorden = string.Empty;
            string tipoArticulo = string.Empty;
            string sede = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            bool exito = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");
                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedeSol", 0).Trim();
                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    almacen = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LABORATORIOS", "U_Almacen", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedReciCuer", 0).Trim(), sapCompany);//Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);
                }
                else
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" la sede esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "ArticuloElementosOrdenlaboratorio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", articulo.Trim());
                query = query.Replace("%Almacen%", almacen.Trim());
                oRSElementos.DoQuery(query);

                fila = filaActual;

                elemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila).Trim();
                nombreElemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_Nombre", fila).Trim();
                tipodeorden = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_tipOrden", fila).Trim();
                tipoArticulo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila).Trim();


                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                {

                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                        }
                        catch { }

                        if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                            //CAB 04-12-2020 oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, "1");//CAB 04-12-2020 

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, "1");

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("WhsCode").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, almacen);
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Stock").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), strpath).ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "A");
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_LineaAdicional", fila, "Y");

                            #region obtengo Numero LineaActual y la seteo en linea
                            //string Linea_ElemOL = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("LineId", fila);
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Linea_ElemOL", fila, Linea_ElemOL);
                            #endregion

                            oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();
                        }
                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarArticuloElemMatrizOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static bool CargarElementosMatrizOrdenLaboratorioDefault(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string TipoArticulo, string TipoOrden, string Elemento, string NombreElemento, string LineId, double CantidaSF, string strpath, int filaActual, ref string mensaje)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";

            string sede = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            bool error = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;
            string NroServicioFunerario = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadre = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");
                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedeSol", 0).Trim();
                NroServicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_numSolSF", 0).Trim();

                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("ENomLab").Specific;
                    string laboratorio = oCombo.Value.ToString().Trim();
                    if (!laboratorio.Equals(string.Empty))
                    {
                        almacen = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LABORATORIOS", "U_Almacen", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedReciCuer", 0).Trim(), sapCompany);//Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);

                        if (!almacen.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {
                            oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "elementosOrdenLaboratorioListaMateriales", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", articulo.Trim());
                            oRSElementos.DoQuery(query);


                            if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                            {

                                #region LINEA PADRE
                                Agregar_lineaMatrix(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtx_0", "@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");

                                fila = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;
                                if (fila == 1)
                                    fila = 0;
                                else
                                    fila = fila - 1;

                                string elem = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString();
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_tipOrden", fila, TipoOrden);
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, TipoArticulo);

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());

                                CodigoPadre = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                                // oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("WhsCode").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, almacen);
                                //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Stock").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), strpath).ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "P");
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ListaMatTipoCuep", fila, "Y");

                                #region obtengo Numero LineaActual y la seteo en linea
                                //string Linea_ElemOL = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("LineId", fila);
                                //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Linea_ElemOL", fila, Linea_ElemOL);
                                #endregion

                                #region seteo codigo del padre en los hijos
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCodePadre", fila, CodigoPadre);
                                #endregion


                                SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting;
                                setting.SetRowEditable(fila + 1, false);

                                oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();
                                oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                                //fila++;

                                #endregion


                                while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                                {

                                    //if (fila != filaActual)
                                    //{
                                    try
                                    {
                                        item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                                    }
                                    catch { }

                                    if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))
                                    {

                                        Agregar_lineaMatrix(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtx_0", "@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");


                                        fila = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;
                                        if (fila == 1)
                                            fila = 0;
                                        else
                                            fila = fila - 1;
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_tipOrden", fila, TipoOrden);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, TipoArticulo);

                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, almacen);
                                        string disponible = RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), strpath).ToString();
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, disponible);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());

                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "H");
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ListaMatTipoCuep", fila, "Y");

                                        #region seteo codigo del padre en los hijos
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCodePadre", fila, CodigoPadre);
                                        #endregion

                                    }
                                    oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();
                                    oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                                    // fila++;
                                }
                            }

                        }
                        else
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" el almacen del laboratorio esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            error = true;
                            mensaje = " el almacen del laboratorio esta vacia... ";
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" el laboratorio  esta vacio... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        error = true;
                        mensaje = " el laboratorio  esta vacio. ";
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" la sede de la orden esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    error = true;
                    mensaje = " la sede de la orden esta vacia... ";
                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarElementosMatrizOrdenLaboratorioDefault", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return error;
        }


        public static bool oldCargarElementosMatrizOrdenLaboratorioDefault(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string TipoArticulo, string TipoOrden, string Elemento, string NombreElemento, string LineId, double CantidaSF, string strpath, int filaActual)

            string almacen = string.Empty;
            bool exito = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;
            string NroServicioFunerario = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadre = string.Empty;
            try
            {

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedeSol", 0).Trim();
                NroServicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_numSolSF", 0).Trim();

                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    almacen = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LABORATORIOS", "U_Almacen", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedReciCuer", 0).Trim(), sapCompany);//Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);
                }

                    fila = 0;
                else

                {

                    {

                        if (fila != filaActual)

                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, NombreElemento);

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_tipOrden", fila, TipoOrden);
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, TipoArticulo);

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(sapCompany, CantidaSF, false, "", 2));
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(sapCompany, CantidaSF, false, "", 2));

                            // oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, tipoArticulo);
                            CodigoPadre = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("WhsCode").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, almacen);
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Stock").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), strpath).ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "P");
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ID_Linea", fila, LineId);
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ObligatorioSF", fila, "Y");
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_NroSF", fila, NroServicioFunerario);

                            #region obtengo Numero LineaActual y la seteo en linea
                            //string Linea_ElemOL = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("LineId", fila);
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Linea_ElemOL", fila, Linea_ElemOL);
                            #endregion

                            #region seteo codigo del padre en los hijos
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCodePadre", fila, CodigoPadre);
                            #endregion

                            SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting;
                            setting.SetRowEditable(fila + 1, false);
                        }
                        oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();
                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarElementosMatrizOrdenLaboratorioDefault", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static double RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string ItemCode, string almacen, string docEntry, string strPath)
        {
            double cantidad = 1;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            StringBuilder Query = new StringBuilder();
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            string strQuery = "";

            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                if (oItem.GetByKey(ItemCode))
                {
                    if (oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES)
                    {
                        oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                        strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "ArticulosDisponiblesOrdenlaboratorio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%ItemCode%", ItemCode);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%DocEntry%", docEntry);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Almacen%", almacen);
                        oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                        if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                        {
                            cantidad = Convert.ToDouble(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                            if (cantidad < 0)
                                cantidad = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarCantidadDisponible", sapCompany);
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrió una excepción en On RetornarCantidadDisponible. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oItem);
            }
            return cantidad;
        }

                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());

                    CodigoPadre = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), strpath).ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "P");

                    oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();

                    fila++;

                    #endregion


                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {

                        //if (fila != filaActual)
                        //{

                            item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());

        public static bool CargarArticuloElemMatrizOrdenLaboratorioDefault(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string TipoArticulo, string TipoOrden, string Elemento, string NombreElemento, string LineId, double CantidadSF, string strpath, int filaActual, string U_NoContr_Prenec, string U_IdLineaPF, string U_Linea, string U_LineaName, string U_ItemCodePB, string U_LineaPadre, string U_tipLinea, string U_LineaPadrePN, ref string mensaje)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string sede = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            string NroServicioFunerario = string.Empty;

            bool error = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");
                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedeSol", 0).Trim();
                NroServicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_numSolSF", 0).Trim();
                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("ESedRC").Specific;
                    string laboratorio = oCombo.Value.Trim();
                    //string laboratorio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_NombreLaboratorio", 0).Trim();
                    if (!laboratorio.Equals(string.Empty))
                    {
                        almacen = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LABORATORIOS", "U_Almacen", "Code", laboratorio, sapCompany); //Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);
                        if (!almacen.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {
                            #region consulta

                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "ArticuloElementosOrdenlaboratorio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                            oRSElementos.DoQuery(query);
                            #endregion

                            //bool exito = retornarUltimaLineaaMatriz(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication, "mtx_0", ref fila);
                            //fila = filaActual;

                            #region cargar campos linea del elementos
                            if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                            {

                                while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                                {
                                    Agregar_lineaMatrix(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtx_0", "@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");
                                    int lineas = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;
                                    fila = lineas - 1;

                                    try
                                    {
                                        item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                                    }
                                    catch { }

                                    if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))
                                    {
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                                        string esCofre = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_ELEPROTECC", "U_cofre", "Code", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString(), sapCompany);

                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_tipOrden", fila, TipoOrden);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, TipoArticulo);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cant", fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(sapCompany, 1, false, "", 2));  //CAB 04-12-20202

                                        if (!esCofre.Equals("Y"))
                                        {
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemName", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_almacen", fila, almacen);
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), strpath).ToString());
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(sapCompany, 1, false, "", 2)); //CAB 04-12-20202
                                        }
                                        else
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_CantRetirar", fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(sapCompany, 1, false, "", 2));

                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "A");
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());

                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ID_Linea", fila, LineId);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ObligatorioSF", fila, "Y");
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_NroSF", fila, NroServicioFunerario);

                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", fila, U_NoContr_Prenec);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_IdLineaPF", fila, U_IdLineaPF);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Linea", fila, U_Linea);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_LineaName", fila, U_LineaName);

                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_ItemCodePB", fila, U_ItemCodePB);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_LineaPadre", fila, U_LineaPadre);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_LineaSF", fila, LineId);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_tipLinea", fila, U_tipLinea);
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_LineaPadrePN", fila, U_LineaPadrePN);
                                        oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                                    }
                                    oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                                    // fila++;
                                }
                            }
                            #endregion
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            error = true;
                            mensaje = " el almacen del laboratorio esta vacia... ";
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" el laboratorio  esta vacio... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        error = true;
                        mensaje = " el laboratorio  esta vacio. ";
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" la sede de la orden esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    error = true;
                    mensaje = " la sede de la orden esta vacia... ";
                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarArticuloElemMatrizOrdenLaboratorioDefault", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return error;
        }

            string query = "";
            //string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            //string elemento = string.Empty;

            string TipoArticulo = "C";

            bool exito = false;
            int fila = 0;

            string CodigoPadre = string.Empty;
            try
            {

                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                NroServicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_numSolSF", 0).Trim();

                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    almacen = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LABORATORIOS", "U_Almacen", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_sedReciCuer", 0).Trim(), sapCompany); //Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);

                fila = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;

                    fila = 0;
                else

                {

                    {

                        if (fila != filaActual)
