                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "P");
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());

        public static void HabilitarCamposFallecidoACorregir(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool opcion)
        {

            try
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("idfallec").Enabled = opcion;
                oForm.Items.Item("nomfalle").Enabled = opcion;
                oForm.Items.Item("numcert").Enabled = opcion;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "HabilitarCamposFallecidoACorregir", sapCompany);
            }
        }

            }
        }

        public static bool enviarAlerta(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta tipoAlerta, string IdSolicitudLaboratorio, string numeroSolicitud, string asunto, string Tipo, string actividad, string UserNotificar, ref string mensaje, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSUsuarios = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService oMS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Message oMsg = null;
            //Consultas cons = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string IdAlerta = string.Empty;

            bool exito = false;
            string userCode = string.Empty;
            bool usuarioAgregado = false;

            try
            {
                if (!UserNotificar.Equals(string.Empty))
                    UserNotificar = DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USERID", "USER_CODE", UserNotificar, sapCompany);

                oRSUsuarios = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                //determinar cuales usuarios deben ser notificados
                switch (tipoAlerta)
                {

                    case ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.corregirDatosFallecidoLab:
                        {
                            //cons.getUsuariosDeAlerta("12", oRSUsuarios);

                            IdAlerta = "12";

                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarMensajeUsuarioAlerta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%IdAlerta%", IdAlerta.Trim());
                            ors.DoQuery(query);
                        }
                        break;

                    case ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.FinalizaProcesoLaboratorio:
                        {
                            //cons.getUsuariosDeAlerta("13", oRSUsuarios);

                            IdAlerta = "13";

                            actividad = string.Empty;
                            actividad = "Finaliza proceso de Laboratorio";

                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarMensajeUsuarioAlerta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%IdAlerta%", IdAlerta.Trim());
                            ors.DoQuery(query);
                        }
                        break;

                    case ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.CambioCofre:
                        {
                            IdAlerta = "14";

                            actividad = string.Empty;
                            actividad = "Solicitud Cambio de cofre";

                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarMensajeUsuarioAlerta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%IdAlerta%", IdAlerta.Trim());
                            ors.DoQuery(query);
                        }
                        break;
                    case ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.CambioHabito:
                        {
                            IdAlerta = "15";
                            actividad = string.Empty;
                            actividad = "Solicitud Hábito";

                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarMensajeUsuarioAlerta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%IdAlerta%", IdAlerta.Trim());
                            ors.DoQuery(query);
                        }
                        break;

                    case ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.CambioCajaMetalica:
                        {
                            IdAlerta = "16";
                            actividad = string.Empty;
                            actividad = "Solicitud Caja Metalica";

                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarMensajeUsuarioAlerta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%IdAlerta%", IdAlerta.Trim());
                            ors.DoQuery(query);
                        }
                        break;
                    case ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.RecogerCuerpoTrasladoLab:
                        {
                            IdAlerta = "20";
                            actividad = string.Empty;
                            actividad = "recoger cuerpo para traslado a laboratorio";

                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarMensajeUsuarioAlerta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%IdAlerta%", IdAlerta.Trim());
                            ors.DoQuery(query);
                        }
                        break;


                }
                int asignadosUsuario = 0;
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    int i = 0;
                    oCS = sapCompany.GetCompanyService();
                    oMS = (SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService)oCS.GetBusinessService(ServiceTypes.MessagesService);
                    oMsg = (SAPbobsCOM.Message)oMS.GetDataInterface(MessagesServiceDataInterfaces.msdiMessage);
                    oMsg.Subject = "Alerta de Laboratorio";
                    oMsg.Text = ors.Fields.Item("U_Mensaje").Value.ToString() + " - No. DocSF: " + numeroSolicitud + " - No. SolLab: " + IdSolicitudLaboratorio + " - Asunto: " + asunto + " -Tipo: " + Tipo + " -Actividad: " + actividad;
                    oMsg.Priority = BoMsgPriorities.pr_High;


                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Add();
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).SendInternal = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                        userCode = ors.Fields.Item("U_Usuario").Value.ToString();
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).UserCode = DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", userCode, sapCompany);

                        if (UserNotificar.Equals(userCode))
                            usuarioAgregado = true;

                        i++;
                        asignadosUsuario++;
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }

                    if (!usuarioAgregado)
                        mensaje = "el usuario " + UserNotificar + " no tiene asignada la alerta definida";

                }
                else
                {
                    int i = 0;
                    oCS = sapCompany.GetCompanyService();
                    oMS = (SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService)oCS.GetBusinessService(ServiceTypes.MessagesService);
                    oMsg = (SAPbobsCOM.Message)oMS.GetDataInterface(MessagesServiceDataInterfaces.msdiMessage);
                    oMsg.Subject = "Alerta de Laboratorio";
                    oMsg.Text = ors.Fields.Item("U_Mensaje").Value.ToString() + " - No. DocSF: " + numeroSolicitud + " - No. SolLab: " + IdSolicitudLaboratorio + " - Asunto: " + asunto + " -Tipo: " + Tipo + " -Actividad: " + actividad;
                    oMsg.Priority = BoMsgPriorities.pr_High;

                    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Add();
                    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).SendInternal = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                    userCode = UserNotificar;
                    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).UserCode = DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", userCode, sapCompany);
                    asignadosUsuario++;
                }

                if (asignadosUsuario > 0)
                {
                    oMS.SendMessage(oMsg);
                    exito = true;
                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "enviarAlerta", sapCompany);
                mensaje = e.Message;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSUsuarios != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSUsuarios);
                if (ors != null)
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return exito;
        }


        public bool GenerarAlertCambiosLaboratorio(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application app, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string actividad, string asunto, string UserNotificar, ref string mensaje, int TipoCambio)
        {
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, app);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool exitoAlerta = false;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string IdSolicitudLaboratorio = string.Empty;
            string idservicioFunerario = string.Empty;
            string Tipo = "Servicio funerario";


            try
            {
                IdSolicitudLaboratorio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_solicLab", 0).ToString().Trim();
                idservicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_numSolSF", 0).ToString().Trim();
                if (UserNotificar.Equals(""))
                    UserNotificar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_UserNotificar", 0).ToString().Trim();

                switch (TipoCambio)
                {
                    case 1:
                        exitoAlerta = enviarAlerta(sapCompany, sapApplication, ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.CambioCofre, IdSolicitudLaboratorio, idservicioFunerario, asunto, Tipo, actividad, UserNotificar, ref mensaje, path);
                        break;

                    case 2:
                        exitoAlerta = enviarAlerta(sapCompany, sapApplication, ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.CambioHabito, IdSolicitudLaboratorio, idservicioFunerario, asunto, Tipo, actividad, UserNotificar, ref mensaje, path);
                        break;

                    case 3:
                        exitoAlerta = enviarAlerta(sapCompany, sapApplication, ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.CambioCajaMetalica, IdSolicitudLaboratorio, idservicioFunerario, asunto, Tipo, actividad, UserNotificar, ref mensaje, path);
                        break;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "GenerarAlertCambiosLaboratorio", sapCompany);
            }
            return exitoAlerta;
        }

        public bool GenerarAlertaModificacionDatosLaboratorio(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application app, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, ref string mensaje)
        {
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, app);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool exitoAlerta = false;
            string UserNotificar = string.Empty;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string IdSolicitudLaboratorio = string.Empty;
            string idservicioFunerario = string.Empty;
            string actividad = string.Empty;
            string asunto = "Corregir Datos";
            string Tipo = "Servicio funerario";

            try
            {
                IdSolicitudLaboratorio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_solicLab", 0).ToString().Trim();
                UserNotificar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_UserNotificar", 0).ToString().Trim();
                idservicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_numSolSF", 0).ToString().Trim();

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(path + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "retornarDatosFromAlertaCorregirDatosLaboratorio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%IdSolicitudLab%", IdSolicitudLaboratorio.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    actividad = ors.Fields.Item("Actividad").Value.ToString().Trim();
                    UserNotificar = ors.Fields.Item("Asignado a").Value.ToString().Trim();
                }

                exitoAlerta = enviarAlerta(sapCompany, sapApplication, ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.corregirDatosFallecidoLab, IdSolicitudLaboratorio, idservicioFunerario, asunto, Tipo, actividad, UserNotificar, ref mensaje, path);

            catch (Exception e)

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "GenerarAlertaModificacionDatosFallecido", sapCompany);
            }

        }

        public bool GenerarAlertaFinalizacionProcesoLaboratorio(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application app, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, ref string mensaje)
        {
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, app);
            bool exitoAlerta = false;
            string UserNotificar = string.Empty;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string IdSolicitudLaboratorio = string.Empty;
            string idservicioFunerario = string.Empty;
            string actividad = string.Empty;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            string asunto = "Finalizacion Proceso Laboratorio";
            string Tipo = "Servicio funerario";
            int fila = 0;
            DateTime Hoy = DateTime.Today;
            DateTime HoraIni = DateTime.Now;
            try
            {
                IdSolicitudLaboratorio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_solicLab", 0).ToString().Trim();
                UserNotificar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_UserNotificar", 0).ToString().Trim();
                idservicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_numSolSF", 0).ToString().Trim();

                string FechaFinProceso = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Hoy, sapApplication);
                string HoraFinProceso = HoraIni.ToString("HH:mm");

                actividad = " Fecha Hora Fin Proceso " + FechaFinProceso + "- " + HoraFinProceso + ".";

        public static int RetornarDocEntryTabla(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string Tabla)
        {
            int docentry = 0;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                string query = "SELECT IFNULL(MAX( \"DocEntry\"),0) + 1 AS \"DocEntry\" FROM   \"@" + Tabla + "\"";
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    docentry = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarDocEntryTabla", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return docentry;
        }

        public static int RetornarLineIdTabla(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string DocEntry, string Tabla, string strpath)
        {
            int LineId = 0;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "retornar_LineId", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = query.Replace("%Tabla%", Tabla.Trim());
                query = query.Replace("%DocEntry%", DocEntry.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    LineId = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdTabla", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return LineId;
        }

                // empleados de recursos humanos funcionario que recibe el cuerpo
                oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("ENoURec").Specific;
                querys = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "Empleados_RecursosHumanosALL", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oCombo, querys);

                // LABORATORIOS
                oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("ENomLab").Specific;
                querys = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "lABORATORIOS", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oCombo, querys);

                //causas de fallecimiento
                oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("edcaufall").Specific;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_CAUSAFALL\" ORDER BY \"Code\"");
                #endregion

                ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oForm.Items.Item("tab_5")).Enabled = false;

                #region CARGAR Y SETEAR EL COMBO AsuntoSolicitud
                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboA = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("CAsunto").Specific;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oComboA, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"OCLS\" ");
                #endregion

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "InicializarFormularioOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany);
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrió una excepción en On InicializarFormularioOrdenLaboratorio. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        public static bool Existe_TanatologoLineasOrdenLaboratorio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string tanatologo = string.Empty;
            int cant = 0;
            bool existe = false;
            bool Salir = false;
            int indice = 1;
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                string DocEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString().Trim();
                if (DocEntry.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "Retornar_Tanatologo", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    query = query.Replace("%DocEntry%", DocEntry.Trim());
                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        cant = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim());
                        if (cant > 0)
                            existe = true;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                    oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_TANATOPRALAB");
                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

                    while (indice < oMatrix.RowCount && !Salir)
                    {
                        tanatologo = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Tanatologo", indice);
                        if (!tanatologo.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            Salir = true;
                        }
                        indice++;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Existe_TanatologoLineasOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }

            return existe;
        }

        public static bool existen_Elementos_USO_OrdenLaboratorio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref int fila)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string Uso = string.Empty;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            string uso = string.Empty;
            string serfun = string.Empty;
            string inventariable = string.Empty;
            int cantidadInventariable = 0;
            int cantidadNoInventariable = 0;
            int cantidadUsoNoInventariable = 0;
            int cantidadUsoInventariable = 0;
            bool usado = false;
            string salidainventario = string.Empty;
            string itemCode = "";

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();

                while (indice < omtx.RowCount)
                {
                    usado = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)omtx.Columns.Item("C_Uso").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific).Checked;
                    salidainventario = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("C_NroISM").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific).Value;
                    inventariable = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_Inventariable", indice).ToString().Trim();
                    itemCode = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_ItemCode", indice).ToString().Trim();

                    #region comentado
                    //uso = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_Uso", indice).ToString().Trim();
                    //serfun = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB").GetValue("U_NroSF", indice).ToString().Trim();


                    //if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serfun))
                    //{
                    //    if (inventariable.Equals("Y"))
                    //    {
                    //       cantidadInventariable ++;
                    //       if(uso.Equals("Y"))
                    //             cantidadUsoInventariable++;
                    //    }else
                    //     if(uso.Equals("Y"))
                    //         cantidadUsoNoInventariable++;
                    //}
                    //else
                    //     if(uso.Equals("Y"))
                    //         cantidadUsoInventariable ++;
                    #endregion

                    if (inventariable.Equals("Y") && !itemCode.Equals(""))
                    {
                        cantidadInventariable++;
                        //if (uso.Equals("Y"))
                        if (usado)
                        {
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(salidainventario))
                                cantidadUsoInventariable++;
                        }
                    }

                    #region comentado 
                    //else
                    //{
                    //    cantidadNoInventariable++;
                    //    if (uso.Equals("Y"))
                    //        cantidadUsoNoInventariable++;
                    //}
                    #endregion

                    indice++;
                }

                if ((cantidadInventariable == cantidadUsoInventariable))
                    existe = true;

            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static bool existen_ProcesoSinFinalizarMatrixTanatopraxia(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref int fila, ref bool matrizVacia)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string estado = string.Empty;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_TANATOPRALAB");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_3").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;

                if (omtx.RowCount == 0)
                {
                    matrizVacia = true;
                }
                else
                    if (omtx.RowCount == 1)
                {
                    string U_TipoTanatologo = oDBS1.GetValue("U_TipoTanatologo", indice).Trim();
                    string U_Tanatologo = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Tanatologo", indice).Trim();
                    string U_Proceso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Proceso", indice).Trim();

                    bool estvacia = U_TipoTanatologo.Equals(string.Empty) && U_Tanatologo.Equals(string.Empty) && U_Proceso.Equals(string.Empty);
                    matrizVacia = estvacia;
                    // existe = true;
                }
                else
                {

                    while (indice < tope && !existe)
                    {
                        estado = oDBS1.GetValue("U_EstadoProceso", indice).Trim();
                        fila = indice;

                        if (!estado.Equals("FIN PROCESO"))
                        {
                            existe = true;
                        }
                        indice++;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static bool existen_RegistrosCreadosLineaElementos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, int fila, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool existe = true;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            double totalvacio = 0;
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();

                string U_Codigo = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Codigo", fila).Trim();
                string U_Nombre = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Nombre", fila).Trim();
                string U_ArtAdMe = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila).Trim();
                string U_ItemCode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemCode", fila).Trim();
                string U_ItemName = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemName", fila).Trim();

                if (U_Codigo.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;
                if (U_Nombre.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;
                if (U_ArtAdMe.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;
                if (U_ItemCode.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;
                if (U_ItemName.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (totalvacio == 5)
                    existe = false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_RegistrosCreadosLineaElementos", ocmp);
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrió una excepción en On existen_RegistrosCreadosLineaElementos. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static bool existen_RegistrosCreadosLineaTanatopraxia(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, int fila, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool existe = true;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            double totalvacio = 0;
            string U_Estado = string.Empty;

                string U_InicioProceso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_InicioProceso", fila).Trim();
                string U_FechaIniProceso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_FechaIniProceso", fila).Trim();
                string U_HoraIniProceso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_HoraIniProceso", fila).Trim();
                string U_FechaFinProceso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_FechaIniProceso", fila).Trim();

                string U_FuncReviso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_FuncReviso", fila).Trim();
                string U_DescripcionCorrecion = oDBS1.GetValue("U_DescripcionCorrecion", fila).Trim();

                U_Estado = oDBS1.GetValue("U_EstadoProceso", fila).Trim();

                if (U_TipoTanatologo.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_Tanatologo.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_FechaIniPrograma.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_HoraIniPrograma.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_FechaFinPrograma.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_HoraFinPrograma.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;


                if (U_Proceso.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_InicioProceso.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_FechaIniProceso.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_HoraIniProceso.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_FechaFinProceso.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_HoraFinProceso.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_RequiereCorrecion.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_FuncReviso.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_DescripcionCorrecion.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (U_Estado.Equals(""))
                    totalvacio++;

                if (totalvacio == 16)
                    existe = false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_RegistrosCreadosLineaTanatopraxia", ocmp);

        }

        public static void HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposOrdenLaboratorioNavegacion(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool blOpcion, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string strpath)
        {

            #region array campos
            string[] strCamposbaseCabecera = { "ENSolLab", "ESedeSL","ETipOrd" ,"ENolAnt", "ELabOri","ENomLab","EDpLab","ECiuLab","EDirLab", "ENSFUN", "ENLisC", "idfallec", "nomfalle", "numcert", "chkcorge", "ESedDes", "ELugDes", "EdirDes", "92",
                                                "5", "ENOL", "EFecCre", "EHorCre", "EEstado",  "EUsuNot", "CCRep", "CCCust", "CHomEsp", "CTana",  "ckEmbFin","ckPrSalPaz","EConsMan","ckCaConsMa","ENReCup" , "EFecRC", "EHorRC", "ENomEC", "ESedRC",
                                                "ENomFRC", "ELocker", "EPeso", "ETipCup", "EFIniCog", "EHinCog", "EFFinCg", "EHFinCg", "EnomEnt", "EPerEnt", "ENoURec", "EfecEnC", "EHEnC", "EObs","CCajMet","CSolHab", "CCamCof", "ECofre", "EMotCam" ,
                                                "EComent","CAsunto","CCance", "chkAnular","EFecCan", "EHorCan", "EMotCan", "ckEmbFin","edcaufall","tdocnuSF", "401","402","403","404" };

            #endregion

            #region array botones
            string[] strBotones = { "btn_AdL", "Btn_OC", "Btn_GS", "btn_expl", "Btn_visu", "Btn_borr", "Btn_act", "btn_adTX", "btn_delTX" };
            #endregion
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);

                #region si  CERRADA 0 CANCELADA
                string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENLAB").GetValue("U_estadoOL", 0).ToString().Trim();
                if (estado.Equals("CERRADA") || estado.Equals("CANCELADA") || estado.Equals("ANULADA"))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        oForm.ActiveItem = "Ed_Val";
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {

                    }
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "86", false);

                    //Base 
                    foreach (string strCpo in strCamposbaseCabecera)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, strCpo, false);
                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposOrdenLaboratorioNavegacion", sapCompany);
                        }
                    }

                    // botones 
                    foreach (string strBtn in strBotones)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, strBtn, false);
                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposOrdenLaboratorioNavegacion", sapCompany); }
                    }

                    if (estado.Equals("ANULADA"))
                    {
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "86", true);
                        try
                        {
                            oForm.ActiveItem = "Ed_Val";
                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {

                        }
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EMotCan", false);
                    }
                }
                #endregion

                #region si esta en otro estado
                else
                {
                    try
                    {

                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "86", true);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EObs", true);

                        #region  botones
                        // botones 
                        foreach (string strBtn in strBotones)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, strBtn, blOpcion);
                            }
                            catch (Exception e)
                            { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposOrdenLaboratorioNavegacion", sapCompany); }
                        }
                        #endregion

                        #region campos de cabecera

                        #region cabecera siempre bloqueados
                        try
                        {
                            oForm.ActiveItem = "Ed_Val";
                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {

                        }
                        // campos fijos debeb estar siempre bloqueados
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ENolAnt", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "92", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "5", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ENOL", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EFecCre", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EHorCre", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ENolAnt", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EEstado", false);

                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ECofre", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EMotCam", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "CAsunto", false);
                        #endregion

                        #region cabecera orden laboratorio

                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ETipOrd", false);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ENSolLab", false);

        public static void HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposOrdenLaboratorio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool blOpcion, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {


            string[] strCamposbaseCabecera = { "ENSolLab", "ESedeSL","ETipOrd" ,"ENolAnt", "ELabOri","ENomLab","EDpLab","ECiuLab","EDirLab", "ENSFUN", "ENLisC", "idfallec", "nomfalle", "numcert", "chkcorge", "ESedDes", "ELugDes", "EdirDes", "92", "5", "ENOL", "EFecCre", "EHorCre", "EEstado",  "EUsuNot", "CCRep", "CCCust", "CHomEsp", "CTana",  "ckEmbFin",
                                               "ENReCup" , "EFecRC", "EHorRC", "ENomEC", "ESedRC", "ENomFRC", "ELocker", "EPeso", "ETipCup", "EFIniCog", "EHinCog", "EFFinCg", "EHFinCg", "EnomEnt", "EPerEnt", "ENoURec", "EfecEnC", "EHEnC", "EObs","CCajMet","CSolHab", "CCamCof", "ECofre", "EMotCam" ,"EComent","CAsunto",
                                                "CCance","chkAnular","EFecCan", "EHorCan", "EMotCan", "ckEmbFin","ckPrSalPaz","EConsMan","ckCaConsMa","tdocnuSF","401","402","403","404"
                                              };

            #region array botones
            string[] strBotones = { "btn_AdL", "Btn_OC", "Btn_GS", "btn_expl", "Btn_visu", "Btn_borr", "Btn_act", "btn_adTX", "btn_delTX" };
            #endregion

            //Base 
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                foreach (string strCpo in strCamposbaseCabecera)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, strCpo, blOpcion);
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany);
                    }
                }

                #region  botones

                // botones 
                foreach (string strBtn in strBotones)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, strBtn, blOpcion);
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInLiqPaddy", "HabilitarDeshabilitarBotonesOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany); }
                }
                #endregion


                // campos fijos debeb estar siempre bloqueados

                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ENolAnt", false);
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "92", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "5", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ENOL", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EFecCre", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EHorCre", false);

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EEstado", false);

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ECofre", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EMotCam", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "chkcorge", DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_corrBenf", "Code", "SETUP", sapCompany).Equals("Y") ? true : false);

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EFecCan", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EHorCan", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "EMotCan", false);

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "idfallec", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "nomfalle", false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "numcert", true);

            }
            catch (Exception e) { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany); }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);

        public static void UpdateNroCertificadoYTanatologoOSF(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string strpath, string docEntryOSF, string DocEntryOL, string NroCert)
        {
            string idOrdenLaboratorio = string.Empty;
            string idServicioFunerario = string.Empty;
            string query = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            try
            {
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "UpdateNroCertificadoYTanatologoOSF", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%DocEntryOL%", DocEntryOL.Trim());
                query = query.Replace("%docEntryOSF%", docEntryOSF.Trim());
                query = query.Replace("%NroCert%", NroCert.Trim());
                oRS.DoQuery(query);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "UpdateNroCertificadoYTanatologoOSF", sapCompany);
            }
        }

        public static void inhabilitarCamposMatrizElementosLaboratorioSerfun(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, int fila, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, bool blopcion)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDELEMLAB");
            string SerFun = string.Empty;
            string usado = string.Empty;
            string inventariable = string.Empty;
            string Eshijo = string.Empty;

            try
            {
                Hashtable indicesCampos = new Hashtable();
                oForm.Freeze(true);

                //====================================

                indicesCampos.Add("U_Codigo", 1);
                indicesCampos.Add("U_tipOrden", 3);
                indicesCampos.Add("U_ArtAdMe", 4);
                indicesCampos.Add("U_CantRetirar", 9);
                indicesCampos.Add("U_Uso", 12);

                //====================================

                foreach (string key in indicesCampos.Keys)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        if (key == "U_CantRetirar")
                        {
                            SerFun = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NroSF", fila).Trim();
                            Eshijo = oDBS1.GetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila).Trim();
                            if (!SerFun.Equals(string.Empty))
                            {
                                if (Eshijo.Equals("H"))
                                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila + 1, Convert.ToInt32(indicesCampos[key].ToString()), true);
                                else
                                    omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila + 1, Convert.ToInt32(indicesCampos[key].ToString()), true);// false
                            }
                            else
                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila + 1, Convert.ToInt32(indicesCampos[key].ToString()), true);
                        }
                        else
                            if (key == "U_Uso")
                        {
                            usado = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", fila).Trim();
                            inventariable = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Inventariable", fila).Trim();
                            if (inventariable.Equals("Y"))
                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila + 1, Convert.ToInt32(indicesCampos[key].ToString()), false);
                            else
                                if (usado.Equals("Y"))
                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila + 1, Convert.ToInt32(indicesCampos[key].ToString()), false);
                            else
                                omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila + 1, Convert.ToInt32(indicesCampos[key].ToString()), true);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila + 1, Convert.ToInt32(indicesCampos[key].ToString()), false);
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "inhabilitarCamposMatrizElementosLaboratorioSerfun", sapCompany);
                    }
                }
            }

            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "inhabilitarCamposMatrizElementosLaboratorioSerfun", sapCompany);
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrió una excepción en On inhabilitarCamposMatrizElementosLaboratorioSerfun. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }
