            OK1.SBO.HelpersXMLSBO.UPDATEQueriesFromXML(StrPath + @"UserQueries\" + "BFKilometrajeFinal2.xml", sapCompany, "Servicios Funerarios", ref Error);

            OK1.SBO.HelpersXMLSBO.LoadFormattedSearchesManual(sapCompany, "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA", "txtKmIni", "-1", SAPbobsCOM.BoFormattedSearchActionEnum.bofsaQuery, "BFKilometrajeFinal1", SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tNO, null, SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tNO, SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tNO, ref Error);
            OK1.SBO.HelpersXMLSBO.LoadFormattedSearchesManual(sapCompany, "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA", "KMIni2", "-1", SAPbobsCOM.BoFormattedSearchActionEnum.bofsaQuery, "BFKilometrajeFinal2", SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tNO, null, SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tNO, SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tNO, ref Error);

            #endregion
            GC.Collect();
        }
        #endregion

        #region rightClickHandler Eventos click derecho
        public static void rightClickHandler(SAPbouiCOM.MenuEvent pVal, out bool BubbleEvent)
        {
            BubbleEvent = true;
        }
        #endregion

        public void RightClickMenu(SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, bool eventInfoBeforeAction, int eventInfoRow, string eventInfoItemUID, string eventInfoFormUID)
        {
            //En el before action se crea el menu
            if ((eventInfoBeforeAction == true))
            {
                try
                {
                    AddRightClickMenu(sapApplication, sapCompany, eventInfoFormUID, eventInfoItemUID);
                }
                catch { }
            }
            //En el afteraction se tiene que borrar el menu con todos sus submenus de la orden lab
            else
            {
                try
                {
                    sapApplication.Menus.RemoveEx("OK1_OLE_DELLINE");
                }
                catch { }

                try
                {
                    sapApplication.Menus.RemoveEx("OK1_OT_CANCSALIDA");
                }
                catch { }

                try
                {
                    sapApplication.Menus.RemoveEx("OK1_OT_MAR_USO");
                }
                catch { }

                try
                {
                    sapApplication.Menus.RemoveEx("OK1_OT_CANLINORDEN");
                }
                catch { }

                try
                {
                    sapApplication.Menus.RemoveEx("OK1_OT_DESMAR_USO");
                }
                catch { }

                try
                {
                    sapApplication.Menus.RemoveEx("OK1_OT_DESMAR_USO");
                }
                catch { }
            }
        }

        public void AddRightClickMenu(SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string strFormType, string strItemUID)
        {

            //Funcion para agregar el Menu que se despliega cuando se oprime el Boton Derecho de Mouse
            SAPbouiCOM.MenuItem oMenuItem = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Menus oMenus = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.MenuCreationParams oCreationPackage = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Form ofrm = (SAPbouiCOM.Form)sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm;

            oCreationPackage = ((SAPbouiCOM.MenuCreationParams)(sapApplication.CreateObject(SAPbouiCOM.BoCreatableObjectType.cot_MenuCreationParams)));
            switch (strFormType)
            {
                #region ORDEN TRASLADO
                case "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA":
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            bool PermiteEstadoOT = !new[] { "Cerrado", "Anulado", "Cancelado" }.Any(p => p.Equals(ofrm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

                            if (strItemUID.Equals("mtxElemen") && ((ofrm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE) || (ofrm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE) || (ofrm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)) && PermiteEstadoOT)
                            {
                                oCreationPackage.Type = SAPbouiCOM.BoMenuType.mt_STRING;
                                oCreationPackage.UniqueID = "OK1_OT_CANCSALIDA";
                                oCreationPackage.String = "Cancelar Salida";
                                oCreationPackage.Enabled = true;
                                oCreationPackage.Position = 3;
                                oMenuItem = sapApplication.Menus.Item("1280"); //El menu 1280 corresponde al RightClick
                                oMenus = oMenuItem.SubMenus;
                                oMenus.AddEx(oCreationPackage);

                                oCreationPackage.Type = SAPbouiCOM.BoMenuType.mt_STRING;
                                oCreationPackage.UniqueID = "OK1_OT_CANLINORDEN";
                                oCreationPackage.String = "Cancelar Línea Orden";
                                oCreationPackage.Enabled = true;
                                oCreationPackage.Position = 5;
                                oMenuItem = sapApplication.Menus.Item("1280"); //El menu 1280 corresponde al RightClick
                                oMenus = oMenuItem.SubMenus;
                                oMenus.AddEx(oCreationPackage);

                                oCreationPackage.Type = SAPbouiCOM.BoMenuType.mt_STRING;
                                oCreationPackage.UniqueID = "OK1_OT_MAR_USO";
                                oCreationPackage.String = "Marcar Uso";
                                oCreationPackage.Enabled = true;
                                oCreationPackage.Position = 3;
                                oMenuItem = sapApplication.Menus.Item("1280"); //El menu 1280 corresponde al RightClick
                                oMenus = oMenuItem.SubMenus;
                                oMenus.AddEx(oCreationPackage);

                                oCreationPackage.Type = SAPbouiCOM.BoMenuType.mt_STRING;
                                oCreationPackage.UniqueID = "OK1_OT_DESMAR_USO";
                                oCreationPackage.String = "DesMarcar Uso";
                                oCreationPackage.Enabled = true;
                                oCreationPackage.Position = 7;
                                oMenuItem = sapApplication.Menus.Item("1280"); //El menu 1280 corresponde al RightClick
                                oMenus = oMenuItem.SubMenus;
                                oMenus.AddEx(oCreationPackage);
                            }

                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "AddRightClickMenu", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                    #endregion
            }
        }

        #region evtMenuHandler enventos del menu
        public static void evtMenuHandler(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.MenuEvent pVal, ref bool BubbleEvent, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string StrPath, int iBranch)
        {
            switch (pVal.MenuUID)
            {
                #region menu abrir orden de traslado
                case "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_MENU":
                    if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                    {
                        if (pVal.MenuUID.Equals("OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_MENU"))
                            OrdenTraslado.abrirFormulario(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, StrPath);

                    }
                    BubbleEvent = true;
                    break;
                #endregion

                #region Menu Contextual Cancelar Salida

                case "OK1_OT_CANCSALIDA":
                    if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                    {
                        string entrySalidaMercancia = "";
                        string mensaje = "";
                        oForm = sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm;
                        if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                        {
                            string estadoOL = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).Trim();
                            if (!estadoOL.Equals("Cerrado") || !estadoOL.Equals("Cancelado") || !estadoOL.Equals("Anulado"))
                            {
                                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                                int fila = oMatrix.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                                string nombreDocumento = Retornar_TipoDocumentoCreadosOTLinea(oForm, sapCompany, fila - 1, ref mensaje, "SM");
                                if (nombreDocumento.Equals("SM"))
                                {
                                    entrySalidaMercancia = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_7").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entrySalidaMercancia))
                                    {
                                        bool errorCancelacionSal_inventario = cancelarSalidaInventario(sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath, oForm, fila, entrySalidaMercancia, iBranch);
                                        if (!errorCancelacionSal_inventario)
                                        {
                                            #region marcar uso NEW

                                            mensaje = string.Empty;
                                            string NrocontratoPrenecesidad = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NrocontratoPrenecesidad))
                                            {

                                                bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = DesMarcarUsoElementosInventariablePorLinea(oForm, sapCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, sapApplication, StrPath, false);
                                                if (ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                                {
                                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede desmarcar el uso del elemento " + mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                                }
                                                else
                                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Proceso finalizado con exito", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                            }
                                            else
                                            {
                                                oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "uso", "");
                                                //sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede desmarcar el uso, el elemento no esta asociado a una prenecesidad.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                            }
                                            #endregion
                                            inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath);

                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("el numero de salida de mercancia esta vacio, no se puede realizar", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                }
                                else
                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede Cancelar.  el documento no es de salida de mercancia", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            }
                            else
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede Cancelar  el documento mientras el formulario este en este estado actual.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        }
                        else
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede Cancelar  el documento mientras el formulario este en modo de actualizar. Actualice primero e intente de nuevo", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    }
                    break;
                #endregion

                #region Menu Contextual Marcar Uso por linea en orden de servicio funerario

                case "OK1_OT_MAR_USO":
                    if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                    {
                        string mensaje = string.Empty;
                        oForm = sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm;
                        if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                        {

                            string estadoOL = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).Trim();
                            if (!estadoOL.Equals("Cerrado") || !estadoOL.Equals("Cancelado") || !estadoOL.Equals("Anulado"))
                            {
                                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                                int fila = -1;
                                fila = oMatrix.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                                if (fila != -1)
                                {
                                    bool marcarUsoinventariableSM = false;
                                    //bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablePorLinea(oForm, sapCompany, ref  mensaje, fila - 1, sapApplication, StrPath);
                                    //if (ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                    bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = MarcarUsoElementosNOInventariablePorLinea(oForm, sapCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, sapApplication, StrPath, true);
                                    if (ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                    {
                                        bool uso = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("uso").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Checked;
                                        if (!uso)
                                            marcarUsoinventariableSM = MarcarUsoElementosNOInventariablePorLineaConSalidaInventario(oForm, sapCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, sapApplication);

                                        if (marcarUsoinventariableSM)
                                        {
                                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Proceso finalizado con exito", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                            BubbleEvent = true;
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede Marcar el uso del elemento " + mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                            sapApplication.MessageBox("No se puede Marcar el uso del elemento " + mensaje);
                                            BubbleEvent = false;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Proceso finalizado con exito", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                        oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("debe seleccionar la linea", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede marcar el uso elemento en estado ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            }

                        }
                        else
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede marcar el uso elemento en este modo ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                #endregion

                #region Menu Contextual desMarcar Uso por linea en orden de servicio funerario

                case "OK1_OT_DESMAR_USO":
                    if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                    {
                        SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
                        string mensaje = string.Empty;
                        oForm = sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm;
                        if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                        {

                            string estadoOL = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).Trim();

                            bool puedeseguir = false;
                            puedeseguir = !estadoOL.Equals("Cerrado") && !estadoOL.Equals("Cancelado") && !estadoOL.Equals("Anulado");

                            // if (!estadoOL.Equals("Cerrado") || !estadoOL.Equals("Cancelado") || !estadoOL.Equals("Anulado"))
                            if (puedeseguir)
                            {
                                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                                int fila = -1;
                                fila = oMatrix.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                                if (fila != -1)
                                {

                                    string NrocontratoPrenecesidad = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NrocontratoPrenecesidad))
                                    {
                                        bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = DesMarcarUsoElementosNOInventariablePorLinea(oForm, sapCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, sapApplication, StrPath, true);
                                        if (ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                        {
                                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede desmarcar el uso del elemento " + mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                            sapApplication.MessageBox("No se puede desmarcar el uso del elemento " + mensaje);
                                            BubbleEvent = false;
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Proceso finalizado con exito", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                            oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                            oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                                        oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_Item").Cells.Item(fila).Specific)).Value);
                                        if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                                        {
                                            string tipoLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                            bool puedeMarcar = false;
                                            puedeMarcar = !tipoLinea.Equals('B') && !tipoLinea.Equals('P');

                                            if (puedeMarcar)
                                            {
                                                bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = DesMarcarUsoElementosNOInventariablePorLineaOtrosServicios(oForm, sapCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, sapApplication, StrPath, true);
                                                if (ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                                {
                                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede desmarcar el uso del elemento " + mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                                    sapApplication.MessageBox("No se puede desmarcar el uso del elemento " + mensaje);
                                                    BubbleEvent = false;
                                                }
                                                else
                                                {
                                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Proceso finalizado con exito", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                                                }
                                            }
                                            else
                                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede marcar el uso-", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                                        }
                                        else
                                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede marcar el uso, el articulo es inventariable..", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("debe seleccionar la linea", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede desmarcar el uso elemento en estado ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            }

                        }
                        else
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede desmarcar el uso elemento en este modo ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                #endregion

                #region Menu Contextual Cancelar Línea ORDEN
                case "OK1_OT_CANLINORDEN":
                    if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                    {
                        oForm = sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm;
                        if (oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE)
                        {
                            string estadoOL = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).Trim();
                            if (!estadoOL.Equals("Cerrado") || !estadoOL.Equals("Cancelado") || !estadoOL.Equals("Anulado"))
                            {
                                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                                int fila = oMatrix.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                                ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication);
                                string mensaje = "";
                                string nombreDocumento = Retornar_TipoDocumentoCreadosSFLinea(oForm, sapCompany, fila - 1, ref mensaje, "OC");
                                //string nombreDocumento = Retornar_TipoDocumentoCreadosOTLinea(oForm, sapCompany, fila - 1, ref mensaje, "SM");
                                int lineasSeleccionadas = 0;
                                if (nombreDocumento.Equals("OC"))
                                {
                                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                    {
                                        //solo tomar en cuenta filas seleccionadas y sin solicitar\

                                        if (oMatrix.IsRowSelected(i))
                                        {
                                            lineasSeleccionadas++;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    if (lineasSeleccionadas.Equals(1))
                                    {

                                        cancelarOrdenLinea(sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm, fila, sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath);
                                        inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath);
                                    }
                                    else
                                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Seleccione una sola línea.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                                }
                                else
                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede Cancelar.  El documento no es una orden de compra o servicio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            }
                            else
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede Cancelar  el documento mientras el formulario este en este estado actual.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        }
                        else
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede Cancelar  el documento mientras el formulario este en modo de actualizar. Actualice primero e intente de nuevo", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                    }
                    break;
                #endregion

                #region MENU SAP CREAR
                case "1282":
                    if (!pVal.BeforeAction)
                    {
                        #region ORDEN DE TRASLADO
                        try
                        {
                            oForm = sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm;
                            if (oForm.TypeEx.Equals("OK1_SF_ORDENTRA"))
                            {
                                #region  FORMULARIO ADD_MODE
                                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                                {
                                    OrdenTraslado.crearFormulario(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, StrPath);
                                }
                                #endregion
                            }
                            // para cuando los campos de usuarios estan abierto el sistema le antepone al TypeEx un menos y asi lo deberia resolver.
                            else
                                if (oForm.TypeEx.Contains("-OK1_SF_ORDENTRA"))
                            {
                                #region  FORMULARIO ADD_MODE
                                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                                {
                                    OrdenTraslado.crearFormulario(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, StrPath);
                                }
                                #endregion
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception er)
                        {
                            // throw new OK1.ExceptionManager.GenericException(this.rmManager.GetString("strGenericError") + er.Message);
                        }


                        #endregion
                    }
                    break;
                #endregion

                #region MENU ELIMINAR SAP
                case "1283"://boton  del menu
                    if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                    {
                        #region FORMULARIO DE ORDEN LABORATORIO
                        oForm = sapApplication.Forms.ActiveForm;
                        if (oForm.TypeEx.Equals("OK1_SF_ORDENTRA"))
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede eliminar el registro de la orden de traslado directamente. Para proceder, por favor, cancela o anula la orden desde las opciones correspondientes.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                sapApplication.MessageBox("No se puede eliminar el registro de la orden de traslado directamente. Para proceder, por favor, cancela o anula la orden desde las opciones correspondientes.");
                                BubbleEvent = false;
                            }
                            catch (Exception e) { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "evtMenuHandler", sapCompany); }
                        }

                        else
                            if (oForm.TypeEx.Contains("-OK1_SF_ORDENTRA"))
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede eliminar el registro de la orden de traslado directamente. Para proceder, por favor, cancela o anula la orden desde las opciones correspondientes.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                sapApplication.MessageBox("No se puede eliminar el registro de la orden de traslado directamente. Para proceder, por favor, cancela o anula la orden desde las opciones correspondientes.");
                                BubbleEvent = false;
                            }
                            catch (Exception e) { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "evtMenuHandler", sapCompany); }

                        }

                        #endregion
                    }
                    break;
                    #endregion


            }

        }
        #endregion

        #region evtItemHandler: eventos de item sobre el formulario
        public static void evtItemHandler(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.ItemEvent pVal, ref bool BubbleEvent, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string StrPath, int iBranch)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = null;

            switch (pVal.EventType)
            {
                #region ITEM_PRESSED
                case BoEventTypes.et_ITEM_PRESSED:
                    switch (pVal.ItemUID)
                    {
                        #region Manejo de Pestañas y PaneLevels

                        case "P_3":
                            if (!pVal.BeforeAction)
                            {
                                oForm.PaneLevel = 3;
                                #region inhabilitar columnas matriz de elementos
                                inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath);
                                #endregion
                            }
                            break;
                        #endregion

                        #region "1" creación de la orden de traslado
                        case "1":
                            if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                            {
                                if (!oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Enabled)
                                {
                                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE || oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE)
                                    {

                                        string mensaje = string.Empty;
                                        BubbleEvent = OrdenTraslado.validarOrdenTraslado(sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath, oForm, ref mensaje);
                                        string estado = string.Empty;
                                        if (BubbleEvent)
                                        {
                                            if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE || oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE)
                                            {
                                                #region cambiar estado
                                                estado = estadosOT(oForm, sapCompany);

                                                bool FaltanOrdenCompraOT = false;
                                                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE)
                                                {
                                                    string liberar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar", 0).Trim();

                                                    if (estado.Equals("Cerrado") && BubbleEvent && liberar.Equals("Y"))
                                                    {

                                                        mensaje = verificarOrdenesObligatorias(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath);
                                                        if (!mensaje.Equals(""))
                                                        {

                                                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Validacion : " + mensaje + " No se puede cerrar la orden de traslado", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                                            sapApplication.MessageBox("Validacion : " + mensaje + " No se puede cerrar la orden de traslado");
                                                            FaltanOrdenCompraOT = true;

                                                        }
                                                        else
                                                        {
                                                            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;
                                                            ocmb.Select(estado, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                                            oForm.Items.Item("txtKmIni").Enabled = false;
                                                            oForm.Items.Item("txtKmFin").Enabled = false;
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                }

                                                if (!FaltanOrdenCompraOT && !estado.Equals("Cerrado"))
                                                {

                                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;
                                                    ocmb.Select(estado, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                                }

                                            }
                                        }

                                        ServicioFunerario.BloquearCeldasComentarios("mtxComen", "comentario", oForm);

                                    if (!pVal.BeforeAction && oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                                    {
                                        crearFormulario(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, StrPath);
                                    }

                                }

                                    int cantidad = Convert.ToInt16(string.IsNullOrEmpty(((EditText)oMatrixElemen.GetCellSpecific("cantUsada", i)).Value.ToString().Trim()) ? "0" : ((EditText)oMatrixElemen.GetCellSpecific("cantUsada", i)).Value.ToString().Trim());
                                    string invent = ((EditText)oMatrixElemen.GetCellSpecific("invent", i)).Value.ToString().Trim();

                                            {

                                                if (cantidad > 0)
                                                {
                                                    //declare stock transfer object
                                                    SAPbobsCOM.StockTransfer oST;

                                                    //string whsDest = ((EditText)oMatrixElemen.GetCellSpecific("almDest", i)).Value.ToString().Trim();

                                                    string query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "Retornar_CC_ConvenioSF", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                                                    {

                                                        cc1 = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                                        cc2 = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                                        cc3 = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                                        cc4 = ors.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nConvenio))
                                                        {
                                                            prjCode = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONV_HEAD", "U_prjCode", "DocEntry", nConvenio, sapCompany);
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    #endregion


                                                    oST.DocDate = DateTime.Now;
                                                    oST.FromWarehouse = whsOri;
                                                    oST.Lines.ItemCode = articulo;
                                                    oST.Lines.WarehouseCode = whsDest;
                                                    //serial number hardcoded here but must exist in the warehouse 01 for item A1000
                                                    oST.Lines.SerialNumbers.InternalSerialNumber = serie;
                                                    oST.Lines.Quantity = cantidad;
                                                    oST.Lines.SerialNumbers.Add();
                                                    oST.Lines.ProjectCode = prjCode;

                                                    //add the second
                                                    oST.Lines.Add();
                                                    int lRetCode = oST.Add();
                                                    if (lRetCode != 0)

                                                        string errorDesc = sapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                                                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error en el artículo " + articulo + ". Linea " + i + ": " + errorDesc, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                                    }

                                                        string DocNum = sapCompany.GetNewObjectKey();
                                                        oMatrixElemen.SetCellWithoutValidation(i, "nroTras", DocNum);
                                                        update = true;
                                                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Se ha creado exitosamente la Entrega", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                                        SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrixElemen.CommonSetting;
                                                        setting.SetRowEditable(i, false);
                                                        oMatrixElemen.SetCellWithoutValidation(i, "uso", "Y");
                                                    }
                                                }
                                                else
                                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El artículo " + articulo + " no tiene cantidad usada. Linea " + i, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                            }
                                            else
                                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El artículo " + articulo + "no tiene asignado un almacen destino o es el mismo del origen. Linea " + i, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);

                                }

                        #endregion

                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(cmbLugInhD);

                                }

                        #endregion
                        #region parenAcom

                                {
                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox parenAcom = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("parenAcom").Specific;
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(parenAcom);
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, parenAcom, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PARENTESCOS\" WHERE \"U_INT_Activo\" = 'SI'");

                                }
                                catch (Exception e)
                                {
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CLICK", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                                }
                            }
                            break;
                        #endregion
                        #region cmbDepOrg
                        case "cmbDepOrg":
                            if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbDepOrg = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Specific;
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(cmbDepOrg);
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, cmbDepOrg, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_DEP\"");

                                }
                                catch (Exception e)
                                {
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CLICK", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                                }
                            }
                            break;
                        #endregion
                        #region cmbDepDes
                        case "cmbDepDes":
                            if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbDepDes = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepDes").Specific;
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(cmbDepDes);
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, cmbDepDes, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_DEP\"");

                                }
                                catch (Exception e)
                                {
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CLICK", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                                }
                            }
                            break;
                        #endregion
                        #region cmbAeroliO
                        case "cmbAeroliO":
                            if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbAeroliO = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmbAeroliO").Specific;
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(cmbAeroliO);
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, cmbAeroliO, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_AEROLINEAS\"");

                                }
                                catch (Exception e)
                                {

                        #endregion
                        #region cmbAeroliD
                        case "cmbAeroliD":
                            if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                            {
                                try

                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbAeroliD = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmbAeroliD").Specific;
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(cmbAeroliD);
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, cmbAeroliD, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_AEROLINEAS\"");

                                }
                                catch (Exception e)
                                {
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CLICK", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                                }
                            }
                            break;
                        #endregion

                        #region Tipo de articulo Traslado (lista de materiales)
                        case "ETipArtT":
                            if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    // TIPO DE ARTICULO TRASLADO
                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("ETipArtT").Specific;
                                    string querys = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ListasMateriales_tipoArtTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                                }
                                catch (Exception e)
                                {
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ETipArtT", sapCompany);
                                }
                            }
                            break;
                            #endregion
                    }
                    break;
                #endregion
                #region FORM_CLOSE
                case BoEventTypes.et_FORM_CLOSE:
                    if (pVal.BeforeAction)
                    {
                        if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE || oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                        {
                            oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE;

                        }
                    }
                    break;
                    #endregion

            }


        }

        #region evtFormDataHandler: eventos del formulario
        public static void evtFormDataHandler(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.BusinessObjectInfo BusinessObjectInfo, ref bool BubbleEvent, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string StrPath)
        {
            oForm = sapApplication.Forms.Item(BusinessObjectInfo.FormUID);
            switch (BusinessObjectInfo.EventType)
            {
                #region actualizar
                case BoEventTypes.et_FORM_DATA_UPDATE:

                    if (BusinessObjectInfo.BeforeAction)
                    {

                        SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboEstado = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;
                        string EstadoNuevo = oComboEstado.Selected.Value.ToString();
                        string EstadoActual = EstadoActualOT(sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString().Trim());
                        if (EstadoActual.Equals("Cerrado"))
                        {
                            if (!EstadoActual.Equals(EstadoNuevo))
                            {
                                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxComen").Specific;
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").Clear();
                                oMtx.AddRow(1, oMtx.RowCount);
                                oMtx.FlushToDataSource();
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_usuComen", oMtx.RowCount - 1, sapCompany.UserName);
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_fecComen", oMtx.RowCount - 1, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(DateTime.Now, sapApplication));
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_hora", oMtx.RowCount - 1, DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm"));
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_tipComen", oMtx.RowCount - 1, "Cambio de estado");
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_comentario", oMtx.RowCount - 1, "Cambio de estado de " + EstadoActual + " a " + EstadoNuevo);
                                oMtx.LoadFromDataSourceEx();

                            }
                            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox ComboEstadoOT = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(ComboEstadoOT);
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, ComboEstadoOT, OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "EstadosOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query"));

                        }

                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (BusinessObjectInfo.ActionSuccess)
                        {
                            string docEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim();

                            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
                            try
                            {
                                string strQry = string.Empty;
                                string nroSF = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_nroOrdenSF", 0).Trim();
                                string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).Trim();
                                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSF) && estado.Equals("Cerrado"))
                                {
                                    SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                    {
                                        bool uso = ((CheckBox)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("uso", i)).Checked;
                                        string lineIdSf = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("lineaSF", i)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineIdSf))
                                        {
                                            strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ActualizarUsoServicioFunerario", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                            strQry = strQry.Replace("%Uso%", uso ? "Y" : "N");
                                            strQry = strQry.Replace("%NroSF%", nroSF.Trim());
                                            strQry = strQry.Replace("%NumeroLineaSF%", lineIdSf);
                                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                            }
                            catch (Exception e)
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error al actualizar la solicitud de traslado" + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addinSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                            }
                            finally
                            {
                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                            }


                            string kmAdicional = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_kilAdic", 0).Trim();
                            string kmAdicionalTmp = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DKmAdi").ValueEx;
                            if (kmAdicionalTmp != null)
                                if (!kmAdicionalTmp.Equals(kmAdicional))
                                {
                                    string mensaje = string.Empty;
                                    GenerarAlertOT(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, StrPath, ref mensaje);

                                }
                            bloquearCampos(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath);
                            ServicioFunerario.BloquearCeldasComentarios("mtxComen", "comentario", oForm);

                        }

                        if (HabilitaReabrirOT(sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath, oForm))
                        {

                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "cbEstOT", true);
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "1", true);
                        }
                        else
                        {

                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "cbEstOT", false);
                        }
                    }

                    break;
                #endregion
                #region cargar
                case BoEventTypes.et_FORM_DATA_LOAD:
                    if (!BusinessObjectInfo.BeforeAction)
                    {

                        oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DKmAdi").Value = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_kilAdic", 0).Trim();
                        OrdenTraslado.bloquearCampos(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath);
                        string origen = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoTraslOrg", 0).Trim();
                        string destino = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoTraslDes", 0).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(origen))
                        {
                            CargarInfoTipoTraslado(oForm, origen, "O", sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath);

                        }
                        else
                        {
                            ocultarCamposOrigen(oForm);
                        }

                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(destino))
                        {
                            CargarInfoTipoTraslado(oForm, destino, "D", sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath);

                        }
                        else
                        {
                            ocultarCamposDestino(oForm);
                        }
                        deshabilitarCamposItinerario(oForm, false);
                        CargarInfoCombos(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath);
                        oForm.Items.Item("P_1").Click();
                        ServicioFunerario.BloquearCeldasComentarios("mtxComen", "comentario", oForm);

                        string liberar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar", 0).Trim();
                        if (liberar.Equals("Y"))
                        {
                            oForm.Items.Item("txtKmIni").Enabled = false;
                            oForm.Items.Item("txtKmFin").Enabled = false;
                        }

                        oForm.Items.Item("Apoyo").Enabled = false;
                        oForm.Items.Item("VehIg").Enabled = false;


                        if (HabilitaReabrirOT(sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath, oForm))
                        {

                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "cbEstOT", true);
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "1", true);
                        }
                        else
                        {

                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "cbEstOT", false);
                        }

                    }
                    break;
                #endregion
                #region adicionar
                case BoEventTypes.et_FORM_DATA_ADD:
                    if (BusinessObjectInfo.ActionSuccess)
                    {
                        string nroST = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_numSolTras", 0).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroST))
                        {

                            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
                            try
                            {

                                string strQry = string.Empty;
                                string nroSF = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_nroOrdenSF", 0).Trim();
                                string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).Trim();
                                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSF) && estado.Equals("Cerrado"))
                                {
                                    SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                    {
                                        bool uso = ((CheckBox)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("uso", i)).Checked;
                                        string lineIdSf = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("lineaSF", i)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineIdSf))
                                        {
                                            strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ActualizarUsoServicioFunerario", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                            strQry = strQry.Replace("%Uso%", uso ? "Y" : "N");
                                            strQry = strQry.Replace("%NroSF%", nroSF.Trim());
                                            strQry = strQry.Replace("%NumeroLineaSF%", lineIdSf);
                                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                #region Actualizar estado Solicitud
                                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ActualizarEstadoSolicitud", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroSolicitud%", nroST);
                                oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                                #endregion
                            }
                            catch (Exception e)
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error al crear la solicitud de traslado" + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addinSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                            }
                            finally
                            {
                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                            }
                        }

                        #region Crear Lista de chequeo
                        string U_tipOrden = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoOrd", 0).Trim();
                        if (U_tipOrden.Equals("D"))
                        {

                            string idSolicitud = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_nroOrdenSF", 0).Trim();
                            string docentryOT = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim();
                            string docentryList = OrdenTraslado.crearListaChequeoTraslado(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication, idSolicitud, docentryOT, StrPath);
                        }
                        #endregion

                        //string resul = OrdenTraslado.estadosOT(oForm);
                        string kmAdicional = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_kilAdic", 0).Trim();
                        string kmAdicionalTmp = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DKmAdi").ValueEx;
                        if (!kmAdicionalTmp.Equals(kmAdicional))
                        {
                            string mensaje = string.Empty;
                            GenerarAlertOT(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, StrPath, ref mensaje);
                        }
                        string docEntry = OK1.SBO.Helpers.GetLastDocEntry("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA", sapCompany);

                        SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSEliminar = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
                        try
                        {

                            string strQry = string.Empty;
                            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix1 = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxComen").Specific;
                            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix2 = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxAnexo").Specific;
                            if (oMatrix.RowCount == 0)
                            {
                                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "eliminarLineaEle", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                strQry = strQry.Replace("%docentry%", docEntry.Trim());
                                oRSEliminar.DoQuery(strQry);
                            }
                            if (oMatrix1.RowCount == 0)
                            {
                                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "eliminarLineaCom", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                strQry = strQry.Replace("%docentry%", docEntry.Trim());
                                oRSEliminar.DoQuery(strQry);
                            }
                            if (oMatrix2.RowCount == 0)
                            {
                                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "eliminarLineaAne", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                strQry = strQry.Replace("%docentry%", docEntry.Trim());
                                oRSEliminar.DoQuery(strQry);
                            }

                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error al actualizar la solicitud de traslado" + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addinSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                        }
                        finally
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRSEliminar);
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                    #endregion

            }
            BubbleEvent = true;
        }

        private static void CargarInfoCombos(Form oFormActividad, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application SBOApplication, string StrPath)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = null;

            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cbTipoTras").Specific;
            string tipoTras = oCombo.Value;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"OCLS\" WHERE \"Type\" = (SELECT \"Code\" FROM OCLT WHERE \"U_tipoAct\" = 'T') AND  \"Code\" = '" + tipoTras + "'  " + "AND \"Active\" = 'Y'");

            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbTiViajO").Specific;
            string cmbTiViajO = oCombo.Value;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_TIPTRASNAC\" WHERE \"U_act\"= 'Y' AND  \"Code\" = '" + cmbTiViajO + "'");

            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbTiViajD").Specific;
            string cmbTiViajD = oCombo.Value;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_TIPTRASNAC\" WHERE \"U_act\"= 'Y' AND  \"Code\" = '" + cmbTiViajD + "'");

            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbNomFunO").Specific;
            string cmbNomFunO = oCombo.Value;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_FUNERARIAS\" WHERE \"Code\" = '" + cmbNomFunO + "'");

            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbNomFunD").Specific;
            string cmbNomFunD = oCombo.Value;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_FUNERARIAS\" WHERE \"Code\" = '" + cmbNomFunD + "'");

            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("parenAcom").Specific;
            string parenAcom = oCombo.Value;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PARENTESCOS\" WHERE \"U_INT_Activo\" = 'SI' AND  \"Code\" = '" + parenAcom + "'");

            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Specific;
            string cmbDepOrg = oCombo.Value;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_DEP\" WHERE  \"Code\" = '" + cmbDepOrg + "'");

            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepDes").Specific;
            string cmbDepDes = oCombo.Value;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);

        #region habilitar campos de busqueda
        public static void habilitarBuscar(SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string StrPath)
        {
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);

                oForm.Items.Item("P_2").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);

                string[] strCamposbase = { "txtOri" ,"txtDes", "series","chbCanc","cbAnular","fcFecCan","txtHorCan", "txtMotivo", "horIniPro", "horFinPro",
                                           "chCritico", "chSimul", "chHomeEsp", "cbLiberar", "fecLiber", "horLiber", "cbLiberar2", "horLiber2","fecLiber2", "kilAdic", "cbAcompa",
                                           "txtIdAcomp", "nomAcompa",  "telAcompa","parenAcom","estadoVia","valComi","medCofre" , "tiempoResp", "horaResp","elemTras", "mtxElemen",
                                           "mtxComen", "mtxAnexo", "cmbTipTrsO", "cmbTipTrsD", "chCritico", "chSimul", "86", "chHomeEsp", "cbHoraAd"};

                string[] strCamposbaseCabecera = { "cbSeries", "cbTipoOrd","cbTipoTras" ,"cbSede", "txtFecCoor","txtHorCoor","docEntry","nroST","OTCance", "txtNroOSF", "EdTipLisCh", "txtLCH",
                                                   "txtIdFall","txtNomFall","docnumSF","docNum","fecIniPro","fecFinPro","cflCondAsi","CondAsi2","cflvehiAsi","vehiAsi2","cbTipCond", "TipCond2",
                                                   "cbTipVehi", "TipVehi2", "cbEstOT"};


                foreach (string campo in strCamposbase)
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item(campo).Enabled = false;
                }

                foreach (string campo in strCamposbaseCabecera)
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item(campo).Enabled = true;
                }

                oForm.Items.Item("1").Enabled = true;

                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox ComboEstadoOT = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(ComboEstadoOT);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, ComboEstadoOT, OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "EstadosOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query"));


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "habilitarBuscar", sapCompany);


            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }


        }
