        #region crear formulario
        public static void crearFormulario(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string StrPath)
        {
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);

                DateTime localDate = DateTime.Now;
                string fechaActual = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(localDate, sapApplication);
                string hora_Actual = DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm");
                if (oForm.Mode.Equals(SAPbouiCOM.BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE))
                {
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_fecCooTras", 0, fechaActual);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_horCooTras", 0, hora_Actual);

                }

                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbEstOT = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;
                cmbEstOT.Select("0", BoSearchKey.psk_Index);

                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbTipoTras = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbTipoTras").Specific;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, cmbTipoTras, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"OCLS\" WHERE \"Type\" = (SELECT \"Code\" FROM OCLT WHERE \"U_tipoAct\" = 'T')  AND \"Active\" = 'Y'");


                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Specific;
                OrdenTraslado.populateComboBox(ref oCombo, sapCompany, "OTER", "territryID", "descript", "U_Tipo", "S");
                oCombo.Select("0", BoSearchKey.psk_Index);


                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ETipArtT", true);
                // TIPO DE ARTICULO
                oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("ETipArtT").Specific;

                string querys = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ListasMateriales_tipoArtTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oCombo, querys);


                if (oForm.Mode.Equals(SAPbouiCOM.BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE))
                {
                    string docentry = Convert.ToString(Convert.ToInt16(OK1.SBO.Helpers.GetLastDocEntry("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA", sapCompany)) + 1);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("docEntry", 0, docentry);
                    restaurarCampos(oForm);
                    ocultarCamposOrigen(oForm);
                    ocultarCamposDestino(oForm);
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtFecCoor").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtHorCoor").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("btTrasStoc").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("btnSalMe").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("btnOC").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsD").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("chbCanc").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("cbAnular").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("cbLiberar").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("cbLiberar2").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("TipCond2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("CondAsi2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("TipVehi2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("vehiAsi2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("KMIni2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("KMFin2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("KMAdc2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("HorAdc2").Enabled = false;
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!oForm.Mode.Equals(SAPbouiCOM.BoFormMode.fm_FIND_MODE))
                        bloquearCampos(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath);
                }


                oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("parenAcom").Specific;
                OrdenTraslado.populateComboBox(ref oCombo, sapCompany, "@OK1_EXE_PARENTESCOS", "Code", "Name", "U_INT_Activo", "SI");

                #region cargar la serie por defecto segun la sede
                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboSede = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Specific;
                string sede = oComboSede.Selected.Value.ToString();
                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    loadSeriesporDefecto(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath, sede);
                }
                #endregion
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "crearFormulario", sapCompany);

            }
            finally { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }
        #endregion

        #region abrir formulario
        public static void abrirFormulario(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string StrPath)
        {
            oForm = OK1.SBO.HelpersXMLSBO.LoadFormFromXML(StrPath + @"Forms\OK1_SF_ORDENTRAForm.xml", sapApplication, "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
            try
            {
                DateTime localDate = DateTime.Now;
                string fechaActual = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(localDate, sapApplication);
                string hora_Actual = DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm");
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_fecCooTras", 0, fechaActual);
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_horCooTras", 0, hora_Actual);
                oForm.Items.Item("txtFecCoor").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("txtHorCoor").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("btTrasStoc").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("btnSalMe").Enabled = false;

                //cab feb 2019
                oForm.Items.Item("btnOC").Enabled = false;
                //

                oForm.Freeze(true);
                string docentry = Convert.ToString(Convert.ToInt16(OK1.SBO.Helpers.GetLastDocEntry("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA", sapCompany)) + 1);
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("docEntry", 0, docentry);

                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbEstOT = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;
                cmbEstOT.Select("0", BoSearchKey.psk_Index);


                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Specific;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"territryID\", \"descript\" FROM OTER  WHERE \"U_Tipo\" = 'S' ORDER BY \"descript\"");
                //OrdenTraslado.populateComboBox(ref oCombo, sapCompany, "OTER", "territryID", "descript", "U_Tipo", "S");
                oCombo.Select("0", BoSearchKey.psk_Index);

                //crearCampositinerario(sapApplication, sapCompany, oForm);
                ocultarCamposOrigen(oForm);
                ocultarCamposDestino(oForm);
                //deshabilitarCamposItinerario(oForm, false);
                oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsD").Enabled = false;

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "ETipArtT", true);
                // TIPO DE ARTICULO
                oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("ETipArtT").Specific;
                string querys = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ListasMateriales_tipoArtTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oCombo, querys);

                loadSeriesporDefecto(oForm, sapCompany, StrPath);

            }
            catch { }
            finally { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="sapCompany"></param>
        private static void loadSeriesporDefecto(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSeries").Specific;
            string serie = string.Empty;
            string DocEntrySF = string.Empty;
            string SerieName = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                oCombo.ValidValues.LoadSeries("OK1_SF_ORDENTRA", BoSeriesMode.sf_Add);
                if (oCombo.ValidValues.Count > 0)
                {
                    oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    try
                    {
                        oRS.DoQuery("SELECT \"DfltSeries\" FROM ONNM WHERE \"ObjectCode\" = 'OK1_SF_ORDENTRA'");
                        serie = oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                        oCombo.Select(serie, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                    }
                    catch (Exception)
                    {
                        oCombo.Select(0, BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        if (oRS != null)
                            System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
                    }
                    if (!serie.Equals(string.Empty))
                    {
                        string NextSerie = oForm.BusinessObject.GetNextSerialNumber(serie, "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").ToString();
                        ((EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docNum").Specific).Value = NextSerie;
                    }

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e) { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "loadSeriesporDefecto", sapCompany); }
        }

        public static bool ExisteServiciosFunerariosCerrados(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string docEntrysolicitudOrden, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool existe = false;
            string query = "";
            int cant = 0;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ExisteSolicitudTraServiciosCerrados", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%NroSolicitud%", docEntrysolicitudOrden.Trim());

                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    cant = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                    if (cant > 0)
                        existe = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteEntradaMercancia", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        #region traer los datos de solicitud de traslado
        public static void datosSolTras(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string StrPath, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool canc)
        {
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Cargando datos...", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                string nroST = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_numSolTras", 0).Trim();
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroST))
                {
                    #region cargar datos de solicitid traslado
                    bool ServicioCerrado = ExisteServiciosFunerariosCerrados(sapCompany, nroST, StrPath);

                    if (!ServicioCerrado)
                    {
                        #region info solicitud de traslado
                        SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
                        try
                        {
                            oForm.Freeze(true);
                            string strQry = string.Empty;

                            strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ObtenerVinculoSolicitud", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            strQry = strQry.Replace("%DocEntry%", nroST.Trim());
                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                            string DocEntryOrdenParque = oRS.Fields.Item("U_DocEntryOPC").Value.ToString();

                            strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "cabeceraOrdenTras", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            strQry = strQry.Replace("%docEntry%", nroST.Trim());

                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DocEntryOrdenParque) || DocEntryOrdenParque.Equals("0"))
                            {
                                strQry = strQry.Replace("%TablaInner%", "@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");
                                strQry = strQry.Replace("%OnTablaInner%", "U_DocEntry");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                strQry = strQry.Replace("%TablaInner%", "@OK1_PQC_OPARQ_HEAD");
                                strQry = strQry.Replace("%OnTablaInner%", "U_DocEntryOPC");
                            }

                            oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                            if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                            {
                                int cant = Convert.ToInt16(oRS.Fields.Item("Asignado").Value.ToString());
                                if (cant > 0 && !canc)
                                {
                                    #region VALIDACION ya esta asignada a otra orden de traslado
                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("La solicitud de traslado " + nroST + " ya esta asignada a otra orden de traslado. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_numSolTras", 0, "");
                                    #endregion
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    #region DATOS CABECERA
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_nroOrdenSF", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_tipoTras", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("Tipo Traslado").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_idFallec", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_nomFallec", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_nroLC", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString());

                                    try
                                    {
                                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_tipListCh", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipListCh").Value.ToString());
                                    }
                                    catch { }


                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_DocNumSF", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("DocNum").Value.ToString());
                                    string sede = oRS.Fields.Item(8).Value.ToString();

                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_idAcompana", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_identAcompa").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_nomAcompana", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_nombreAcompa").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_telAcompana", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_telefonoAcompa").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_parenAcompa", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_parentescoAcompa").Value.ToString());
                                    string dato = oRS.Fields.Item("U_identAcompa").Value.ToString();

                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_identAcompa").Value.ToString()) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_nombreAcompa").Value.ToString())
                                        || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_telefonoAcompa").Value.ToString()) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_parentescoAcompa").Value.ToString()))
                                    {
                                        if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_acompana", 0).Trim().Equals("N"))
                                            ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oForm.Items.Item("cbAcompa")).Click();
                                    }

                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_simultaneo", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_fallMult").Value.ToString());

                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_tipoOrd", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipoSolic").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_homeEspeci", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_HomEsp").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_estadoVia", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_estadoVias").Value.ToString());
                                    double minutos = Convert.ToDouble(oRS.Fields.Item("Duration").Value) / 60;
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_tiemResp", 0, minutos.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_feciniProgra", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(oRS.Fields.Item("Recontact").Value.ToString()), sapApplication));
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_fecFinProgra", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(oRS.Fields.Item("endDate").Value.ToString()), sapApplication));
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_horIniProgra", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("BeginTime").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_horFinProgra", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("ENDTime").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_horaResp", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_horSolic").Value.ToString());
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_Observac", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("Notes").Value.ToString());
                                    #endregion

                                    #region agrega comentarios lineas
                                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                                    {
                                        try
                                        {
                                            bool Exito = BorrarMatrizComentarios(oForm, sapCompany, sapApplication);

                                            string USERCODE = oRS.Fields.Item("AssignedBy").Value.ToString();
                                            string Comentario = oRS.Fields.Item("Comentario").Value.ToString();

                                            Agregar_lineaMatriz(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtxComen", "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM");
                                            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxComen").Specific;
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").Clear();
                                            oMtx.FlushToDataSource();

                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_usuComen", oMtx.RowCount - 1, DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", USERCODE, sapCompany));
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_fecComen", oMtx.RowCount - 1, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(DateTime.Now, sapApplication));
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_hora", oMtx.RowCount - 1, DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm"));
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").SetValue("U_comentario", oMtx.RowCount - 1, Comentario);
                                            oMtx.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception e)
                                        {
                                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Excepción al ingresar los datos a la matriz. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                                        }

                                    }
                                    #endregion

                                    #region tipo traslado ORIGEN
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipoTraslOrg").Value.ToString()))
                                    {
                                        #region TRASLADO ORIGEN
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Enabled = true;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Enabled = true;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Enabled = true;

                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)(oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Specific)).Select(oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipoTraslOrg").Value.ToString(), SAPbouiCOM.BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);

                                        llenarDatosTras(sapApplication, sapCompany, oForm, StrPath, oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipoTraslOrg").Value.ToString(), nroST, "O");

                                        CargarComboDepartamentoMunicipioOrigen(sapApplication, sapCompany, oForm, nroST);

                                        oForm.Items.Item("P_1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);

                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Enabled = false;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Enabled = false;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Enabled = false;
                                        #endregion

                                    }
                                    #endregion

                                    #region tipo traslado DESTINO
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipoTraslDes").Value.ToString()))
                                    {
                                        #region DESTINO
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsD").Enabled = true;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepDes").Enabled = true;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbMunDes").Enabled = true;

                                        string tipoTraslDes = oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipoTraslDes").Value.ToString();

                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)(oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsD").Specific)).Select(tipoTraslDes, SAPbouiCOM.BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);

                                        llenarDatosTras(sapApplication, sapCompany, oForm, StrPath, oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipoTraslDes").Value.ToString(), nroST, "D");

                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsD").Enabled = false;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepDes").Enabled = false;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("cmbMunDes").Enabled = false;
                                        #endregion
                                    }
                                    #endregion

                                    #region inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos campos cabecera

                                    oForm.Items.Item("P_1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);

                                    oForm.Items.Item("docnumSF").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("txtNroOSF").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("cbTipoTras").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("txtIdFall").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("txtNomFall").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("txtLCH").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("EdTipLisCh").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("txtOri").Enabled = false;
                                    oForm.Items.Item("txtDes").Enabled = false;
                                    #endregion

                                    #region cargar elementos tipo traslado
                                    SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                                    oMatrix.Clear();
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString().Trim()))
                                    {
                                        strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "cabeceraOrdenTrasElementos", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%DocEntry%", oRS.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString().Trim());
                                        strQry = strQry.Replace("%SolicTras%", nroST.Trim());

                                        oRS.DoQuery(strQry);

                                        while (!oRS.EoF)
                                        {
                                            Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "C_CElem", oRS.Fields.Item("U_Codigo").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "C_NElem", oRS.Fields.Item("U_Nombre").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "C_TipArt", "C");
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "C_Item", oRS.Fields.Item("U_ItemCode").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "desiste", oRS.Fields.Item("U_Renuncia").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "cantidad", oRS.Fields.Item("U_Cant").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "desc", oRS.Fields.Item("U_ItemName").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "almOri", oRS.Fields.Item("U_almacen").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "invent", oRS.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "C_linEle", oMatrix.RowCount.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "lineaSF", oRS.Fields.Item("U_IdLinea").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_7", oRS.Fields.Item("U_Documento").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_dedo", oRS.Fields.Item("U_DescDoc").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_tido", oRS.Fields.Item("U_TipDocB1").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "colLinea", oRS.Fields.Item("U_IdLinea").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_linPF", oRS.Fields.Item("U_IdLineaPF").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_contr", oRS.Fields.Item("U_NoContr_Prenec").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_LiqF", oRS.Fields.Item("U_LPagadaPrenec").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_NFPN", oRS.Fields.Item("U_NoFacturaPrenec").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "C_Linea", oRS.Fields.Item("U_Linea").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "C_NLinea", oRS.Fields.Item("U_LineaName").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "coltLinea", oRS.Fields.Item("U_tipLinea").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "LineaPSF", oRS.Fields.Item("U_LineaPadre").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "colArtPB", oRS.Fields.Item("U_ItemCodePB").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_linPPa", oRS.Fields.Item("U_LineaPadrePN").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_tipOrd", "OC");
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_11", "NO");
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "C_Prov", oRS.Fields.Item("U_CardCode").Value.ToString());
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_VlCom", oRS.Fields.Item("U_ValorCom").Value.ToString());

                                            oRS.MoveNext();

                                        }
                                    }
                                    #endregion

                                    #region sede
                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboSede = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Specific;
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sede))
                                    {
                                        oComboSede.Select(sede, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                    }
                                    else
                                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo sede esta vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                    #endregion

                                }
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Excepción al ingresar los datos a la matriz. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
                        }
                        finally
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                            oForm.Freeze(false);
                        }

                        #endregion

                        oForm.Items.Item("P_1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);

                        oForm.Items.Item("cbTipoOrd").Enabled = false;
                    }
                    else
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("el servicio funerario de esta solicitud ya esta Cerrado por Traslado.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    #endregion
                }
                else
                {
                    #region limpiar orden traslado

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_nroOrdenSF", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_tipoTras", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_idFallec", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_nomFallec", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_fecCooTras", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_horCooTras", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_nroLC", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_estadoVia", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_tipoOrd", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_idAcompana", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_nomAcompana", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_telAcompana", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_parenAcompa", 0, "");

                    if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_acompana", 0).Trim().Equals("Y"))
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oForm.Items.Item("cbAcompa")).Click();

                    SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                    oMatrix.Clear();
                    oForm.Items.Item("docnumSF").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtNroOSF").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("cbTipoTras").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtIdFall").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtNomFall").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtFecCoor").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtHorCoor").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtHorCoor").Enabled = true;

                    #endregion
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "datosSolTras", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }

        }
        #endregion

        #region validar datos de traslado antes de guardar
        public static bool validarOrdenTraslado(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string StrPath, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, ref string mensaje)
        {
            bool bEvent = true;
            string cancelado = string.Empty;
            string anulado = string.Empty;

            string fechaCan = string.Empty;
            string horaCan = string.Empty;
            string motivoCan = string.Empty;

            string origen = string.Empty;
            string destino = string.Empty;
            string kmAdicional = string.Empty;

            bool puedeAnular = false;
            bool puedeCancelar = false;

            bool errorAC = false;
            bool ExistenDocumentosCreados = false;

            try
            {
                #region Campos Obligatorios

                #endregion

                cancelado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cancelar", 0).Trim();
                anulado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_anular", 0).Trim();

                fechaCan = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecCancel", 0).Trim();
                horaCan = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horaCancel", 0).Trim();
                motivoCan = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_motivCance", 0).Trim();

                origen = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoTraslOrg", 0).Trim();
                destino = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoTraslDes", 0).Trim();
                kmAdicional = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_kilAdic", 0).Trim();

                #region anulado
                if (anulado.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    mensaje = string.Empty;
                    puedeAnular = false;
                    errorAC = false;
                    ExistenDocumentosCreados = ExistenDocumentoMarketingCreadosMatrizElementos(oForm, sapCompany, ref mensaje, sapApplication);

                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaCan) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaCan) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(motivoCan))
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Debe ingresar la fecha, hora y motivo de cancelación", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                        mensaje = "Debe ingresar la fecha, hora y motivo de cancelación";
                        bEvent = false;
                    }

                    if (ExistenDocumentosCreados && !errorAC)
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Excepcion Existen documentos creados " + mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        mensaje = "Excepcion Existen documentos creados " + mensaje;
                        bEvent = false;
                    }

                    puedeAnular = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaCan) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaCan) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(motivoCan) && !ExistenDocumentosCreados;

                    if (puedeAnular)
                        bEvent = true;
                    else
                        bEvent = false;
                }
                #endregion

                #region cancelacion
                #region cancelacion
                if (cancelado.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    mensaje = string.Empty;
                    puedeCancelar = false;
                    errorAC = false;
                    ExistenDocumentosCreados = ExistenDocumentoMarketingCreadosMatrizElementos(oForm, sapCompany, ref mensaje, sapApplication);

                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaCan) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaCan) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(motivoCan))
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Debe ingresar la fecha, hora y motivo de cancelación", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                        mensaje = "Debe ingresar la fecha, hora y motivo de cancelación";
                    }

                    if (ExistenDocumentosCreados && !errorAC)
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Excepcion Existen documentos creados " + mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        mensaje = "Excepcion Existen documentos creados " + mensaje;
                    }
                    puedeCancelar = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaCan) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaCan) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(motivoCan) && !ExistenDocumentosCreados;

                    if (puedeCancelar)
                        bEvent = true;
                    else
                        bEvent = false;
                }
                #endregion

                #region  CANCELACION DE TRASLADO
                if (!cancelado.Equals("Y") && !anulado.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    if (origen.Equals("TraslFuera") || destino.Equals("TraslFuera"))
                    {
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(kmAdicional))
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Kilometraje adcional es obligatorio debido a que el traslado es nacional", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "Kilometraje adcional es obligatorio debido a que el traslado es nacional";
                            bEvent = false;
                        }
                    }

                    Hashtable hTObligatorio = new Hashtable();
                    hTObligatorio.Add("U_fecIniProgra", "Fecha Inicial Programada");
                    hTObligatorio.Add("U_horIniProgra", "Hora Inicial Programada");
                    hTObligatorio.Add("U_fecFinProgra", "Fecha Final Programada");
                    hTObligatorio.Add("U_horFinProgra", "Hora Final Programada");

                    hTObligatorio.Add("U_tipoCond", "Tipo Conductor");
                    hTObligatorio.Add("U_condAsig", "Conductor");
                    hTObligatorio.Add("U_tipoVehi", "Tipo Vehiculo");
                    hTObligatorio.Add("U_vehiAsig", "Vehiculo");


                    string error = validarCamposObligatorios(oForm, hTObligatorio);
                    int cant = error.Split(',').Length;


                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(error) && cant < 13)
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Los campos " + error + "son obligatorios", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                        mensaje = "Los campos " + error + "son obligatorios";
                        return false;
                    }
                    else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
                    {
                        #region Validacion de disponibilidad para conductores y vehiculos

                        SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                        string DocEntryOT = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString().Trim();

                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DocEntryOT))
                        {
                            DocEntryOT = "0";
                        }

                        string FechaInicial = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecIniProgra", 0).Trim();

                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FechaInicial))
                        {
                            FechaInicial = "19000101";
                        }

                        string HoraInicial = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horIniProgra", 0).Trim();

                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(HoraInicial))
                        {
                            HoraInicial = "0000";
                        }

                        string FechaFinal = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecFinProgra", 0).Trim();

                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FechaFinal))
                        {
                            FechaFinal = "21000101";
                        }

                        string HoraFinal = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horFinProgra", 0).Trim();

                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(HoraFinal))
                        {
                            HoraFinal = "2359";
                        }

                        string VehiculoPrincipal = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehiAsig", 0).Trim();

                        string VehiculoApoyo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehi2Asig", 0).Trim();

                        string ConductorPrincipal = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_condAsig", 0).Trim();

                        string ConductorApoyo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cond2Asig", 0).Trim();

                        if (!((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("chSimul").Specific).Checked)
                        {

                            #region Disponibilidad Vehiculos

                            string QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "DisponibilidadVehiculosCreacionOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                            QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos = QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos.Replace("%FechaInicial%", FechaInicial);

                            QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos = QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos.Replace("%FechaFinal%", FechaFinal);

                            QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos = QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos.Replace("%HoraInicial%", HoraInicial);

                            QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos = QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos.Replace("%HoraFinal%", HoraFinal);

                            QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos = QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos.Replace("%VehiculoPrincipal%", VehiculoPrincipal);

                            QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos = QueryDisponibilidadVehiculos.Replace("%VehiculoApoyo%", VehiculoApoyo);

                            if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)

                                sapApplication.MessageBox("El vehiculo: " + oRecordSet.Fields.Item("Vehiculo asignado").Value.ToString() + " esta asignado en al orden de traslado " + oRecordSet.Fields.Item("Orden de traslado").Value.ToString() + ".", 1, "Aceptar", "", "");

                                return false;
                            }

                            string QueryDisponibilidadConductores = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "DisponibilidadConductoresCreacionOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                            QueryDisponibilidadConductores = QueryDisponibilidadConductores.Replace("%ConductorPrincipal%", ConductorPrincipal);

                            QueryDisponibilidadConductores = QueryDisponibilidadConductores.Replace("%ConductorApoyo%", ConductorApoyo);

                            QueryDisponibilidadConductores = QueryDisponibilidadConductores.Replace("%DocEntryOT%", DocEntryOT);

                            oRecordSet.DoQuery(QueryDisponibilidadConductores);

                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El Conductor: " + oRecordSet.Fields.Item("Conductor Asignado").Value.ToString() + " esta asignado en al orden de traslado " + oRecordSet.Fields.Item("Orden de traslado").Value.ToString() + ".", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE || oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE)

                        string U_munOrigen = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_munOrigen", 0).Trim();

                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_tipoTras) && !error)
                        {

                            mensaje = "El campo tipo de lista de chequeo no puede ser vacio.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;

                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo numero de lista de chequeo no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "El campo numero de lista de chequeo no puede ser vacio.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;
                        }

                        #region sf comodin 
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_nroOrdenSF) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo Nro. De servicio funerario comodín  no puede ser vacío, es posible que falte diligenciarlo en parámetros generales.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "El campo Nro.De servicio funerario comodín  no puede ser vacío, es posible que falte diligenciarlo en parámetros generales.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;
                        }
                        #endregion



                        // origen
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_depOrigen) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo departamento origen no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "El campo departamento origen no puede ser vacio.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;

                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo municipio origen no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "El campo municipio origen no puede ser vacio.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;
                        }
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_direcOrg) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo direccion origen no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "El campo direccion origen no puede ser vacio.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;
                        }

                        // destino
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_depDest) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo departamento destino no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "El campo departamento destino no puede ser vacio.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;
                        }
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_munDest) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo municipio destino no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "El campo municipio destino no puede ser vacio.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;
                        }
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_direcDest) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo direccion destino no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            mensaje = "El campo direccion destino no puede ser vacio.";
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        #region NO DIRECTA que viene de servicio funerario
                        string U_idFallec = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_idFallec", 0).Trim();
                        string U_nomFallec = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_nomFallec", 0).Trim();
                        string U_nroLC = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_nroLC", 0).Trim();
                        string U_tipListCh = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipListCh", 0).Trim();

                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_idFallec) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo id de fallecido no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            bEvent = false;

                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_nomFallec) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo nombre del fallecido no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;
                        }
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(U_tipListCh) && !error)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El campo tipo de lista de chequeo no puede ser vacio.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            bEvent = false;

                            bEvent = false;
                            error = true;

                string Apoyo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_Apoyo", 0).Trim();

                string Veh1Veh2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_VehIg", 0).Trim();

                if (Apoyo.Equals("Y") && Veh1Veh2.Equals("N"))
                {

                    string TipoConductor2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoCond2", 0).Trim();

                    string ConductorAsignado2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cond2Asig", 0).Trim();

                    string TipoVehiculo2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoVehi2", 0).Trim();

                    string Vehiculo2Asignar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehi2Asig", 0).Trim();

                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(TipoConductor2) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConductorAsignado2) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(TipoVehiculo2) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Vehiculo2Asignar))
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Los campos relacionados con la asignación de Conductor y Vehículo de Apoyo son obligatorios", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                        mensaje = "Los campos relacionados con la asignación de Conductor y Vehículo de Apoyo son obligatorios";

                        bEvent = false;
                    }
                }

                #endregion

                #region Validacion KM inicial y final
                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE)
                {
                    var ParametrosAValidar = new List<(string KmInicial, string KmFinal, bool VehiculoPrincipal)>
                    {

                    };

                    if (!((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbLiberar").Specific).Checked)
                    {
                        ParametrosAValidar.Add(("U_KmInicial", "U_KmFinal", true));
                    }

                    if (Apoyo.Equals("Y") && Veh1Veh2.Equals("N") && !((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbLiberar2").Specific).Checked)
                    {
                        ParametrosAValidar.Add(("U_KmInicial2", "U_KmFinal2", false));
                    }

                    foreach (var Parametros in ParametrosAValidar)
                    {
                        bEvent = ValidacionKMFinal(sapCompany, sapApplication, StrPath, oForm, Parametros.VehiculoPrincipal, Parametros.KmInicial, Parametros.KmFinal, true);

                    }
                }


                #endregion
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                string Error = e.ToString();
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "validarOrdenTraslado", sapCompany);
            }

            return bEvent;
        }

        public static bool ExistenDocumentoMarketingCreadosMatrizElementos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool error = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;

            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                while (indice <= omtx.RowCount && !salir)
                {
                    if (existen_DocumentosCreadosOSLinea(oForm, ocmp, ref mensaje, indice))
                    {
                        error = true;
                        salir = true;
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExistenDocumentosCreadosMatrizElementos", ocmp);
            }
            return error;
        }

        public static bool existen_DocumentosCreadosOSLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, int fila)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            string OrdenGenerada = "";
            string DocumentoOrden = "";
            string Documento = "";
            string NoDoc = "";
            string nroTrasArt = "";


            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();

                NoDoc = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", fila).Trim();
                Documento = oDBS1.GetValue("U_DescDoc", fila).Trim();
                DocumentoOrden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docOrd", fila).Trim();
                OrdenGenerada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ordCom", fila).Trim();
                nroTrasArt = oDBS1.GetValue("U_nroTrasArt", fila).Trim();


                if (!NoDoc.Equals(""))
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = NoDoc;
                }
                if (!Documento.Equals("") && !existe)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = Documento;
                }
                if (!OrdenGenerada.Equals("NO") && (!OrdenGenerada.Equals("") && !existe))
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = DocumentoOrden;
                }
                if (!DocumentoOrden.Equals("") && !existe)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = DocumentoOrden;
                }
                if (!nroTrasArt.Equals(string.Empty) && !existe)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    mensaje = nroTrasArt;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_DocumentosCreadosOSLinea", ocmp);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        #region estadosOT estados de la orden de traslado
        public static string estadosOT(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company Company)
        {
            string resp = "Abierto";

            try
            {
                string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_estOT", 0).Trim();
                string nroSolTras = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_numSolTras", 0).Trim();
                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox cmbEstOT = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;

                string cancelado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_cancelar", 0).Trim();
                string anular = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_anular", 0).Trim();
                if (cancelado.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    resp = "Cancelado";
                    return resp;
                }
                if (anular.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    resp = "Anulado";
                    return resp;
                }


                string tipoVehi = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoVehi", 0).Trim();
                string Vehi = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehiAsig", 0).Trim();
                string tipoCond = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_tipoCond", 0).Trim();
                string cond = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_condAsig", 0).Trim();
                string fechaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                string horaIni = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horIniProgra", 0).Trim();
                string fechaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_fecFinProgra", 0).Trim();
                string horaFin = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_horFinProgra", 0).Trim();


                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoVehi) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Vehi) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipoCond) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cond)
                    && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaIni) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaIni) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fechaFin) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(horaFin))
                {
                    resp = "Programado";
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSolTras))
                        return resp;
                }

                string kmInicial = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_kmInicial", 0).Trim();
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(kmInicial))
                {
                    resp = "En Proceso";
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSolTras))
                        return resp;
                }

                string kmFinal = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_kmFinal", 0).Trim();
                string liberar = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar", 0).Trim();
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(kmFinal) && liberar.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    resp = "Ejecutado";
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSolTras))
                        return resp;
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(kmFinal) && liberar.Equals("Y") && oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                {

                    string Apoyo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_Apoyo", 0).Trim();

                    string LiberarAsignacion2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar2", 0).Trim();

                    string Veh1Veh2 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_VehIg", 0).Trim();

                    if (Apoyo.Equals("Y") && Veh1Veh2.Equals("N"))
                    {
                        if (LiberarAsignacion2.Equals("Y"))
                        {
                            resp = "Cerrado";
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        resp = "Cerrado";
                    }


                }
                else
                {
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroSolTras))
                        return resp;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                string Error = e.ToString();
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "estadosOT", Company);
            }


            return resp;
        }
        #endregion

        #region alertaKmAdiconal crear alerta
        //public enum TipoAlerta { GrabarSinAutorizar, NegarServicio, FallecimientoTitular, FallecimientoContratante, CupoBeneficiario, FueraCobertura, PeriodoCarencia, FueraRangoEdad, ModificarNroDoc, ModificaDatosFallecido, CreacionVehiculo, corregirDatosFallecidoLab, FinalizaProcesoLaboratorio, CambioCofre, CambioHabito, CambioCajaMetalica, KilometrajeAdicional };
        public static bool GenerarAlertOT(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string StrPath, ref string mensaje)
        {
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication);

            bool exitoAlerta = false;
            string docNum = string.Empty;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string serie = string.Empty;
            string idservicioFunerario = string.Empty;
            string actividad = string.Empty;
            string asunto = "Kiolometra Adicional";
            string Tipo = "Servicio funerario";

            try
            {
                serie = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("Series", 0).ToString().Trim();
                docNum = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocNum", 0).ToString().Trim();
                idservicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_nroOrdenSF", 0).ToString().Trim();
                //"Se registro kilometraje adicional en la otrden de traslado:  Serie:  " +
                mensaje = serie + " - Nro " + docNum + " - No. Orden servicio Funerario: " + idservicioFunerario + " - Asunto: " + asunto;


                bool ErrorAlerta = enviarAlerta(sapCompany, sapApplication, ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.KilometrajeAdicional, ref mensaje, StrPath);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "GenerarAlertCambiosLaboratorio", sapCompany);
            }
            return exitoAlerta;
        }
        public static bool enviarAlerta(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta tipoAlerta, ref string mensaje, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSUsuarios = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService oMS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Message oMsg = null;
            //Consultas cons = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string IdAlerta = string.Empty;

            bool exito = false;
            string userCode = string.Empty;

            try
            {
                oRSUsuarios = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                //determinar cuales usuarios deben ser notificados
                switch (tipoAlerta)
                {

                    case ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.KilometrajeAdicional:
                        {
                            //cons.getUsuariosDeAlerta("12", oRSUsuarios);

                            IdAlerta = "17";

                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "RetornarMensajeUsuarioAlerta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            query = query.Replace("%IdAlerta%", IdAlerta.Trim());
                            ors.DoQuery(query);
                        }
                        break;
                }

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    int i = 0;
                    oCS = sapCompany.GetCompanyService();
                    oMS = (SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService)oCS.GetBusinessService(ServiceTypes.MessagesService);
                    oMsg = (SAPbobsCOM.Message)oMS.GetDataInterface(MessagesServiceDataInterfaces.msdiMessage);
                    oMsg.Subject = "Alerta Servicio Funerario";
                    //oMsg.Text = ors.Fields.Item("U_Mensaje").Value.ToString() + " - No. DocSF: " + idOT + " - No. SolLab: " + numeroSolicitud + " - Asunto: " + asunto + " -Tipo: " + Tipo + " -Actividad: " + actividad;
                    oMsg.Text = ors.Fields.Item("U_Mensaje").Value.ToString() + mensaje;


                    oMsg.Priority = BoMsgPriorities.pr_High;

                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Add();
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).SendInternal = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                        // oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).EmailAddress = "";
                        userCode = ors.Fields.Item("U_Usuario").Value.ToString();

                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).UserCode = DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", userCode, sapCompany);
                        i++;
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }

                    //if (!UserNotificar.Equals(string.Empty))
                    //{
                    //    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Add();
                    //    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).SendInternal = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                    //    oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).UserCode = UserNotificar;
                    //    //DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", UserNotificar, sapCompany);
                    //    i++;
                    //}
                    oMS.SendMessage(oMsg);
                    exito = true; ;
                }

            }



            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "enviarAlerta", sapCompany);
                mensaje = e.Message;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSUsuarios != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSUsuarios);
                if (ors != null)
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return exito;
        }

        public static string DevolverItemEnTabla(string TableName, string FieldCodeName, string FieldName, string value, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {
            string item = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                string query = "SELECT \"" + FieldCodeName + "\" FROM \"" + TableName + "\" WHERE \"" + FieldName + "\"  = '" + value + "'";
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    item = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "DevolverItemEnTabla", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return item;

        }

                }
                else
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item("KMIni2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("KMFin2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("KMAdc2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("HorAdc2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("TipCond2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("CondAsi2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("TipVehi2").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("vehiAsi2").Enabled = false;
                }

                string LiberacionVehiculoPrincipal = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar", 0).Trim();

                if (!LiberacionVehiculoPrincipal.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtKmIni").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtKmFin").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("kilAdic").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("HorAdc").Enabled = true;

                }
                else
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtKmIni").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("txtKmFin").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("kilAdic").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("HorAdc").Enabled = false;

                }

                return true;

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "bloquearCampos", SBOCompany);
                return false;
            }
        }

        #region cargar series deacuerdo a una sede
        public static void loadSeriesporDefecto(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string strPath, string Sede)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            string strQry = string.Empty;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSeries").Specific;
            //SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboSede = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSede").Specific;
            while (oCombo.ValidValues.Count > 0)
                oCombo.ValidValues.Remove(0, SAPbouiCOM.BoSearchKey.psk_Index);


            oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            try
            {
                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "serieXSede", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%sede%", Sede);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    oCombo.ValidValues.Add(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString(), oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                    oCombo.Select("0", BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
                }

            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                oCombo.Select(0, BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
            }
            if (oCombo.ValidValues.Count > 0)
                ((EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docNum").Specific).Value = oForm.BusinessObject.GetNextSerialNumber(((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbSeries").Specific).Selected.Value, "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").ToString();

        }

        public void loadSeriesOrdenTras(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            ((EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docEntry").Specific).Value = oForm.BusinessObject.GetNextSerialNumber(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("serial").Specific).Value, "OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").ToString();
        }
