        #region populateComboBox: llenar un combobox con una tabla y una condición
        public static void populateComboBox(ref SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboBox, SAPbobsCOM.Company oCompany, string strTable, string strNameField, string strDescriptionField, string strFieldCond, string strCondition)
        {
            string strQuery = "";
            string tipoServer = string.Empty;
            //tipoServer = tipoMotorBD(oCompany);
            string sql = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)oCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            strQuery = "SELECT \"" + strNameField + "\",\"" + strDescriptionField + "\" FROM \"" + strTable + "\" WHERE \"" + strFieldCond + "\" = '" + strCondition + "'";

            try
            {
                oRecordSet.DoQuery(strQuery);

                oRecordSet.MoveFirst();

                string strCode = "";
                string strName = "";

                while (!oRecordSet.EoF)
                {
                    strCode = oRecordSet.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    strName = oRecordSet.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString();

                    oComboBox.ValidValues.Add(strCode, strName);
                    oRecordSet.MoveNext();
                }
            }
            catch
            {

            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRecordSet);
                }
                catch
                {

                }
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region populateComboBoxQuery llenar un combobox a partir de una consulta

                }

        #region limpiar combobox
        /// <summary>
        /// Eliminia todos los items de un combobox
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oComboBox"></param>
        public static void LimpiarComboBox(SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboBox)
        {
            do
            {
                oComboBox.ValidValues.Remove(0, SAPbouiCOM.BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
            } while (oComboBox.ValidValues.Count > 0);
        }

        #region adicionar lineas a las matrices y ordenar los numeros
        /// <summary>
        /// Metodo que agrega una nueva fila a la matriz en la ultima posición
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication"></param>
        /// <param name="sapCompany"></param>
        /// <param name="nomtabla"></param>
        /// <param name="matriz"></param>
        public static void Agregar_linea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string nomtabla, string matriz)
        {

            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Item oItem = oForm.Items.Item(matriz);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oItem.Specific;
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla).Clear();
                oMtx.SelectionMode = SAPbouiCOM.BoMatrixSelect.ms_Auto;
                // Añade la línea
                int rowCount = oMtx.RowCount;
                oMtx.AddRow(1, rowCount);

                //Selecciona la fila añadida
                oMtx.SelectRow(1 + rowCount, true, false);

                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.AddLineNew(oForm);
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.AddLineNew(oForm, "mtx0", "@OK1_ASIS_SERVLINEAS");
                NumerarLineas(oForm, sapCompany, nomtabla, matriz);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Borrar_linea", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Numera lineas de una matriz
        /// /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="sapCompany"></param>
        /// <param name="nomtabla"></param>
        /// <param name="matriz"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public static void NumerarLineas(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string nomtabla, string matriz)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;

            try
            {
                //oForm.Freeze(true);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla);

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;

                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                for (int i = 0; i < dslineas.Size; i++)
                {
                    dslineas.SetValue("LineId", i, Convert.ToString(i + 1));
                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "NumerarLineas", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }
        #endregion

        #region eliminar linea de una matriz
        //Codigo para borrar linea
        private static void Borrar_linea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string matriz)
        {
            if (oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_FIND_MODE)
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);

                SAPbouiCOM.Item oItem = oForm.Items.Item(matriz);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oItem.Specific;

                //Obtiene el número de la fila seleccionada
                int selRow = oMtx.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                if (selRow == -1)
                {
                    oForm.Freeze(false);
                    return;
                }

                //Borra la fila seleccionada
                oMtx.DeleteRow(selRow);
                oMtx.FlushToDataSource();
                //Pone el número de la fila en la columna #
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.UpdateNumberColumn(oMtx);

                //if (oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                //    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;

                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Reordena el número de lineas despues de borrar
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="nomtabla"></param>
        /// <param name="matriz"></param>
        public static void NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string nomtabla, string matriz)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla);

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;
                if (oMatrix.RowCount > 0)
                {
                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                    for (int i = 0; i < dslineas.Size; i++)
                    {
                        dslineas.SetValue("LineId", i, Convert.ToString(i + 1));

                    }
                    //dslineas.RemoveRecord(dslineas.Size - 1);
                    oMatrix.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                }
                // Erick: Borra la última línea ya que siempre quedan dos líneas vacias al cargar nuevamente la numeración.
                //oMatrix.DeleteRow(dslineas.Size);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            { throw e; }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        #region adicionarLinea colocar menus en click derecho
        public static void adicionarLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapComapny, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.MenuEvent pVal, string StrPath)
        {
            if (!pVal.BeforeAction)
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;
                switch (oForm.PaneLevel)
                {
                    case 3:

                        Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapComapny, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                        //oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                        //oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrix.RowCount, 1, true);
                        //oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrix.RowCount, 4, true);
                        //oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrix.RowCount, 5, true);
                        //oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrix.RowCount, 7, true);

                        //cab feb 2019
                        oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;

                        string lineId = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("LineId").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value = lineId;

                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_11", "NO");
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "col_tipOrd", "OC");

                        //
                        inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos(oForm, sapComapny, StrPath);

                        break;
                    case 4:

                        Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapComapny, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM", "mtxComen");
                        oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxComen").Specific;
                        DateTime localDate = DateTime.Now;
                        string fechaActual = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(localDate, sapApplication);
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "fecComen", fechaActual);
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "colum_3", DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm"));
                        string user = sapComapny.UserName;
                        string idUser = sapComapny.UserSignature.ToString();
                        SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboBox = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("usuComen").Cells.Item(1).Specific;
                        if (oComboBox.ValidValues.Count <= 0)
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapComapny, sapApplication, oComboBox, "SELECT \"USERID\", \"U_NAME\" FROM \"OUSR\" WHERE \"Locked\" = 'N' ORDER BY \"U_NAME\"");
                        //oComboBox.ValidValues.Add(idUser, user);
                        //oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "usuComen", idUser);
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMatrix.RowCount, "usuComen", user);
                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        #region eliminarLinea coloca menus en el clic derehco
        public static void eliminarLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapComapny, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.MenuEvent pVal)
        {
            if (!pVal.BeforeAction)
            {
                switch (oForm.PaneLevel)
                {
                    case 3:
                        SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;

                        int selRow = oMatrix.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                        Hashtable hTElem = new Hashtable();
                        hTElem.Add(1, true);
                        hTElem.Add(2, false);
                        hTElem.Add(3, true);
                        hTElem.Add(4, false);
                        hTElem.Add(5, false);
                        hTElem.Add(6, true);
                        hTElem.Add(7, true);
                        hTElem.Add(8, true);
                        hTElem.Add(9, false);
                        hTElem.Add(10, false);
                        hTElem.Add(11, true);
                        hTElem.Add(12, false);
                        hTElem.Add(13, false);
                        hTElem.Add(14, false);
                        hTElem.Add(15, true);
                        hTElem.Add(16, false);
                        hTElem.Add(17, true);
                        hTElem.Add(18, false);

                        string nroTras = string.Empty;
                        if (selRow != -1)
                        {

                            string tipoElem = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_TipELM", selRow)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                            if (tipoElem.Equals("P"))
                            {
                                bool otroEle = true;
                                bool tieneDocumento = false;
                                int i = selRow;
                                int cantRow = oMatrix.RowCount;
                                while (otroEle && (i <= cantRow))
                                {
                                    if ((i < cantRow))
                                    {
                                        string tmpTipoElem = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_TipELM", i + 1)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                        if (!tmpTipoElem.Equals("H"))
                                        {
                                            otroEle = false;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    nroTras = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("nroTras", i)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroTras))
                                    {
                                        tieneDocumento = true;
                                    }
                                    i++;
                                }

                                if (!tieneDocumento)
                                {
                                    int j = selRow;
                                    //SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrix.CommonSetting;
                                    //setting.SetRowEditable(selRow, true);                                    
                                    while (j < i)
                                    {
                                        restablecerColumnasEle(oMatrix, selRow, hTElem);
                                        Borrar_linea(oForm, "mtxElemen", selRow);
                                        NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                                        j++;
                                    }

                                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                                    {
                                        oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                nroTras = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("nroTras", selRow)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nroTras))
                                {
                                    restablecerColumnasEle(oMatrix, selRow, hTElem);
                                    Borrar_linea(oForm, "mtxElemen");
                                    NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                                    {
                                        oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede eliminar la linea porque tiene asignado un documento de transferencia. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                }
                                //Recorro la matriz para que si es padre bloquear la  matriz
                                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                {
                                    string TipoElem = ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_TipELM", i)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                    if (TipoElem.Equals("P"))
                                    {
                                        SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrix.CommonSetting;
                                        setting.SetRowEditable(i, false);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        break;
                    case 4:

                        SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxComen").Specific;

                        //Obtiene el número de la fila seleccionada
                        selRow = omtx.GetNextSelectedRow(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                        if (selRow != -1)
                        {

                            string user = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").GetValue("U_usuComen", selRow - 1).ToString().Trim();
                            string fecha = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").GetValue("U_fecComen", selRow - 1).ToString().Trim();
                            string comentario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM").GetValue("U_comentario", selRow - 1).ToString().Trim();
                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(comentario))
                            {

                                Borrar_linea(oForm, "mtxComen");
                                NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM", "mtxComen");
                                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                                {
                                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                }

                            }
                            else
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se puede eliminar un comentario.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        }
                        #region old borrar linea comentarios
                        //Borrar_linea(oForm, "mtxComen");
                        //NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_COM", "mtxComen");
                        //if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                        //{
                        //    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                        //}
                        #endregion

                        break;
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region funciones tipo origen y destino
        /// <summary>
        /// Cargar Información según el Tipo de Traslado
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="tipoTraslado"></param>
        #region tipo Traslado
        public static void CargarInfoTipoTraslado(Form oFormActividad, string tipoTraslado, string dir, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application SBOApplication, string strPath)
        {

            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = null;
                SAPbouiCOM.Item oitm = null;
                SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

                oFormActividad.Freeze(true);

                #region Inhabilitar Campos
                if (dir.Equals("O") || dir.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocultarCamposOrigen(oFormActividad);
                }
                else if (dir.Equals("D") || dir.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocultarCamposDestino(oFormActividad);
                }
                #endregion

                #region Consulta Datos Servicio
                string strQuery = "";
                string idSOF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtNroOSF").Specific).Value;
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetDatosOrdenServicioOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSolicitud%", string.IsNullOrEmpty(idSOF) ? "0" : idSOF);
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                #endregion


                if (dir.Equals("O") || dir.Equals(""))
                {
                    #region origen
                    if (dir.Equals(""))
                    {
                        tipoTraslado = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Specific).Value.Trim();
                        oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbTipTrsO").Enabled = false;
                    }

                    switch (tipoTraslado)
                    {
                        case "AutPatol":
                        case "lugDefun":
                            #region lugar de defuncion
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_OrgCu").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbOrgCu").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_UbOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbUbOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labPaisOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbPaisOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labSedFOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtSedFOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labTelFOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg").Visible = true;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_depOr");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 15;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 15;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_munOr");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 30;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 30;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_dirOrg");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 45;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtDirOrg");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg")).Top + 45;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_depOr").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_munOr").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_dirOrg").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtDirOrg").Visible = true;

                            if (!dir.Equals(""))
                            {
                                #region comentado
                                //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_LugDefunc").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                                //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbOrgCu").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_LugDefunc").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_UbicLoc").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                                //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbUbOrg").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_UbicLoc").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_paisFa").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                                //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbPaisOrg").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_paisFa").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_DptoFa").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                                //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_DptoFa").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                //if (!ors.Fields.Item("U_CiudadFa").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals(""))
                                //    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Specific).Select(ors.Fields.Item("U_CiudadFa").Value.ToString().Trim(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                //((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtSedFOrg").Specific).Value = ors.Fields.Item("U_sedBarr").Value.ToString().Trim();
                                //((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtDirOrg").Specific).Value = ors.Fields.Item("U_Ubicacio").Value.ToString().Trim();
                                //((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg").Specific).Value = ors.Fields.Item("U_Telf").Value.ToString().Trim();
                                #endregion
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbOrgCu").Specific;
                                string orgCuerpo = oCombo.Value;
                                if (!orgCuerpo.Equals("CSA"))
                                {
                                    oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbUbOrg").Specific;
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ORIGCUERPO\" WHERE  \"U_origen\" = '" + orgCuerpo + "'ORDER BY \"Name\"");

                                }
                            }
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("15").Click();

                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbOrgCu").Enabled = false;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbUbOrg").Enabled = false;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbPaisOrg").Enabled = false;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtSedFOrg").Enabled = false;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtTelFOrg").Enabled = false;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Enabled = false;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Enabled = false;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtDirOrg").Enabled = false;
                            #endregion
                            break;
                        case "Aereo":
                            #region aereo
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labAeroPuO").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbAeroPuO").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labAeroliO").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbAeroliO").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labservPuO").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtservPuO").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labnumVuOr").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumVuOr").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labhorVuOr").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txthorVuOr").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("labnumGuOr").Visible = true;
                            oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumGuOr").Visible = true;

                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("labservPuO");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("labAeroliO")).Top + 15;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtservPuO");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("labAeroliO")).Top + 15;

                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_depOr");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumGuOr")).Top + 15;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumGuOr")).Top + 15;
                            oitm = (SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("lab_munOr");
                            oitm.Top = ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oFormActividad.Items.Item("txtnumGuOr")).Top + 30;

        /// <summary>
        /// Consulta la información de la funeraria.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="funer"></param>
        /// <param name="dep"></param>
        /// <param name="mun"></param>
        /// <param name="dir"></param>
        public static void consultarDatosFuneraria(string funer, ref string dep, ref string mun, ref string dir, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_dep\",\"U_mun\",\"U_dir\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_FUNERARIAS\" WHERE \"Code\" ='" + funer + "' AND \"U_act\" = 'Y'");
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    dep = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    mun = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    dir = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Consulta los datos del aeropuerto
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="aeroPu"></param>
        /// <param name="dep"></param>
        /// <param name="mun"></param>
        /// <param name="dir"></param>
        /// <param name="servMart"></param>
        public static void consultarDatosAeroPu(string aeroPu, ref string dep, ref string mun, ref string dir, ref string servMart, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_dep\",\"U_mun\",\"U_dir\",\"U_serMarit\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_AEROPUERTOS\" WHERE \"Code\" ='" + aeroPu + "'");
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    dep = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    mun = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    dir = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    servMart = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)

            }

            }
        }

        #region otras funciones
        public static string fechaFormato(string fecha, int time, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            string hr, min, hora;
            min = Convert.ToString(time % 100);
            hr = Convert.ToString(time / 100);
            if (hr.Length == 1) hr = "0" + hr;
            if (min.Length == 1) min = "0" + min;
            hora = hr + ":" + min;

            DateTime dtFecha = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsDateTime(fecha, sapApplication);
            return dtFecha.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd") + " " + hora;
        }

        public static string validarCamposObligatorios(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, Hashtable hT)
        {
            string mensaje = string.Empty;
            foreach (string key in hT.Keys)
            {
                string dato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue(key, 0).Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dato))
                    mensaje += hT[key].ToString() + ", ";
            }
            return mensaje;
        }

        public static void bloquearDesbloCampos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, ArrayList aLCampos, bool enabled)
        {
            foreach (string campo in aLCampos)
            {
                try
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item(campo).Enabled = enabled;
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(e);
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Abrir Browser
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="p"></param>
        public static void AbrirBrowser(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string url)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Item oItem = oForm.Items.Add("WebBrowser", SAPbouiCOM.BoFormItemTypes.it_WEB_BROWSER);
            SAPbouiCOM.WebBrowser oWebBrowser = (SAPbouiCOM.WebBrowser)oItem.Specific;
            oItem.Width = oForm.Width - 20;
            oItem.Height = oForm.Height - 30;

            //Open the WebPage 
            oWebBrowser.Url = url;
        }

        #region Retornar nombre del elemento
        public static string Retornar_nombreElemento(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string codeElemento, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "Retornar_nombreElemento", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%Code%", codeElemento.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    nombreElemento = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Retornar_nombreElemento", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return nombreElemento;
        }
        #endregion

        #region verificar si es articulo
        public static bool EsArticulo(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string ItemCode, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string tipo = string.Empty;
            bool existe = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "RetornarTipoArticulo", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", ItemCode.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    tipo = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    if (tipo.Equals("N"))
                        existe = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EsArticulo", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        #region cargar Elemento de la matriz
        public static bool CargarElementosMatrizOrden(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string strpath, int filaActual)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            string elemento = string.Empty;
            string tipodeorden = string.Empty;
            string tipoArticulo = string.Empty;
            string sede = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            bool exito = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_sede", 0).Trim();
                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    almacen = Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);
                }
                else
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" la sede esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "elementosOrdenLaboratorioListaMateriales", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", articulo.Trim());
                oRSElementos.DoQuery(query);

                fila = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;
                //if (fila == 0)
                //  fila = 1;
                // else
                // fila = fila - 1;

                //elemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila).Trim();
                elemento = ((EditText)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_CElem", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                //nombreElemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_Nombre", fila).Trim();
                nombreElemento = ((EditText)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_NElem", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                //tipodeorden = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_tipOrden", fila).Trim();
                //tipoArticulo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila).Trim();
                tipoArticulo = ((ComboBox)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_TipArt", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();


                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    filaActual = fila;
                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {

                        if (fila != filaActual)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                            }
                            catch { }

                            if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))
                            {
                                Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE", "mtxElemen");
                                // oMatrixElementos.AddRow(1, oMatrixElementos.RowCount);
                                //Agregar_linea(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtxElemen", "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_CElem", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_NElem", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "cantidad", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                                // oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipArt", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("tipoArticulo").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Item", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "desc", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "almOri", almacen);
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Prov", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipELM", "H");
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "invent", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                                if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                                {
                                    oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, 17, false);
                                }
                                oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, 1, false);
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Cofre", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("cofre").Value.ToString());
                                oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipArt", "A");


                                if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("cofre").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                                {
                                    medidasCofre(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, strpath, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString().Trim());
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {

                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "cantidad", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());

                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Item", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "desc", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "almOri", almacen);
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Prov", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipELM", "P");
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "invent", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                            if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, 17, false);
                            }
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "uso", "Y");
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Cofre", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("cofre").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipArt", "A");



                            SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting;
                            setting.SetRowEditable(fila, false);
                        }
                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarElementosMatrizOrdenLaboratorio", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return exito;
        }
        #endregion

        #region cargar elementos de la matriz por orden
        public static bool CargarArticuloElemMatrizOrden(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string strpath, int filaActual)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string nombreElemento = string.Empty;
            string elemento = string.Empty;
            string tipodeorden = string.Empty;
            string tipoArticulo = string.Empty;
            string sede = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            bool exito = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                //oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                //oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_sede", 0).Trim();
                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    almacen = Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);
                }
                else
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" la sede esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ArticuloElementosOrdenlaboratorio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", articulo.Trim());
                query = query.Replace("%Almacen%", almacen.Trim());
                oRSElementos.DoQuery(query);

                fila = filaActual + 1;


                //elemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila).Trim();
                elemento = ((EditText)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_CElem", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                //nombreElemento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_Nombre", fila).Trim();
                nombreElemento = ((EditText)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_NElem", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();
                //tipodeorden = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_tipOrden", fila).Trim();
                //tipoArticulo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila).Trim();
                tipoArticulo = ((ComboBox)oMatrixElementos.GetCellSpecific("C_TipArt", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim();

                // U_cantArt


                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                {

                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                        }
                        catch { }

                        if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {

                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "cantidad", "1");
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Item", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "desc", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "almOri", almacen);
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Prov", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipELM", "A");
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "invent", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                            if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, 17, false);
                            }
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_Cofre", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("cofre").Value.ToString());
                            if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("cofre").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                medidasCofre(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, strpath, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString().Trim());
                            }
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "C_TipArt", "A");

                        }
                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarArticuloElemMatrizOrden", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return exito;
        }
        #endregion

        #region almacen por sede
        public static string Retornar_AlmacenXSede(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Sede, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "Retornar_AlmacenXSede", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%Sede%", Sede.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    almacen = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Retornar_AlmacenXSede", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return almacen;
        }
        #endregion


        #region cargar combos de municipio departamento
        public static void CargarComboDepartamentoMunicipioOrigen(SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string id)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
            string strQry = string.Empty;
            string select = string.Empty;
            string departamento = string.Empty;
            select = " SELECT \"U_depOrigen\", \"U_munOrigen\" ";
            string from = " FROM OCLG WHERE \"ClgCode\" = " + id + "";
            strQry = select + from;

            try
            {
                #region CARGAR COMBOS DEPARTAMENTO Y MUNICIPIOS

                try
                {
                    oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                }
                catch { }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString()) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString()))
                {
                    #region CARGAR Y SETEAR EL COMBO  DEPARTAMENTO
                    try
                    {
                        SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmbDepOrg").Specific;
                        string code = oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                        departamento = code;
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, oCombo, "SELECT \"Code\", \"Name\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_DEP\"");
                        oCombo.Select(code, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                    }
                    catch { oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_depOrigen", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString()); }
                    #endregion

                    #region CARGAR COMBO  MUNICIPIO

                    try
                    {
                        SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmbMunOrg").Specific;
                        string code = oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString();
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(ocmb);
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, ocmb, "SELECT \"U_codMun\", \"U_Municip\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_MUN\" WHERE \"U_codMun\" LIKE '" + departamento.Trim() + "%'  ORDER BY \"U_Municip\"");
                        ocmb.Select(code, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                    }
                    catch { oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_munOrigen", 0, oRS.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString()); }
                    #endregion
                }
                #endregion

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarComboDepartamentoMunicipio", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
        }
        #endregion

        public static int retornarIndiceColumn(SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix, string columna)
        {
            Columns columns = (Columns)oMatrix.Columns;
            int indexFound = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < columns.Count; j++)
            {
                string dato = columns.Item(j).UniqueID;
                if (columns.Item(j).UniqueID == columna)
                {
                    indexFound = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            return indexFound;
        }

        private static void medidasCofre(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string strPath, string Articulo)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = ((SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)(sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset)));
            try
            {

                string strQry = string.Empty;

                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "volumenCofre", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%itemcode%", Articulo);

                oRS.DoQuery(strQry);
                string vol = oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(vol))
                {
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_medCofre", 0, vol);

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error al actualizar la solicitud de traslado" + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addinSrvFun", "1", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
        }

        private static void restablecerColumnasEle(SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix, int fila, Hashtable hT)
        {
            foreach (int item in hT.Keys)
                oMatrix.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(fila, item, Convert.ToBoolean(hT[item]));
        }

        private static void ordenCancelada(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string StrPath, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)

                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)

                        string estado = oRS.Fields.Item("U_estOT").Value.ToString();
                        if (!estado.Equals("Cancelado"))

        public static void NumerarLineas(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string nomtabla, string matriz, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla);

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                for (int i = 0; i < dslineas.Size; i++)
                {
                    dslineas.SetValue("LineId", i, Convert.ToString(i + 1));
                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "NumerarLineas", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static void Agregar_lineaMatriz(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string matrix, string DBdatsource)
        {
            try
            {
                Item oItem = oForm.Items.Item(matrix);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matrix).Specific;
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(DBdatsource).Clear();

                // Añade la línea
                int rowCount = oMtx.RowCount;
                oMtx.AddRow(1, rowCount);

                //Selecciona la fila añadida
                oMtx.SelectRow(1 + rowCount, true, false);
                NumerarLineas(oForm, DBdatsource, matrix, sapCompany);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Agregar_lineaMatriz", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }
        public static bool BorrarMatrizComentarios(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool error = false;
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxComen").Specific;

                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                if (oMatrixElementos.RowCount > 0)
                {
                    oMatrixElementos.Clear();
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "BorrarMatrizComentarios", sapCompany);
                error = true;
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
            return error;
        }

        public static bool ExisteSalidaMercancia(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string docEntrysolicitudServicio, string lineID, string itemCode, ref string DocNumSalidaMercancia)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool existe = false;
            string strQuery = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = strQuery + " SELECT T0.\"DocNum\" as \"DocNum\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " FROM \"OIGE\" T0 " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " INNER JOIN \"IGE1\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" = T1.\"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " WHERE T0.\"U_OK1_SF_NSOL\" = '" + docEntrysolicitudServicio + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T1.\"U_linea\" ='" + lineID + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T1.\"ItemCode\" ='" + itemCode + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T0.\"DocEntry\" NOT IN " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " ( " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " SELECT  T0.\"U_OK1_SF_EntrySM\" as \"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " FROM \"OIGN\" T0 INNER JOIN \"IGN1\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" =  T1.\"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " WHERE  T0.\"U_OK1_SF_NSOL\" = '" + docEntrysolicitudServicio + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   T1.\"U_linea\" ='" + lineID + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   T1.\"ItemCode\" ='" + itemCode + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   IFNULL(T0.\"U_OK1_SF_EntrySM\",'') <> '')";
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    DocNumSalidaMercancia = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteSalidaMercancia", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static bool elemPermiteGenerarDoc(string idElem, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, string StrPath)
        {
            bool permite = true;
            string strQuery = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

            try
            {
                ors = (Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetPermisoElemento", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idElemento%", idElem);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_destFinal").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_traslado").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_laboratorio").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                        permite = false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw e;
            }
            finally
            { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors); }


            return permite;
        }

        public static string RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntry, int indice)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string LineId = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT \"LineId\" FROM (select  \"LineId\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "'" + " ORDER BY \"LineId\"  LIMIT " + indice.ToString().Trim() + ") ";
                query = query + " ORDER BY \"LineId\" DESC LIMIT 1 ";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    LineId = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return LineId;
        }

        public static string validarCantidadesFila(SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, Form oForm, int Fila, string strPath, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            string mensaje = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            string docEntry = "";


            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
            docEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0);

            try
            {

                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                string itemCode = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_nomArt", Fila).Trim();
                //string itemName = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_ItemName", Fila).Trim();
                string itemName = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_descArt", Fila).Trim();

                string almacen = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_almacenOri", Fila).Trim();
                double disponible = Convert.ToDouble(calcularCantidadDisponible(oForm, itemCode, almacen, strPath, sapApplication, SapCompany));

                // se valida que no existe una salida de mercancia
                string NroDocumentoSM = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_Documento", Fila).Trim();
                if (NroDocumentoSM.Equals(""))
                {
                    if (oItem.GetByKey(itemCode))
                    {
                        if (oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES)
                        {
                            double cantidad = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SapCompany, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_cantUsoArt", Fila));
                            string InventoryNumber = oItem.InventoryNumber.ToString();
                            if (cantidad > 0)
                            {
                                if (!oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_nomArt", Fila).Trim().Equals("") && (cantidad > disponible))
                                {
                                    mensaje = " La cantidad a pedir supera a la cantidad disponible del articulo: " + ".\n";
                                    mensaje = mensaje + itemName + ". \n";
                                    mensaje = mensaje + " Disponible :  " + Convert.ToString(disponible) + "  en el almacen: " + almacen + ".\n";
                                    mensaje = mensaje + ServicioFunerario.MensajeArticulosComprometidos(SapCompany, itemCode, strPath, itemName, docEntry, almacen);
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                mensaje = "No se pudo crear la salida de mercancia, debe diligenciar el campo \"Cantidad usada\" con un valor diferente de cero";
                            }

                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    mensaje = "Ya existe la salida de mercancia  Nro " + NroDocumentoSM;
                }


            }
            catch { }
            finally { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oItem); }
            return mensaje;
        }

        public static double RetornarCantidadDisponible(string ItemCode, string almacen, string docEntry, string strPath, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany)
        {
            double cantidad = 0;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            StringBuilder Query = new StringBuilder();
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            string strQuery = "";

            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                if (oItem.GetByKey(ItemCode))
                {
                    if (oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES)
                    {
                        oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                        strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ArticulosDisponiblesOrdenTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%itemCode%", ItemCode);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docEntry%", docEntry);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%almacen%", almacen);
                        oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                        if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                        {
                            cantidad = Convert.ToDouble(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                            if (cantidad < 0)
                                cantidad = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarCantidadDisponible", SapCompany);
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrió una excepción en On RetornarCantidadDisponible. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oItem);
            }
            return cantidad;
        }

        public static string calcularCantidadDisponible(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string itemCode, string almacen, string strPath, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany)
        {
            string docEntry = "0";
            double cantidad = 0;
            docEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0);
            if (docEntry.Equals(""))
                docEntry = "0";
            if (!itemCode.Equals("") && !almacen.Equals("") && !docEntry.Equals(""))
                cantidad = RetornarCantidadDisponible(itemCode, almacen, docEntry, strPath, sapApplication, SapCompany);
            return cantidad.ToString();
        }

        public static bool existen_ArticulosNoSeleccionadoBasicos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref bool lineasSinArticulo, ref bool LineaSeleccionadaNoInventariable, ref int linea)
        {
            bool encontradoError = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string tipolinea = "";
            string itemcode = "";
            bool seleccionada = false;

            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {

                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                    if (seleccionada)
                    {
                        itemcode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_nomArt", indice).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemcode))
                        {
                            oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("C_Item").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                            if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                            {
                                encontradoError = true;
                                LineaSeleccionadaNoInventariable = true;
                                salir = true;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            encontradoError = true;
                            lineasSinArticulo = true;
                            salir = true;
                        }
                    }

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_ArticulosNoSeleccionadoBasicos", ocmp);
            }
            return encontradoError;
        }

        public static void inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos_old(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            int indice = 0;

            string Uso = "";

            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;

            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
