                            campo = "U_SerieOC";
                            Serie = RetornarSeries(sapCompany, campo);
                            ordenCompra.Series = Convert.ToInt32(Serie);
                        }
                        #endregion

                        ordenCompra.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value = docEntrysolicitudServicio; //((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString();
                        ordenCompra.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_idFallec").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("txtIdFall").Specific).Value.ToString();
                        ordenCompra.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_NomFallec").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("txtNomFall").Specific).Value.ToString();
                        CamposUsuario(sapCompany, sapCompany.UserSignature, ref almacen, ref codMun, ref mun, ref sucur, ref nomSucur);
                        ordenCompra.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_mun").Value = mun;
                        ordenCompra.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_sucur").Value = nomSucur;
                        ordenCompra.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OrigDoc").Value = "OT";

                        string CodImpuestoSN = ServicioFunerario.RetornarCodigoImpuestoSN(sapCompany, id);

                        for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                        {
                            idsocio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_Prov").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                            oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                            lineID = oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLinea", i - 1).Trim();
                            lineID = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;

                            // docEntrysolicitudServicio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString();
                            //string docEntrysolicitudServicioAnterior = "";
                            // docEntrysolicitudServicioAnterior = Retornar_NroContratoServicioAnterior(sapCompany, docEntrysolicitudServicio, StrPath); // ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.ToString();

                            //si el socio de negocio es el mismo a nivel de linea al que existe en el array
                            if (idsocio.Equals(id))
                            {
                                if (!docEntrysolicitudServicio.Equals("") && !lineID.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    //obtener item
                                    oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_Item").Cells.Item(i).Specific)).Value);
                                    itemCode = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_Item").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                                    elemento = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_CElem").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                                    tipoOrden = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_tipOrd").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;

                                    existeOrdenCompra = ExisteOrdenCompra(sapCompany, docEntrysolicitudServicio, lineID, itemCode, idsocio, ref strDocNumOrdenCompra);

                                    //solo tomar las que notienen salida mercancia
                                    if (!existeOrdenCompra && oMatrix.IsRowSelected(i))
                                    {
                                        if (tipoOrden.Equals("OC"))
                                        {
                                            ordenCompra.Lines.ItemCode = itemCode;
                                            ordenCompra.Lines.ProjectCode = prjCode;
                                            ordenCompra.Lines.ItemDescription = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_NElem").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                                            ordenCompra.Lines.Quantity = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(sapCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("cantidad").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value);
                                            ordenCompra.Lines.UnitPrice = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(sapCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_VlCom").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value);
                                            ordenCompra.Lines.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_linea").Value = lineID;
                                            Quantity = ordenCompra.Lines.Quantity;
                                            UnitPrice = ordenCompra.Lines.UnitPrice;

                                            if (CodImpuestoSN.Equals(""))
                                                ordenCompra.Lines.TaxCode = oItem.ApTaxCode;
                                            else
                                                ordenCompra.Lines.TaxCode = CodImpuestoSN;

                                            if (!cc1.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                ordenCompra.Lines.CostingCode = cc1;
                                            if (!cc2.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                ordenCompra.Lines.CostingCode2 = cc2;
                                            if (!cc3.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                ordenCompra.Lines.CostingCode3 = cc3;
                                            if (!cc4.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                ordenCompra.Lines.CostingCode4 = cc4;
                                            docTotal += Quantity * UnitPrice;
                                            ordenCompra.Lines.Add();
                                            filaSelecciona.Add(i);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (!existeOrdenCompra)
                        {
                            if (ordenCompra.Add() != 0)
                            {
                                sapApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo crear orden de compra. Error: " + sapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "OK", "", "");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                numdoc = sapCompany.GetNewObjectKey();

                                Documents oOC = (Documents)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oPurchaseOrders);  // orden Compra
                                string docnum = oOC.DocNum.ToString();
                                oOC.GetByKey(int.Parse(numdoc));
                                string documento = oOC.DocNum.ToString();

                                foreach (int fila in filaSelecciona)
                                {
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_11").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value = "SI";
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_12").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value = numdoc;
                                }
                                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (existeOrdenCompra)
                            {
                                string mesg = " La orden de compra no se puede generar, ya existe la orden de compra Nro.  " + strDocNumOrdenCompra + " Para este servicio funerario Nro. " + docEntrysolicitudServicio;
                                sapApplication.MessageBox(mesg, 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(mesg, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                string mesg = " La orden de compra no se puede generar, por favor revise los siguientes valores esten diligenciados o sean mayores a cero. \n";
                                mesg = mesg + " Item: = " + itemCode + "\n";
                                mesg = mesg + " Elemento: = " + elemento + " \n";
                                mesg = mesg + " Tipo Orden: =" + tipoOrden + "\n";
                                mesg = mesg + " cantidad: = " + Convert.ToString(Quantity).Trim() + "\n";

                                sapApplication.MessageBox(mesg, 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                    if (socios.Count == 0)
                    {
                        string mesg = " La orden de servicio no se puede generar, por favor revise el campo proveedor este diligenciado. \n";
                        sapApplication.MessageBox(mesg, 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    sapApplication.MessageBox("No hay filas seleccionadas. No se puede crear el documento.", 1, "OK", "", "");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC012", sapCompany);
            }

        }

        public static string Retornar_TipoDocumentoCreadosSFLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, int fila, ref string mensaje, string TipoDocumento)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            string OrdenGenerada = "";
            string DocumentoOrden = "";
            string Documento = "";
            string NoDoc = "";
            string NombreDocumento = "";
            string tipoOrden = "";

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();

                NoDoc = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", fila).Trim();
                Documento = oDBS1.GetValue("U_DescDoc", fila).Trim();
                //DocumentoOrden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docOrd", fila).Trim();
                OrdenGenerada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ordCom", fila).Trim();

                tipoOrden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipOrden", fila).Trim();



                switch (TipoDocumento)
                {
                    case "SM":
                        if (!NoDoc.Equals(""))
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            NombreDocumento = "SM";
                            mensaje = NoDoc;
                        }
                        if (!Documento.Equals("") && !existe)
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            NombreDocumento = "SM";
                            mensaje = Documento;
                        }
                        break;
                    case "OC":
                        if (tipoOrden.Equals("OC"))
                        {
                            NombreDocumento = "OC";
                            if (!OrdenGenerada.Equals("NO"))
                            {
                                existe = true;
                                mensaje = DocumentoOrden;
                            }

                        }
                        break;

                }
            }
            catch { }
            return NombreDocumento;
        }

        public static string RetornarSeries(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string Campo)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string serie = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT \"" + Campo + "\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_PARAM\" WHERE \"Code\" " + "= 'SETUP'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    serie = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarSeries", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return serie;
        }

        public static void cancelarOrdenLinea(Form oForm, int fila, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string StrPath)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
            SAPbobsCOM.Documents oOrden = null;
            bool actualizar = false;
            int exito = -1;
            int lineaAct = 0;

            oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
            try
            {
                if ((fila >= 0) && (fila <= oMatrix.RowCount))
                {
                    string docOrden = oDBS.GetValue("U_docOrd", fila - 1).Trim();
                    string docEntryOT = oDBS.GetValue("DocEntry", fila - 1).Trim();

                    string docEntrysolicitudServicio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("txtNroOSF").Specific).Value.ToString();

                    if (docEntryOT.Equals(""))
                        docEntryOT = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docEntry").Specific).Value.ToString();

                    //string docEntrysolicitudServicioAnterior = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    string docEntrysolicitudServicioAnterior = string.Empty;
                    //docEntrysolicitudServicioAnterior = Retornar_NroContratoServicioAnterior(sapCompany, docEntrysolicitudServicio, StrPath); // ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.ToString();


                    //if (docEntrysolicitudServicioAnterior.Equals(""))
                    //    docEntrysolicitudServicioAnterior = docEntrysolicitudServicio;


                    if (!docOrden.Equals(""))
                    {
                        oOrden = (Documents)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oPurchaseOrders);  // orden Compra
                        oOrden.GetByKey(int.Parse(docOrden));
                        string DocNumOC = oOrden.DocNum.ToString();
                        string lineID = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim();

                        if (!docEntryOT.Equals("") && !lineID.Equals(""))
                        {
                            string itemCode = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_Item").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            string elemento = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_CElem").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            string tipoOrden = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_tipOrd").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            string idsocio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("C_Prov").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;

                            string strDocNumOrdenCompra = "";
                            bool existeOrdenCompra = ExisteOrdenCompra(sapCompany, docEntrysolicitudServicio, lineID, itemCode, idsocio, ref strDocNumOrdenCompra);

                            if (existeOrdenCompra && oMatrix.IsRowSelected(fila))
                            {

                                for (int i = 0; i < oOrden.Lines.Count; i++)
                                {
                                    oOrden.Lines.SetCurrentLine(i);
                                    string lineaOC = oOrden.Lines.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_linea").Value.ToString();

                                    if (lineID == lineaOC && oOrden.Lines.LineStatus.Equals(BoStatus.bost_Open))
                                    {
                                        oOrden.Lines.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_linea").Value = "";
                                        actualizar = true;
                                        lineaAct = i;
                                    }
                                }

                                if (actualizar)
                                    exito = oOrden.Update();
                                if (exito != 0)
                                {
                                    if (exito == -1)
                                        sapApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar las lineas de la orden.", 1, "OK", "", "");
                                    else
                                        sapApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar las lineas de la orden. Error: " + sapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "OK", "", "");
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    oOrden = (Documents)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oPurchaseOrders);  // orden Compra
                                    oOrden.GetByKey(int.Parse(docOrden));
                                    oOrden.Lines.SetCurrentLine(lineaAct);
                                    oOrden.Lines.LineStatus = BoStatus.bost_Close;
                                    exito = oOrden.Update();

                                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;


                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_ordCom", fila - 1, "NO");
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_docOrd", fila - 1, "");


                                    oMatrix.LoadFromDataSourceEx();

                                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                                    sapApplication.MessageBox(" Se cancela la linea " + lineID + " de orden Nro. " + DocNumOC + " [ " + docOrden + " ]. ", 1, "OK", "", "");
                                }
                            }
                            else
                                sapApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la linea de la orden : " + DocNumOC);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC030", sapCompany);

            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oOrden);
            }
        }

        public static bool ExisteOrdenCompra(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string docEntrysolicitudServicio, string lineID, string itemCode, string cardCode, ref string DocNumOrdenCompra)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool existe = false;
            string strQuery = "";

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = strQuery + " SELECT T0.\"DocNum\" as \"DocNum\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " FROM \"OPOR\" T0 " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " INNER JOIN \"POR1\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" = T1.\"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " WHERE T0.\"U_OK1_SF_NSOL\" = '" + docEntrysolicitudServicio + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T1.\"U_linea\" ='" + lineID + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND CANCELED ='N'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T1.\"ItemCode\" ='" + itemCode + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T0.\"CardCode\" ='" + cardCode + "'" + "\n";
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    DocNumOrdenCompra = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteOrdenCompra", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static void getPrecioArticulo(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, int fila, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application SBOApplication, string StrPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners oBP = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.EditText oEdit = null;
            string strQuery;
            int row = fila + 1;
            double precio = 0, cantidad, totalElemento;

            //obtener precio del item para el proveedor
            //1. traer precio del convenio de proveedor si existe,
            //2. sino, traer precio de la lista de precios si existe,
            //3. sino, traer precio como costo del artículo

            try
            {
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oBP = (SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oBusinessPartners);
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                //obtengo la cantidad a pedir del elemento
                //cantidad = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_cantArt", fila));
                cantidad = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("cantidad", fila)).Value);
                precio = 0;

                //3. traer costo del artículo; se calcula siempre antes de traer cualquier otro precio
                SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                //if (oItem.GetByKey(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_nomArt", fila)))
                if (oItem.GetByKey(((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_Item", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim()))
                {
                    precio = oItem.AvgStdPrice;
                }

                // if (oBP.GetByKey(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_CardCode", fila)))
                if (oBP.GetByKey(((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_Prov", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim()))
                {
                    //if (oItem.GetByKey(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_nomArt", fila)))
                    if (oItem.GetByKey(((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("C_Item", fila)).Value.ToString().Trim()))
                    {
                        for (int i = 0; i < oItem.PriceList.Count; i++)
                        {
                            oItem.PriceList.SetCurrentLine(i);

                            //si la lista de precios del proveedor
                            //corresponde con la del artículo, mostrar el precio
                            if (oBP.PriceListNum == oItem.PriceList.PriceList)
                            {
                                precio = oItem.PriceList.Price;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El artículo no existe. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                }

                //calcular el total por elemento
                totalElemento = precio;
                if (totalElemento > 0)
                    //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_ValorCom", fila, totalElemento.ToString());
                    ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("col_VlCom", fila)).Value = totalElemento.ToString();
                else
                    // oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_ValorCom", fila, "0");
                    ((EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("col_VlCom", fila)).Value = "0";
                //((SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific).LoadFromDataSourceEx();

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC021", SBOCompany);
            }
        }

        public static string verificarOrdenesObligatorias(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany, string StrPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty, mensaje = string.Empty;
            string numOSF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docEntry").Specific).Value;

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "verificarOrdenesCompraObligatoriasInTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%DoEntryOTraslado%", numOSF);
                ors.DoQuery(query);

                StringBuilder strTransacciones = new StringBuilder();

                bool Mensaje = false;

                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    strTransacciones.AppendLine("Existen ordenes de compra y/o servicio obligatorias pendientes por realizar:");

                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        int Linea = int.Parse(ors.Fields.Item("LineId").Value.ToString());

                        string OrdenGenerada = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_11").Cells.Item(Linea).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();

                        string DocumentoOrden = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_12").Cells.Item(Linea).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();

                        if (OrdenGenerada.Equals("NO") && string.IsNullOrEmpty(DocumentoOrden))
                        {
                            strTransacciones.AppendLine("Código: " + ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString() + ". ");
                            Mensaje = true;
                        }


                        ors.MoveNext();

                    }
                }
                if (!Mensaje)
                {
                    query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "VerificarInventariables", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                    query = query.Replace("%DocEntryOTraslado%", numOSF);

                    ors.DoQuery(query);

                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        strTransacciones.AppendLine("Existen documentos pendientes por realizar:");

                        while (!ors.EoF)
                        {
                            int Linea = int.Parse(ors.Fields.Item("LineId").Value.ToString());

                            string NumeroDocumento = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_7").Cells.Item(Linea).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();

                            string Documento = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_dedo").Cells.Item(Linea).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();

                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(NumeroDocumento) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(Documento))
                            {
                                strTransacciones.AppendLine("Código: " + ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString() + ". ");

                                Mensaje = true;
                            }

                            ors.MoveNext();

                        }
                    }
                }




                if (!Mensaje)
                {
                    strTransacciones.Clear();
                }

                mensaje = strTransacciones.ToString();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "verificarOrdenesObligatorias", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return mensaje;
        }

        public static bool MarcarUsoElementosNOInventariablePorLineaConSalidaInventario(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, int Fila, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool exito = false;
            int tope = 0;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            // SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            int indice = Fila;
            Fila++;
            bool esInventariable = false;

            try
            {
                //oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;

                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("C_Item").Cells.Item(Fila).Specific)).Value);
                esInventariable = oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                bool esLineaPrenececidad = !((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_linPF").Cells.Item(Fila).Specific).Value.ToString().Equals(string.Empty);
                bool TieneSalidaInventario = !((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_7").Cells.Item(Fila).Specific).Value.ToString().Equals(string.Empty);
                bool TieneOrdencompra = !((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_12").Cells.Item(Fila).Specific).Value.ToString().Equals(string.Empty);

                bool tienedocumentoRealizado = TieneSalidaInventario || TieneOrdencompra;
                if (esInventariable && !esLineaPrenececidad && tienedocumentoRealizado)
                {
                    #region marcar uso orden de parque
                    omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(Fila, "uso", "Y");
                    exito = true;
                    #endregion
                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!TieneSalidaInventario)
                        mensaje = mensaje + ": No tiene salida de inventario, por lo tanto no se puede marcar el uso.";
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "MarcarUsoElementosNOInventariablePorLineaConSalidaInventario", ocmp);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static bool retornarCofreConfirmadoFromSF(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string DocEntrySf, string ItemcodeCofreLaboratorio, string U_IdLinea, ref string mensaje, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string strConfirmado = string.Empty;
            string ItemCodeCofreServicioF = string.Empty;
            bool Confirmado = false;

            try
            {
                mensaje = string.Empty;
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "retornarCofreConfirmadoFromSF", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%DocEntry%", DocEntrySf);
                query = query.Replace("%U_IdLinea%", U_IdLinea);

                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    strConfirmado = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    ItemCodeCofreServicioF = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();

                    if (ItemCodeCofreServicioF.Equals(ItemcodeCofreLaboratorio))
                    { Confirmado = true; }
                    else
                        mensaje = " El cofre: " + ItemCodeCofreServicioF + " no corresponde con el mismo cofre de laboratorio , cofre laboratorio: " + ItemcodeCofreLaboratorio;

                    //if (!strConfirmado.Equals("Y"))
                    //    mensaje = " El cofre no esta confirmado en el servicio funerario";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CantidadOrdenesTrasladoCerradas", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return Confirmado;
        }

        public static string crearListaChequeoTraslado(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application SBOApplication, string nSerFun, string docentryOT, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService oGS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData oGD = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCmpServ = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string lastDoc = string.Empty;
            int lastDocEntry = 0;
            string strQuery = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                oCmpServ = sapCompany.GetCompanyService();
                oGS = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService)oCmpServ.GetGeneralService("OK1_SF_LISTCHEQ");
                oGD = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData)oGS.GetDataInterface(SAPbobsCOM.GeneralServiceDataInterfaces.gsGeneralData);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_OK1_SF_NSOL", nSerFun);
                oGS.Add(oGD);
                lastDoc = OK1.SBO.Helpers.GetLastDocEntry("@OK1_SF_LISCHEQ_HEAD", sapCompany);
                try
                {
                    lastDocEntry = Convert.ToInt32(lastDoc);
                    // lastDocEntry++;
                    lastDoc = lastDocEntry.ToString();
                }
                catch { }
                if (!lastDocEntry.Equals(0))
                {
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ActualizarListaChequeoTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%DocEntry%", docentryOT);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docentryList%", lastDoc);
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    ors.DoQuery(strQuery);

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "crearListaChequeo", sapCompany, SBOApplication);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oGS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oGD);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oCmpServ);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return lastDoc;
        }


        //lista de emateriales
        public static bool QuitarLineasListaTipoArticuloTraslado(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, ref string mensaje)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            bool error = false;
            int indice = 1;
            int tope = 0;
            int fila = 0;
            string LMTP = string.Empty;
            {
                try
                {
                    oForm.Freeze(true);
                    oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("se inicia el proceso de validacion de las lineas ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                    tope = oMatrix.RowCount;
                    if (oMatrix.RowCount > 1)
                    {
                        while (indice <= oMatrix.RowCount && !error)
                        {
                            fila = indice - 1;
                            LMTP = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila).Trim();
                            if (LMTP.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                oMatrix.DeleteRow(indice);
                                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" Procesando Fila " + indice + "/" + tope, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                indice++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (oMatrix.RowCount == 1)
                        {
                            LMTP = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").GetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila).Trim();
                            if (LMTP.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                oMatrix.DeleteRow(indice);
                                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("se Finaliza el proceso de validacion de las lineas", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "QuitarLineasListaTipoArticuloTraslado ", sapCompany);
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    mensaje = e.Message;
                    error = true;
                }
                finally
                {
                    oForm.Freeze(false);
                }
            }
            return error;
        }

        public static bool Existe_ListaMaterialesEnTraslado(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string codigoArticulo, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "Existe_ListaMaterialesEnTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", codigoArticulo.Trim());
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)

                    cant = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim());

                }
            }

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Existe_ListaMaterialesEnTraslado", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static void Agregar_lineaMatrix(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string matrix, string DBdatsource)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            int intMaxRowCount = 0;
            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                Item oItem = oForm.Items.Item(matrix);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(DBdatsource);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oItem.Specific;
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(DBdatsource).Clear();

                int rowCount = oMtx.RowCount;
                oMtx.AddRow(1, rowCount);

                string U_MaxRowCount = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_MaxRowCount", 0);
                try
                {
                    intMaxRowCount = Convert.ToInt32(U_MaxRowCount) + 1;
                }
                catch { }
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_MaxRowCount", 0, Convert.ToString(intMaxRowCount));
                oMtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(oMtx.RowCount, "C_linEle", Convert.ToString(intMaxRowCount));
                oMtx.SelectRow(1 + rowCount, true, false);
                NumerarLineas(oForm, DBdatsource, matrix, sapCompany);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Agregar_lineaMatrix", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        public static bool CargarElementosMatrizOrdenTrasladoTipoArticulo(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string articulo, string strpath, int filaActual)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string query = "";
            string TipoOrden = "OC";
            string TipoArticulo = "C";
            string sede = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            bool exito = false;
            int fila = 0;
            string item = string.Empty;
            string NroServicioFunerario = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadre = string.Empty;
            int DocEntry = 0;
            double cantidadDisponible = 0;
            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtxElemen").Specific;
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA");
                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                sede = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_sede", 0).Trim();
                NroServicioFunerario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_nroOrdenSF", 0).Trim();

                if (!sede.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    almacen = Retornar_AlmacenXSede(sapCompany, sapApplication, sede, strpath);
                }
                else
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" la sede esta vacia... ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "elementosOrdenTrasladoListaMateriales", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%ItemCode%", articulo.Trim());
                oRSElementos.DoQuery(query);

                fila = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;
                if (fila == 1)
                    fila = 0;
                else
                    fila = fila - 1;

                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    #region LINEA PADRE
                    string elem = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString();
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_tipOrden", fila, TipoOrden);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, TipoArticulo);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_tipLinea", fila, "P");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_cantArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_cantUsoArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                    CodigoPadre = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_nomArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_descArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_almacenOri", fila, almacen);
                    try

                    {
                        DocEntry = Convert.ToInt32(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim());
                    }
                    catch { }

                    cantidadDisponible = RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, DocEntry.ToString(), strpath);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, cantidadDisponible.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "Y");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());
                    #region seteo codigo del padre en los hijos
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_ItemCodePadre", fila, CodigoPadre);
                    #endregion

                    string lineId = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("LineId").Cells.Item(fila + 1).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(fila + 1).Specific).Value = lineId;

                    oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila + 1, "col_11", "NO");
                    oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila + 1, "col_tipOrd", "OC");

                    oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();

                    SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting;
                    setting.SetRowEditable(fila + 1, false);

                    oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                    fila++;

                    #endregion

                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {
                        #region lineas HIJO
                        try
                        {
                            item = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString();
                        }
                        catch { }

                        if (!item.Equals(string.Empty))
                        {

                            Agregar_lineaMatrix(oForm, sapApplication, sapCompany, "mtxElemen", "@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE");
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Codigo", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Elemento").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Nombre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NomElemento").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_tipOrden", fila, TipoOrden);
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_cantArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_cantUsoArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", fila, TipoArticulo);

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_nomArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_descArt", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("NombreArticulo").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_almacenOri", fila, almacen);
                            cantidadDisponible = RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(sapCompany, sapApplication, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Articulo").Value.ToString(), almacen, DocEntry.ToString(), strpath);
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Disponible", fila, cantidadDisponible.ToString());

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_CardCode", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Proveedor").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_TipoElemListaMat", fila, "Y");
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Inventariable", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("InvntItem").Value.ToString());
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_Cofre", fila, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Cofre").Value.ToString());

                            #region seteo codigo del padre en los hijos
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_ItemCodePadre", fila, CodigoPadre);
                            #endregion
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA_ELE").SetValue("U_tipLinea", fila, "H");

                            lineId = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("LineId").Cells.Item(fila + 1).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(fila + 1).Specific).Value = lineId;

                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila + 1, "col_11", "NO");
                            oMatrixElementos.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila + 1, "col_tipOrd", "OC");

                        }
                        oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();
                        #endregion

                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "CargarElementosMatrizOrdenTrasladoTipoArticulo", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static double RetornarCantidadDisponibleStock(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string ItemCode, string almacen, string docEntry, string strPath)
        {
            double cantidad = 1;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            StringBuilder Query = new StringBuilder();
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            string strQuery = "";

            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                if (oItem.GetByKey(ItemCode))
                {
                    if (oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES)
                    {
                        oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                        strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ArticulosDisponiblesOrdenTrasladoTipoArticulo", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%ItemCode%", ItemCode);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%DocEntry%", docEntry);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Almacen%", almacen);
                        oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                        if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                        {
                            cantidad = Convert.ToDouble(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                            if (cantidad < 0)
                                cantidad = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarCantidadDisponible", sapCompany);
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrió una excepción en On RetornarCantidadDisponible. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oItem);
            }
            return cantidad;
        }


        public static string retornarUltimaListaChequeo(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application SBOApplication, string nSerFun, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService oGS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData oGD = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCmpServ = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string lastDoc = string.Empty;
            int lastDocEntry = 0;
            string strQuery = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                oCmpServ = sapCompany.GetCompanyService();
                oGS = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService)oCmpServ.GetGeneralService("OK1_SF_LISTCHEQ");
                oGD = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData)oGS.GetDataInterface(SAPbobsCOM.GeneralServiceDataInterfaces.gsGeneralData);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_OK1_SF_NSOL", nSerFun);
                oGS.Add(oGD);
                lastDoc = OK1.SBO.Helpers.GetLastDocEntry("@OK1_SF_LISCHEQ_HEAD", sapCompany);
                try
                {
                    lastDocEntry = Convert.ToInt32(lastDoc);
                    lastDoc = lastDocEntry.ToString();
                }
                catch { }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "crearListaChequeo", sapCompany, SBOApplication);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oGS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oGD);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oCmpServ);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return lastDoc;
        }

        public static string retornarSerieAlmacenSalida(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string Almacen, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string serie = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "retornarSerieAlmacenSalida", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%WhsCode%", Almacen);

                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    serie = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "retornarSerieAlmacenSalida", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return serie;
        }

        /// <summary>Obtiene el ultimo Kilometraje registrado de un vehiculo </summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="Path">Ruta</param>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario Orden de traslado</param>
        /// <param name="VehiculoPrincipal">True si las placas son del vehiculo principal</param>
        public static void ObtenerUltimoKmFinal(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Path, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool VehiculoPrincipal)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;
            try
            {
                if (oForm.Mode != BoFormMode.fm_FIND_MODE)
                {
                    oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                    string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(Path + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "KilometrajeFinal", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                    if (VehiculoPrincipal)
                    {
                        query = query.Replace("%Vehiculo%", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehiAsig", 0).ToString());

                    }
                    else
                    {
                        query = query.Replace("%Vehiculo%", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_vehi2Asig", 0).ToString());

                    }

                    query = query.Replace("%DocEntry%", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString());

                    oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                    if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        int KMFinalAnterior = int.Parse(oRecordSet.Fields.Item("KM").Value.ToString());

                        if (VehiculoPrincipal)
                        {
                            if (KMFinalAnterior != int.Parse(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_KmInicial", 0).ToString()))
                            {
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_KmInicial", 0, KMFinalAnterior.ToString());

                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (KMFinalAnterior != int.Parse(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_KmInicial2", 0).ToString()))
                            {
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue("U_KmInicial2", 0, KMFinalAnterior.ToString());

                            }
                        }

                    }

                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ObtenerUltimoKmFinal", sapCompany);

            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Verifica si el usuario tiene permisos para reabrir la OT</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="Path">Ruta</param>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario Orden de traslado</param>
        /// <returns>True si tiene permisos</returns>
        public static bool HabilitaReabrirOT(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Path, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {

                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(Path + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "PermisoReabrirOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                query = query.Replace("%CodigoUsuario%", sapCompany.UserSignature.ToString());

                oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                {

                    if (oRecordSet.Fields.Item("U_AbrirOT").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        string DocEntryOSF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("txtNroOSF").Specific).Value.ToString();
                        string DocSolicitud = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_numSolTras", 0).Trim();

                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DocEntryOSF) && !DocEntryOSF.Equals("0"))
                        {
                            if (EstadoOSF_OP_OT(sapCompany, sapApplication, Path, DocEntryOSF, DocSolicitud))
                            {
                                if (EstadoActualOT(sapCompany, sapApplication, Path, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("docEntry").Specific).Value.ToString()).Equals("Cerrado"))
                                {
                                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox ComboEstadoOT = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstOT").Specific;
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(ComboEstadoOT);
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(sapCompany, sapApplication, ComboEstadoOT, "SELECT REPLACE((SELECT * FROM DUMMY),'X', 'Abierto') AS Abierto, REPLACE((SELECT * FROM DUMMY),'X', 'Abierto') AS Abierto FROM DUMMY " +
                                                                                                              "UNION ALL SELECT REPLACE((SELECT * FROM DUMMY), 'X', 'Cerrado') AS Cerrado, REPLACE((SELECT * FROM DUMMY),'X', 'Cerrado') AS Cerrado FROM DUMMY");

                                    return true;
                                }


                            }

                        }

                    }

                }

                return false;

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "HabilitaReabrirOT", sapCompany);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Verifica que la OSF vinculada a la OT este en estado abierto </summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="Path">Ruta</param>
        /// <param name="DocEntryOSF">DocEntry OSF</param>
        /// <returns>True si la OSF esta en estado abierto</returns>
        public static bool EstadoOSF_OP_OT(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Path, string DocEntryOSF_OP,string nroST)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {

                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                if (documentoParqueCementerio(sapCompany,Path,nroST))
                {
                    string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(Path + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "EstadoOP", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                    query = query.Replace("%DocEntryOP%", DocEntryOSF_OP);

                    oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                    if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                    {

                        if (oRecordSet.Fields.Item("U_Estado").Value.ToString().Equals("01"))
                        {
                            return true;
                        }


                    }
                }
                else
                {

                    string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(Path + @"AddInQueries\QueriesOrdenLab.xml", "EstadoOSF", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                    query = query.Replace("%DocEntryOSF%", DocEntryOSF_OP);

                    oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                    if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                    {

                        if (oRecordSet.Fields.Item("U_Estado").Value.ToString().Equals("1"))
                        {
                            return true;
                        }


                    }
                }


                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EstadoOSF_OT", sapCompany);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Obtiene el estado actual de la OT</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="Path">Ruta</param>
        /// <param name="DocEntryOL">DocEntry OT</param>
        /// <returns>El estado de la OL</returns>
        public static string EstadoActualOT(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Path, string DocEntryOT)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {

                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                }

                return "";
            }
            catch (Exception e)

                return "";
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Valida si el KmFinal es superior al inicial</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="Path">Ruta</param>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario OT</param>
        /// <param name="VehiculoPrincipal">True si la validacion es para el vehiculo principal</param>
        /// <param name="CampoKMInicial">Nombre campo KM Inicial</param>
        /// <param name="CampoKMFinal">Nombre campo KM Final</param>
        /// <param name="ValidacionConsecutiva">True si se valida ambos vehiculos de forma consecutiva</param>
        /// <returns>True si cumple con la validacion</returns>
        public static bool ValidacionKMFinal(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Path, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool VehiculoPrincipal, string CampoKMInicial, string CampoKMFinal, bool ValidacionConsecutiva)
        {
            try
            {
                string LiberarPrimeraUbicacion = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar", 0).Trim();

                string LiberarSegundaUbicacion = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue("U_liberar2", 0).Trim();


                if (LiberarPrimeraUbicacion.Equals("Y") || LiberarSegundaUbicacion.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    ObtenerUltimoKmFinal(sapCompany, sapApplication, Path, oForm, VehiculoPrincipal);

                    int KMInicial = int.Parse(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue(CampoKMInicial, 0).ToString());

                    int KMFinal = int.Parse(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").GetValue(CampoKMFinal, 0).ToString());

                    if (KMFinal <= KMInicial)
                    {
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El Km Final debe ser superior al Km Inicial registrado.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                        if (!ValidacionConsecutiva)
                        {
                            sapApplication.MessageBox("El Km Final  debe ser superior al Km Inicial registrado.", 1, "Aceptar", "", "");

                        }

                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue(CampoKMFinal, 0, "");

                        return false;
                    }
                }

                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El Km Final debe ser superior al Km Inicial registrado.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                if (!ValidacionConsecutiva)
                {
                    sapApplication.MessageBox("El Km Final  debe ser superior al Km Inicial registrado.", 1, "Aceptar", "", "");

                }
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ORDENTRA").SetValue(CampoKMFinal, 0, "");

                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Obtiene documento parque cementerio</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="Path">Ruta</param>
        /// <param name="nroST">DocEntry OT</param>
        /// <returns>El estado de la OL</returns>
        public static bool documentoParqueCementerio(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string StrPath, string nroST)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {

                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                string strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(StrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ObtenerVinculoSolicitud", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%DocEntry%", nroST.Trim());
                oRecordSet.DoQuery(strQry);


                if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    string nroOP = oRecordSet.Fields.Item("U_DocEntryOPC").Value.ToString();

                    if (!nroOP.Equals(""))
                        return true;
                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EstadoActualOT", sapCompany);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }

            return false;
        }


        /// <summary>Verifica si la lista de chequeo es de una orden de parque directa</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="StrPath">Ruta</param>

        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {
                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                query = query.Replace("%DocEntry%", TipoListaChequeo);

                oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                    {

                    }

                }

                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ListaChequeoOPDirecta", sapCompany);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }
