        /// <summary>
        /// Clase para el manejo de Enumeraciones con String
        /// </summary>
        public class StringValueAttribute : System.Attribute
        {

            private string _value;

            public StringValueAttribute(string value)
            {
                _value = value;
            }

            public string Value
            {
                get { return _value; }
            }
        }

        public string GetStringValue(Enum value)
        {
            string output = null;
            Type type = value.GetType();
            Hashtable _stringValues = new Hashtable();

            if (_stringValues.ContainsKey(value))
                output = (_stringValues[value] as StringValueAttribute).Value;
            else
            {
                FieldInfo fi = type.GetField(value.ToString());
                StringValueAttribute[] attrs =
                   fi.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(StringValueAttribute),
                                           false) as StringValueAttribute[];
                if (attrs.Length > 0)
                {
                    _stringValues.Add(value, attrs[0]);
                    output = attrs[0].Value;
                }
            }

            return output;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Carga los datos generales del socio de negocios en la solicitud de servicio
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Form solicitud de servicio</param>
        public void cargarInfoSN(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool contra = false)
        {
            string cardCode = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim();
            string contrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();
            SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners oBP = (SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oBusinessPartners);
            string sPrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", SBOCompany);
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
            bool esPreOrden = false;
            bool esCotiza = esSerieCotizaciónApertura(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("Series", 0).Trim(), ref esPreOrden);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRs = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                if (oBP.GetByKey(cardCode) == false)
                {
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocios no existe. " + SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    ((SAPbouiCOM.Button)oForm.Items.Item("122").Specific).Caption = "Crear SN";
                }
                else
                {
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_NombreCo", 0, oBP.CardName);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TelContr", 0, oBP.Phone1);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Celular", 0, oBP.Cellular);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_DirContr", 0, oBP.Address);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Email", 0, oBP.EmailAddress);
                    SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_Municip\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_MUN\" WHERE \"U_codMun\" = '" + oBP.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_CS").Value + "'");
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Ciudad", 0, ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                    }

                    ((SAPbouiCOM.Button)oForm.Items.Item("122").Specific).Caption = "Actualizar SN";


                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("IdemIDCont").Specific).Checked)
                    {
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SolIdent", 0, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdContra", 0));
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SolNomb", 0, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NombreCo", 0));
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SolTelef", 0, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Celular", 0));
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_DirSolic", 0, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_DirContr", 0));
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_EmailSolic", 0, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Email", 0));

                    }

                    if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
                        oRs.DoQuery(cons.getQueryContratosActivos(cardCode, true, sPrenecFin));
                    else
                        oRs.DoQuery(cons.getQueryContratosActivos(cardCode, false, sPrenecFin));

                    if (oRs.RecordCount > 0 && esCotiza && contrato.Equals(""))
                    {
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Existen contratos vigentes.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                    }

                    if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                    {
                        oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                        oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                    }


                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRs);
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }

        }

                    SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                    oMatrix.Clear();
                    if (oAttach.GetByKey(oBP.AttachmentEntry))
                    {
                        for (int i = 0; i < oAttach.Lines.Count; i++)
                        {
                            oAttach.Lines.SetCurrentLine(i);
                            oMatrix.AddRow(1, oMatrix.RowCount);
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value = ObtenerRutaAnexos();
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_1").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value = oAttach.Lines.FileName;
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(oAttach.Lines.AttachmentDate, SBOApplication);
                        }
                    }

                    #endregion

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {

                oForm.Items.Item("6").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                oForm.Items.Item("cmdTipClie").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("5").Enabled = false;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oBP);
                oForm.Freeze(false);
                oForm.Refresh();
            }

        }

                        if (!valueInactivo.Equals(""))
                        {
                            ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_15").Specific;
                            ocmb.Select(valueInactivo, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                        }
                    }


                    #region Cargar Anexos
                    SAPbobsCOM.Attachments2 oAttach = (SAPbobsCOM.Attachments2)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.oAttachments2);
                    SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                    oMatrix.Clear();
                    if (oAttach.GetByKey(oBP.AttachmentEntry))
                    {
                        for (int i = 0; i < oAttach.Lines.Count; i++)
                        {
                            oAttach.Lines.SetCurrentLine(i);
                            oMatrix.AddRow(1, oMatrix.RowCount);
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value = ObtenerRutaAnexos();
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_1").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value = oAttach.Lines.FileName;
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(oMatrix.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(oAttach.Lines.AttachmentDate, SBOApplication);
                        }
                    }

                    #endregion



                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {

                oForm.Items.Item("6").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                oForm.Items.Item("5").Enabled = false;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oBP);
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }

        }


        private string ObtenerRutaAnexos()
        {
            CompanyService com_service = SBOCompany.GetCompanyService();
            SAPbobsCOM.PathAdmin oPathAdmin = com_service.GetPathAdmin();

            return System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(oPathAdmin.AttachmentsFolderPath);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// ELC 20170222 Actualiza vehiculos en el dato maestro de artículos
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Form solicitud de servicio</param>
        public bool ActualizarVehiculoServicio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool EsMatriz = false, int iFila = 0)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItms = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool bandera = true;
            bool prueba = true;
            try
            {
                prueba = oItms.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_13").Specific).Value);
                if (oItms.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_13").Specific).Value) == true)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_13").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                        {
                            oItms.ItemName = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_13").Specific).Value;
                        }
                        if (!((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_16").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                        {
                            oItms.ItemName = " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_16").Specific).Value;
                            oItms.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_vehiculo").Value = "Y";
                        }
                    }
                    catch { }

                    if (oItms.Update() == 0)
                    {
                        string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El vehículo se ha actualizado correctamente.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                        AnexosAgregarVehiculos(oForm, oItms);
                        bandera = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No se ha actualizado el vehículo correctamente. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                        bandera = false;
                    }

                }
                else
                {
                    string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("La placa no se encuentra dentro de los datos maestros de artículos. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    bandera = false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                string error = e.Message;
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El vehiculo no se ha actualizado correctamente. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oItms);
            }

            return bandera;
        }

                            if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_16").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                                oBp.FrozenRemarks = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_MOTSOCINAC", "Name", "Code", ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_15").Specific).Value.Trim(), SBOCompany);

                string IDContacto = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("TxIDCont").Specific).Value.ToString();

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(IDContacto))
                {
                    oBp.ContactEmployees.Name = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("TxIDCont").Specific).Value;
                    oBp.ContactEmployees.FirstName = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("TxNom").Specific).Value;

                    oBp.ContactEmployees.Phone1 = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("TxTel1").Specific).Value;
                    oBp.ContactEmployees.MobilePhone = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("TxTelMov").Specific).Value;

                oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_CSS_ZONA").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("TxtZona").Specific).Value.ToString();

                if (oBp.Add() == 0)
                {
                    if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("200").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"CardName\" FROM OCRD WHERE \"CardCode\"='" + oBp.CardCode + "'");
                            if (ors.RecordCount > 0)

                                string IdForm = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("200").Specific).Value;
                                SAPbouiCOM.Form oFrm1 = SBOApplication.Forms.Item(IdForm);
                                if (!EsMatriz)
                                {
                                    SAPbouiCOM.EditText oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFrm1.Items.Item("21").Specific;
                                    oedt.Value = oBp.CardCode;
                                    oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFrm1.Items.Item("23").Specific;
                                    oedt.Value = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                                    cargarInfoSN(oFrm1);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        catch { }
                        finally
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                        }
                    }

                    if (!oBp.CardCode.Equals(""))
                    {
                        #region crear alerta del nuevo cliente

                        try
                        {

                            bool exitoAlerta = ServicioFunerario.GenerarAlerta_Crear_Cliente(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, oBp.CardCode);
                            if (exitoAlerta)
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" se envio alerta de creacion de cliente", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);

                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Crear clientes", sapCompany);
                            //mensaje = e.Message;
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                    AnexosAgregar(oForm, oBp);

                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio se ha creado correctamente.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                    LimpiarFormularioSN(oForm);
                }
                else
                {
                    string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio no se ha creado correctamente. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    BubbleEvent = false;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                string error = e.Message;
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio no se ha creado correctamente. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                BubbleEvent = false;

            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oBp);
            }
        }


        public void ActualizarClienteServicio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, ref bool BubbleEvent)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners oBp = (SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.oBusinessPartners);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

                {
                    if (!((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmdEst").Specific).Value.Trim().Equals(""))
                    {
                        if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmdEst").Specific).Value.Trim().Equals("1"))
                        {
                            oBp.Valid = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;

                            if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_16").Specific).Value.Equals(""))

                                oBp.FrozenRemarks = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_MOTSOCINAC", "Name", "Code", ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_15").Specific).Value.Trim(), SBOCompany);
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch { }

                try
                {
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_permRecibNotif").Value = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("perRecN").ValueEx;
                }
                catch { }

                if (oBp.Add() == 0)
                {
                    AnexosAgregar(oForm, oBp);
                    LimpiarFormularioSNProveedor(oForm);
                    if (!oBp.CardCode.Equals(""))
                    {
                        #region crear alerta del nuevo Proveedor

                        try
                        {
                            bool exitoAlerta = ServicioFunerario.GenerarAlerta_Crear_Proveedor(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, oBp.CardCode);
                            if (exitoAlerta)
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" se envio alerta de creacion de cliente", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);

                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Crear clientes", sapCompany);
                            //mensaje = e.Message;
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio se ha creado correctamente.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);

                }
                else
                {
                    string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio no se ha creado correctamente. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    BubbleEvent = false;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                string error = e.Message;
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio no se ha creado correctamente. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                BubbleEvent = false;

            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oBp);
            }
        }

                    //oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_estrato").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item(7).Specific).Value;
                }

        /// <summary>Agrega anexos a un Socio de negocio</summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario donde estan los anexos</param>
        /// <param name="oBp">Socio de negocio</param>
        private void AnexosAgregar(Form oForm, BusinessPartners oBp)
        {
            try
            {
                SAPbobsCOM.Attachments2 oAttach = (SAPbobsCOM.Attachments2)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.oAttachments2);
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                string nombreArchivo = "";
                string pathArchivo = "";
                if (oBp.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value) == true)
                {
                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                    {
                        pathArchivo = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pathArchivo))
                        {
                            nombreArchivo = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo);
                            if (AnexoNoExiste(oBp.AttachmentEntry, nombreArchivo))
                            {

                                if (oBp.AttachmentEntry.Equals(0))
                                {
                                    oAttach.Lines.Add();
                                    oAttach.Lines.FileName = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo);
                                    oAttach.Lines.FileExtension = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(pathArchivo).Substring(1);
                                    oAttach.Lines.SourcePath = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(pathArchivo);
                                    oAttach.Lines.Override = SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tNO;

                                    int iAttEntry = -1;
                                    if (oAttach.Add() == 0)
                                    {
                                        iAttEntry = int.Parse(SBOCompany.GetNewObjectKey());
                                        oBp.AttachmentEntry = iAttEntry;
                                        oBp.Update();
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();

                                        if (error.Contains("Ya existe un archivo con este nombre"))
                                        {
                                            SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ya existe un archivo con este nombre : " + System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo).ToString(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                                            SBOApplication.MessageBox("Ya existe un archivo con este nombre: " + System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo).ToString(), 1, "Aceptar", "", "");

                                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = "";
                                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_1").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = "";
                                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = "";


                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error: " + error + "", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                            SBOApplication.MessageBox("Error: " + error, 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
                                        }


                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (oAttach.GetByKey(oBp.AttachmentEntry))
                                    {
                                        try
                                        {

                                            oAttach.Lines.Add();
                                            oAttach.Lines.FileName = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo);
                                            oAttach.Lines.FileExtension = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(pathArchivo).Substring(1);
                                            oAttach.Lines.SourcePath = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(pathArchivo);
                                            oAttach.Lines.Override = SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tNO;

                                            if (oAttach.Update() != 0)
                                            {

                                                string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                                                if (error.Contains("Ya existe un archivo con este nombre"))
                                                {
                                                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ya existe un archivo con este nombre : " + System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo).ToString(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                                                    SBOApplication.MessageBox("Ya existe un archivo con este nombre: " + System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo).ToString(), 1, "Aceptar", "", "");

                                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = "";
                                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_1").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = "";
                                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = "";

                                                }
                                                else
                                                {
                                                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error: " + error + "", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                                    SBOApplication.MessageBox("Error: " + error, 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
                                                }

                                            }
                                        }
                                        catch { }

                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "AnexosAgregar", SBOCompany);
            }
        }
        private void AnexosAgregarVehiculos(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Items oBp)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Attachments2 oAttach = (SAPbobsCOM.Attachments2)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.oAttachments2);
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
            string nombreArchivo = "";
            string pathArchivo = "";

            if (oMatrix.RowCount > 0)
            {
                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                {
                    pathArchivo = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                    nombreArchivo = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo);
                    if (AnexoNoExiste(oBp.AttachmentEntry, nombreArchivo))
                    {

                        if (oBp.AttachmentEntry.Equals(0))
                        {
                            oAttach.Lines.Add();
                            oAttach.Lines.FileName = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo);
                            oAttach.Lines.FileExtension = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(pathArchivo).Substring(1);
                            oAttach.Lines.SourcePath = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(pathArchivo);
                            oAttach.Lines.Override = SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                            int iAttEntry = -1;
                            if (oAttach.Add() == 0)
                            {
                                iAttEntry = int.Parse(SBOCompany.GetNewObjectKey());
                                //Assign the attachment to the GR object (GR is my SAPbobsCOM.Documents object)
                                oBp.AttachmentEntry = iAttEntry;
                                oBp.Update();
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                                SBOApplication.MessageBox(error);
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (oAttach.GetByKey(oBp.AttachmentEntry))
                            {
                                oAttach.Lines.Add();
                                oAttach.Lines.FileName = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(pathArchivo);
                                oAttach.Lines.FileExtension = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(pathArchivo).Substring(1);
                                oAttach.Lines.SourcePath = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(pathArchivo);
                                oAttach.Lines.Override = SAPbobsCOM.BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                                oAttach.Update();
                            }
                        }



                    }

                }

            }
        }
        private bool AnexoNoExiste(int actEntry, string nombreArchivo)
        {
            bool noExiste = false;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                string query = "SELECT \"AbsEntry\" FROM ATC1 WHERE \"AbsEntry\" = " + actEntry + "  AND  \"FileName\" = '" + nombreArchivo + "'";
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount == 0)
                {
                    noExiste = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SER01", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return noExiste;
        }

                                    oedt.Value = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                                    oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_CodSN").Cells.Item(iFila).Specific;
                                    oedt.Value = "C" + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        catch { }
                        finally
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                        }
                    }

                    if (!oBp.CardCode.Equals(""))
                    {
                        #region crear alerta del nuevo cliente

                        try
                        {

                            bool exitoAlerta = ServicioFunerario.GenerarAlerta_Crear_Cliente(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oForm, oBp.CardCode);

                                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" se envio alerta de creacion de cliente", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);

                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Crear clientes", SBOCompany);
                            //mensaje = e.Message;
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio se ha creado correctamente.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                    oForm.Close();
                }
                else
                {
                    string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio no se ha creado correctamente. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    //sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(sapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                }
                //oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_estrato").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item(7).Specific).Value;
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oBp);
            }
        }

        public void ActualizarSocioNegocio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners oBp = (SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.oBusinessPartners);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                if (oBp.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value) == true)
                {
                    //try
                    //{
                    //    oBp.Territory = int.Parse(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("33").Specific).Value);
                    //}
                    //catch { }

                    try
                    {

                        oBp.CardName = "";
                        oBp.Address = "";
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_1Apellido").Value = "";
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_2Apellido").Value = "";
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_Nombre").Value = "";

                        if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("6").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                        {
                            oBp.CardName += ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("6").Specific).Value;
                            try
                            {
                                oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_1Apellido").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("6").Specific).Value;
                            }
                            catch { }
                        }
                        if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("22").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                        {
                            oBp.CardName += " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("22").Specific).Value;
                            try
                            {
                                oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_2Apellido").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("22").Specific).Value;
                            }
                            catch { }
                        }
                        if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("23").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                        {
                            oBp.CardName += " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("23").Specific).Value;
                            try
                            {
                                oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_Nombre").Value += ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("23").Specific).Value;
                            }
                            catch { }
                        }
                        if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("24").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                        {
                            oBp.CardName += " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("24").Specific).Value;
                            try
                            {
                                oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_Nombre").Value += " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("24").Specific).Value;
                            }
                            catch { }
                        }

                        try
                        {
                            if (!((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("29").Specific).Value.ToString().Equals(""))
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_estciv").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("29").Specific).Value.ToString();
                                }
                                catch { }
                            }
                        }
                        catch { }
                    }
                    catch { }
                    oBp.CardType = SAPbobsCOM.BoCardTypes.cCustomer;
                    oBp.FederalTaxID = AgregarDigitoDeVerificacion(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value.Replace("C", "").Trim());
                    try
                    {
                        oBp.Address = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("1000004").Specific).Value.ToString();
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_dir1").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("1000004").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    }
                    catch { }
                    if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("27").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                    {
                        oBp.Address += " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("27").Specific).Value;
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_dir2").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("27").Specific).Value;
                    }
                    if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("25").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                    {
                        oBp.Address += " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("25").Specific).Value;
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_dir3").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("25").Specific).Value;
                    }
                    try
                    {
                        oBp.Address += " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("26").Specific).Value.ToString();
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_dir4").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("26").Specific).Selected.Value.ToString();
                    }
                    catch { }
                    if (!((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("17").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                    {
                        oBp.Address += " " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("17").Specific).Value;
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_dir5").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("17").Specific).Value;
                    }

                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_Address").Value = oBp.Address;
                    try
                    {
                        if (oBp.Addresses.Count > 1)
                        {
                            oBp.Addresses.SetCurrentLine(1);
                            if (oBp.Addresses.AddressName.Equals("Ship To"))
                                oBp.Addresses.Street = oBp.Address;
                        }
                    }
                    catch { }

                    try
                    {
                        oBp.Phone1 = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("18").Specific).Value;
                        oBp.Cellular = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("36").Specific).Value;
                        oBp.EmailAddress = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("38").Specific).Value;
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_addInFaElectronica_email_contacto_FE").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("38").Specific).Value;
                    }
                    catch { }
                    oBp.City = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_MUN", "U_Municip", "U_codMun", ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbMunic").Specific).Value, SBOCompany);
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_estrato").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("7").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    //oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_tipoviv").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("11").Specific).Selected.Value.ToString();
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_RTC").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbRegTri").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_TDC").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbTipDoc").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_TP").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbTipPer").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    cons.getGrupoCliente(ref ors);
                    oBp.GroupCode = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                    cons.getNacionalidad(ref ors);
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_BPExt").Value = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    cons.getTipoExtranjero(ref ors);
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_TBPE").Value = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_TP").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbTipPer").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Depto").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbDepto").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_BPCO_CS").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbMunic").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Ocupac").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbOcup").Specific).Value.ToString();
                    oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Barrio").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("txBarrio").Specific).Value;
                    try
                    {
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_tipoviv").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("11").Specific).Value;
                    }
                    catch { }
                    try
                    {
                        DateTime prueba = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsDateTime(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("8").Specific).Value, SBOApplication);
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_fecnac").Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsDateTime(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("8").Specific).Value, SBOApplication);
                    }
                    catch { }
                    try
                    {
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_estciv").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("29").Specific).Value;
                    }
                    catch { }
                    try
                    {
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_sexo").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("31").Specific).Value;
                    }
                    catch { }
                    try
                    {
                        oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_socTitul").Value = "Y";
                    }
                    catch { }

                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("56").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                        oBp.PayTermsGrpCode = -1;
                    else
                        oBp.PayTermsGrpCode = int.Parse(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("56").Specific).Value);

                    if (oBp.Update() == 0)
                    {
                        //SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
                        try
                        {
                            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"CardName\" FROM OCRD WHERE \"CardCode\"='" + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value + "'");
                            if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                            {
                                SAPbouiCOM.Form oFrm1 = SBOApplication.Forms.GetForm("OK1_SF_LLAMADA2", 0);
                                SAPbouiCOM.EditText oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFrm1.Items.Item("21").Specific;
                                oedt.Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value;
                                //oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFrm1.Items.Item("23").Specific;
                                //oedt.Value = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                                cargarInfoSN(oFrm1);
                            }
                        }
                        catch { }
                        finally
                        {
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                        }
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio se ha actualizado correctamente.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                        oForm.Close();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        string error = SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El socio de negocio no se ha actualizado correctamente. " + error, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                        //sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(sapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    }
                    //oBp.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_estrato").Value = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item(7).Specific).Value;
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oBp);
            }
        }

                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("8").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Especifique la fecha de nacimiento.";
                    }
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstCiv").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Especifique el estado civil.";
                    }
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbOcup").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Especifique la ocupación.";
                    }
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("18").Specific).Value.Equals("") && ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("36").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Especifique el teléfono o celular.";
                    }
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmdTipProv").Specific).Value.Equals("Conductor"))
                    {
                        if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("edVehi").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                        {
                            mensaje = "Especifique el vehículo asignado.";
                        }
                        if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbTipLic").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                        {
                            mensaje = "Especifique el tipo de licencia de conducción.";
                        }
                        if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("edVenLicCo").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                        {
                            mensaje = "Especifique la fecha de vencimiento de la licencia de conducción.";
                        }
                        if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbPlaVacVi").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                        {
                            mensaje = "Especifique si el plan de vacunación está vigente.";
                        }
                    }
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmdTipProv").Specific).Value.Equals("Sacerdote"))
                    {
                        if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbComRelig").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                        {
                            mensaje = "Especifique la comunidad religiosa.";
                        }
                        if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("edLicMinis").Specific).Value.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                        {
                            mensaje = "Especifique el número de licencia ministerial.";
                        }

                    }

                    string correo = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("38").Specific).Value;
                    if (correo.Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Especifique el correo.";
                    }

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            { mensaje = e.Message; }


            return mensaje;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Valida la edad del fallecido de acuerdo con el plan del contrato
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Form solicitud de servicio</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool validarEdad(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            int edadFallecido, edadMaxima, edadMinima;
            string codigoPlan, codigoParentesco, codigoTipoBene;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            bool resultado = true;

            try
            {
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                edadFallecido = Convert.ToInt16(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Edad", 0));

                codigoPlan = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_CodPlan", 0).Trim();
                codigoParentesco = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Parentes", 0).Trim();
                codigoTipoBene = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoBene", 0).Trim();

                //verificar la edad máxima permitida para el plan del contrato
                //verificar si el plan tiene beneficiarios definidos

                cons.consultarBeneficiariosPlanTipoB(ref oRS, codigoPlan, codigoParentesco, codigoTipoBene);
                //si tiene, se verifica la edad a nivel de linea
                if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    //SBOApplication.MessageBox("el plan si tiene beneficiarios", 1, "ok", "", "");
                    edadMaxima = (int)oRS.Fields.Item("U_edmax").Value;
                    if (edadFallecido > edadMaxima)
                    {
                        //alerta, proced autoriz
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Edad fuera del rango mínimo/máximo para el parentesco del grupo incluido en el plan.");
                        resultado = false;
                    }
                }
                else //si no tiene, se verifica la edad a nivel de cabecera
                {
                    //oRS = null;
                    cons.consultarEdadMinimaMaximaPlan(ref oRS, codigoPlan);
                    //SBOApplication.MessageBox("el plan no tiene beneficiarios", 1, "ok", "", "");
                    edadMaxima = (int)oRS.Fields.Item("U_edmax").Value;
                    edadMinima = (int)oRS.Fields.Item("U_edmin").Value;
                    if (edadFallecido > edadMaxima || edadFallecido < edadMinima)
                    {
                        //alerta, proced autoriz
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Edad fuera del rango mínimo/máximo para el parentesco del grupo incluido en el plan.");
                        resultado = false;
                    }
                }

                //se debe validar también edad en repatriación
                //mirar si aplica repatriación
                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("85").Specific).Checked)
                {
                    //obtener plan de repatriación
                    codigoPlan = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("121").Specific).Value;
                    //verificar edad minima/maxima a nivel de cabecera
                    cons.consultarEdadMinimaMaximaPlan(ref oRS, codigoPlan);
                    edadMaxima = (int)oRS.Fields.Item("U_edmax").Value;
                    edadMinima = (int)oRS.Fields.Item("U_edmin").Value;
                    if (edadFallecido > edadMaxima || edadFallecido < edadMinima)
                    {
                        //alerta, proced autoriz
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Edad no cubierta de acuerdo con el plan de repatriación.");
                        resultado = false;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC002", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
            }
            return resultado;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Valida el parentesco del fallecido no registrado de acuerdo con el plan del contrato
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Form solicitud de servicio</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool validarParentescoBenfNoReg(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            string codigoPlan, codigoParentesco, codigoTipoBene;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            bool resultado = true;

            try
            {
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                codigoParentesco = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Parentes", 0).Trim();
