        /// <summary>
        /// Establece las condiciones de los diferentes CFL de la matriz de elementos para mostrar los artículos de acuerdo con el elemento, la calificación y ciudad
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oCFL">Objeto CFL</param>
        /// <param name="idContrato">Código del contrato</param>
        /// <param name="idElemento">Código del elemento</param>
        /// <param name="ciudad">Nombre ciudad</param>
        /// <param name="strTipo">FRC 20140520: Tipo de Articulo (C: Cubuerto, A: Adicional, M: Mejora)</param>
        public void setCondicionesCFLElementos(Form oForm, ref SAPbouiCOM.ChooseFromList oCFL, string idContrato, string idElemento, string ciudad, string strTipo, string strPlan = "")
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Conditions oConds = new Conditions();
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSProteccion = null;
            string minValue, maxValue;
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
            try
            {
                oRSProteccion = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                if (!idContrato.Equals("") && !prenec.Equals("Y"))
                    cons.getProteccion(ref oRSProteccion, idContrato);
                else
                {
                    string strPlanPart = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_CodPlan", 0).Trim();
                    if (strPlan.Equals("2"))
                        cons.getProteccion(ref oRSProteccion, "", strPlanPart);
                    else
                        cons.getProteccion(ref oRSProteccion, "", strPlanPart);

                }
                minValue = oRSProteccion.Fields.Item("U_min").Value.ToString();
                maxValue = oRSProteccion.Fields.Item("U_max").Value.ToString();

                if (minValue.Length == 1)
                    minValue = "0" + minValue;

                if (maxValue.Length == 1)
                    maxValue = "0" + maxValue;

                //oConds = oCFL.GetConditions();

                //si el servicio es de prevision (tiene contrato)
                if (!idContrato.Equals(""))
                {
                    //FRC 20140521 Se valida si el Tipo de Artículo es "Cubierto" para aplicar todas las condiciones, de lo contrario solo se aplica la condición del elemento.
                    if (strTipo.Equals("C"))
                    {
                        //si el CFL no tiene condiciones, se le agregan 5 q corresponden al elemento, calificacion
                        //y ciudad
                        /**/

                        if (oConds.Count <= 1)
                        {
                            oConds.Add();
                            oConds.Add();
                            oConds.Add();
                            oConds.Add();
                        }

                        //establecer condiciones
                        //ej: where ((u_ok1_sf_elem = '1') and ((u_ok1_sf_calif >= '5') or (u_ok1_sf_calif <= '10')) and ((u_ok1_sf_ciudad='Manizales') or (u_ok1_sf_ciudad is null)))

                        //condicion de elemento
                        oConds.Item(0).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(0).Alias = "U_OK1_SF_ELEM";
                        oConds.Item(0).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_EQUAL;
                        oConds.Item(0).CondVal = idElemento;
                        oConds.Item(0).BracketCloseNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(0).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_AND;

                        //condicion de calificacion
                        oConds.Item(1).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(1).Alias = "U_OK1_SF_CALIF";
                        oConds.Item(1).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_GRATER_EQUAL;
                        oConds.Item(1).CondVal = minValue;
                        oConds.Item(1).BracketCloseNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(1).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_AND;

                        oConds.Item(2).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(2).Alias = "U_OK1_SF_CALIF";
                        oConds.Item(2).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_LESS_EQUAL;
                        oConds.Item(2).CondVal = maxValue;
                        oConds.Item(2).BracketCloseNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(2).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_AND;

                        oConds.Item(3).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(3).Alias = "validFor";
                        oConds.Item(3).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_END;
                        oConds.Item(3).CondVal = "Y";
                        oConds.Item(3).BracketCloseNum = 1;
                        //oConds.Item(2).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_AND;

                        ////condicion de ciudad - se establece para traer los articulos de la ciudad indicada o de aquellos q no tienen ciudad asignada
                        //oConds.Item(3).BracketOpenNum = 2;
                        //oConds.Item(3).Alias = "U_OK1_SF_CIUDAD";
                        //oConds.Item(3).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_EQUAL;
                        //oConds.Item(3).CondVal = ciudad;
                        //oConds.Item(3).BracketCloseNum = 1;
                        //oConds.Item(3).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_OR;

                        //oConds.Item(4).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                        //oConds.Item(4).Alias = "U_OK1_SF_CIUDAD";
                        //oConds.Item(4).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_IS_NULL;
                        //oConds.Item(4).BracketCloseNum = 3;
                        /**/
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (oConds.Count == 0)
                        {
                            oConds.Add();
                            oConds.Add();
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            for (int i = 1; i < oConds.Count; i++)
                            {
                                oConds.Item(i).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_NONE;
                            }
                        }

                        oConds.Item(0).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(0).Alias = "U_OK1_SF_ELEM";
                        oConds.Item(0).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_EQUAL;
                        oConds.Item(0).CondVal = idElemento;
                        oConds.Item(0).BracketCloseNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(0).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_AND;
                        oConds.Item(1).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                        oConds.Item(1).Alias = "validFor";
                        oConds.Item(1).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_END;
                        oConds.Item(1).CondVal = "Y";
                        oConds.Item(1).BracketCloseNum = 1;
                    }
                }

                //si el servicio no es previsión (no tiene contrato), solo se pone condición de elemento
                if (idContrato.Equals(""))
                {
                    if (oConds.Count == 0)
                    {
                        oConds.Add();
                        oConds.Add();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        for (int i = 1; i < oConds.Count; i++)
                        {
                            oConds.Item(i).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_NONE;
                        }
                    }

                    //establecer condiciones
                    //ej: where (u_ok1_sf_elem = '1')

                    //condicion de elemento
                    oConds.Item(0).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                    oConds.Item(0).Alias = "U_OK1_SF_ELEM";
                    oConds.Item(0).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_EQUAL;
                    oConds.Item(0).CondVal = idElemento;
                    oConds.Item(0).BracketCloseNum = 1;
                    oConds.Item(0).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_AND;
                    oConds.Item(1).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                    oConds.Item(1).Alias = "validFor";
                    oConds.Item(1).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_END;
                    oConds.Item(1).CondVal = "Y";
                    oConds.Item(1).BracketCloseNum = 1;

                }

                oCFL.SetConditions(oConds);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "setCondicionesCFLElementos", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSProteccion != null)
                {
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSProteccion);
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oConds);
                }
            }

        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Carga los auxilios en la solicitud, de acuerdo con el contrato
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public void cargarAuxilios(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixAuxilios;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSAuxilios = null;
            string plan;

            try
            {
                oRSAuxilios = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                //idContrato = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("35").Specific).Selected.Value.ToString();
                plan = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("94").Specific).Value.ToString();

                //traer auxilios del contrato
                cons.getAuxilios(ref oRSAuxilios, plan);

                //mostrar elementos en matrix
                if (oRSAuxilios.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    oMatrixAuxilios = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                    oMatrixAuxilios.Clear();
                    while (!oRSAuxilios.EoF)
                    {
                        oMatrixAuxilios.AddRow(1, oMatrixAuxilios.RowCount);
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixAuxilios.Columns.Item("col_f").Cells.Item(oMatrixAuxilios.RowCount).Specific).Value = "";
                        //  oRSAuxilios.Fields.Item("code").Value.ToString();
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixAuxilios.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(oMatrixAuxilios.RowCount).Specific).Value =
                            oRSAuxilios.Fields.Item("Name").Value.ToString();
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixAuxilios.Columns.Item("col_3").Cells.Item(oMatrixAuxilios.RowCount).Specific).Value =
                            oRSAuxilios.Fields.Item("U_codaux").Value.ToString();
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixAuxilios.Columns.Item("col_bmin").Cells.Item(oMatrixAuxilios.RowCount).Specific).Value =
                           oRSAuxilios.Fields.Item("U_basemin").Value.ToString();
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixAuxilios.Columns.Item("col_valor").Cells.Item(oMatrixAuxilios.RowCount).Specific).Value =
                            oRSAuxilios.Fields.Item("U_valor").Value.ToString();

                        oRSAuxilios.MoveNext();

                    }
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC007", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSAuxilios != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSAuxilios);
            }

        }

        public void cargarInfoContrato(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string strcontrato)
        {
            string idContrato;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSContrato = null, oRSPlan = null, oRSPlanEq = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSConvenio = null;
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
            string sPrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", SBOCompany);
            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbPlanEq").Specific;

            try
            {
                oRSContrato = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRSPlan = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRSPlanEq = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRSConvenio = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                //tomar idcontrato del combo

                idContrato = strcontrato;
                cons.getContrato(ref oRSContrato, idContrato, prenec, sPrenecFin);

                if (!prenec.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    string var = oRSContrato.Fields.Item("U_vigencia").Value.ToString();

                    //llenar edits
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Vigencia", 0, "");
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Vigencia", 0, oRSContrato.Fields.Item("U_vigencia").Value.ToString());
                    //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Vigencia", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(fecha, SBOApplication));
                }
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_CodPlan", 0, "");
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_CodPlan", 0, oRSContrato.Fields.Item("U_plan").Value.ToString().Trim());
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_conve", 0, oRSContrato.Fields.Item("U_conve").Value.ToString().Trim());

                cons.getPlan(ref oRSPlan, oRSContrato.Fields.Item("u_plan").Value.ToString().Trim());
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Plan", 0, "");
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Plan", 0, oRSPlan.Fields.Item("Name").Value.ToString().Trim());

                string query = "SELECT T0.\"U_codPlan\", \"U_nomPlan\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_CONV_PLANES\" T0 WHERE  T0.\"U_codPlanEquiv\" ='" + oRSContrato.Fields.Item("U_plan").Value.ToString().Trim() + "' AND T0.\"DocEntry\" = '" + oRSContrato.Fields.Item("U_conve").Value.ToString().Trim() + "'";
                oRSPlanEq.DoQuery(query);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.DelValidValues(oCombo);

                if (oRSPlanEq.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item("cbPlanEq").Enabled = true;
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oCombo, query);
                    oCombo.ValidValues.Add("", "");

                }
                else
                    oForm.Items.Item("cbPlanEq").Enabled = false;

                #region Tipo Servicio
                string tipoServ = oRSPlan.Fields.Item("U_tipServ").Value.ToString().Trim();
                switch (tipoServ)
                {
                    case "I":
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipoCubr", 0, "1");
                        break;
                    case "T":
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipoCubr", 0, "2");
                        break;
                    case "P":
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipoCubr", 0, "3");
                        break;
                    default:
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipoCubr", 0, "1");
                        break;
                }
                #endregion

                cons.getConvenio(oRSConvenio, idContrato, prenec, sPrenecFin);
                // cons.getNameConvenio(oRSConvenio, idContrato);




                string empresa = "";
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Empresa", 0, "");
                // empresa = oRSConvenio.Fields.Item("U_empNom").Value.ToString().Trim();
                empresa = ServicioFunerario.RetornarNombreConvenio(SBOCompany, idContrato, prenec);
                if (empresa.Length > 100)
                    empresa = empresa.Substring(0, 100);
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Empresa", 0, empresa);

                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_cobSaldo", 0, oRSConvenio.Fields.Item("U_cobSaldo").Value.ToString());
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_misaConme", 0, oRSConvenio.Fields.Item("U_misaConm").Value.ToString());
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_convPart", 0, oRSConvenio.Fields.Item("U_convPart").Value.ToString());


                oForm.Items.Item("btnValCare").Enabled = true;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC008", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSContrato != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSContrato);
                if (oRSPlan != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSPlan);
                if (oRSConvenio != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSConvenio);
                if (oRSPlanEq != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSPlanEq);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// ELC 20170727 Método que carga los documentos configurados en el convenio
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Form solicitud de servicio</param>
        public void cargarInfoDocumentosConvenio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string strcontrato, string strconvenio = "")
        {
            string strQuery = string.Empty;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixDocumentos;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
            string sPrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", SBOCompany);
            bool remover = true;
            int fila = 1;
            ArrayList oDocumento = new ArrayList();
            string lineId = "";
            string nOSF = "";

            try
            {

                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oMatrixDocumentos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_9").Specific;
                SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_CUSTDOC");
                nOSF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString();
                if (nOSF.Equals(""))
                    nOSF = "0";

                #region Borrar Registros sin diligenciar

                oMatrixDocumentos.FlushToDataSource();


                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrixDocumentos.RowCount; i++)
                {

                    remover = true;

                    if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_tipoTramite", i - 1).Equals(""))
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_estadoTramite", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_dispDoc", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_ciudTramito", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_notarTramito", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_nroRegistro", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_nombEntrega", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_fechaEntrega", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_horaEntrega", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_nombRecibe", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_fechaRecibe", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_horaRecibe", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;
                    else if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_Observac", i - 1).Equals("") && remover)
                        remover = false;

                    if (remover)
                    {
                        lineId = oDBS.GetValue("LineId", i - 1);
                        oDocumento.Add(lineId);
                    }


                }

                foreach (string linea in oDocumento)
                {
                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrixDocumentos.RowCount; i++)
                    {

                        if (linea.Equals(oDBS.GetValue("LineId", i - 1)))
                        {
                            oDBS.RemoveRecord(i - 1);
                            break;
                        }


                    }
                }

                oMatrixDocumentos.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                ServicioFunerario.NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_CUSTDOC", "mtx_9");


                #endregion

                #region Agregar Líneas Documento Nuevos
                fila = 1;
                bool valido = true;
                if (!strcontrato.Equals(""))
                {
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetDocumentosContrato", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        if (sPrenecFin.Equals("Y"))
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%tb%", "@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HEAD");
                        else
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%tb%", "@OK1_EXE_PRENE_HEAD");
                    }
                    else
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%tb%", "@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD");

                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%NumContrato%", strcontrato);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%osf%", nOSF);
                }
                else
                {
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetDocumentosConvenio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%NumConvenio%", strconvenio);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%osf%", nOSF);
                }



                oRSElementos.DoQuery(strQuery);
                //oDBS.Clear();
                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {
                        valido = ExisteDocumentoMatriz(oMatrixDocumentos, oRSElementos.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString(), oDBS);
                        if (valido)
                        {
                            oDBS.InsertRecord(oDBS.Size);
                            oDBS.SetValue("LineId", oDBS.Size - 1, (oDBS.Size).ToString());
                            oDBS.SetValue("U_documento", oDBS.Size - 1, oRSElementos.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                            oDBS.SetValue("U_obligatorio", oDBS.Size - 1, oRSElementos.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                        }
                        oMatrixDocumentos.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }


                }


                if (oDBS.GetValue("U_documento", 0).Equals(""))
                {
                    oDBS.RemoveRecord(0);
                    oMatrixDocumentos.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                    ServicioFunerario.NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(oForm, "@OK1_SF_CUSTDOC", "mtx_9");
                }
                #endregion
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC008", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                //oForm.Items.Item("tab_0").Click();
                //oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        private bool ExisteDocumentoMatriz(SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixDocumentos, string documento, DBDataSource oDBS)
        {
            bool valido = true;
            string documentoActual = "";

            oMatrixDocumentos.FlushToDataSource();
            for (int i = 0; i < oDBS.Size; i++)
            {
                documentoActual = oDBS.GetValue("U_documento", i).Trim();
                if (documentoActual.Equals(documento))
                {
                    valido = false;
                    break;
                }

            }

            return valido;
        }



        /// <summary>
        /// ELC 20170731 Método que confirma si el convenio esta en estado bloqueado por Mora
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Form solicitud de servicio</param>
        public bool ConfirmarConvenioBloqueadoXMora(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string strcontrato)
        {
            string strQuery = string.Empty;
            bool esConvBloq = false;
            string strBloq = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSBXC = null;
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
            string sPrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", SBOCompany);


            try
            {
                oRSBXC = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetConvenioMoroso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    if (sPrenecFin.Equals("Y"))
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%tb%", "@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HEAD");
                    else
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%tb%", "@OK1_EXE_PRENE_HEAD");
                }
                else
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%tb%", "@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD");

                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%NumContrato%", strcontrato);
                oRSBXC.DoQuery(strQuery);

                if (oRSBXC.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    strBloq = oRSBXC.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    if (strBloq.Trim().Equals("Y"))
                        esConvBloq = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC008", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSBXC);
            }
            return esConvBloq;
        }

            }
        }
        public static int CalcularEdadFallecer(DateTime birthdate, DateTime deadDate)
        {
            // get the difference in years
            int years = deadDate.Year - birthdate.Year;

            if (birthdate.Month < deadDate.Month || (birthdate.Month == deadDate.Month && birthdate.Day < deadDate.Day))
                // if (deadDate.Month < birthdate.Month || (deadDate.Month == birthdate.Month && deadDate.Day < birthdate.Day))
                years--;

            return years;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Carga los datos del beneficiario seleccionado en la sección de datos de fallecido
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oFormBenef">Form búsqueda beneficiario</param>
        /// <param name="idContrato">Código contrato</param>
        public void cargarInfoFallecido(SAPbouiCOM.Form oFormBenef, ref string idContrato)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Grid oGrid = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Form oFormLlamada = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            DateTime fecha = new DateTime();
            int fila = 0;
            string cardCode = "", strQuery = "", strTD = "";
            string parentescoName = "";
            string parentescoCode = "";

            try
            {


                oGrid = (SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oFormBenef.Items.Item("grid_1").Specific;
                fila = oGrid.Rows.SelectedRows.Item(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);

                if (oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Fecha Nacimiento").Cells.Item(fila).Value != null)
                    fecha = (DateTime)oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Fecha Nacimiento").Cells.Item(fila).Value;

                //int iEdad = OK1.SBO.Helpers.CalculateAge(fecha);
                string uniqueform = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormBenef.Items.Item("uniform").Specific).Value.ToString();


                oFormLlamada = SBOApplication.Forms.Item(uniqueform);
                //if (idContrato.Equals(""))
                idContrato = oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();

                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_IdFallec", 0, oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("No. Doc").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString());
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_NombreFa", 0, oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Beneficiario").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString());
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_FechaNac", 0, fecha.ToString("yyyyMMdd"));
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Edad", 0, oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Edad").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString());
                parentescoName = oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Parentesco").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString();


                parentescoCode = ServicioFunerario.RetornarCodeParentesco(SBOCompany, parentescoName);
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Parentes", 0, parentescoCode);
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_nParentes", 0, DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PARENTESCOS", "Name", "Code", parentescoCode, SBOCompany));


                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipoBene", 0, oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("TipoBenef").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString());

                string tipodoc = oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("TipoDoc").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString();
                tipodoc = RetornarCodeTipoDocumento(SBOCompany, tipodoc);

                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipDoc", 0, tipodoc);
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_nTipDoc", 0, DevolverItemEnTabla("@BPCO_TD", "Name", "Code", tipodoc, SBOCompany));

                //oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipDoc", 0, oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("TipoDoc").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString());

                //FRC 20140301 Se copia la edad al form
                //oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Edad", 0, oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Edad").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString());
                // oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Edad", 0, iEdad.ToString());

                //si primero se elige el beneficiario, el sistema indica el codigo del SN
                if (oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                {
                    cardCode = oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Contratante").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString();
                    idContrato = oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("No. Contrato").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString();
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_IdContra", 0, cardCode);
                }

                //en el caso de repatriación, cargar país y ciudad origen
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_PaisRep", 0, "");
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_nPaisRep", 0, "");
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_CiudRep", 0, "");
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetInfoBeneficiarioRepatriacion", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idBeneficiario%", oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdFallec", 0));
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idContrato%", idContrato);
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_PaisRep", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_PaisRep").Value.ToString());
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_nPaisRep", 0, DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PAISES", "Name", "Code", oRS.Fields.Item("U_PaisRep").Value.ToString(), SBOCompany));
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_CiudRep", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_ciuOr").Value.ToString());
                }
                strTD = oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("TipoDoc").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString();
                if (strTD.Equals("ADT"))
                    oFormLlamada.Items.Item("43").Enabled = true;
                else
                    oFormLlamada.Items.Item("43").Enabled = false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC010", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                { System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS); }
            }
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Carga los datos del beneficiario seleccionado en la sección de datos de fallecido
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oFormBenef">Form búsqueda beneficiario</param>
        /// <param name="idContrato">Código contrato</param>
        public void cargarinformaciónFallecido(SAPbouiCOM.Form oFormLlamada, string idContrato, string strIdPag, string No_Doc, string Beneficiario, string lafecha, string parentescoName, string TipoBenef, string tipodoc, int fila, bool BenefFallecido)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            string cardCode = "", strQuery = "", strTD = "";
            string parentescoCode = "";

            try
            {
                oFormLlamada.Items.Item("51").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                oFormLlamada.Items.Item("43").Enabled = BenefFallecido;
                oFormLlamada.Items.Item("45").Enabled = BenefFallecido;
                oFormLlamada.Items.Item("47").Enabled = BenefFallecido;
                oFormLlamada.Items.Item("55").Enabled = BenefFallecido;
                oFormLlamada.Items.Item("TipDoc").Enabled = BenefFallecido;

                if (BenefFallecido)
                {
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_BenNoReg", 0, "Y");
                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormLlamada.Items.Item("43").Specific).Value = "";
                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormLlamada.Items.Item("45").Specific).Value = "";
                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormLlamada.Items.Item("47").Specific).Value = "";
                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFormLlamada.Items.Item("53").Specific).Value = "";

                }
                else
                {
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_BenNoReg", 0, "N");
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_IdFallec", 0, No_Doc);
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_NombreFa", 0, Beneficiario);
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_FechaNac", 0, lafecha);

                    if (ServicioFunerario.ExisteCodeParentesco(SBOCompany, parentescoName))
                    {
                        oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Parentes", 0, parentescoName);
                        oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_nParentes", 0, DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PARENTESCOS", "Name", "Code", parentescoName, SBOCompany));
                    }


                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipoBene", 0, TipoBenef);

                    tipodoc = RetornarCodeTipoDocumento(SBOCompany, tipodoc);

                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TipDoc", 0, tipodoc);
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_nTipDoc", 0, DevolverItemEnTabla("@BPCO_TD", "Name", "Code", tipodoc, SBOCompany));

                    strTD = tipodoc;
                    if (strTD.Equals("ADT"))
                        oFormLlamada.Items.Item("43").Enabled = true;
                    else
                        oFormLlamada.Items.Item("43").Enabled = false;

                }




                //si primero se elige el beneficiario, el sistema indica el codigo del SN
                if (oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                {
                    cardCode = strIdPag;
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_IdContra", 0, cardCode);
                }

                //en el caso de repatriación, cargar país y ciudad origen
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_PaisRep", 0, "");
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_nPaisRep", 0, "");
                oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_CiudRep", 0, "");
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetInfoBeneficiarioRepatriacion", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idBeneficiario%", oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdFallec", 0));
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idContrato%", idContrato);
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_PaisRep", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_PaisRep").Value.ToString());
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_nPaisRep", 0, DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PAISES", "Name", "Code", oRS.Fields.Item("U_PaisRep").Value.ToString(), SBOCompany));
                    oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_CiudRep", 0, oRS.Fields.Item("U_ciuOr").Value.ToString());
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC010", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                { System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS); }
            }
        }
