        /// <summary>
        /// Obtiene el precio del artículo de acuerdo con el convenio del proveedor o la lista de precios
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="fila"></param>
        public void getPrecioArticulo(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, int fila)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners oBP = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.EditText oEdit = null;
            string strQuery;
            //bool encontroValorEnListaPrecio = false;
            int row = fila + 1;
            double precio = 0, cantidad, totalElemento;

            //obtener precio del item para el proveedor
            //1. traer precio del convenio de proveedor si existe,
            //2. sino, traer precio de la lista de precios si existe,
            //3. sino, traer precio como costo del artículo

            try
            {
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oBP = (SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oBusinessPartners);
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                //obtengo la cantidad a pedir del elemento
                cantidad = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Cant", fila));
                precio = 0;

                //3. traer costo del artículo; se calcula siempre antes de traer cualquier otro precio
                SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                if (oItem.GetByKey(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_ItemCode", fila)))
                {
                    precio = oItem.AvgStdPrice;
                }
                if (oBP.GetByKey(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_CardCode", fila)))
                {
                    ////1. traer precio del convenio de proveedor si existe
                    //strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetPrecioArticuloDeConvenio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    //strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%codProveedor%", oBP.CardCode);
                    //strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%codArticulo%", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_ItemCode", fila));
                    //oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    //if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                    //{
                    //    precio = Convert.ToDouble(oRS.Fields.Item("U_Precio").Value);
                    //}
                    //else
                    //{
                    //2. obtener lista de precios del proveedor
                    //obtener item
                    //SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                    if (oItem.GetByKey(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_ItemCode", fila)))
                    {
                        for (int i = 0; i < oItem.PriceList.Count; i++)
                        {
                            oItem.PriceList.SetCurrentLine(i);

                            //si la lista de precios del proveedor
                            //corresponde con la del artículo, mostrar el precio
                            if (oBP.PriceListNum == oItem.PriceList.PriceList)
                            {
                                precio = oItem.PriceList.Price;
                                //encontroValorEnListaPrecio = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        //3. si no encuentra lista de precios, obtiene el costo del articulo
                        //if (!encontroValorEnListaPrecio)
                        //{
                        //    precio = oItem.AvgStdPrice;
                        //}
                    }
                    else
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El artículo no existe. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    //}

                }

                //calcular el total por elemento
                totalElemento = precio;
                //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_Valor", fila, totalElemento.ToString());
                if (totalElemento > 0)
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_ValorCom", fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, totalElemento, false, "", -1));
                else
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_ValorCom", fila, "0");
                ((SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific).LoadFromDataSourceEx();

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC021", SBOCompany);
            }
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// FRC 20140301 Obtiene el precio de Mejora o Adicional del artículo de acuerdo a la lista de precios
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="fila"></param>
        /// <param name="Tipo">A: Adicional M: Mejora</param>
        public void getPrecioArticuloAdiMej(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, int fila, string Tipo)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("80").Specific;
            int row = fila + 1;
            double precio, cantidad, totalElemento, porDto;
            string sede = "";
            string strLstAdic = "1";
            //1. Trae precio de la lista de precios de Adicion o Mejora,

            try
            {
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                ((SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific).FlushToDataSource();
                //obtengo la cantidad a pedir del elemento
                cantidad = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Cant", fila));
                porDto = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_VlrDto", fila));
                precio = 0;

                cons.getLstPrecioAdicional(ref oRS);
                if (oRS.RecordCount > 1)
                    strLstAdic = oRS.Fields.Item("U_LstAdic").Value.ToString();

                cons.getLstPrecioMejora(ref oRS);
                string strLstMejora = oRS.Fields.Item("U_LstMejo").Value.ToString();
                string strLstTipoServicios = "";
                bool aplica = ListaPrecioTipoServicio(oCombo.Selected.Value, ref strLstTipoServicios);

                SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                if (oItem.GetByKey(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_ItemCode", fila)))
                {
                    precio = oItem.AvgStdPrice;
                    for (int i = 0; i < oItem.PriceList.Count; i++)
                    {
                        oItem.PriceList.SetCurrentLine(i);

                        if (aplica)
                        {
                            if (oItem.PriceList.PriceList == Convert.ToInt32(strLstTipoServicios) && Tipo != "C")
                            {
                                precio = oItem.PriceList.Price;
                                //encontroValorEnListaPrecio = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (Tipo == "A")
                            {
                                //si la lista de precios del proveedor
                                //corresponde con la del artículo, mostrar el precio
                                if (oItem.PriceList.PriceList == Convert.ToInt32(strLstAdic))
                                {
                                    precio = oItem.PriceList.Price;
                                    //encontroValorEnListaPrecio = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            else if (Tipo == "M")
                            {
                                //si la lista de precios del proveedor
                                //corresponde con la del artículo, mostrar el precio
                                if (oItem.PriceList.PriceList == Convert.ToInt32(strLstMejora))
                                {
                                    precio = oItem.PriceList.Price;
                                    //encontroValorEnListaPrecio = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            else
                                precio = 0;
                        }
                    }

                }
                else
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El artículo no existe. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);



                //calcular el total por elemento
                totalElemento = precio * cantidad;
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_Valor", fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, totalElemento, false, "", -1));
                totalElemento = totalElemento - porDto;
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_ValorFac", fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, totalElemento, false, "", -1));

                ((SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific).LoadFromDataSourceEx();
                //calcularGastoTotal(oForm);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC021", SBOCompany);
            }
        }

        #region Gestiona Iva
        public bool GestionaIva(string TipoElemento, string proceso, double totalLinea)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string existe = "";
            string strQuery = "";
            try
            {

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                if (!TipoElemento.Equals(""))
                {
                    if ((TipoElemento.Equals("M") || TipoElemento.Equals("E")) && totalLinea.Equals(0))
                        TipoElemento = "C";

                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "AplicaIva", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%TipoElemento%", TipoElemento);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%proceso%", proceso);
                    ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        existe = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    }
                    if (existe.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return false;
        }
        #endregion

        public void CargarSaldosContrato(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            double ValorDSeg = 0;
            double ValorSaldo = 0; //Cartera
            double ValorTotal = 0;
            double ValorPendFact = 0; // Fin Vig
            double ValorTotalCont = 0;
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
            string sPrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", SBOCompany);

            //U_fecCober
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            addInExequial.ClaseContrato oContrato = new addInExequial.ClaseContrato(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
            addInExequial.ClaseConvenio oConvenio = new addInExequial.ClaseConvenio(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
            string strQuery = "";
            string factUnificada = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PARAMETROS", "U_factUnificada", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);


            try
            {
                string strNumContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).ToString().Trim();
                string strNumConvenio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_conve", 0).ToString().Trim();
                if (!prenec.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    if (!strNumContrato.Equals("") || !strNumConvenio.Equals(""))
                    {
                        if (!strNumContrato.Equals(""))
                        {
                            strQuery = "SELECT \"DocEntry\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + strNumContrato.Trim() + "'";
                            ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                            oContrato.getByKeyLight(int.Parse(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString()));
                            if (oContrato.RESPONSABLE == "C")//Contratante
                            {
                                strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"Total\") AS \"Total\", SUM(\"Saldo\") AS Saldo FROM (";
                                strQuery += "SELECT T0.\"TransId\" AS \"Numero\", T0.\"TaxDate\" AS \"Fecha\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                                strQuery += "THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END) AS \"Total\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                                strQuery += "THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END) AS \"Saldo\", T2.\"TrnsCodDsc\" AS \"Transaccion\", 'Ver Pagos' AS \"Pagos Aplicados\" ";
                                strQuery += "FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\" INNER JOIN OTRC T2 ON T1.\"TransCode\" = T2.\"TrnsCode\" ";
                                strQuery += "WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                                strQuery += "AND T1.\"U_contra\" = '" + strNumContrato + "' ";
                                strQuery += "AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oContrato.CONTRATANTE + "')";
                                //oDTB.ExecuteQuery("SELECT T0.\"TransId\" AS \"Numero\", T0.\"TaxDate\" AS \"Fecha\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END) AS \"Total\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END) AS \"Saldo\", T2.\"TrnsCodDsc\" AS \"Transaccion\", 'Ver Pagos' AS \"Pagos Aplicados\" FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\" INNER JOIN OTRC T2 ON T1.\"TransCode\" = T2.\"TrnsCode\" WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') AND T1.\"U_contra\" = '" + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value.ToString() + "' AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oContrato.CONTRATANTE + "'");
                            }
                            else if (oContrato.RESPONSABLE == "E")//Empresa
                            {
                                oConvenio.getByKey(int.Parse(oContrato.CONVENIO));
                                if (factUnificada.Equals("Y"))
                                {
                                    //strQuery = "SELECT * FROM (SELECT  SUM((CASE WHEN (T0.\"U_TransactionCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"U_TransactionCode\" = 'OKND') THEN T0.\"U_LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"U_LocTotal\" END)) AS \"Total\",  CAST('0' AS Decimal) AS \"Saldo\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_FACT_OJDT\" T0 INNER JOIN \"@OK1_EXE_FACT_JDT1\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" = T1.\"DocEntry\" WHERE (T0.\"U_TransactionCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"U_TransactionCode\" = 'OKNC' OR T0.\"U_TransactionCode\" = 'OKND') AND T1.\"U_contra\" = '" + strNumContrato + "' AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oConvenio.EMPRESA + "' AND T0.\"U_Ref3\" != 'FACTCOMPL') TA ";
                                    //strQuery = strQuery + "UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT SUM((CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END)) AS \"Total\", SUM((CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END)) AS \"Saldo\" FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\" WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') AND T1.\"U_contra\" = '" + strNumContrato + "' AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oConvenio.EMPRESA + "')TB";
                                    strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"Total\") AS \"Total\", SUM(\"Saldo\") AS Saldo FROM (";
                                    strQuery += "SELECT  (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                                    strQuery += "THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END) AS \"Total\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                                    strQuery += "THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END) AS \"Saldo\" ";
                                    strQuery += "FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\"";
                                    strQuery += "WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') AND (T1.\"U_conve\" = '" + strNumConvenio + "'  OR (T1.\"U_contra\" != '' AND  ((T0.\"Ref3\" = 'FACTSALDO' AND (SELECT \"U_conve\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD\" WHERE CAST(\"DocEntry\" AS NVARCHAR) = T1.\"U_contra\") = '" + strNumConvenio + "') OR (T0.\"Ref3\" = 'FACTCOMPL' AND T0.\"U_conve\" = '" + strNumConvenio + "' ))))  AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oConvenio.EMPRESA + "')";
                                }
                                else
                                {

                                    strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"Total\") AS \"Total\", SUM(\"Saldo\") AS Saldo FROM (";
                                    strQuery += "SELECT T0.\"TransId\" AS \"Numero\", T0.\"TaxDate\" AS \"Fecha\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                                    strQuery += "THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END) AS \"Total\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                                    strQuery += "THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END) AS \"Saldo\", T1.\"TransCode\" AS \"Transaccion\", 'Ver Pagos' AS \"Pagos Aplicados\" ";
                                    strQuery += "FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\" WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' ";
                                    strQuery += "OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') AND T1.\"U_contra\" = '" + strNumContrato + "' ";
                                    strQuery += "AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oConvenio.EMPRESA + "')";
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {

                            oConvenio.getByKey(int.Parse(strNumConvenio));
                            strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"Total\") AS \"Total\", SUM(\"Saldo\") AS Saldo FROM (";
                            strQuery += "SELECT  (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                            strQuery += "THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END) AS \"Total\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                            strQuery += "THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END) AS \"Saldo\" ";
                            strQuery += "FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\"";
                            strQuery += "WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') AND (T1.\"U_conve\" = '" + strNumConvenio + "'  OR (T1.\"U_contra\" != '' AND  ((T0.\"Ref3\" = 'FACTSALDO' AND (SELECT \"U_conve\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = T1.\"U_contra\") = '" + strNumConvenio + "') OR (T0.\"Ref3\" = 'FACTCOMPL' AND T0.\"U_conve\" = '" + strNumConvenio + "' ))))  AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oConvenio.EMPRESA + "')";

                        }
                        ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                        ValorTotal = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                        ValorSaldo = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item(1).Value);

                        if (!strNumContrato.Equals(""))
                        {
                            if (oContrato.PERIODFACT.Equals("D"))
                            {
                                if (ValorTotal == 0)
                                {
                                    ValorDSeg = oContrato.VALORSEGUROS / (oContrato.NSEMANAS * 7);
                                    ValorDSeg = Math.Floor(ValorDSeg);
                                    //ValorPendFact = addInExequial.FuncionesGenerales.valor_plan(SBOCompany, oContrato.PLAN) + oContrato.VALORTOTALPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORTOTALREPATRIACIONES + oContrato.VALORSEGUROS;
                                    ValorPendFact = ((oContrato.VALOR * oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT) + oContrato.VALORTOTALPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORTOTALREPATRIACIONES + oContrato.VALORSEGUROS);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (!oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT.Equals(0))
                                    {
                                        ValorDSeg = oContrato.VALORSEGUROS / (oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT);
                                        ValorDSeg = Math.Floor(ValorDSeg);
                                    }
                                    else
                                        ValorDSeg = 0;
                                    ValorPendFact = (oContrato.VALOR + oContrato.VALORPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORREPATRIACIONES + ValorDSeg) * oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT;
                                }
                                ValorTotalCont = oContrato.VALOR + oContrato.VALORPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORREPATRIACIONES + (oContrato.VALORSEGUROS / (oContrato.NSEMANAS * 7));
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ValorPendFact = (oContrato.VALOR + oContrato.VALORPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORREPATRIACIONES + oContrato.VALORSEGUROS) * oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT;
                                ValorTotalCont = oContrato.VALOR + oContrato.VALORPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORREPATRIACIONES + oContrato.VALORSEGUROS;
                            }
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Cartera", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ValorSaldo, false, "", -1));
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SaldFVig", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ValorPendFact, false, "", -1));
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_EstCta", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, (ValorSaldo + ValorPendFact), false, "", -1));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Cartera", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ValorSaldo, false, "", -1));
                            //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SaldFVig", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ValorPendFact, false, "", -1));
                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_EstCta", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, (ValorSaldo + ValorPendFact), false, "", -1));

                        }
                    }

                }
                else
                {
                    if (sPrenecFin.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        if (OK1.SBO.Helpers.CheckIfAnAddInIsOn(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, "Financiacion"))
                        {
                            addInFinanciacion.Consultas oConsulta = new addInFinanciacion.Consultas(SBOCompany, strPath.Replace("addInSrvFun", "addInFinanciacion"), "HANA");
                            addInFinanciacion.FuncionesGenerales oFG = new addInFinanciacion.FuncionesGenerales(SBOCompany, strPath.Replace("addInSrvFun", "addInFinanciacion"), "HANA");
                            addInFinanciacion.CreditosFinanciacion oCred = new addInFinanciacion.CreditosFinanciacion(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, strPath.Replace("addInSrvFun", "addInFinanciacion"), "HANA");

                            string nCred = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HEAD", "U_NroCredFinan", "DocEntry", strNumContrato, SBOCompany).Trim();
                            oCred.GetByKey(nCred);
                            string fecPago = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd");
                            double dbVlrMora = 0;
                            double dbVlrSaldoCr = 0;
                            double dbVlrEstCue = 0;

                            #region Valor Saldo Credito
                            ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_VlrCaPen\" FROM \"@OK1_FINAN_CRED_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + nCred + "");
                            if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                            {
                                dbVlrSaldoCr = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                            }
                            #endregion

                            #region CalculoInteresesMora
                            string stEstado = oFG.EstadoActual(int.Parse(nCred));
                            if (!stEstado.Equals("09"))
                                strQuery = oConsulta.QryInteresMora(fecPago, "N");
                            else
                                strQuery = oConsulta.QryInteresMora(fecPago, "Y");

                            oConsulta.EjecutarConsulta(ref ors, strQuery);
                            if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                            {
                                dbVlrMora = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                            }
                            #endregion

                            #region Calculo Saldo Pendiente
                            int iDiasCarencia = oFG.ObtenerDiasCarenciaMora(oCred.stTipCre);
                            double dbIncInteresCte = oFG.ObtenerIncrementoInteresCte(oCred.stTipCre);
                            strQuery = oConsulta.QueryCuotasPendientesPago(nCred, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourcePorcentaje(SBOCompany, dbVlrMora), fecPago, "0", "1");
                            oConsulta.EjecutarConsulta(ref ors, strQuery);

                            double dbvlrSinR = 0d;
                            double dbVlrOtSeg = 0d;
                            double vlrCartera = 0;
                            if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                            {
                                ors.MoveFirst();

                                while (!ors.EoF)
                                {
                                    if (oCred.strTipoAmortizacion.Equals("2"))
                                    {
                                        if (int.Parse(ors.Fields.Item("DiasIntCte").Value.ToString()) >= iDiasCarencia)
                                        {
                                            dbvlrSinR += (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlrPMora").Value));
                                            dbvlrSinR += (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlrCapital").Value));
                                            dbvlrSinR += Math.Round(((dbVlrSaldoCr * (oCred.dbTIM + dbIncInteresCte)) / 100), 0);
                                            if (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlPendInt").Value) > 0)
                                                dbvlrSinR -= (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("Interes").Value) - OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlPendInt").Value));
                                            //FRC 20160404 Se resta la mora segùn dìas de carencia
                                            if (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("DiasMora").Value) < iDiasCarencia)
                                                dbvlrSinR -= OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlrPMora").Value);
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            dbvlrSinR += (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlrAPagar").Value));
                                            dbvlrSinR += (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlrPMora").Value));
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        dbvlrSinR += (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlrAPagar").Value));
                                        if (int.Parse(ors.Fields.Item("DiasMora").Value.ToString()) < iDiasCarencia)
                                            dbvlrSinR -= (OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlrPMora").Value));
                                        //dbvlrSinR += OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(this.sapCompany, oRs.Fields.Item("VlrAPagar").Value);
                                    }
                                    //FRC 20160330 Se incluye el valor Pendiente de Mora
                                    dbvlrSinR += OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item("VlrPendMora").Value);
                                    //FRC 20160310 Valor de seguros por cuota
                                    dbVlrOtSeg += oCred.SegurosPorCuota(Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item("NroCuota").Value));
                                    ors.MoveNext();
                                }
                                dbvlrSinR += dbVlrOtSeg;
                            }


                            vlrCartera = dbvlrSinR;


                            #endregion

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Cartera", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrCartera, false, "", -1));

                            #region Valor Total Pago
                            if (vlrCartera.Equals(0))
                                dbVlrEstCue = oCred.VlrTotalPago(DateTime.Now, nCred, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourcePorcentaje(SBOCompany, dbVlrMora), "0", strPath.Replace("addInSrvFun", "addInFinanciacion"));
                            else
                                dbVlrEstCue = oCred.VlrTotalPagoConCartera(DateTime.Now, nCred, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourcePorcentaje(SBOCompany, dbVlrMora), "0", strPath.Replace("addInSrvFun", "addInFinanciacion"));

                            #endregion

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_EstCta", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, dbVlrEstCue, false, "", -1));

                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SaldFVig", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, dbVlrEstCue - vlrCartera, false, "", -1));
                        }

                    }
                    else
                    {
                        double vlrPendPago = 0;
                        try
                        {
                            strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"U_vlrMesPrenec\") AS \"Total Cuotas\",(SELECT \"U_vlrSaldo\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRENE_AMORT\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + strNumContrato + " ";
                            strQuery = strQuery + "AND \"U_pag\" = 'N'  AND \"U_fechaPag\" <= CURRENT_DATE AND \"LineId\" =  (SELECT MAX(\"LineId\") FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRENE_AMORT\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" =  " + strNumContrato + " ";
                            strQuery = strQuery + "AND \"U_pag\" = 'N'  AND \"U_fechaPag\" <= CURRENT_DATE)) AS \"Saldo\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRENE_AMORT\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" =  " + strNumContrato + " ";
                            strQuery = strQuery + "AND \"U_pag\" = 'N'  AND \"U_fechaPag\" <= CURRENT_DATE";

                            ors.DoQuery(strQuery);

                            vlrPendPago = Convert.ToDouble(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);


                            if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                            {
                                vlrPendPago = Convert.ToDouble(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value) + Convert.ToDouble(ors.Fields.Item(1).Value);
                            }

                            if (vlrPendPago > 0)
                            {

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SaldFVig", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrPendPago, false, "", -1));

                            }
                            else
                            {
                                //Sin Cuotas Vencidas y Cuotas Pagas.
                                strQuery = "SELECT  \"U_vlrSaldo\"  FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRENE_AMORT\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + strNumContrato + "  AND \"U_pag\" = 'Y' ORDER BY \"U_fechaPag\" DESC limit 1";
                                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);

                                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                                {


                                    vlrPendPago = Convert.ToDouble(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);


                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    vlrPendPago = Convert.ToDouble(DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PRENE_HEAD", "U_valorPrenec", "DocEntry", strNumContrato, SBOCompany));

                                }
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SaldFVig", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrPendPago, false, "", -1));

                            }


                        }

                        catch { }
                        finally { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors); }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }
        public double CargarSaldoFinVigenciaContrato(string numContrato)
        {
            double ValorDSeg = 0;
            double ValorSaldo = 0; //Cartera
            double ValorTotal = 0;
            double ValorPendFact = 0; // Fin Vig
            double ValorTotalCont = 0;
            //U_fecCober
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            addInExequial.ClaseContrato oContrato = new addInExequial.ClaseContrato(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
            addInExequial.ClaseConvenio oConvenio = new addInExequial.ClaseConvenio(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
            string strQuery = "";
            try
            {
                if (!numContrato.Equals(""))
                {
                    oContrato.getByKey(int.Parse(numContrato));
                    if (oContrato.RESPONSABLE == "C")//Contratante
                    {
                        strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"Total\") AS \"Total\", SUM(\"Saldo\") AS Saldo FROM (";
                        strQuery += "SELECT T0.\"TransId\" AS \"Numero\", T0.\"TaxDate\" AS \"Fecha\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                        strQuery += "THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END) AS \"Total\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                        strQuery += "THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END) AS \"Saldo\", T2.\"TrnsCodDsc\" AS \"Transaccion\", 'Ver Pagos' AS \"Pagos Aplicados\" ";
                        strQuery += "FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\" INNER JOIN OTRC T2 ON T1.\"TransCode\" = T2.\"TrnsCode\" ";
                        strQuery += "WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                        strQuery += "AND T1.\"U_contra\" = '" + numContrato + "' ";
                        strQuery += "AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oContrato.CONTRATANTE + "')";
                        //oDTB.ExecuteQuery("SELECT T0.\"TransId\" AS \"Numero\", T0.\"TaxDate\" AS \"Fecha\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END) AS \"Total\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END) AS \"Saldo\", T2.\"TrnsCodDsc\" AS \"Transaccion\", 'Ver Pagos' AS \"Pagos Aplicados\" FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\" INNER JOIN OTRC T2 ON T1.\"TransCode\" = T2.\"TrnsCode\" WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') AND T1.\"U_contra\" = '" + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value.ToString() + "' AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oContrato.CONTRATANTE + "'");
                    }
                    else if (oContrato.RESPONSABLE == "E")//Empresa
                    {
                        oConvenio.getByKey(int.Parse(oContrato.CONVENIO));
                        strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"Total\") AS \"Total\", SUM(\"Saldo\") AS Saldo FROM (";
                        strQuery += "SELECT T0.\"TransId\" AS \"Numero\", T0.\"TaxDate\" AS \"Fecha\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                        strQuery += "THEN T0.\"LocTotal\" ELSE -T0.\"LocTotal\" END) AS \"Total\", (CASE WHEN (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') ";
                        strQuery += "THEN T1.\"BalDueDeb\" ELSE -T1.\"BalDueCred\" END) AS \"Saldo\", T1.\"TransCode\" AS \"Transaccion\", 'Ver Pagos' AS \"Pagos Aplicados\" ";
                        strQuery += "FROM OJDT T0 INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0.\"TransId\" = T1.\"TransId\" WHERE (T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKEX' OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKNC' ";
                        strQuery += "OR T0.\"TransCode\" = 'OKND') AND T1.\"U_contra\" = '" + numContrato + "' ";
                        strQuery += "AND T1.\"U_InfoCo01\" = '" + oConvenio.EMPRESA + "')";
                    }
                    ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    ValorTotal = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                    ValorSaldo = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ors.Fields.Item(1).Value);
                    if (oContrato.PERIODFACT.Equals("D"))
                    {
                        if (ValorTotal == 0)
                        {
                            ValorDSeg = oContrato.VALORSEGUROS / (oContrato.NSEMANAS * 7);
                            ValorDSeg = Math.Floor(ValorDSeg);
                            //ValorPendFact = addInExequial.FuncionesGenerales.valor_plan(SBOCompany, oContrato.PLAN) + oContrato.VALORTOTALPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORTOTALREPATRIACIONES + oContrato.VALORSEGUROS;
                            ValorPendFact = ((oContrato.VALOR * oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT) + oContrato.VALORTOTALPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORTOTALREPATRIACIONES + oContrato.VALORSEGUROS);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (!oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT.Equals(0))
                            {
                                ValorDSeg = oContrato.VALORSEGUROS / (oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT);
                                ValorDSeg = Math.Floor(ValorDSeg);
                            }
                            else
                                ValorDSeg = 0;
                            ValorPendFact = (oContrato.VALOR + oContrato.VALORPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORREPATRIACIONES + ValorDSeg) * oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT;
                        }
                        ValorTotalCont = oContrato.VALOR + oContrato.VALORPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORREPATRIACIONES + (oContrato.VALORSEGUROS / (oContrato.NSEMANAS * 7));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ValorPendFact = (oContrato.VALOR + oContrato.VALORPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORREPATRIACIONES + oContrato.VALORSEGUROS) * oContrato.CUOTASPENDFACT;
                        ValorTotalCont = oContrato.VALOR + oContrato.VALORPRENECESIDADES + oContrato.VALORREPATRIACIONES + oContrato.VALORSEGUROS;
                    }



                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return ValorPendFact;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Calcula el valor total de elementos para una solicitud de servicio
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public void calcularGastoTotal(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            double totalGastos = 0;

            try
            {
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                {
                    totalGastos += OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.GetCellSpecific("col_6", i)).Value);
                }
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_DocTotal", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, totalGastos));
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC022", SBOCompany);
            }
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Graba en TIPS el evento de la comisión por reembolso de una solicitud de servicio
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public void notificarComisionPorReembolso(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            addInExequial.ClaseSP oSp = new addInExequial.ClaseSP(SBOCompany);
            ArrayList oArrName = new ArrayList();
            ArrayList oArrValue = new ArrayList();
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string mensaje = "";
            bool bandera = false;

            try
            {
                oSp.Conectar();
                oArrName.Clear();
                oArrValue.Clear();

                oArrName.Add("@IdItemDeContrato");
                oArrName.Add("@Plan");
                oArrName.Add("@Fecha");
                oArrName.Add("@Vendedor");
                oArrName.Add("@Estado");
                oArrName.Add("@ValordeItemContrato");

                oArrValue.Add("SOLSER-" + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim());
                oArrValue.Add("ComisionServicios");
                oArrValue.Add(DateTime.Now);
                try
                {
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_cardcode\" FROM OUSR WHERE USER_CODE = '" + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Usuario", 0).Trim() + "'");
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        oArrValue.Add(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                    }
                }
                catch { }
                finally
                {
                    if (ors != null)
                    { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors); }

                }
                oArrValue.Add(oSp.devolver_codigo_en_tabla("estEstados", "Codigo", "Nombre", "Activo"));
                oArrValue.Add("0");

                bandera = oSp.consumir_sp("Sp_Sap_CrearItemDeContrato", oArrName, oArrValue, ref mensaje);
                oSp.Desconectar();
                if (!bandera)
                {
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error de envío a TIPS. Comisión Reembolso", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC022-1", SBOCompany);
            }
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Verifica que se hayan diligenciado campos obligatorios; también valida la fecha de fallecimiento
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool validarCamposObligatoriosAvisoSiniestro(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {

            bool resultado = true;
            string strCampos = ""; //Para almacenar los campos sin diligenciar

            /* Texto NroSolicitud*/
            SAPbouiCOM.EditText ETNroAvisoSiniestro = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("0_U_E").Specific;
            string NroAvisoSiniestro = ETNroAvisoSiniestro.Value.ToString().Trim();

            /* Texto NroSolicitud*/
            SAPbouiCOM.EditText ETNumSol = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("18_U_E").Specific;
            string NumeroSolicitud = ETNumSol.Value.ToString().Trim();

            /* Texto NroSolicitud*/
            SAPbouiCOM.EditText ETIdFallecido = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("17_U_E").Specific;
            string idFallecido = ETIdFallecido.Value.ToString().Trim();


            /* Texto IDFallecido*/
            SAPbouiCOM.EditText ETFecha = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("19_U_E").Specific;
            string Fecha = ETFecha.Value;


            //validación aviso siniestro
            if (NroAvisoSiniestro.Equals(""))
            {
                resultado = false;
                strCampos += "Nro Aviso Siniestro";
            }

            //validación aviso siniestro
            if (NumeroSolicitud.Equals("") && strCampos.Equals(""))
            {
                resultado = false;
                strCampos += "Numero Solicitud";
            }

            //validación aviso siniestro
            if (idFallecido.Equals("") && strCampos.Equals(""))
            {
                resultado = false;
                strCampos += "Id Fallecido";
            }
            //validación aviso siniestro
            if (Fecha.Equals("") && strCampos.Equals(""))
            {
                resultado = false;
                strCampos += "Fecha";
            }


            return resultado;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Verifica que se hayan diligenciado campos obligatorios; también valida la fecha de fallecimiento
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool validarCamposObligatorios(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool esCotiz, bool esPreOrden, string prenec)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            DateTime fechaDT;
            bool resultado = true;
            string strCampos = ""; //Para almacenar los campos sin diligenciar
            string idContratanteDB = "", idContratanteSource = "";
            string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim();
            string sConvenio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_conve", 0).Trim();
            string respon = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONV_HEAD", "U_respon", "DocEntry", sConvenio, SBOCompany);
            string TipoPrestacion = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipPrest", 0).Trim();
            string NivelServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NivServ", 0).Trim();
            string tipoServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim();
            string val = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_vincElemProg", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);


            if (esCotiz)
            {
                //validación obligatoria de campos
                if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                {
                    resultado = false;
                    strCampos += "Sede de prestacion del servicio funerario; ";
                }

                    idContratanteDB = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD", "U_IdContra", "DocEntry", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);

                    if (!idContratanteSource.Equals(idContratanteDB))
                    {
                        if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
                            idContratanteDB = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HEAD", "U_contrant", "DocEntry", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
                        else
                            idContratanteDB = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_contrant", "DocEntry", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);

                    }
                }



                if (!idContratanteSource.Equals(idContratanteDB))
                {
                    if (SBOApplication.MessageBox("La identificación del contratante del servicio registrado no corresponde con la identificación del contratante para el contrato #" + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim() + ". ¿ Está seguro que desea continuar?", 1, "Aceptar", "Cancelar") == 1)
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Se ha modificado el contratante del servicio: (" + idContratanteDB + ") -> (" + idContratanteSource + ")");
                    else
                        resultado = false;
                }

            }

            return resultado;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Valida que el parentesco del fallecido corresponda con el definido en el contrato
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <returns>True si la validación es correcta, False en caso contrario</returns>
        public bool validarParentesco(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            string codigoParentesco, strQuery;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            bool resultado = true;

            try
            {
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                codigoParentesco = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("55").Specific).Value;

                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetParentescoContrato", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idBeneficiario%", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdFallec", 0).Trim());
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idContrato%", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim());
                oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    //si el parentesco no coincide se reporta inconsistencia
                    if (!oRS.Fields.Item("U_parent").Value.ToString().Equals(codigoParentesco.Trim()))
                    {
                        //alerta, proced autoriz
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "El parentesco difiere del definido en el contrato para el beneficiario");
                        resultado = false;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC023", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
            }
            return resultado;
        }

            {

        }

            {
                idContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();

        /// <summary>
        /// FRC 20140415 Verifica el valor del Saldo de Fin de Vigencia del contrato
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool validarSaldoFinVig(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            bool resultado = true;
            string strSaldoFVig;
            double dbSaldoFVig = 0;
            string strQuery = "", numContrato = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            double valor = 0;

            try
            {

                strSaldoFVig = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_SaldFVig", 0);
                dbSaldoFVig = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, strSaldoFVig);
                if (dbSaldoFVig > 0)
                {
                    //alerta, proced autoriz
                    reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "El Contrato tiene un Saldo de Fin de Vigencia pendiente por saldar");
                    resultado = false;
                }



                if (resultado)
                {
                    #region Validar saldo facturación complemento
                    numContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();

                    strQuery = "SELECT T0.\"U_factCompl\",T0.\"U_valor\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_CONT_BENEFI\"  T0 WHERE T0.\"DocEntry\" = '" + numContrato + "' AND  T0.\"U_factCompl\" = 'N' AND T0.\"U_valor\" > 0";
                    oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        //alerta, proced autoriz
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "El contrato tiene beneficiarios pendientes por facturar.");
                        resultado = false;
                    }


                    #endregion

                    #region Validar saldo facturación complemento seguro
                    numContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();

                    strQuery = "SELECT T0.\"U_factCompl\",T0.\"U_valor\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_CONT_SEGURO\"  T0 WHERE T0.\"DocEntry\" = '" + numContrato + "' AND  T0.\"U_factCompl\" = 'N' AND T0.\"U_valor\" > 0";
                    oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        //alerta, proced autoriz
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "El contrato tiene seguros pendientes por facturar.");
                        resultado = false;
                    }

                }
                #endregion


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC025", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
            return resultado;
        }





        /// <summary>
        /// Indica en la solicitud de servicio los auxilios pagados luego de que se realiza un pago efectuado
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="xmlDocEntry">XML con el docEntry del pago</param>
        public void chequearAuxilios(string xmlDocEntry)
        {
            XmlDocument oXML = new XmlDocument();
            XmlNode oNode;
            string strDocEntry, strQuery, idAuxilio = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            Solicitud solicitud;
            LineasAuxilios lineasAux;

            try
            {
                oXML.LoadXml(xmlDocEntry);
                oNode = oXML.LastChild;

                strDocEntry = oNode.InnerText;

                if (strDocEntry != null && !strDocEntry.Equals(""))
                {
                    // SBOCompany.StartTransaction();
                    //obtener lineas de facturas
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetLineasFacturasAuxilios", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docEntryPago%", strDocEntry);
                    oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        solicitud = new Solicitud(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
                        oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                        while (!oRS.EoF)
                        {
                            //verificar si el artículo esta marcado como auxilio
                            oItem.GetByKey(oRS.Fields.Item("ItemCode").Value.ToString());
                            idAuxilio = oItem.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_AUX").Value.ToString();
                            if (!idAuxilio.Equals(""))
                            {
                                solicitud.getByKey(Convert.ToInt32(oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value.ToString()));
                                //recorrer las lineas de auxilio de la solicitud para ver con cual corresponde
                                for (int i = 0; i < solicitud.lineasAuxilios.Length; i++)
                                {
                                    lineasAux = solicitud.lineasAuxilios[i];
                                    if (lineasAux.idAuxilio.Equals(idAuxilio))
                                    {
                                        lineasAux.cancelado = "Y";
                                        //como ya encontró el auxilio, rompe el ciclo
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                solicitud.update();
                            }
                            oRS.MoveNext();
                        }
                    }
                    //if (SBOCompany.InTransaction)
                    //{
                    //    SBOCompany.EndTransaction(BoWfTransOpt.wf_Commit);
                    //}
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC026", SBOCompany);
                //if (SBOCompany.InTransaction)
                //{
                //    SBOCompany.EndTransaction(BoWfTransOpt.wf_RollBack);
                //}
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
            }
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Indica en la solicitud de servicio los auxilios luego de que se realiza un pedidod
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="xmlDocEntry">XML con el docEntry del pago</param>
        public void chequearAuxiliosPedidos(string xmlDocEntry, string serFun)
        {
            XmlDocument oXML = new XmlDocument();
            XmlNode oNode;
            string strDocEntry, strQuery, idAuxilio = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS1 = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            Solicitud solicitud;
            LineasAuxilios lineasAux;

            try
            {
                oXML.LoadXml(xmlDocEntry);
                oNode = oXML.LastChild;

                strDocEntry = oNode.InnerText;

                if (strDocEntry != null && !strDocEntry.Equals(""))
                {
                    //obtener lineael pedido
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetLineasPedidoDerechosAuxilios", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docEntry%", strDocEntry);
                    oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);


                    oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        solicitud = new Solicitud(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
                        oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                        while (!oRS.EoF)
                        {
                            //verificar si el artículo esta marcado como auxilio
                            oItem.GetByKey(oRS.Fields.Item("ItemCode").Value.ToString());
                            idAuxilio = oItem.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_AUX").Value.ToString();
                            if (!idAuxilio.Equals(""))
                            {
                                solicitud.getByKey(Convert.ToInt32(oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value.ToString()));

                                bool retirarAdicionalFallecido = getDerechoValidaAdicionalFallecido(solicitud.NUMCONTRATO.ToString(), idAuxilio);



                                //recorrer las lineas de auxilio de la solicitud para ver con cual corresponde
                                for (int i = 0; i < solicitud.lineasAuxilios.Length; i++)
                                {
                                    lineasAux = solicitud.lineasAuxilios[i];
                                    if (lineasAux.idAuxilio.Equals(idAuxilio))
                                    {
                                        lineasAux.cancelado = "Y";

                                        if (retirarAdicionalFallecido)
                                            actualizarFechaRetiroBenef(solicitud.NUMCONTRATO.ToString(), solicitud.IDFALLECIDO, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(DateTime.Now, SBOApplication));
                                        //como ya encontró el auxilio, rompe el ciclo
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                solicitud.update();
                            }
                            oRS.MoveNext();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC026", SBOCompany);
                //if (SBOCompany.InTransaction)
                //{
                //    SBOCompany.EndTransaction(BoWfTransOpt.wf_RollBack);
                //}
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
            }
        }

        private bool getDerechoValidaAdicionalFallecido(string numContrato, string idAuxilio)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS1 = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            string strQuery = "";
            bool valor = false;

            strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetDerechoValidaAdicionalFallecido", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%numContrato%", numContrato);
            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idAuxilio%", idAuxilio);

            oRS1.DoQuery(strQuery);
            if (oRS1.RecordCount > 0)
            {
                if (oRS1.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                    valor = true;
            }

            return valor;
        }

        /// <summary>Valida duplicidad en PRE-ORDEN y COTIZACION</summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario OSF</param>
        /// <param name="id">Id Fallecido</param>
        /// <param name="Creacion">True si aplica mensaje en pestaña "Historico" </param>
        /// <returns>True si encuentra duplicidad en PRE-ORDEN o OSF</returns>
        public bool ExisteIdFallecidoCotización(Form oForm, string id, bool Creacion)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            bool esPreOrden = false;

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");
                bool esCotiz = esSerieCotizaciónApertura(oDBS.GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), oDBS.GetValue("Series", 0).Trim(), ref esPreOrden);
                string nOSF = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString();
                if (esPreOrden)
                {

                    query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ObtenerPREOSFSegunContratoFallecido", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    query = query.Replace("%IDFallecido%", id);

                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        if (Creacion)
                        {
                            SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ya existe una PRE-orden grabada para la persona fallecida. No. PRE-orden: " + ors.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                            if (permiteDuplicidad(SBOCompany, SBOApplication, oForm, strPath))
                            {
                                reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Ya existe una PRE-orden grabada para la persona fallecida. No. PRE-orden: " + ors.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString());
                                return true;
                            }
                        }
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ya existe una PRE-orden grabada para la persona fallecida. No. PRE-orden: " + ors.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                    }


                }
                else
                {
                    if (esCotiz && !Creacion)
                    {
                        if (nOSF.Equals(""))
                            nOSF = "0";


                        query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "existeCotizacionAbierta", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        query = query.Replace("%id%", id);
                        query = query.Replace("%nOSF%", nOSF);

                        ors.DoQuery(query);
                        if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                        {
                            SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ya existe una Cotizacion grabada para la persona fallecida. No. Cotizacion: " + ors.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                        }

                    }

                }

                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteIdFallecidoCotización", SBOCompany);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

        }




        public bool ExisteIdFallecidoContrato(Form oForm, string id, ref string docEntry)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            bool existe = false;

            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "existeBeneficiarioContrato", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%id%", id);


                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    docEntry = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    existe = true;
                }

                if (!existe)
                {
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "existeBeneficiarioContratoPrenecesidad", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    query = query.Replace("%id%", id);


                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        docEntry = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                        existe = true;
                    }
                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteIdFallecidoCotización", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return existe;
        }


        public void deschequearAuxiliosPedidos(string DocEntry)
        {
            string strDocEntry, strQuery, idAuxilio = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            Solicitud solicitud;
            LineasAuxilios lineasAux;

            try
            {
                strDocEntry = DocEntry;
                if (strDocEntry != null && !strDocEntry.Equals(""))
                {
                    //obtener lineael pedido
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetLineasPedidoDerechosAuxilios", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docEntry%", strDocEntry);
                    oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        solicitud = new Solicitud(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
                        oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                        while (!oRS.EoF)
                        {
                            //verificar si el artículo esta marcado como auxilio
                            string itemcode = oRS.Fields.Item("ItemCode").Value.ToString();
                            oItem.GetByKey(itemcode);
                            idAuxilio = oItem.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_AUX").Value.ToString();
                            if (!idAuxilio.Equals(""))
                            {
                                solicitud.getByKey(Convert.ToInt32(oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value.ToString()));
                                //recorrer las lineas de auxilio de la solicitud para ver con cual corresponde
                                for (int i = 0; i < solicitud.lineasAuxilios.Length; i++)
                                {
                                    lineasAux = solicitud.lineasAuxilios[i];
                                    if (lineasAux.idAuxilio.Equals(idAuxilio))
                                    {
                                        lineasAux.cancelado = "N";
                                        //como ya encontró el auxilio, rompe el ciclo
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                solicitud.update();
                            }
                            oRS.MoveNext();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC026", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRS != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
            }
        }
