                    }
                    #endregion
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "generarFacturaPrenecesidadFinanciera", sapCompany);

        }

        public void generarFacturaConvenio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, int iBranch)
        {
            #region variables
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix1 = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Documents oFactura = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.SalesTaxCodes oTax = null;
            string numdoc, idsocio, idCliente, nomCliente, valor, articulo, cantidad, almacen = "", codMun = "", mun = "", sucur = "", nomSucur = "";
            int fila1;
            ArrayList socios = new ArrayList();//para guardar los socios que estan en la matriz sin que se repitan
            ArrayList general = new ArrayList();//para guardar por cada socio, las lineas de la matriz que se estan solicitando en la OC
            ArrayList filaSelecciona = null;//para guardar el no. de la fila en la matriz del item que se solicita en una OC
            bool existenItemsSeleccionados = false;
            double docTotal = 0;//para verificar si una OC queda con valor cero, para no crearla.
            SAPbouiCOM.EditText oEdit = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox oChkPreliminar = null;
            string nContrato = "", nConvenio = "", responsableFact = "", tipoDocConv = "";
            string cc1 = "", cc2 = "", cc3 = "", cc4 = "";
            string tipoElemento = "";
            string strTipoS = "";
            double ValorIvaLinea = 0, vlrDescuento = 0;
            double totalValorConIva = 0;
            string codigoIVA = "";
            double totalValorConIvaFAC = 0;
            double totalVentaComision = 0;
            string prenec = "";
            string prjCode = "";
            string idSerie = "";
            string ctaAsociada = "";
            string ctaConIVA = "";
            string ctaSinIVA = "";
            string ctaSinIVAAdMe = "";
            string ctaIngElem = "";
            string ctaIngArt = "";
            string sPrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", SBOCompany);
            string contDesc = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_contDesc", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);
            string ctasTipoServicio = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_ctasTipoServicio", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);
            string factCC = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_factCC", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);
            bool esConvPart = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("ckConvPart").Specific).Checked;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");
            ArrayList oArrMejorasExcIVA = new ArrayList();
            bool CalculaIVA = true;
            string ctaDescuento = "";
            string sZona = "";
            string nivelServicio = "";
            string fecha = "";
            string tipoLinea = "";
            double vlrDescuentoCubierto = 0;

            #region Retenciones variables

            double ValorTotalLinea = 0;
            double ValorIVALinea = 0;
            double SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion = 0;
            double SumaValorBaseIVARetencion = 0;
            double ValorFact = 0;
            double SumaValorFact = 0;


            #endregion

            #region facturar renuncias
            bool Renuncia = false;
            bool facturarRenuncia = true;
            bool facturarRenunciaSF = true;
            string tipoServicio = string.Empty;
            string ElementoItemCodigo = string.Empty;
            string linea = string.Empty;

            #endregion

            #endregion

            if (existePermisoUsuarioSede(oDBS.GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany.UserSignature.ToString()))
            {
                #region si tiene permisos sede
                try
                {
                    oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                    oTax = (SAPbobsCOM.SalesTaxCodes)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oSalesTaxCodes);
                    oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                    oMatrix1 = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_8").Specific;

                    filaSelecciona = new ArrayList();


                    //obtener lista unica de socios de negocios incluidos en la matriz
                    #region consultar los socios de la factura
                    //si el item existe
                    idsocio = "";
                    nContrato = oDBS.GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();
                    nConvenio = oDBS.GetValue("U_conve", 0).Trim();
                    responsableFact = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONV_HEAD", "U_respon", "DocEntry", oDBS.GetValue("U_conve", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
                    tipoDocConv = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONV_HEAD", "U_tipoDocEmp", "DocEntry", oDBS.GetValue("U_conve", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);

                    // se agrega el socio de la cabecera responsable de facturaccion
                    if (!nConvenio.Equals("") && nContrato.Equals(""))
                    {
                        if (responsableFact.Equals("E"))
                            idsocio = oDBS.GetValue("U_EntConCl", 0).Trim();
                        else
                            idsocio = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim();
                    }
                    else if (!nContrato.Equals(""))
                        idsocio = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim();
                    else
                        idsocio = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim();

                    if (!idsocio.Equals("") && !socios.Contains(idsocio))
                    {
                        socios.Add(idsocio);
                    }
                    #endregion

                    //recorrer arraylist de socios para crear una Documento por cada uno
                    //obtener lista unica de socios de negocios incluidos en la matriz
                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                    {

                                                                oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = oItem.ArTaxCode;
                                                            else
                                                                oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = strIVAExc;
                                                            oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = strCuentaIngGrupo;
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    else
                                                    {
                                                        if (ctasTipoServicio.Equals("Y"))
                                                        {
                                                            ctaAsociada = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_CUENFACT", "U_ctaAsoc", "U_tipServ", strTipoS, SBOCompany);
                                                            oFactura.ControlAccount = ctaAsociada;
                                                            oTax.GetByKey(oItem.ArTaxCode);

                                                            if (!oTax.Rate.Equals(0))
                                                            {
                                                                ctaConIVA = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_CUENFACT", "U_ctaConIVA", "U_tipServ", strTipoS, SBOCompany);
                                                                oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = oItem.ArTaxCode;
                                                                if (ctaConIVA.Equals(""))
                                                                    oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = strCuentaIngGrupo;
                                                                else
                                                                {
                                                                    oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = ctaConIVA;
                                                                }
                                                            }
                                                            else
                                                            {
                                                                tipoElemento = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_AAdMe").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                                                                oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = strIVAExc;
                                                                if (tipoElemento.Equals("A") || tipoElemento.Equals("M") || tipoElemento.Equals("E"))
                                                                {
                                                                    ctaSinIVAAdMe = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_CUENFACT", "U_ctaSinIVAAdMe", "U_tipServ", strTipoS, SBOCompany);
                                                                    if (ctaSinIVAAdMe.Equals(""))
                                                                        oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = strCuentaIngGrupo;
                                                                    else
                                                                    {
                                                                        oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = ctaSinIVAAdMe;
                                                                    }

                                                                }
                                                                else
                                                                {
                                                                    oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = strIVAExc;
                                                                    ctaSinIVA = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_CUENFACT", "U_ctaSinIVA", "U_tipServ", strTipoS, SBOCompany);
                                                                    if (ctaSinIVA.Equals(""))
                                                                        oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = strCuentaIngGrupo;
                                                                    else
                                                                    {
                                                                        oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = ctaSinIVA;
                                                                    }
                                                                }
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                        else
                                                        {
                                                            tipoElemento = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_AAdMe").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                                                            oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = strIVAExc;
                                                            if (tipoElemento.Equals("A") || tipoElemento.Equals("M") || tipoElemento.Equals("E"))
                                                                oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = strCuentaIngGrupo;
                                                            else
                                                                oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = strIVAExc;
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    #endregion


                                                    oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = strIVAExc;
                                                    codigoIVA = oFactura.Lines.TaxCode;
                                                    if (!oArrCodIva.Contains(codigoIVA))
                                                        oArrCodIva.Add(codigoIVA);

                                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cIva").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = codigoIVA;

                                                    double valorIvaFAC = ServicioFunerario.RetornarValorCodigoIva(SBOCompany, codigoIVA);

                                                    double ValorIvaLineaFac = oFactura.Lines.Price * valorIvaFAC / 100;
                                                    //totalValorConIvaFAC += ValorIvaLineaFac + (oFactura.Lines.Price);
                                                    //totalValorConIva += ValorIvaLinea + oFactura.Lines.Price;

                                                    docTotal += oFactura.Lines.Price;

                                                    if (!cc1.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                        oFactura.Lines.CostingCode = cc1;
                                                    if (!cc2.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                        oFactura.Lines.CostingCode2 = cc2;
                                                    if (!cc3.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                        oFactura.Lines.CostingCode3 = cc3;
                                                    if (!cc4.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                        oFactura.Lines.CostingCode4 = cc4;

                                                    oFactura.Lines.WarehouseCode = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_alm").Cells.Item(i).Specific)).Value;

                                                    #region RETENCIONES CALCULAR BASES

                                                    //BASE DE NETOS
                                                    ValorTotalLinea = SumaValorFact;
                                                    SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion = SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion + ValorTotalLinea;


                                                    //BASE DE IMPUESTOS
                                                    ValorIVALinea = ValorIvaLineaFac;
                                                    SumaValorBaseIVARetencion = SumaValorBaseIVARetencion + ValorIVALinea;

                                                    #endregion

                                                    if (!oFactura.Lines.LineTotal.Equals(0))
                                                        oFactura.Lines.Add();

                                                    if (marcarFila)
                                                        filaSelecciona.Add(i);
                                                }
                                            }
                                            #endregion
                                        }
                                        #endregion
                                    }
                                    else
                                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" El elemento " + ElementoItemCodigo + " de la línea " + linea + " se marco como elemento renunciado y de acuerdo a la configuración no se facturará.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                                }
                            }
                            #endregion
                        }

                        #region Asignar Linea Solo Impuesto
                        if (oArrMejorasExcIVA.Count > 0)
                        {
                            foreach (string idLinea in oArrMejorasExcIVA)
                            {
                                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                {

                                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value.Equals(idLinea))
                                    {
                                        oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(i).Specific)).Value);
                                        oFactura.Lines.ItemDescription = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_3").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                                        oFactura.Lines.ProjectCode = prjCode;
                                        oFactura.Lines.Price = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_6").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value) * OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_9").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value);
                                        oFactura.Lines.LineTotal = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_6").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value) * OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_9").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value);


                                        #region IVA
                                        oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                                        string query = "SELECT \"RevenuesAc\" FROM OITB WHERE \"ItmsGrpCod\" = '" + oItem.ItemsGroupCode + "'";
                                        oRS.DoQuery(query);
                                        string strCuentaIngGrupo = oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();

                                        oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = strCuentaIngGrupo;

                                        oTax.GetByKey(oItem.ArTaxCode);

                                        if (!oTax.Rate.Equals(0))
                                            oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = oItem.ArTaxCode;


                                        #endregion

                                        //oFactura.Lines.TaxOnly = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;

                                        codigoIVA = oFactura.Lines.TaxCode;
                                        if (!oArrCodIva.Contains(codigoIVA))
                                            oArrCodIva.Add(codigoIVA);

                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cIva").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = codigoIVA;

                                        if (!cc1.ToString().Equals(""))
                                            oFactura.Lines.CostingCode = cc1;
                                        if (!cc2.ToString().Equals(""))
                                            oFactura.Lines.CostingCode2 = cc2;
                                        if (!cc3.ToString().Equals(""))
                                            oFactura.Lines.CostingCode3 = cc3;
                                        if (!cc4.ToString().Equals(""))
                                            oFactura.Lines.CostingCode4 = cc4;

                                        oFactura.Lines.WarehouseCode = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_alm").Cells.Item(i).Specific)).Value;

                                        oFactura.Lines.Add();
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        #endregion
                        #region Asignar Linea Descuentos
                        if (contDesc.Equals("Y") && vlrDescuento > 0)
                        {
                            foreach (string codIva in oArrCodIva)
                            {
                                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                {

                                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_10").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value.Equals("NO"))
                                    {
                                        if (!((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_AAdMe").Cells.Item(i).Specific)).Value.Equals("C"))
                                        {
                                            double vlrDescLinea = getValorTotalDescuento(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString(), ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(i).Specific)).Value);

                                            if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cIva").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value.Equals(codIva) && vlrDescLinea > 0)
                                            {
                                                oFactura.Lines.ItemDescription = "DESCUENTO VENTA";
                                                oFactura.Lines.ProjectCode = prjCode;
                                                oFactura.Lines.Price = -vlrDescLinea;
                                                oFactura.Lines.LineTotal = -vlrDescLinea;

                                                #region //Maneja_Retenciones  valor base para la retencion
                                                ValorFact = oFactura.Lines.LineTotal;
                                                #endregion
                                                #region //Maneja_Retenciones  valor base para la retencion
                                                SumaValorFact = ValorFact;
                                                #endregion

                                                if (ctasTipoServicio.Equals("Y"))
                                                    ctaDescuento = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_CUENFACT", "U_ctaDesc", "U_tipServ", strTipoS, SBOCompany);
                                                else
                                                    ctaDescuento = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_ctaDesc", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);


                                                oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = ctaDescuento;
                                                oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = codIva;
                                                if (!cc1.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                    oFactura.Lines.CostingCode = cc1;
                                                if (!cc2.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                    oFactura.Lines.CostingCode2 = cc2;
                                                if (!cc3.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                    oFactura.Lines.CostingCode3 = cc3;
                                                if (!cc4.ToString().Equals(""))
                                                    oFactura.Lines.CostingCode4 = cc4;

                                                #region RETENCIONES CALCULAR BASES

                                                //BASE DE NETOS
                                                ValorTotalLinea = SumaValorFact;
                                                SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion = SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion + ValorTotalLinea;

                                                #endregion

                                                oFactura.Lines.Add();
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }


                        vlrDescuentoCubierto = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oDBS.GetValue("U_DescCub", 0).Trim());

                        if (vlrDescuentoCubierto > 0)
                        {
                            if (contDesc.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                oFactura.Lines.ItemDescription = "DESCUENTO VENTA";
                                oFactura.Lines.ProjectCode = prjCode;
                                oFactura.Lines.Price = -vlrDescuentoCubierto;
                                oFactura.Lines.LineTotal = -vlrDescuentoCubierto;

                                #region //Maneja_Retenciones  valor base para la retencion
                                ValorFact = oFactura.Lines.LineTotal;
                                #endregion
                                #region //Maneja_Retenciones  valor base para la retencion
                                SumaValorFact = ValorFact;
                                #endregion

                                if (ctasTipoServicio.Equals("Y"))
                                    ctaDescuento = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_CUENFACT", "U_ctaDesc", "U_tipServ", strTipoS, SBOCompany);
                                else
                                    ctaDescuento = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_ctaDesc", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);


                                oFactura.Lines.AccountCode = ctaDescuento;
                                oFactura.Lines.TaxCode = strIVAExc;
                                if (!cc1.ToString().Equals(""))
                                    oFactura.Lines.CostingCode = cc1;
                                if (!cc2.ToString().Equals(""))
                                    oFactura.Lines.CostingCode2 = cc2;
                                if (!cc3.ToString().Equals(""))
                                    oFactura.Lines.CostingCode3 = cc3;
                                if (!cc4.ToString().Equals(""))
                                    oFactura.Lines.CostingCode4 = cc4;

                                #region RETENCIONES CALCULAR BASES

                                //BASE DE NETOS
                                ValorTotalLinea = SumaValorFact;
                                SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion = SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion + ValorTotalLinea;

                                #endregion

                                oFactura.Lines.Add();

                            }
                            else
                            {
                                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("No está configurado la contabilización del descuento.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                                break;
                            }


                        }

                        #endregion
                        #region crear la factura en SAP
                        if (docTotal > 0)
                        {
                            #region Redondeo
                            if (totalValorConIva > 0)
                            {
                                int floorTotal = (int)Math.Floor(totalValorConIvaFAC);
                                floorTotal = (int)Math.Round(totalValorConIvaFAC);
                                double roundTotal = totalValorConIva - floorTotal;
                            }
                            #endregion

                            #region RETENCIONES

                            bool Maneja_Retencion = ServicioFunerario.Maneja_Retenciones(SBOCompany, strPath);
                            if (Maneja_Retencion)
                            {
                                #region Retenciones FUENTE
                                SAPbobsCOM.Recordset orset = null;
                                try
                                {
                                    if (!id.Equals(string.Empty))
                                    {
                                        #region consulta la retenciones aplicar a cada socio
                                        orset = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                                        string query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "Consultar_Retenciones_FUENTE_SocioNegocio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                        query = query.Replace("%CardCode%", id.Trim());

                                        try
                                        {
                                            orset.DoQuery(query);
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception e) { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSvrFun", "retenciones", SBOCompany); }
                                        #endregion

                                        #region valido cada retencion del socio que arroja la consulta
                                        if (orset.RecordCount > 0)
                                        {
                                            #region si tiene retenciones aplico retenciones aplico

                                            #region recorro la retenciones del socio para calcularlas

                                            for (int ind = 0; ind < orset.RecordCount; ind++)
                                            {
                                                string typoBase = orset.Fields.Item("TipoBase").Value.ToString();
                                                if (typoBase.Equals("N"))
                                                {
                                                    #region valores netos lineas

                                                    if (SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion > 0)
                                                    {
                                                        double ValorBaseMinima = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, orset.Fields.Item("BaseMinima").Value);

                                                        if (SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion > ValorBaseMinima)
                                                        {
                                                            double PrctajeRetencion = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, orset.Fields.Item("PrctajeRetencion").Value);
                                                            double calculo = Math.Round((PrctajeRetencion * SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion) / 100);
                                                            double VRRetencion = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, (calculo));

                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.WTCode = orset.Fields.Item("CodigoRetencion").Value.ToString();
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.WTAmount = VRRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Base_ML").Value = SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Tarifa").Value = PrctajeRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Fuente").Value = "A";
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Ret_ML").Value = VRRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.Add();
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    #endregion
                                                }
                                                else
                                                {
                                                    #region  valores de impuestos lineas

                                                    if (SumaValorBaseIVARetencion > 0)
                                                    {
                                                        double ValorBaseMinima = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, orset.Fields.Item("BaseMinima").Value);

                                                        if (SumaValorBaseIVARetencion > ValorBaseMinima)
                                                        {

                                                            double PrctajeRetencion = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, orset.Fields.Item("PrctajeRetencion").Value);
                                                            double calculo = Math.Round((PrctajeRetencion * SumaValorBaseIVARetencion) / 100);
                                                            double VRRetencion = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, (calculo));

                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.WTCode = orset.Fields.Item("CodigoRetencion").Value.ToString();
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.WTAmount = VRRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Base_ML").Value = SumaValorBaseIVARetencion;

                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Tarifa").Value = PrctajeRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Fuente").Value = "A";
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Ret_ML").Value = VRRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.Add();

                                                            string TipoRetencion = orset.Fields.Item("TipoRetencion").Value.ToString();
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    #endregion
                                                }

                                                orset.MoveNext();
                                            }
                                            #endregion
                                        }
                                        #endregion
                                        #endregion

                                    }
                                }
                                catch (Exception e)
                                {
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSvrFun", "Cargar_Retenciones_SocioNegocio", SBOCompany);
                                }
                                finally
                                {
                                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(orset);
                                }

                                #endregion

                                #region Retenciones ICA
                                orset = null;
                                try
                                {
                                    if (!id.Equals(string.Empty))
                                    {

                                        string sede = oDBS.GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim();
                                        string municipioICA = RetornarMunicipioMM_ICA_XSede(SBOCompany, sede, strPath);

                                        #region consulta la retenciones aplicar a cada socio
                                        orset = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                                        string query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "Consultar_Retenciones_iCA_SocioNegocio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                        query = query.Replace("%CardCode%", id.Trim());
                                        query = query.Replace("%municipio%", municipioICA.Trim());
                                        try
                                        {
                                            orset.DoQuery(query);
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception e) { OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSvrFun", "CrearFactura", SBOCompany); }
                                        #endregion

                                        #region valido cada retencion del socio que arroja la consulta
                                        if (orset.RecordCount > 0)
                                        {
                                            #region si tiene retenciones aplico retenciones aplico

                                            #region recorro la retenciones del socio para calcularlas

                                            for (int ind = 0; ind < orset.RecordCount; ind++)
                                            {
                                                string typoBase = orset.Fields.Item("TipoBase").Value.ToString();
                                                if (typoBase.Equals("N"))
                                                {
                                                    #region valores netos lineas

                                                    if (SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion > 0)
                                                    {
                                                        double ValorBaseMinima = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, orset.Fields.Item("BaseMinima").Value);

                                                        if (SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion > ValorBaseMinima)
                                                        {
                                                            double PrctajeRetencion = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, orset.Fields.Item("PrctajeRetencion").Value);
                                                            double calculo = Math.Round((PrctajeRetencion * SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion) / 100);
                                                            double VRRetencion = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, (calculo));
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.WTCode = orset.Fields.Item("CodigoRetencion").Value.ToString();
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.WTAmount = VRRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Base_ML").Value = SumaValorBaseNetoRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Tarifa").Value = PrctajeRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Fuente").Value = "A";
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Ret_ML").Value = VRRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.Add();
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    #endregion
                                                }
                                                else
                                                {
                                                    #region  valores de impuestos lineas

                                                    if (SumaValorBaseIVARetencion > 0)
                                                    {
                                                        double ValorBaseMinima = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, orset.Fields.Item("BaseMinima").Value);

                                                        if (SumaValorBaseIVARetencion > ValorBaseMinima)
                                                        {
                                                            double PrctajeRetencion = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, orset.Fields.Item("PrctajeRetencion").Value);
                                                            double calculo = Math.Round((PrctajeRetencion * SumaValorBaseIVARetencion) / 100);
                                                            double VRRetencion = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, (calculo));

                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.WTCode = orset.Fields.Item("CodigoRetencion").Value.ToString();
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.WTAmount = VRRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Base_ML").Value = SumaValorBaseIVARetencion;

                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Tarifa").Value = PrctajeRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Fuente").Value = "A";
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Ret_ML").Value = VRRetencion;
                                                            oFactura.WithholdingTaxData.Add();

                                                            string TipoRetencion = orset.Fields.Item("TipoRetencion").Value.ToString();
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    #endregion
                                                }

                                                orset.MoveNext();
                                            }
                                            #endregion
                                        }
                                        #endregion
                                        #endregion

                                    }
                                }
                                catch (Exception e)
                                {
                                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSvrFun", "Cargar_Retenciones_SocioNegocio", SBOCompany);
                                }
                                finally
                                {
                                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(orset);
                                }

                                #endregion

                            }
                            #endregion

                            #region Add Factura

                            int exitoFac = oFactura.Add();
                            if (exitoFac != 0)
                            {
                                SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo crear el documento. Error: " + SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "OK", "", "");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (!oChkPreliminar.Checked)
                                {
                                    numdoc = SBOCompany.GetNewObjectKey();
                                    foreach (int fila in filaSelecciona)
                                    {
                                        string facturada = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_10").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                        if (!facturada.Equals("SI"))
                                        {
                                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_10").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value = "SI";
                                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_NFa").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value = numdoc;
                                        }
                                    }

                                    //enviar campos actualizados al datasource
                                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_factConvPart", 0, "Y");
                                }
                            }
                            #endregion
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            SBOApplication.MessageBox("Uno de los documentos no se puede generar ya que el total es cero o uno de los elementos ya tiene una factura asociada.", 1, "Aceptar", "", "");

                        }
                        #endregion

                    }

                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC012", SBOCompany);
                }
                #endregion
            }
            else
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El usuario actual no cuenta permisos para gestionar series de numeración de la sede: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSedeNom", 0).Trim() + "", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Devuelve las condiones de pago de un SN
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id"></param>
        /// <param name="FecFac"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private DateTime condicionPagoSN(string id, DateTime FecFac, ref int idCondPago, bool recobro = false)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners oBp = (SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.oBusinessPartners);
            string smonth, sdays;

            oBp.GetByKey(id);
            if (!recobro)
            {
                smonth = DevolverItemEnTabla("OCTG", "ExtraMonth", "GroupNum", oBp.PayTermsGrpCode.ToString(), SBOCompany);

                if (!smonth.Equals("0"))
                    FecFac = FecFac.AddMonths(int.Parse(smonth));

                sdays = DevolverItemEnTabla("OCTG", "ExtraDays", "GroupNum", oBp.PayTermsGrpCode.ToString(), SBOCompany);

                if (!sdays.Equals("0"))
                    FecFac = FecFac.AddDays(int.Parse(sdays));

            }
            else
            {
                sdays = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_RECOB_ENT", "U_diasVenc", "Code", id, SBOCompany);
                if (!sdays.Equals("0") && !sdays.Equals(""))
                    FecFac = FecFac.AddDays(int.Parse(sdays));
                else
                    FecFac = FecFac.AddDays(30);
            }

            idCondPago = oBp.PayTermsGrpCode;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oBp);


            return FecFac;
        }

                                        // consultar

                                        docTotal += oFactura.Lines.Price;
                                        //docTotal += ordenCompra.Lines.Quantity * ordenCompra.Lines.Price;
                                        if (!cc1.ToString().Equals(""))
                                            oFactura.Lines.CostingCode = cc1;
                                        if (!cc2.ToString().Equals(""))
                                            oFactura.Lines.CostingCode2 = cc2;
                                        if (!cc3.ToString().Equals(""))
                                            oFactura.Lines.CostingCode3 = cc3;
                                        if (!cc4.ToString().Equals(""))
                                            oFactura.Lines.CostingCode4 = cc4;

                                        oFactura.Lines.WarehouseCode = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_alm").Cells.Item(i).Specific)).Value;

                                        if (!oFactura.Lines.LineTotal.Equals(0))
                                            oFactura.Lines.Add();

                                        if (marcarFila)
                                            filaSelecciona.Add(i);

                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_AAdMe").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value.Equals("C"))
                                        filaSelecciona.Add(i);
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (docTotal > 0)
                        {

                            #region Redondeo
                            if (totalValorConIva > 0)
                            {
                                int floorTotal = (int)Math.Floor(totalValorConIvaFAC);
                                floorTotal = (int)Math.Round(totalValorConIvaFAC);
                                double roundTotal = totalValorConIva - floorTotal;

                                //20150824 se inhabilita por solicitud  del cliente 
                                //if (roundTotal != 0)
                                //{
                                //    oFactura.Rounding = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                                //    oFactura.RoundingDiffAmount = roundTotal;
                                //}
                            }
                            #endregion


                            //oFactura.DocTotal = docTotal;
                            //string strRuta = @"D:\Copias Fredy Ruiz\temp\fact" + String.Format("{0:y yyyyMMdd}", DateTime.Now) + ".xml";
                            //oFactura.SaveXML(ref strRuta);
                            int exitoFac = oFactura.Add();
                            //if (oFactura.Add() != 0)
                            if (exitoFac != 0)
                            {
                                SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo crear el documento. Error: " + SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "OK", "", "");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                numdoc = SBOCompany.GetNewObjectKey();
                                foreach (int fila in filaSelecciona)
                                {
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_10").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value = "SI";

                                    //try
                                    //{
                                    //    oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                                    //    string query = "UPDATE \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" SET \"U_seFactu\" = 'SI' WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString() + " AND \"LineId\" = " + fila + "";
                                    //    oRS.DoQuery(query);
                                    //    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                                    //}
                                    //catch { }
                                }


                                //enviar campos actualizados al datasource
                                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_factConvPart", 0, "Y");
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            //SBOCompany.EndTransaction(BoWfTransOpt.wf_RollBack);
                            SBOApplication.MessageBox("Uno de los documentos no se puede generar ya que el total es cero o uno de los elementos ya tiene una factura asociada.", 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
                        }

                    }

                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    //try
                    //{
                    //    SBOCompany.EndTransaction(BoWfTransOpt.wf_RollBack);
                    //}
                    //catch { }
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC012", SBOCompany);
                }
            }
            else
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El usuario actual no cuenta permisos para gestionar series de numeración de la sede: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSedeNom", 0).Trim() + "", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);


        }

        #region Cambiar Estado PQC llamada servicio
        public void CambiarEstadpPQC(string factura, string pago, int Estado, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors1 = null;
            string strQuery = "";

            try
            {

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors1 = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                if (!factura.Equals(""))
                {
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ConsultarPQRFactura", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%factura%", factura);
                    ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                }
                if (Estado != -1)
                {
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "EstadoDevolucion", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    ors1.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    Estado = Int32.Parse(ors1.Fields.Item("statusID").Value.ToString().Trim());
                }

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {

                        string callID = ors.Fields.Item("U_NumPqr").Value.ToString();
                        SAPbobsCOM.ServiceCalls oServiceCall = null;
                        oServiceCall = (SAPbobsCOM.ServiceCalls)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oServiceCalls);
                        oServiceCall.GetByKey(int.Parse(callID));
                        if (Estado == -1)
                        {
                            oServiceCall.Status = Estado;
                            oServiceCall.Resolution = "CERRADO POR CREACIÓN DE COMPROBANTE DE EGRESO: " + pago;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            oServiceCall.Status = Estado;
                            oServiceCall.Resolution = "DEVOLUCIÓN DE PAGO POR CANCELACIÓN DE COMPROBANTE DE EGRESO: " + pago;
                        }
                        int error = oServiceCall.Update();
                        if (error != 0)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error cerrando Llamada de servicios. " + SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                        }

                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }


        }
        #endregion

        private string DescripcionArticulosFactura(string strDocEntry, string Tabla, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {
            string item = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                string query = "SELECT \"Dscription\" FROM " + Tabla + " WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + strDocEntry + "";
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        item = item + ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString() + ",";
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }
                    item = item.Remove(item.Length - 1);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SER01", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return item;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Devuelve el almacén configurado en el usuario.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="usuario"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public void CamposUsuario(int usuario, ref string almacen, ref string codMun, ref string nomMun, ref string sucursal, ref string nomSucursal)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            almacen = "";
            codMun = "";
            nomMun = "";
            sucursal = "";
            nomSucursal = "";

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_almacen\", \"U_Municipio\", (SELECT \"U_Municip\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_MUN\" WHERE \"U_codMun\" = \"U_Municipio\") AS \"Nombre Municipio\", \"Branch\" AS \"Sucursal\",(SELECT \"Name\" FROM OUBR WHERE \"Code\" = \"Branch\") AS \"Nombre Sucursal\"  FROM OUSR WHERE \"USERID\" = " + usuario + "");

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    almacen = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    codMun = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    nomMun = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    sucursal = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    nomSucursal = ors.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Campos Usuario", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }


        }

        {

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)Company.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery("select \"SeriesName\"  from NNM1  where \"Series\" = '" + serie + "'");
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    serieName = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    if (serieName.Equals("DERECHOS"))
                        esSerie = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EsSerieDerechos", Company);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return esSerie;
        }

        public void BitacoraElementosAdiMej(Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

            try
            {
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                for (int i = 0; i < oDBS.Size; i++)
                {
                    if ((oDBS.GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", i).Equals("A") || oDBS.GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", i).Equals("M")) && oDBS.GetValue("U_envHist", i).Equals("N"))
                    {
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Elemento Adicional o Mejora: " + oDBS.GetValue("U_Codigo", i).Trim());
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_5").Specific).FlushToDataSource();
                        ors.DoQuery("UPDATE \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" SET \"U_envHist\" = 'Y' WHERE  \"DocEntry\" = " + oDBS.GetValue("DocEntry", i) + " AND  \"LineId\" = " + oDBS.GetValue("LineId", i) + "");
                    }

                }


                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Bitacora Elementos o Mejora", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

        }

        {
            string item = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                string query = "SELECT \"" + FieldCodeName + "\" FROM \"" + TableName + "\" WHERE \"" + FieldName + "\"  = '" + value + "'";

        }
        public void PermisosUsuario(Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool esPreOrden = false;
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim();
            bool esCotiz = esSerieCotizaciónApertura(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("Series", 0).Trim(), ref esPreOrden);
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;

            cons.getPermisos(ors, SBOCompany.UserSignature);
            try
            {
                if (!esCotiz && existePermisoUsuarioSede(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany.UserSignature.ToString()))
                {
                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_permSal").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") && (estado.Equals("1") || estado.Equals("2")))
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("96").Enabled = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("96").Enabled = false;
                    }

                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_permOC").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") && (estado.Equals("1") || estado.Equals("2")))
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("97").Enabled = true;
                        oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("97").Enabled = false;
                        oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = false;
                    }

                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_permOS").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") && (estado.Equals("1") || estado.Equals("2")))
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = false;
                    }
                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_permPag").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") && (estado.Equals("1") || estado.Equals("2")))
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("126").Enabled = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("126").Enabled = false;
                    }

                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_permFac").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") && (permiteGenerarFactura(estado)))
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("107").Enabled = true;
                        oForm.Items.Item("196").Enabled = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("107").Enabled = false;
                        oForm.Items.Item("196").Enabled = false;
                    }

                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_PermCementrio").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("btcement").Enabled = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("btcement").Enabled = false;
                    }
                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_permSelAlm").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_alm").Editable = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_alm").Editable = false;
                    }
                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_permSelCC").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cc1").Editable = true;
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cc2").Editable = true;
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cc3").Editable = true;
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cc4").Editable = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cc1").Editable = false;
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cc2").Editable = false;
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cc3").Editable = false;
                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_cc4").Editable = false;
                    }

                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_permCertGast").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("tab_10").Enabled = true;
                        oForm.Items.Item("tab_10").Visible = true;

                        SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("250").Specific;
                        try
                        {
                            oCombo.ValidValues.Add("CG", "Certificación Gastos");
                        }
                        catch { }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oForm.Items.Item("tab_10").Enabled = false;
                        oForm.Items.Item("tab_10").Visible = true;

                    }

                }
                else
                {

                    oForm.Items.Item("96").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("97").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("126").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("107").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("131").Enabled = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("196").Enabled = false;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SER01", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }


        public string SeleccionarArticuloDefecto(Form oForm, string idElemento, string idContrato, string strTipoS, string idSede, ref string nArticulo, ref string almacen)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSProteccion = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string minValue, maxValue;
            string articulo = "";
            string aplicaVigenciaPreciosXElementos = SETUP_RULE("APLVIGPRECELEM", SBOCompany);


            try
            {
                oRSProteccion = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                if (!idContrato.Equals(""))
                    cons.getProteccion(ref oRSProteccion, idContrato);
                else
                {
                    if (strTipoS.Equals("2"))
                    {
                        //cons.getPlanParticular(ref oRSProteccion);
                        string strPlanPart = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_CodPlan", 0).Trim();
                        cons.getProteccion(ref oRSProteccion, "", strPlanPart);
                    }
                    else
                        cons.getProteccion(ref oRSProteccion, "", "");
                }
                minValue = oRSProteccion.Fields.Item("U_min").Value.ToString();
                maxValue = oRSProteccion.Fields.Item("U_max").Value.ToString();

                if (aplicaVigenciaPreciosXElementos.Equals("Y"))
                    ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"ItemCode\",\"ItemName\", (SELECT \"U_almacen\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_SERIESXSUCUR\" WHERE \"U_sede\" = '" + idSede + "') AS \"Almacen\" FROM OITM WHERE \"U_OK1_SF_ELEM\" = '" + idElemento + "' AND \"U_OK1_SF_CALIF\" BETWEEN '" + minValue + "' AND '" + maxValue + "'");
                else
                    ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"ItemCode\",\"ItemName\", (SELECT \"U_almacen\" FROM OUSR WHERE USERID = " + SBOCompany.UserSignature + ") AS \"Almacen\" FROM OITM WHERE \"U_OK1_SF_ELEM\" = '" + idElemento + "' AND \"U_OK1_SF_CALIF\" BETWEEN '" + minValue + "' AND '" + maxValue + "'");
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    articulo = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    nArticulo = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString();
                    almacen = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString();
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SeleccionarArticuloDefecto", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSProteccion != null)
                {
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSProteccion);
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);

                }
            }

            return articulo;
        }

        private void DatosConexionWebService(ref string path, ref string apliClieNoEnf, ref string qryClieNoEnf, ref string usuario, ref string pass, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            StringBuilder oQuery = new StringBuilder();
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {

                oQuery.AppendLine("SELECT * FROM \"@OK1_PARAMCLINOENF\" WHERE \"Code\" = 'SETUP'");
                ors.DoQuery(oQuery.ToString());
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    path = ors.Fields.Item("U_pathWS").Value.ToString();
                    apliClieNoEnf = ors.Fields.Item("U_apliClieNoEnf").Value.ToString();
                    qryClieNoEnf = ors.Fields.Item("U_qryClieNoEnf").Value.ToString();
                    usuario = ors.Fields.Item("U_user").Value.ToString();
                    pass = ors.Fields.Item("U_passw").Value.ToString();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Datos Conexion Web Service", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }
        public void RegistrarClienteNoEnfocado(string Documento, string Nombre, string AddIn, string TipoCliente)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            StringBuilder oQuery = new StringBuilder();
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {

                oQuery.AppendLine("INSERT INTO \"@OK1_EXE_SF_CLINOENF\" (\"Code\", \"Name\",\"U_doc\",\"U_nom\", \"U_addin\", \"U_tipoClie\", \"U_fecha\", \"U_hora\", \"U_usuario\") VALUES ((SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(\"Code\" AS decimal)) + 1, 1) FROM \"@OK1_EXE_SF_CLINOENF\"), (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(\"Code\" AS decimal)) + 1, 1) FROM \"@OK1_EXE_SF_CLINOENF\"), '" + Documento + "', '" + Nombre + "', '" + AddIn + "', '" + TipoCliente + "', CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_TIME, '" + SBOCompany.UserName + "')");
