        public void setCondicionesCFLPlan(Form oForm, ref SAPbouiCOM.ChooseFromList oCFL, string strTipoS)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Conditions oConds = new Conditions();
            string tipoContrato = "";

            try
            {

                switch (strTipoS)
                {
                    case "2":
                        tipoContrato = "P";
                        break;
                    case "4":
                        tipoContrato = "C";
                        break;
                    default:
                        tipoContrato = "P";
                        break;
                }



                if (oConds.Count <= 1)
                {
                    oConds.Add();
                }

                //establecer condiciones
                //ej: where ((u_ok1_sf_elem = '1') and ((u_ok1_sf_calif >= '5') or (u_ok1_sf_calif <= '10')) and ((u_ok1_sf_ciudad='Manizales') or (u_ok1_sf_ciudad is null)))

                //condicion de elemento
                oConds.Item(0).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                oConds.Item(0).Alias = "U_tipCont";
                oConds.Item(0).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_EQUAL;
                oConds.Item(0).CondVal = tipoContrato;
                oConds.Item(0).BracketCloseNum = 1;

                oCFL.SetConditions(oConds);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "setCondicionesCFLPlan", SBOCompany);
            }

        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Valida según la protección los elementos que son obligatorios dependiendo el nivel de servicio.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oDBSLlamada"></param>
        /// <param name="oDBSElementos"></param>
        /// <param name="sapCompany"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public string ValidarElementosObligatorios(DBDataSource oDBSLlamada, DBDataSource oDBSElementos, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {
            string sPlan = oDBSLlamada.GetValue("U_CodPlan", 0).Trim();
            string sNivelServicio = oDBSLlamada.GetValue("U_NivServ", 0).Trim();
            string mensaje = "", campo = "", query = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool existe;
            ArrayList elementos = new ArrayList();


            if (!sPlan.Equals(""))
            {
                switch (sNivelServicio)
                {
                    case "1":
                        campo = "U_inicial";
                        break;
                    case "2":
                        campo = "U_final";
                        break;
                    case "3":
                        campo = "U_completo";
                        break;
                    case "5":
                        campo = "U_traslados";
                        break;
                    case "6":
                        campo = "U_otrasVtas";
                        break;

                }
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT \"U_codele\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRELELINES\" WHERE \"Code\" = (SELECT \"U_protecc\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD\" WHERE \"Code\" = '" + sPlan + "') AND \"" + campo + "\" = 'Y'";
                try
                {
                    ors.DoQuery(query);

                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        for (int j = 1; j <= ors.RecordCount; j++)
                        {
                            elementos.Add(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString());
                            ors.MoveNext();
                        }

                        foreach (string elemento in elementos)
                        {
                            existe = false;

                            for (int i = 0; i < oDBSElementos.Size && mensaje.Equals(""); i++)
                            {
                                if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_Codigo", i).Trim().Equals(elemento) && !oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_ItemCode", i).Trim().Equals(""))
                                {
                                    existe = true;
                                }
                            }

                            if (!existe)
                            {
                                mensaje = "El elemento " + elemento + " aparece como obligatorio para este nivel de servicio. Desea continuar?";
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Validación Elementos Obligatorios", SBOCompany);
                }
                finally
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                }
            }

            return mensaje;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cambiar estado a facturado.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public void cambiarEstadoFacturado(Form oForm, ref bool estaFacturado)
        {
            DBDataSource oDBSElementos = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
            DBDataSource oDBSDerechos = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_AUXILIO");

            bool facturado = true;
            bool derechosCancelados = true;
            bool esMultiempresa = false;

            #region obtener informacion del convenio y el plan
            string idConvenio = "", idPlan = "";
            string idContrato = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("35").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
            if (!idContrato.Equals(""))
            {
                idConvenio = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_conve", "DocEntry", idContrato, SBOCompany);
                idPlan = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_plan", "DocEntry", idContrato, SBOCompany);
            }
            else
            {
                idConvenio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_conve", 0).Trim();
                idPlan = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_CodPlan", 0).Trim();
            }
            string planBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_planBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
            if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                idPlan = planBase;

            string esPlanBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_esPlanBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
            if (esPlanBase.Equals("Y"))
                planBase = idPlan;

            string idPlanEqui = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_codPlanEquiv", 0).Trim();
            if (!idPlanEqui.Equals(""))
            {
                idPlan = idPlanEqui;
                planBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_planBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);

                esPlanBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_esPlanBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
                if (esPlanBase.Equals("Y"))
                    planBase = idPlan;

                if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                    idPlan = planBase;
            }

            if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                idConvenio = "";
            #endregion


            string convenio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_conve", 0).Trim();
            string MultiNS = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONV_HEAD", "U_convPart", "DocEntry", convenio, SBOCompany);
            string Multi = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONV_HEAD", "U_convEmp", "DocEntry", convenio, SBOCompany);
            string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim();
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
            bool esConvPart = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("ckConvPart").Specific).Checked;
            string nivelServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NivServ", 0).Trim();
            bool eshijo = false;
            string TipoLinea = string.Empty;

            if (!esConvPart)
                nivelServicio = "N/A";

            string fecha = "";
            if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                fecha = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("7").Specific).Value;
            else
                fecha = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD", "U_FechaSol", "DocEntry", ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value, SBOCompany)), SBOApplication);

            #region facturar renuncias
            string tipoServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim();
            bool facturarRenunciaSF = ServicioFunerario.PuedeFacturaElementosRenunciados(SBOCompany, tipoServicio, strPath);
            bool facturarRenuncia = true;
            #endregion

            if (MultiNS.Equals("Y") || Multi.Equals("Y"))
                esMultiempresa = true;

            if (esMultiempresa)
            {
                if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_factConvPart", 0).Trim().Equals("N") && calcularValorCubiertoADD(oForm, SBOCompany, SBOApplication, strPath) > 0)
                    facturado = false;

                for (int i = 0; i < oDBSElementos.Size; i++)
                {
                    facturarRenuncia = false;
                    if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_Renuncia", i).Trim().Equals("N"))
                        facturarRenuncia = true;
                    else if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_Renuncia", i).Trim().Equals("Y") && facturarRenunciaSF)
                        facturarRenuncia = true;

                    TipoLinea = oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_tipLinea", i).Trim();
                    eshijo = TipoLinea.Equals("H") || TipoLinea.Equals("C");

                    if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", i).Equals("C") && oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_seFactu", i).Equals("NO") && facturarRenuncia && !eshijo)
                    {
                        double valor = getValorTopeElementoConvenio(idConvenio, idPlan, oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_Codigo", i).Trim(), esConvPart, nivelServicio, fecha);
                        if (valor > 0)
                        {
                            facturado = false;
                            break;
                        }

                    }
                }
            }

            if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < oDBSElementos.Size; i++)
                {
                    facturarRenuncia = false;
                    if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_Renuncia", i).Trim().Equals("N"))
                        facturarRenuncia = true;
                    else if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_Renuncia", i).Trim().Equals("Y") && facturarRenunciaSF)
                        facturarRenuncia = true;

                    if (!oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", i).Trim().Equals(""))
                    {
                        if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_LPagadaPrenec", i).Trim().Equals("N") && !oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", i).Trim().Equals("A") && (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_tipLinea", i).Trim().Equals("") || oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_tipLinea", i).Trim().Equals("B") || oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_tipLinea", i).Trim().Equals("P")) && facturarRenuncia)
                        {
                            facturado = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (facturado)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < oDBSElementos.Size; i++)
                {
                    if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_EsFactu", i).Trim().Equals("Y") && oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_seFactu", i).Trim().Equals("NO"))
                    {
                        facturado = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_recobro", 0).Trim().Equals("Y") && oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_factRecobro", 0).Trim().Equals("N"))
            {
                facturado = false;
            }

            if (facturado)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < oDBSDerechos.Size; i++)
                {
                    if (!oDBSDerechos.GetValue("U_AuxCanc", i).Equals("Y") && !oDBSDerechos.GetValue("U_Codigo", i).Equals(""))
                    {

                        derechosCancelados = false;
                        break;

                    }
                }
            }

            if (facturado)
            {
                if (!estado.Equals("6") && derechosCancelados)
                {
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Estado", 0, "6");
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Cerrando Orden de Servicio Funerario.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                    SBOApplication.MessageBox("Cerrando Orden de Servicio Funerario.");
                }

                if (!estado.Equals("6") && !estado.Equals("12") && !derechosCancelados)
                {
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Estado", 0, "13");
                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Cerrando con Derechos Pendientes.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                    SBOApplication.MessageBox("Cerrando con Derechos Pendientes.");

                }
                estaFacturado = true;
            }

        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Verificar estado a facturado.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public string verificarEstadoFacturado(Form oForm)
        {
            DBDataSource oDBSElementos = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
            string mensaje = "";

            for (int i = 0; i < oDBSElementos.Size; i++)
            {
                if (oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_EsFactu", i).Trim().Equals("Y") && oDBSElementos.GetValue("U_seFactu", i).Trim().Equals("NO"))
                {
                    mensaje = "Existen líneas de elementos pendientes por facturar.";
                    break;
                }
            }

            return mensaje;

        }


        public string calcularCantidadDisponible(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string itemCode, string almacen, string strPath)
        {
            string docEntry = "0";
            double cantidad = 0;
            //docEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("DocEntry", 0);
            docEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0);
            if (docEntry.Equals(""))
                docEntry = "0";
            if (!itemCode.Equals("") && !almacen.Equals("") && !docEntry.Equals(""))
                cantidad = cons.RetornarCantidadDisponible(itemCode, almacen, docEntry, strPath);
            return cantidad.ToString();
        }

        public string calcularCantidadDisponibleOP(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string itemCode, string almacen, string strPath, string OSF = "")
        {

            double cantidad = 0;

            if (!itemCode.Equals("") && !almacen.Equals("") && !OSF.Equals(""))
                cantidad = cons.RetornarCantidadDisponible(itemCode, almacen, OSF, strPath);
            return cantidad.ToString();
        }

        public void calcularTotales(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, bool calcTotalElementos, bool calcTotalDocs)
        {
            double subtotal = 0, descuentos = 0, iva = 0, total = 0, vlrCompra = 0, totalesLinea = 0;

            try
            {
                //calcularTotalesLineasServicio(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0), ref subtotal, ref descuentos, ref iva, ref vlrCompra, ref totalesLinea);
                if (calcTotalElementos)
                {
                    calcularTotalesLineasServicioForm(oForm, ref subtotal, ref descuentos, ref iva, ref vlrCompra, ref totalesLinea);
                    //total = subtotal - descuentos + iva;

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Subtotal", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, subtotal));
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TotalDesc", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, descuentos));
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TotalIVA", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, iva));
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TotalDoc", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, totalesLinea));
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_DocTotal", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, vlrCompra));
                }

                if (calcTotalDocs)
                {
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TotIng", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, calcularTotalPagos(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0))));

                    double totalFac = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, calcularTotalFacturas(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0)));
                    double totalNC = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, calcularTotalNotasCredito(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0)));
                    double totales = totalFac - totalNC;
                    // oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TotalFac", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, calcularTotalFacturas(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0))));
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TotalFac", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, totales));
                }

                try
                {
                    string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);
                    if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("vlrCub").ValueEx = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, "0", false, "", -1);
                        oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("vlrTotal").ValueEx = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, "0", false, "", -1);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        double vlrTotalAuxilio = 0;
                        double vlrCubierto = calcularValorCubierto(oForm, ref vlrTotalAuxilio);
                        double vlrDescCubierto = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_DescCub", 0));
                        double vlrTotalAdicionales = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TotalDoc", 0));
                        oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("vlrCub").ValueEx = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrCubierto, false, "", 2);
                        vlrCubierto -= vlrDescCubierto;
                        oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_TotalCubierto", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(SBOCompany, vlrCubierto));
                        oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("vlrTotal").ValueEx = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrTotalAdicionales + vlrCubierto + vlrTotalAuxilio, false, "", 2);
                        oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("vlrAux").ValueEx = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrTotalAuxilio, false, "", -1);
                    }
                }
                catch { }

                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_ADD_MODE)
                    oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("vlrCub").ValueEx = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, calcularValorCubiertoADD(oForm, SBOCompany, SBOApplication, strPath), false, "", 2);


                //oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("VlrTotSel").ValueEx = "0";

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC022", SBOCompany);
            }
        }

        public double calcularValorCubierto(Form oForm, ref double vlrTotalAuxilio)
        {
            XmlDocument xmlDoc = new XmlDocument();
            XmlNodeList xmlFilas;


            double vlrAuxilio = 0;
            string strDTXML = string.Empty;
            string esFacturable = string.Empty;
            Matrix netMatrix;
            StringReader strReader;

            string strQuery = "", idContrato = "", idConvenio = "", idPlan = "", filtro = "", fechaOSF = "", numOSF = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            double valorCubierto = 0;

            try
            {
                #region Valor Cubierto Convenio
                idContrato = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("35").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                numOSF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                if (!idContrato.Equals(""))
                {
                    idConvenio = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_conve", "DocEntry", idContrato, SBOCompany);
                    idPlan = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_plan", "DocEntry", idContrato, SBOCompany);
                }
                else
                {
                    idConvenio = oDBS.GetValue("U_conve", 0).Trim();
                    idPlan = oDBS.GetValue("U_CodPlan", 0).Trim();
                }

                string planBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_planBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
                if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                    idPlan = planBase;

                string esPlanBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_esPlanBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
                if (esPlanBase.Equals("Y"))
                    planBase = idPlan;

                string idPlanEqui = oDBS.GetValue("U_codPlanEquiv", 0).Trim();
                if (!idPlanEqui.Equals(""))
                {
                    idPlan = idPlanEqui;
                    planBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_planBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);

                    esPlanBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_esPlanBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
                    if (esPlanBase.Equals("Y"))
                        planBase = idPlan;

                    if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                        idPlan = planBase;
                }

                if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                    idConvenio = "";

                bool esConvPart = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("ckConvPart").Specific).Checked;
                string nivelServicio = oDBS.GetValue("U_NivServ", 0).Trim();


                switch (nivelServicio)
                {
                    case "1":
                        filtro = "AND \"U_inicial\" = 'Y'";
                        break;
                    case "2":
                        filtro = "AND \"U_final\" = 'Y'";
                        break;
                    case "3":
                        filtro = "AND \"U_completo\" = 'Y'";
                        break;
                    case "5":
                        filtro = "AND \"U_traslados\" = 'Y'";
                        break;
                    case "6":
                        filtro = "AND \"U_otrasVtas\" = 'Y'";
                        break;
                    case "7":
                        filtro = "AND T1.\"U_mascotas\" = 'Y'";
                        break;
                }

                if (!esConvPart)
                    nivelServicio = "N/A";


                if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                    fechaOSF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("7").Specific).Value;
                else
                    fechaOSF = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD", "U_FechaSol", "DocEntry", ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value, SBOCompany)), SBOApplication);

                if (!filtro.Equals(""))
                {
                    oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetVlrCubiertoElementoConvenio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    if (idConvenio.Equals(""))
                    {
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("'%idConvenio%' || '-' ||  ", idConvenio);
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idConvenio%", idConvenio);
                    }
                    else
                        strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idConvenio%", idConvenio);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idPlan%", idPlan);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nivelServicio%", nivelServicio);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%filtro%", filtro);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%fechaOSF%", fechaOSF);
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nOSF%", numOSF);
                    oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                        valorCubierto = Convert.ToDouble(oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                }
                #endregion

                #region Valor Auxilios
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                strDTXML = oMatrix.SerializeAsXML(BoMatrixXmlSelect.mxs_All);
                xmlDoc.LoadXml(strDTXML);
                System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer(typeof(Matrix));
                xmlFilas = xmlDoc.GetElementsByTagName("Row");
                strReader = new StringReader(strDTXML);
                netMatrix = (Matrix)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(strReader);

                int fila = 0;

                foreach (XmlElement item in xmlFilas)
                {
                    vlrAuxilio = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[55].Value.ToString());

                    vlrTotalAuxilio += vlrAuxilio;

                    fila++;
                }
                #endregion
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC022", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
            return valorCubierto;
        }

        private void calcularTotalesLineasServicioForm_old(Form oForm, ref double subtotal, ref double descuentos, ref double iva, ref double vlrCompra, ref double totalesLinea)
        {
            XmlDocument xmlDoc = new XmlDocument();
            XmlNodeList xmlFilas;

            double cant = 0;
            double vlrCompraLinea = 0, subtotalLinea = 0, descuentoLinea = 0, ivaLinea = 0, totalLinea = 0;
            string strDTXML = string.Empty;
            string esFacturable = string.Empty;
            Matrix netMatrix;
            StringReader strReader;


            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
            strDTXML = oMatrix.SerializeAsXML(BoMatrixXmlSelect.mxs_All);
            xmlDoc.LoadXml(strDTXML);
            System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer(typeof(Matrix));
            xmlFilas = xmlDoc.GetElementsByTagName("Row");
            strReader = new StringReader(strDTXML);
            netMatrix = (Matrix)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(strReader);

            int fila = 0;

            foreach (XmlElement item in xmlFilas)
            {

                cant = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[4].Value.ToString());


                vlrCompraLinea = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[15].Value.ToString());
                vlrCompra += cant * vlrCompraLinea;

                esFacturable = netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[16].Value.ToString();

                if (esFacturable.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    subtotalLinea = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[17].Value.ToString());
                    descuentoLinea = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[19].Value.ToString());
                    ivaLinea = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[21].Value.ToString());
                    totalLinea = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[22].Value.ToString());

                    subtotal += cant * subtotalLinea;
                    descuentos += cant * descuentoLinea;
                    iva += ivaLinea;
                    totalesLinea += totalLinea;
                }


                fila++;
            }


        }

        private void calcularTotalesLineasServicioForm(Form oForm, ref double subtotal, ref double descuentos, ref double iva, ref double vlrCompra, ref double totalesLinea)
        {
            XmlDocument xmlDoc = new XmlDocument();
            XmlNodeList xmlFilas;

            double cant = 0;
            double vlrCompraLinea = 0, subtotalLinea = 0, descuentoLinea = 0, ivaLinea = 0, totalLinea = 0;
            string strDTXML = string.Empty;
            string esFacturable = string.Empty;
            Matrix netMatrix;
            StringReader strReader;


            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
            strDTXML = oMatrix.SerializeAsXML(BoMatrixXmlSelect.mxs_All);
            xmlDoc.LoadXml(strDTXML);
            System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer(typeof(Matrix));
            xmlFilas = xmlDoc.GetElementsByTagName("Row");
            strReader = new StringReader(strDTXML);
            netMatrix = (Matrix)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(strReader);

            int fila = 0;

            foreach (XmlElement item in xmlFilas)
            {

                cant = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[5].Value.ToString());


                vlrCompraLinea = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[16].Value.ToString());
                vlrCompra += cant * vlrCompraLinea;

                esFacturable = netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[17].Value.ToString();

                if (esFacturable.Equals("Y"))

                    descuentoLinea = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[20].Value.ToString());
                    ivaLinea = Convert.ToDouble(netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[22].Value.ToString());

                    subtotal += cant * subtotalLinea;
                    descuentos += cant * descuentoLinea;
                    iva += ivaLinea;
                    totalesLinea += totalLinea;
                }


                fila++;
            }


        }
