        public string Validar_ExequiasInhumacion(Form oForm)
        {
            string mensaje = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDbs;
            try
            {
                oDbs = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");
                string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim();
                string val = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_vincElemProg", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);

                if (val.Equals("N"))
                {
                    if (estado.Equals("4") || estado.Equals("6"))
                    {
                        string nivelServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NivServ", 0).Trim();
                        switch (nivelServicio)
                        {
                            case "1": // Inicial
                                      // Campos de Velacion
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la sede de velación.";
                                }
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_VLugar", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la sala de velación.";
                                }
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_VFecha", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la fecha de velación.";
                                }

                                //// campos de salida
                                //if (oDbs.GetValue("U_SFecha", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                //{
                                //    mensaje = "Especifique la fecha de salida.";
                                //}
                                //if (oDbs.GetValue("U_SHora", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                //{
                                //    mensaje = "Especifique la hora de salida.";
                                //}
                                break;

                            case "2": //Final
                            case "3":// Completo
                                     // Campos de Velacion
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la sede de velación.";
                                }
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_VLugar", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la sala de velación.";
                                }
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_VFecha", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la fecha de velación.";
                                }

                                //// campos de salida
                                //if (oDbs.GetValue("U_SFecha", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                //{
                                //    mensaje = "Especifique la fecha de salida.";
                                //}
                                //if (oDbs.GetValue("U_SHora", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                //{
                                //    mensaje = "Especifique la hora de salida.";
                                //}
                                // Campos de inhumacion
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_IUbic", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique el cementerio donde se hace la inhumación.";
                                }
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_ILugar", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la ubicacion donde se hace la inhumación.";
                                }
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_IHora", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la hora de inhumación .";
                                }

                                // Campos de Exequias
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_ELugar", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique el lugar de las exequias.";
                                }
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_EFecha", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la fecha de las exequias.";
                                }
                                if (oDbs.GetValue("U_EHora", 0).Trim().Equals("") && mensaje.Equals(""))
                                {
                                    mensaje = "Especifique la hora de las exequias.";
                                }
                                break;
                        }
                    }
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                mensaje = e.Message;
            }
            return mensaje;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Consulta los datos de Inhumación.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="Code"></param>
        /// <param name="boveda"></param>
        /// <param name="lote"></param>
        /// <param name="campo_Cremacion"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <returns>existe</returns>
        public static bool consultarDatosInhumacion(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string Code, ref SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors)
        {
            string query = "";
            bool existe = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT * FROM \"@OK1_SF_CEMENTERIOS\" WHERE \"Code\" = '" + Code + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {

                    existe = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "consultarDatosInhumacion", ocmp);
            }

            return existe;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Retornar Series .
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="Campo"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <returns>existe</returns>
        public static string RetornarSeries(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string Campo)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string serie = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT \"" + Campo + "\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_PARAM\" WHERE \"Code\" " + "= 'SETUP'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    serie = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarSeries", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return serie;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Retorna las opciones de tipo de orden del elemento.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="Code"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <returns>existe</returns>
        public string RetornarTipoOrden(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string elemento)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string tipoOrden = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                //  select  "U_TipoOrden" from "@OK1_EXE_ELEPROTECC" Where "Code" = 'ARG-01'
                query = "SELECT \"U_TipoOrden\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_ELEPROTECC\" WHERE \"Code\" = '" + elemento + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    tipoOrden = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarTipoOrden", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return tipoOrden;
        }
        public static bool ActualizarAvisoSiniestro(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string NroServicio, string NroAvisoSiniestro)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool respuesta = false;
            string query = "";
            string asiniestro = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "UPDATE  \"@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD\" SET \"U_ASiniestro\" =" + NroAvisoSiniestro + "  WHERE \"DocEntry\" ='" + NroServicio + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT  \"U_ASiniestro\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" ='" + NroServicio + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    asiniestro = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
                if (asiniestro.Equals(NroAvisoSiniestro))
                    respuesta = true;
                else
                    respuesta = false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return respuesta;
        }
        public static bool ActualizarSalidaMercanciaMatrizSF(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string NroServicio, string Documento, string NroDocumento, string lineID)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool respuesta = false;
            string query = "";
            string NroDocSM = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "UPDATE  \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" SET \"U_Documento\" = '" + NroDocumento + "', \"U_DescDoc\" = '" + Documento + "'";
                query = query + "  WHERE \"DocEntry\" ='" + NroServicio + "'";
                query = query + "  AND   \"LineId\" ='" + lineID + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT  \"U_Documento\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" WHERE \"U_Documento\" ='" + NroDocumento + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    NroDocSM = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
                if (NroDocSM.Equals(NroDocumento))
                    respuesta = true;
                else
                    respuesta = false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return respuesta;
        }
        public static bool ConsultarExistenciaProcedure(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string procedimientoAlmacenadoName)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool respuesta = false;
            string query = "";

            string schema = "";
            try
            {
                schema = sapCompany.CompanyDB;
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                //query = "SELECT  * FROM \"PUBLIC\".\"PROCEDURES\" WHERE \"SCHEMA_NAME\" ='" + schema + "' AND \"PROCEDURE_NAME\" = '" + procedimientoAlmacenadoName + "'";
                query = "SELECT  * FROM  \"SYS\".\"PROCEDURES\" WHERE \"SCHEMA_NAME\" ='" + schema + "' AND \"PROCEDURE_NAME\" = '" + procedimientoAlmacenadoName + "'";

                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    respuesta = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ConsultarExistenciaProcedure", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return respuesta;
        }
        public static void DropProcedure(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string procedimientoAlmacenadoName)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string schema = "";
            try
            {
                schema = sapCompany.CompanyDB;
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "DROP PROCEDURE \"" + procedimientoAlmacenadoName + "\"";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "DropProcedure", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }
        public static void CargarProcedure(string folderPath, SAPbobsCOM.Company oCompany, string nameProcedure)
        {
            if (System.IO.Directory.Exists(folderPath))
            {
                try
                {
                    string[] files = System.IO.Directory.GetFiles(folderPath, "*.xml");
                    foreach (string filePath in files)
                    {
                        CargarProcedureFromXML(filePath, oCompany, nameProcedure);
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    throw e;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                throw new OK1.ExceptionManager.GenericException("El folder no existe");
            }
        }
        public static void CargarProcedureFromXML(string elPath, SAPbobsCOM.Company vCmp, string nameProcedure)
        {
            UserQueries oUQ = (UserQueries)AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData("StoreProcedures");
            int Ecount = 0;
            vCmp.XmlExportType = BoXmlExportTypes.xet_ExportImportMode;

            try
            {
                Ecount = vCmp.GetXMLelementCount(elPath);
                for (int i = 0; i < Ecount; i++)
                {

                    XmlDocument elXML = new XmlDocument();
                    elXML.Load(elPath);
                    XmlNodeList nodes = elXML.SelectNodes("//Procedure");
                    foreach (XmlNode node in nodes)
                    {
                        string id = node.Attributes["ID"].InnerText;
                        if (id.Equals(nameProcedure))
                        {
                            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRec = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)vCmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                            oRec.DoQuery("SELECT COUNT(PROCEDURE_NAME) FROM \"SYS\".\"PROCEDURES\" WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = '" + vCmp.CompanyDB + "' AND PROCEDURE_NAME = '" + id + "'");

                            string cons1 = oRec.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                            if (oRec.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Equals("0"))
                            {
                                string sProcedimiento = node.InnerText;
                                sProcedimiento = sProcedimiento.Replace("\r\n", " ");
                                oRec.DoQuery(sProcedimiento);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw e;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oUQ);
            }
        }
        public static void Insertar_Tabla(string strTabla, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRec = null;
            try
            {
                string strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Tablas.xml", strTabla, "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                oRec = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRec.DoQuery(strQuery.Trim());
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "Insertar_Tabla", sapCompany, sapApplication.Company);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRec);
            }
        }

        public static bool ActualizarInfoFallecidoAVisoSiniestro(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string idFallecido, string NroAvisoSiniestro)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool respuesta = false;
            string query = "";
            string IdFallecido = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "UPDATE  \"@OK1_SF_ASINIESTRO\" SET \"U_IdFallecido\" =" + idFallecido + "  WHERE \"DocEntry\" ='" + NroAvisoSiniestro + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT  \"U_IdFallecido\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ASINIESTRO\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" ='" + NroAvisoSiniestro + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    IdFallecido = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
                if (IdFallecido.Equals(idFallecido))
                    respuesta = true;
                else
                    respuesta = false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return respuesta;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Retorna servicios religiosos en un municipio.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="Hora"></param>
        /// <param name="municipio"></param>
        /// <param name="fecha"></param>
        /// <param name="iglesia"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <returns>existe</returns>
        public static bool ExisteServicioExequialProgramado(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string Hora, string municipio, string fecha, ref string iglesia, string docEntry, ref string docnum)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            bool existe = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = " SELECT \"U_Nombre\",\"DocNum\" FROM  \"@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD\" T1 INNER JOIN \"@OK1_SF_IGLESIAS\" T2 ON T1.\"U_ELugar\" = T2.\"Code\"";
                query = query + " Where \"U_EHora\"  ='" + Hora + "'"
                    + " AND \"U_EFecha\" = '" + fecha + "'"
                    + " AND \"U_EMuni\" = '" + municipio + "'"
                    + " AND \"U_ELugar\" = '" + iglesia + "'"
                     //+ " AND \"U_Estado\" <> '4'";
                     + " AND \"U_Estado\" NOT IN('3','4','6','8')";
                if (!docEntry.Equals(""))
                    query = query + " AND \"DocEntry\" <> '" + docEntry + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    iglesia = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    docnum = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    existe = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteServicioExequialProgramado", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Retorna si existe salas de velacion en el mismo dia ocupada
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="lugar"></param>
        /// <param name="sede"></param>
        /// <param name="sala"></param>
        /// <param name="fecha"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <returns>existe</returns>
        public static bool ExisteServicioVelacionProgramado(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string lugar, string sede, string fecha, string docEntry, string horaServicio, ref string docNum)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            bool existe = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = " SELECT \"DocNum\" FROM  \"@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD\"";
                query = query + " WHERE \"U_VLugar\"  ='" + lugar + "'"
                    + " AND \"U_VSede\" = '" + sede + "'"
                    //+ " AND \"U_Estado\" <> '4'" 
                    + " AND \"U_Estado\" NOT IN('3','4','6','8')"
                    + " AND \"U_VFecha\" = '" + fecha + "'"
                    + " AND \"U_SHora\" >" + horaServicio;

                if (!docEntry.Equals(""))
                    query = query + " AND \"DocEntry\" <> '" + docEntry + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    docNum = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    existe = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC_ExisteServicioVelacionProgramado", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Reordena el número de lineas despues de borrar
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="nomtabla"></param>
        /// <param name="matriz"></param>
        public static void NumerarLineasDespuesDeBorrar(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string nomtabla, string matriz)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(nomtabla);

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                for (int i = 0; i < dslineas.Size; i++)
                {
                    dslineas.SetValue("LineId", i, Convert.ToString(i + 1));

                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            { throw e; }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public void BuscarAvisoSiniestro(Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Application oApp)
        {
            string strFiltro = "";
            string strQuery = "";
            string dsFechaIniServ = "";
            string dsFechaFinServ = "";
            string strContrato = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNroCon").Value.ToString();
            string strSolicitud = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNroSol").Value.ToString();
            string strIdFall = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSIdFall").Value.ToString();
            string strNomFall = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNomFal").Value.ToString();
            string strIdPag = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSIdPag").Value.ToString();
            string strNomPag = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNomPag").Value.ToString();
            string strFecIni = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSFecIni").Value.ToString();
            string strFecFin = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSFecFin").Value.ToString();
            string strNroSiniestro = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNroAvi").Value.ToString();

            if (!strFecIni.Equals(""))
            {
                strFecIni = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(strFecIni), oApp);
                dsFechaIniServ = strFecIni;
                if (strFecFin.Equals(""))
                    dsFechaFinServ = strFecIni;
            }

            if (!strFecFin.Equals(""))
            {
                strFecFin = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(strFecFin), oApp);
                dsFechaFinServ = strFecFin;
                if (strFecIni.Equals(""))
                    dsFechaIniServ = strFecFin;
            }

            if (strContrato.Equals("") && strNroSiniestro.Equals("") && strSolicitud.Equals("") && strIdFall.Equals("") && strNomFall.Equals("") && strFecIni.Equals("") && strFecFin.Equals("") && strIdPag.Equals("") && strNomPag.Equals(""))
            {
                SBOApplication.SetStatusBarMessage("Al menos uno de los campos debe estar diligenciado.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, true);
            }
            else
            {
                strQuery = " SELECT   T1.\"DocEntry\" AS \"NroSiniestro\",";
                // strQuery += "T0.\"DocEntry\"   AS \"NroSolicitud\",";
                strQuery += "T0.\"DocEntry\"   AS \"NroSolicitud\",";
                strQuery += "\"U_IdFallec\"    AS \"Identificación Fallecido\",";
                strQuery += "\"U_NombreFa\"    AS \"Nombre Fallecido\", ";
                strQuery += "\"U_FechaFal\"    AS \"Fecha Fallecimiento\", ";
                strQuery += "\"U_IdContra\" AS \"Identificación Contratante\", ";
                strQuery += "\"U_NombreCo\" AS \"Nombre Contratante\",";
                strQuery += "\"U_FechaSol\" AS \"Fecha Solicitud\", ";
                strQuery += "  ( SELECT T3.\"Name\" ";
                strQuery += "  FROM   \"@OK1_SF_ESTLLAMADA\" T3";
                strQuery += "  WHERE  T3.\"Code\"= T0.\"U_Estado\") AS \"Estado\",";

                strQuery += "      (SELECT \"Name\" ";
                strQuery += "     FROM   \"@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO\" ";
                strQuery += "     WHERE  \"Code\"=\"U_TipoSrv\") AS \"Tipo Servicio\", ";
                strQuery += "(     SELECT \"Name\" ";
                strQuery += "    FROM   \"@OK1_SF_NIVELSERV\" ";
                strQuery += "    WHERE  \"Code\"=\"U_NivServ\") AS \"Nivel Servicio\" ";

                strQuery += "FROM \"@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD\" T0 INNER JOIN  \"@OK1_SF_ASINIESTRO\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" = T1.\"U_NumID\" ";
                strQuery += " WHERE T1.\"DocEntry\" IS NOT NULL";
                if (!strSolicitud.Equals(""))
                {
                    // strFiltro += " AND T0.\"DocEntry\" = '" + strSolicitud + "'";
                    strFiltro += " AND T0.\"DocEntry\" = '" + strSolicitud + "'";
                }
                if (!strNroSiniestro.Equals(""))
                {
                    strFiltro += " AND T1.\"DocEntry\" = '" + strNroSiniestro + "'";
                }
                if (!strContrato.Equals(""))
                {
                    strFiltro += " AND  \"U_NumContr\" = '" + strContrato + "'";
                }
                if (!strIdFall.Equals(""))
                {
                    strFiltro += " AND \"U_IdFallec\" = '" + strIdFall + "'";
                }
                if (!strIdFall.Equals(""))
                {
                    strFiltro += " AND \"U_IdFallecido\" = '" + strIdFall + "'";
                }
                if (!strNomFall.Equals(""))
                {
                    strFiltro += " AND \"U_NombreFa\" LIKE UPPER('%" + strNomFall + "%')";
                }
                if (!dsFechaIniServ.Equals(""))
                {
                    strFiltro += " AND \"U_FechaFal\" BETWEEN '" + dsFechaIniServ + "' AND '" + dsFechaFinServ + "'";
                }
                if (!strIdPag.Equals(""))
                {
                    if (!strIdPag.Contains("C"))
                        strIdPag = "C" + strIdPag;
                    strFiltro += " AND  \"U_IdContra\" = '" + strIdPag + "'";
                }
                if (!strNomPag.Equals(""))
                {
                    strFiltro += " AND \"U_NombreCo\" LIKE '%" + strNomPag + "%'";
                }
                strQuery += strFiltro;
                strQuery += " ORDER BY T0.\"DocEntry\"";

                oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_Grid").ExecuteQuery(strQuery);

                SAPbouiCOM.Grid oGRD = (SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_1").Specific;

                SAPbouiCOM.EditTextColumn oCol = (SAPbouiCOM.EditTextColumn)oGRD.Columns.Item("NroSiniestro");
                oCol.LinkedObjectType = "2";

                //SAPbouiCOM.EditTextColumn oColSS = (SAPbouiCOM.EditTextColumn)oGRD.Columns.Item("NroSolicitud");
                //oColSS.LinkedObjectType = "OK1_SF_LLAMADA";

                oGRD.Columns.Item(0).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(1).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(2).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(3).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(4).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(5).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(6).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(7).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(8).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(9).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(10).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
                oGRD.Columns.Item(10).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            }

        public void BuscarAvisoSiniestroSinSolicitudServicio(Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Application oApp)
        {
            string strFiltro = "";
            string strQuery = "";
            string dsFechaIniServ = "";
            string dsFechaFinServ = "";
            string strContrato = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNroCon").Value.ToString();
            string strSolicitud = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNroSol").Value.ToString();
            string strIdFall = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSIdFall").Value.ToString();
            string strNomFall = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNomFal").Value.ToString();
            string strIdPag = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSIdPag").Value.ToString();
            string strNomPag = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNomPag").Value.ToString();
            string strFecIni = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSFecIni").Value.ToString();
            string strFecFin = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSFecFin").Value.ToString();
            string strNroSiniestro = oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("DSNroAvi").Value.ToString();

            if (!strFecIni.Equals(""))
            {
                strFecIni = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(strFecIni), oApp);
                dsFechaIniServ = strFecIni;
                if (strFecFin.Equals(""))
                    dsFechaFinServ = strFecIni;
            }

            if (!strFecFin.Equals(""))
            {
                strFecFin = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(strFecFin), oApp);
                dsFechaFinServ = strFecFin;
                if (strFecIni.Equals(""))
                    dsFechaIniServ = strFecFin;
            }

            strQuery = "";
            strQuery = strQuery + "SELECT DISTINCT ";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	T2.\"DocEntry\"            AS \"NroSiniestro\", " + "\n";
            //strQuery = strQuery + "	''                     AS \"NroSolicitud\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	T0.\"DocNum\"              AS \"NroContrato\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	T1.\"U_numdoc\"          AS \"Identificación Fallecido\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	IFNULL(T1.\"U_nombre\",'') ||' '|| IFNULL(T1.\"U_snombre\",'') ||' '|| IFNULL(T1.\"U_pape\",'') ||' '|| IFNULL(T1.\"U_sape\",'') AS \"NombreFallecido\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	T1. \"U_fecSin\" AS \"Fecha Fallecimiento\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	T0. \"U_contrant\" AS \"Identificación Contratante\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	T0. \"U_ncontrat\" AS \"Nombre Contratante\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	'' AS \"Fecha Solicitud\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	T0.\"U_estado\"               AS \"Estado\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	'SERVICIO EXEQUIAL' AS \"Tipo Servicio\", " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "	''               AS \"Nivel Servicio\" " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "FROM \"@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD\" T0 " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "INNER JOIN \"@OK1_EXE_CONT_BENEFI\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" = T1.\"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "left JOIN \"@OK1_SF_ASINIESTRO\" T2  ON T1.\"U_numdoc\" = T2.\"U_IdFallecido\" " + "\n";
            strQuery = strQuery + "WHERE T1.\"DocEntry\" IS NOT NULL " + "\n";

            if (!strNroSiniestro.Equals(""))
            {
                strFiltro += " AND T2.\"DocEntry\" = '" + strNroSiniestro + "'";
            }
            if (!strIdFall.Equals(""))
            {
                strFiltro += " AND \"U_numdoc\" = '" + strIdFall + "'";
            }
            if (!strNomFall.Equals(""))
            {
                strFiltro = strFiltro + " AND T1.\"U_nombre\" ||' '|| T1.\"U_snombre\" ||' '|| T1.\"U_pape\" ||' '|| T1.\"U_sape\" LIKE UPPER('%" + strNomFall + "%') " + "\n";
            }
            if (!dsFechaIniServ.Equals(""))
            {
                strFiltro += " AND \"U_fecSin\" BETWEEN '" + dsFechaIniServ + "' AND '" + dsFechaFinServ + "'";
            }
            strFiltro = strFiltro + " AND IFNULL(T1.\"U_fecSin\", '') <> '' " + "\n";
            strFiltro = strFiltro + "AND IFNULL(T1.\"U_numSolicitud\",'') ='' " + "\n";
            strFiltro = strFiltro + "AND T0.\"U_estado\" = 'ACT' " + "\n";

            strQuery += strFiltro;
            strQuery += " ORDER BY T2.\"DocEntry\"";

            oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_Grid").ExecuteQuery(strQuery);
            SAPbouiCOM.Grid oGRD = (SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_1").Specific;

            SAPbouiCOM.EditTextColumn oCol = (SAPbouiCOM.EditTextColumn)oGRD.Columns.Item("NroSiniestro");
            oCol.LinkedObjectType = "2";

            //SAPbouiCOM.EditTextColumn oColC = (SAPbouiCOM.EditTextColumn)oGRD.Columns.Item("NroContrato");
            //oColC.LinkedObjectType = "EXE_CONTRATO";

            oGRD.Columns.Item(0).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(1).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(2).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(3).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(4).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(5).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(6).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(7).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(8).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(9).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(10).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
            oGRD.Columns.Item(10).TitleObject.Sortable = true;
        }
        public void cancelarOrden(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, Form oForm, int fila)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
            SAPbobsCOM.Documents oOrden = null;
            oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
            try
            {
                if ((fila >= 0) && (fila <= oMatrix.RowCount))
                {
                    string docOrden = oDBS.GetValue("U_docOrd", fila - 1).Trim();
                    string docEntry = oDBS.GetValue("DocEntry", fila - 1).Trim();
                    if (docEntry.Equals(""))
                        docEntry = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString();



                    if (!docOrden.Equals(""))
                    {
                        oOrden = (Documents)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oPurchaseOrders);  // orden Compra
                        oOrden.GetByKey(int.Parse(docOrden));

                        string DocNumOC = oOrden.DocNum.ToString();
                        oOrden.Comments = "Se cancela la orden Nro." + DocNumOC + " [" + docOrden + "]. Cancelado por el servicio Funerario. N°: " + docEntry;

                        //string lineID = oDBS.GetValue("LineId", fila - 1).Trim();
                        string lineID = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim();
                        // if (lineID.Equals(""))
                        //     lineID = ServicioFunerario.RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos(SBOCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString(), fila);

                        if (!docEntry.Equals("") && !lineID.Equals(""))
                        {
                            string itemCode = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            string elemento = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            string tipoOrden = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_tipOrd").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            string idsocio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_4").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;

                            #region solucion error basado en  contrato activo antyerior con documentos asociados a esa orden
                            string tiposolicitud = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("19").Specific).Value.ToString();
                            string DocEntryAnterior = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.ToString();

                            if (tiposolicitud.Equals("B"))
                            {
                                bool esCotización = esCotizaciónContratoOSFAnterior(sapCompany, sapApplication, DocEntryAnterior, strPath);
                                if (!esCotización)
                                    docEntry = DocEntryAnterior;
                            }
                            #endregion

                            string strDocNumOrdenCompra = "";
                            bool existeOrdenCompra = ExisteOrdenCompra(SBOCompany, docEntry, lineID, itemCode, idsocio, ref strDocNumOrdenCompra);

                            if (existeOrdenCompra && oMatrix.IsRowSelected(fila))
                            {
                                int exito = oOrden.Cancel();
                                if (exito != 0)
                                {
                                    SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la orden. Error: " + SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "OK", "", "");
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                    {
                                        if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_docOrd", i - 1).Trim().Equals(docOrden))
                                        {
                                            lineID = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", i - 1).Trim();
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_ordCom", i - 1, "NO");
                                            oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_docOrd", i - 1, "");

                                            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                                            string query = "UPDATE \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" SET \"U_ordCom\" = 'NO',\"U_docOrd\" = '' WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString() + " AND \"U_IdLinea\" = " + lineID + "";
                                            oRS.DoQuery(query);
                                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                                        }
                                    }
                                    oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();

                                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);

                                    string AsientosProvisionCancelados = string.Empty;

                                    for (int i = 0; i <= oOrden.Lines.Count - 1; i++)
                                    {
                                        oOrden.Lines.SetCurrentLine(i);

                                        string TransIDProvision = oOrden.Lines.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Provision").Value.ToString();

                                        if (!TransIDProvision.Equals("0") && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TransIDProvision))
                                        {
                                            if (CancelarAsientoProvision(SBOCompany, TransIDProvision))
                                            {
                                                AsientosProvisionCancelados += TransIDProvision + ",";
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(AsientosProvisionCancelados))
                                    {
                                        AsientosProvisionCancelados = AsientosProvisionCancelados.Remove(AsientosProvisionCancelados.Length - 1);
                                        sapApplication.MessageBox(" Se cancela el asiento de provision con TransID : " + AsientosProvisionCancelados, 1, "OK", "", "");
                                    }

                                    SBOApplication.MessageBox(" Se cancela la orden Nro. " + DocNumOC + " [ " + docOrden + " ]. ", 1, "OK", "", "");
                                }
                            }
                            else
                                SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la orden : " + DocNumOC);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC030", SBOCompany);

            }
            finally
            {
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Verifica si existe un socio de negocio.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="CardCode"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        /// <summary>
        /// Verifica si existe un socio de negocio.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="CardCode"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool existe_socio(string CardCode, ref int tipoDocumento, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, bool validaTitular, ref bool existeTitular)
        {
            bool bandera = false;
            string substr;
            substr = CardCode.Substring(0, 1);

            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset orsTitu = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                if (substr == "C")
                {
                    ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"CardName\",\"U_BPCO_TDC\" FROM OCRD WHERE \"CardCode\" = '" + CardCode + "'");
                }
                else
                {
                    CardCode = "C" + CardCode;
                    ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"CardName\",\"U_BPCO_TDC\" FROM OCRD WHERE \"CardCode\" = '" + CardCode + "'");
                }


                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    bandera = true;
                    tipoDocumento = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                }
                else
                {
                    if (validaTitular)
                    {
                        string setupValue = SETUP_RULE("NOGUARDARSN", ocmp);
                        if (setupValue.Equals("Y"))
                        {
                            CardCode = CardCode.Remove(0, 1);
                            orsTitu.DoQuery("SELECT (\"U_papell\" || ' ' || \"U_sapell\" || ' ' || \"U_pnom\"  || ' ' || \"U_snom\") \"CardName\",\"U_tipoDoc\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_TITUBENF\" WHERE \"Code\" = '" + CardCode + "'");
                            if (orsTitu.RecordCount > 0)
                            {
                                existeTitular = true;
                                tipoDocumento = Convert.ToInt32(orsTitu.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(orsTitu);
                ors = null;
                orsTitu = null;
            }
            return bandera;
        }
        public object devolverEstadoDimension(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string dimCode)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string valor = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"DimActive\" FROM \"ODIM\" WHERE \"DimCode\" ='" + dimCode + "'");
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    valor = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return valor;
        }
        public void crearIglesia(Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCmpServ = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService oGS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData oGD = null;

            try
            {
                string sIglesia = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_1").Specific).Value;
                string sSede = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_0").Specific).Value;
                string sDep = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_7").Specific).Value;
                string sMunicipio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_4").Specific).Value;
                string sDir = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_10").Specific).Value;
                string sNit = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_11").Specific).Value;
                string sql = "SELECT CAST(IFNULL (MAX (substr(\"Code\",5)),0) + 1 AS NVARCHAR(8))  FROM \"@OK1_SF_IGLESIAS\"";
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS.DoQuery(sql);
                string i = oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                string tempCode = "";
                for (int aux = 0; aux < 4 - i.Length; aux++)
                {
                    tempCode += "0";
                }
                tempCode += i;
                tempCode = "IGLE" + tempCode;



                oCmpServ = SBOCompany.GetCompanyService();
                oGS = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService)oCmpServ.GetGeneralService("OK1_SF_IGLESIAS");
                oGD = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData)oGS.GetDataInterface(SAPbobsCOM.GeneralServiceDataInterfaces.gsGeneralData);

                oGD.SetProperty("Code", tempCode);
                oGD.SetProperty("Name", tempCode);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Nombre", sIglesia);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_sede", sSede);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_dep", sDep);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Munic", sMunicipio);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_dir", sDir);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Prov", sNit);
                oGS.Add(oGD);


                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("La Iglesia se ha creado satisfactoriamente.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                oForm.Close();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
                SBOApplication.MessageBox("La Iglesia no se ha creado satisfactoriamente.", 1, "OK", "", "");
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oGS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oGD);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oCmpServ);
            }

        }

        public void crearCementerioHorno(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application SapApplication)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCmpServ = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService oGS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData oGD = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.OptionBtn obtn;
            string sql = "";
            string prefijo = "";

            try
            {
                string nit = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("ET_Nit").Specific).Value;
                string sNombre = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_1").Specific).Value;
                string sDepto = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_10").Specific).Value;
                string sMunicipio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_3").Specific).Value;
                string sDir = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("Item_12").Specific).Value;
                string sBoveda = "N";
                string sCampo = "N";
                string sLote = "N";
                string sLoteFamiliar = "N";
                string sOsario = "N";
                string sColumbario = "N";
                string sMausoleo = "N";
                string sCenizario = "N";

                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_4").Specific).Checked) sBoveda = "Y";
                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_5").Specific).Checked) sCampo = "Y";
                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_6").Specific).Checked) sLote = "Y";
                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_8").Specific).Checked) sLoteFamiliar = "Y";

                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_13").Specific).Checked) sOsario = "Y";
                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_14").Specific).Checked) sColumbario = "Y";
                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_15").Specific).Checked) sMausoleo = "Y";
                if (((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("Item_16").Specific).Checked) sCenizario = "Y";

                obtn = (SAPbouiCOM.OptionBtn)oForm.Items.Item("3").Specific;
                if (obtn.Selected)
                {
                    prefijo = "CEM";
                }

                obtn = (SAPbouiCOM.OptionBtn)oForm.Items.Item("4").Specific;
                if (obtn.Selected)
                {
                    prefijo = "HOR";
                }

                sql = "SELECT  CAST(IFNULL (MAX (substr(\"Code\",4,LENGTH(\"Code\"))),0) AS NVARCHAR(8)) FROM \"@OK1_SF_CEMENTERIOS\" WHERE substr(\"Code\",0,3) = '" + prefijo + "'";
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS.DoQuery(sql);

                string i = oRS.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                string tempCode = "";
                i = "" + (Convert.ToInt32(i) + 1);

                for (int aux = 0; aux < 3 - i.Length; aux++)
                {
                    tempCode += "0";
                }
                tempCode = tempCode + i;
                tempCode = prefijo + tempCode;



                oCmpServ = SBOCompany.GetCompanyService();
                oGS = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService)oCmpServ.GetGeneralService("OK1_SF_CEMENTERIO");
                oGD = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData)oGS.GetDataInterface(SAPbobsCOM.GeneralServiceDataInterfaces.gsGeneralData);

                oGD.SetProperty("Code", tempCode);
                oGD.SetProperty("Name", sNombre);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Nro_Nit", nit);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_dep", sDepto);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Munic", sMunicipio);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_dir", sDir);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Boveda", sBoveda);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Campo_Cremacion", sCampo);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Lote", sLote);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_LoteFamiliar", sLoteFamiliar);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Osario", sOsario);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Columbario", sColumbario);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Mausoleo", sMausoleo);
                oGD.SetProperty("U_Cenizario", sCenizario);

                oGS.Add(oGD);

                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El registro se ha creado satisfactoriamente.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                #region Enviar alerta
                bool exitoAlerta = ServicioFunerario.GenerarAlertaCreacionCementerio(SapCompany, SapApplication, oForm, nit);
                if (exitoAlerta)
                    SapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" se envio alerta de modificacion  de creacion de cementerio", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                oForm.Close();
                #endregion
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
                SBOApplication.MessageBox("El registro no se ha creado satisfactoriamente.", 1, "OK", "", "");
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRS);
            }

        }
        public static void obtenerInfoSocioNegocio(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string idcontratante, ref string cedula, ref string barrio, ref string tipoVivienda, ref string nombre)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string primerApellido = "";
            string segundoApellido = "";

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT \"LicTradNum\",\"U_Barrio\",\"U_tipoviv\",\"U_BPCO_Nombre\",\"U_BPCO_1Apellido\", \"U_BPCO_2Apellido\" FROM  OCRD WHERE \"CardCode\" = '" + idcontratante + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    cedula = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    barrio = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    tipoVivienda = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    nombre = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    primerApellido = ors.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    segundoApellido = ors.Fields.Item(5).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    nombre = nombre + " " + primerApellido + " " + segundoApellido;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ON_obtenerInfoSocioNegocio", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }
        public static double RetornarTotalIngresosCoDeudor(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, Form oFormSC, int index)
        {
            double total = 0;
            double valorIngreso = 0;
            double valorSueldo = 0;
            string strValorIngreso = "";
            string strValorSueldo = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;

            oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oFormSC.Items.Item("mtx_1").Specific;
            oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

            strValorIngreso = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_9").Cells.Item(1).Specific).Value;
            strValorSueldo = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_10").Cells.Item(1).Specific).Value;

            valorIngreso = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, strValorIngreso);
            valorSueldo = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, strValorSueldo);
            try
            {
                total = ObtenerSumaTotal(valorIngreso, valorSueldo);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
            }
            return total;
        }

        public bool validarCamposCarencia(Form oForm)
        {
            string fechaFall, horaFall, causaFall;
            bool error = false;

            fechaFall = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("49").Specific).Value;
            horaFall = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("51").Specific).Value; //se toma del Edit ya que el DS borra el cero inicial cuando la hora es de un solo digito
            causaFall = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("59").Specific).Value;

            if (fechaFall.Equals("") || horaFall.Equals("") || causaFall.Equals(""))
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Los campos fecha de fallecimiento, hora de fallecimiento y causa de fallecimiento son necesarios para validar carencias.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                error = true;
            }

            return error;
        }
        public static bool llenar_valores_validos_columna_Grid(SAPbouiCOM.Column ocl, string Query, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool bandera = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(Query);
                int Count = ocl.ValidValues.Count;
                for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
                {
                    ocl.ValidValues.Remove(ocl.ValidValues.Count - 1, SAPbouiCOM.BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
                }
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        ocl.ValidValues.Add(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString(), ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }
                    bandera = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return bandera;
        }

        public static string RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntry, int indice)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string LineId = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                // query = "SELECT \"LineId\" FROM (select  \"LineId\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "'" + " ORDER BY \"LineId\"  LIMIT " + indice.ToString().Trim() + ") ";
                query = "SELECT \"LineId\" FROM (select  \"LineId\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "'" + " ORDER BY \"LineId\"  LIMIT " + indice.ToString().Trim() + ") ";
                query = query + " ORDER BY \"LineId\" DESC LIMIT 1 ";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    LineId = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return LineId;
        }
        public static string RetornarMaxLineId(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntry)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            string query = "";
            string LineId = "";
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                if (!DocEntry.Equals(string.Empty))
                {

                    query = "SELECT MAX(\"U_IdLinea\") FROM \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "'";
                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        LineId = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                    LineId = Convert.ToString(oMatrix.RowCount);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return LineId;
        }

        public static void BloquearCeldasComentarios(string matriz, string columna, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm)
        {
            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;
                #region Bloquear lineas comentarios
                try
                {
                    omtx.Columns.Item("colum_5").Editable = true;
                    omtx.Columns.Item(columna).Editable = true;
                }
                catch { }


                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < omtx.RowCount; i1++)
                {
                    string comentario = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item(columna).Cells.Item(i1 + 1).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(comentario))
                    {
                        SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = omtx.CommonSetting;
                        try
                        {
                            setting.SetRowEditable(i1 + 1, false);
                        }
                        catch { }
                    }
                }

                #endregion
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                string Error = e.ToString();
            }


        }

        public static void UsuarioFechaMatrizComentarios(string matriz, string columnaFecha, string columnausuario, int pVal, string tabla, string dsFecha, string dsuser, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, bool combo = false)
        {
            try
            {
                string usuario = "";
                string usr = "";
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item(matriz).Specific;
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                int fila = pVal - 1;//No. de fila en el dbdatasource
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                string Fecha = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item(columnaFecha).Cells.Item(pVal).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                if (combo)
                {
                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oComboBox = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item(columnausuario).Cells.Item(pVal).Specific;
                    usuario = oComboBox.Value;
                    usr = sapCompany.UserSignature.ToString();
                }
                else
                {
                    usuario = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item(columnausuario).Cells.Item(pVal).Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    usr = sapCompany.UserName;
                }
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Fecha) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(usuario))
                {
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(tabla).SetValue(dsuser, fila, usr);
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(tabla).SetValue(dsFecha, fila, OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(DateTime.Now, sapApplication));
                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item(tabla).SetValue("U_hora", fila, DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm"));

                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();

            }
            catch
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }

        }

        public static string RetornarMaxLineIdForm(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntry, double lineaIdUlt)
        {
            XmlDocument xmlDoc = new XmlDocument();
            XmlNodeList xmlFilas = null;
            string strDTXML = string.Empty;
            Matrix netMatrix = null; ;
            StringReader strReader;
            string LineId = "";
            int intLineId = 0;
            int mayor = 0;
            int temporalMayor = 0;

            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                strDTXML = oMatrix.SerializeAsXML(BoMatrixXmlSelect.mxs_All);
                xmlDoc.LoadXml(strDTXML);

                System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer(typeof(Matrix));
                xmlFilas = xmlDoc.GetElementsByTagName("Row");
                strReader = new StringReader(strDTXML);
                netMatrix = (Matrix)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(strReader);

                int fila = 0;

                LineId = netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[41].Value.ToString();  //36


                try
                {
                    mayor = Convert.ToInt32(LineId);
                }
                catch { mayor = 0; }

                foreach (XmlElement item in xmlFilas)
                {
                    LineId = netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[41].Value.ToString();  //36
                    try
                    {
                        temporalMayor = Convert.ToInt32(LineId);
                    }
                    catch { mayor = 0; }

                    if (temporalMayor > mayor)
                        mayor = temporalMayor;

                    fila++;
                }
                LineId = (mayor + 1).ToString();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos", ocmp);
            }
            return LineId;
        }

        public static string old_RetornarMaxLineIdForm(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntry, double lineaIdUlt)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            string query = "";
            string LineId = "";
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                if (!DocEntry.Equals(string.Empty))
                {
                    LineId = (lineaIdUlt + 1).ToString();
                }
                else
                {
                    oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                    LineId = Convert.ToString(oMatrix.RowCount);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return LineId;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// actualizar  en contrato cuando se hace cambio TipoServicioConvenio.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public static void ActualizarContratoCambioTipoServicioConvenio(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";

            try
            {
                string idFallecido, NroContrato, docEntry;

                idFallecido = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("43").Specific).Value;
                NroContrato = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("35").Specific).Value.Trim();

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT  \"DocEntry\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocNum\" = '" + NroContrato + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    docEntry = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    if (!docEntry.Equals(""))
                    {
                        ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                        query = " UPDATE  \"@OK1_EXE_CONT_BENEFI\" SET \"U_numSolicitud\" = '' WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + docEntry + "' AND  \"U_numdoc\" = '" + idFallecido + "'";
                        ors.DoQuery(query);
                    }
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ActualizarContratoCambioTipoServicioConvenio", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }
