        public string alertaCobroSaldo(Form oForm)
        {
            string mensaje = "";
            string cobroSaldo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_cobSaldo", 0).Trim();
            string idContratante = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim();
            string idFallecido = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdFallec", 0).Trim();
            string tipoServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim();
            int prevision = (int)ServicioFunerario.TipoServicio.Prevision;
            string parentesco = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Parentes", 0).Trim();


            switch (cobroSaldo)
            {
                case "T":
                    if (idContratante.Contains(idFallecido.Trim()) && tipoServicio.Equals(prevision.ToString()))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Aplica cobro de saldo por muerte del pagador titular.";
                    }
                    break;
                case "B":
                    if ((!parentesco.Equals("0")) && tipoServicio.Equals(prevision.ToString()))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Aplica cobro de saldo por muerte de beneficiario.";
                    }
                    break;
                case "A":
                    if (tipoServicio.Equals(prevision.ToString()))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Aplica cobro de saldo.";
                    }
                    break;
            }

            return mensaje;
        }
        public void calcularConsolidadoSaldoFinVigencia(Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string cardCode = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim();
            int prevision = (int)ServicioFunerario.TipoServicio.Prevision;
            string tipoServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim();
            string numContrato = "";
            double ValorConsolidado = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.ProgressBar objProgressBar = null;
            string sPrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", SBOCompany);

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                if (tipoServicio.Equals(prevision.ToString()))
                {

                    ors.DoQuery(cons.getQueryContratosActivos(cardCode, false, sPrenecFin));

                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        objProgressBar = SBOApplication.StatusBar.CreateProgressBar("Consolidando Saldo...", ors.RecordCount, false);

                        while (!ors.EoF)
                        {
                            numContrato = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                            ValorConsolidado = ValorConsolidado + CargarSaldoFinVigenciaContrato(numContrato);
                            objProgressBar.Value++;
                            ors.MoveNext();
                        }
                        objProgressBar.Stop();
                    }

                    oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_SaldFVigCons", 0, OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, ValorConsolidado, false, "", -1));

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(objProgressBar);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);

            }
        }

        public void actualizarElementos(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref Boolean exitoActualizacion, ref bool calcularPrecios, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string Strpath, bool OmitirValidacion = false)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos = null;
            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("EdNivS").Specific;
            string idSolicitud = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim();
            string estado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim();
            SAPbouiCOM.ProgressBar objProgressBar = null;
            string idContrato = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("35").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(ocmp, sapApplication);
            string prenec = serfun.DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), ocmp);
            string PrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", ocmp);
            string planModificado = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_CodPlanAnt", 0).Trim();

            try
            {

                if (OmitirValidacion || SBOApplication.MessageBox("Se van actualizar los elementos.\n" + " ¿ Está seguro que desea continuar?", 2, "Aceptar", "Cancelar", "") == 1)
                {
                    if (estado.Equals("1"))
                    {
                        //ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                        //ors.DoQuery(cons.getQueryDocumentos(idSolicitud, strPath).ToString());

                        //if (ors.RecordCount == 0)
                        int fila = 0;
                        string mensaje = "";
                        if (planModificado.Equals(""))
                        {
                            if (!ServicioFunerario.existen_DocumentosCreadosOS(oForm, SBOCompany, ref mensaje, ref fila))
                            {
                                oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                                oMatrixElementos.Clear();
                                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                                objProgressBar = SBOApplication.StatusBar.CreateProgressBar("Cargando Elementos...", 1, false);
                                if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
                                {
                                    if (PrenecFin.Equals("Y"))
                                    {
                                        cargarElementosPrenecFinc(oForm, PrenecFin, ocmp, Strpath, sapApplication);
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                    cargarElementos(oForm, ocmp, ref calcularPrecios);
                                objProgressBar.Value++;
                                objProgressBar.Stop();
                                exitoActualizacion = true;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (mensaje.Equals("USO"))
                                    mensaje = "La solicitud ya tiene documentos creados. Existe un uso registrado en la Fila " + Convert.ToString(fila) + " de la tabla de elementos del servicio";
                                else if (mensaje.Equals("RENUNCIA"))
                                    mensaje = "La solicitud ya tiene documentos creados. Existe una renuncia registrada en la Fila " + Convert.ToString(fila) + " de la tabla de elementos del servicio";
                                else
                                    mensaje = "La solicitud ya tiene documentos creados. Existe un documento creado " + mensaje + " en la Fila " + Convert.ToString(fila) + " de la tabla de elementos del servicio";


                                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (!oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_CodPlan", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                            {

                                if (!oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim().Equals("1") && !oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim().Equals("5"))
                                {
                                    objProgressBar = SBOApplication.StatusBar.CreateProgressBar("Cargando Elementos...", 1, false);
                                    cargarElementosCambioPlan(oForm, ocmp, Strpath, ref calcularPrecios);

                                    objProgressBar.Value++;
                                    objProgressBar.Stop();

                                    exitoActualizacion = true;
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                SBOApplication.MessageBox("El plan no puede estar vacío.");
                                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El plan no puede estar vacío.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            }

                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Solo se puede actualizar lineas de los elementos en estado activo.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    }
                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(objProgressBar);

            }
        }

        public static int RetornarEdad(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string U_FechaNac, string U_FechaFal)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            int edad = 0;
            string query = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = "SELECT  FLOOR((FLOOR(DAYS_BETWEEN('" + U_FechaNac + "','" + U_FechaFal + "')) - FLOOR((DAYS_BETWEEN('" + U_FechaNac + "','" + U_FechaFal + "')/365 )/4))/365)   \"Edad\"  FROM  DUMMY ";
                ors.DoQuery(query);

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    edad = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim());
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarEdad", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return edad;
        }
        public static string ConsultarFieldID(string Alias, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            string query = "";
            string valor = "";

            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                query = "SELECT \"FieldID\" FROM CUFD WHERE \"TableID\" = '@OK1_SF_ASINIESTRO' AND \"AliasID\" = '" + Alias + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    valor = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                ors = null;
            }

            return "ritc_" + valor;
        }

        public static bool ExisteSalidaMercancia(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string docEntrysolicitudServicio, string lineID, string itemCode, ref string DocNumSalidaMercancia)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool existe = false;
            string strQuery = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = strQuery + " SELECT T0.\"DocNum\" as \"DocNum\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " FROM \"OIGE\" T0 " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " INNER JOIN \"IGE1\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" = T1.\"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " WHERE T0.\"U_OK1_SF_NSOL\" = '" + docEntrysolicitudServicio + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T1.\"U_linea\" ='" + lineID + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T1.\"ItemCode\" ='" + itemCode + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T0.\"U_esDerecho\" ='N'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND T0.\"DocEntry\" NOT IN " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " ( " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " SELECT  T0.\"U_OK1_SF_EntrySM\" as \"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " FROM \"OIGN\" T0 INNER JOIN \"IGN1\" T1 ON T0.\"DocEntry\" =  T1.\"DocEntry\" " + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " WHERE  T0.\"U_OK1_SF_NSOL\" = '" + docEntrysolicitudServicio + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   T1.\"U_linea\" ='" + lineID + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   T1.\"ItemCode\" ='" + itemCode + "'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   T0.\"U_esDerecho\" ='N'" + "\n";
                strQuery = strQuery + " AND   IFNULL(T0.\"U_OK1_SF_EntrySM\",'') <> '')";
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    existe = true;
                    DocNumSalidaMercancia = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteSalidaMercancia", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }

        public static string RetornarCodeTipoDocumento(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string Name)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string Code = "";
            string Query = "";
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                Query = "SELECT \"Code\" FROM \"@BPCO_TD\" WHERE \"Name\" ='" + Name + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(Query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    Code = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarCodeTipoDocumento", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return Code;
        }
        public static string RetornarCodeParentesco(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string Name)

            {

            }

        }

        public static bool PuedeHabilitarEstado(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string codEstado)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string Code = "";
            string Query = "";
            bool habilita = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                Query = " SELECT IFNULL(T1.\"U_Estado\",'') FROM \"@OK1_SF_ESTLLAMADA\" T0 INNER JOIN \"@OK1_SF_PERMISOSEST\" T1 ON T0.\"Code\" = T1.\"U_Estado\" ";
                Query = Query + " INNER JOIN \"@OK1_SF_PERMISOS\" T2 ON T1.\"Code\" = T2.\"Code\" WHERE  T2.\"U_Usuario\" = '" + sapCompany.UserSignature + "' ";
                Query = Query + " AND T1.\"U_Estado\" = '" + codEstado + "' ";
                ors.DoQuery(Query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    habilita = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC-RetornarSerie", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return habilita;
        }
        public static string MensajeArticulosComprometidos(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string itemCode, string strPath, string itemName, string docEntry, string Almacen)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string strQuery = "";
            string mensaje = "";
            string nroSolicitud = "";
            //string Almacen = "";
            string CantSolicitada = "";
            string Pedido = "";
            string Stock = "";
            string Comprometido = "";

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ArticulosComprometidosOrdenServicio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%itemCode%", itemCode);
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docEntry%", docEntry);
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Almacen%", Almacen);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    mensaje = " Los siguientes ordenes de servicio tienen comprometido el articulo: " + " \n";
                    mensaje = mensaje + "                                                            " + " \n";
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        nroSolicitud = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        Almacen = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        CantSolicitada = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        Pedido = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        Stock = ors.Fields.Item(4).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        Comprometido = ors.Fields.Item(5).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        mensaje = mensaje + " Servicio: " + nroSolicitud + " Almacen : " + Almacen + " CantSolicitada: " + CantSolicitada + " Pedido: " + Pedido + " Stock: " + Stock + " Comprometido: " + Comprometido + "\n";
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }
                    mensaje = mensaje + "                                                            " + " \n";
                    mensaje = mensaje + " " + itemName + ". \n";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC_MensajeArticulosComprometidos", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return mensaje;
        }

        public static void inhabilitarFilasFacturadas(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string Factura = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = omtx.CommonSetting;
                while (indice < tope)
                {
                    Factura = oDBS1.GetValue("U_seFactu", indice).Trim();
                    if (Factura.Equals("SI"))
                    {
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 21, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 17, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 16, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 15, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 4, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 21, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 17, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 16, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 15, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 4, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, true);
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static void inhabilitarCeldasOrdenesCS(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {

        public static void inhabilitarCeldaFilasSalidaMercancia(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string SalidaMercancia = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = omtx.CommonSetting;
                while (indice < tope)
                {
                    SalidaMercancia = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", indice).Trim();
                    if (!SalidaMercancia.Equals(""))
                    {
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, true);
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
                omtx.LoadFromDataSource();
            }
            catch { }
            finally { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static void inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos_old(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            bool Facturas = false;
            bool ordenCompra = false;
            bool salidaMercancia = false;
            int opcion = 0;
            string Factura = "";
            string orden = "";
            string DocumentoOrden = "";
            string SalidaMercancia = "";
            string confirmarCofre = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = omtx.CommonSetting;
                while (indice < tope)
                {
                    Factura = oDBS1.GetValue("U_seFactu", indice).Trim();
                    orden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ordCom", indice).Trim();
                    DocumentoOrden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docOrd", indice).Trim();
                    SalidaMercancia = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", indice).Trim();
                    confirmarCofre = oDBS1.GetValue("U_confirmCofre", indice).Trim();
                    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    if (Factura.Equals("SI"))
                        Facturas = true;
                    if (orden.Equals("SI"))
                        ordenCompra = true;
                    if (!SalidaMercancia.Equals(""))
                        salidaMercancia = true;
                    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    if (Facturas == true && ordenCompra == true && salidaMercancia == true)
                        opcion = 1;
                    else
                        if (Facturas == true && ordenCompra == true)
                        opcion = 2;
                    else
                            if (Facturas == true && salidaMercancia == true)
                        opcion = 3;
                    else
                                if (ordenCompra == true && salidaMercancia == true)
                        opcion = 4;
                    else
                                    if (ordenCompra == true && Facturas == false && salidaMercancia == false)
                        opcion = 5;
                    else
                                        if (Facturas == true && ordenCompra == false && salidaMercancia == false)
                        opcion = 6;
                    else
                                            if (salidaMercancia == true && ordenCompra == false && Facturas == false)
                        opcion = 7;
                    else
                                                if (confirmarCofre.Equals("Y"))
                        opcion = 8;
                    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    //habilitar todos
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 21, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 17, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 16, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 15, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 14, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 12, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 4, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, true);
                    //omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, true);
                    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------

                    switch (opcion)
                    {

                        case 1: // deshabilitar todos
                        case 2: // deshabilitar Facturas - Ordenes de Compra
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 56, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 23, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 19, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 18, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 17, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 16, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 15, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 13, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 4, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                            break;
                        case 3: //deshabilitar Facturas  y Salida Mercancia 
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 56, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 23, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 19, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 18, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 17, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 16, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 4, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                            break;
                        case 4:  //deshabilitar orden de compra y salida de mercancia
                        case 5: //deshabilitar Orden Compra
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 15, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 13, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 4, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 3, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                            break;
                        case 6: // deshabilitar Facturas 
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 56, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 23, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 19, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 18, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 17, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 16, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 12, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 4, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                            break;
                        case 7:  // deshabilitar Salida Mercancia 
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                            break;
                        case 8:  // deshabilitar Confirmar Cofre 
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                            omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                            break;
                    }

                    Facturas = false;
                    ordenCompra = false;
                    salidaMercancia = false;
                    opcion = 0;

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch { oForm.Freeze(false); }
            finally { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public static void RefrescarFormaCambiarEstado(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string strPath)
        {
            string tituloForm = "Solicitud de Servicio Funerario";
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication);
            serfun.StrPath = strPath;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo;
            Consultas cons = new Consultas(sapCompany, sapApplication); ;
            int prevision = 0;

            ((SAPbouiCOM.Item)oForm.Items.Item("tab_1")).Click();
            oForm.Items.Item("94").Enabled = false;

            #region  Habilitar Estado 5, 6,7
            //si el estado de la solicitud es cerrado o negado cerrado se deshabilita el botón crear/modificar
            //ya que este estado no permite cambios
            if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim().Equals("5") || oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim().Equals("7"))
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("1").Enabled = false;
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("La solicitud se encuentra en un estado que no permite modificaciones.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

            }
            if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim().Equals("6"))
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("1").Enabled = true;
                //oForm.Items.Item("131").Visible = true;
                //oForm.Items.Item("131").Enabled = true;
            }
            else
                oForm.Items.Item("1").Enabled = true;
            #endregion

            //en cualquier caso se deshabilita el combobox de contrato
            oForm.Items.Item("35").Enabled = false;

            #region verificar si el status de la solicitud es pendiente de aprobación por proceso de autorizacion
            //verificar si el status de la solicitud es P (pendiente de aprobación por proceso de autorizacion)
            //en este caso se deshabilita el botón crear/modificar
            if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("Status", 0).Trim().Equals("P"))
            {
                oForm.Title = tituloForm + "  [Autorización Pendiente]";
                oForm.Items.Item("1").Enabled = false;
                //Deshabilitar los botones de creación de documentos (Orden Compra, Salida Mcia, Fact Cliente)
                oForm.Items.Item("96").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("97").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("107").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("126").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = false;
            }
            else
            {
                oForm.Title = tituloForm;
                oForm.Items.Item("96").Enabled = true;
                oForm.Items.Item("97").Enabled = true;
                oForm.Items.Item("107").Enabled = true;
                oForm.Items.Item("126").Enabled = true;
                //  oForm.Items.Item("131").Enabled = true; //CAB NEGAR 15-12-2020 
                oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = true;
            }
            #endregion
            #region habilitar los checks de reembolso y genera comision en la pestaña de auxilios,
            //habilitar los checks de reembolso y genera comision en la pestaña de auxilios,
            //si el form esta en modo actualizar (por defecto vienen deshabilitados para que al
            //momento de elegir 'genera comisión' se llame al procedimiento de autorización en el
            //evento form_data_update
            if (!oForm.Items.Item("91").Enabled)
            { oForm.Items.Item("91").Enabled = true; }
            if (!oForm.Items.Item("90").Enabled)
            { oForm.Items.Item("90").Enabled = true; }
            #endregion
            #region deshabilitar campos DocNum, DocEntry, Tipo servicio
            //deshabilitar campos DocNum, DocEntry, Tipo servicio
            oForm.Items.Item("5").Enabled = false;
            oForm.Items.Item("99").Enabled = false;
            oForm.Items.Item("80").Enabled = false;
            oForm.Items.Item("EdTipP").Enabled = false;
            oForm.Items.Item("EdNivS").Enabled = false;
            #endregion
            #region deshabilitar escritura en campo Identificación fallecido si el servicio es de prevision
            //deshabilitar escritura en campo Identificación fallecido si el servicio es de prevision
            prevision = (int)ServicioFunerario.TipoServicio.Prevision;
            if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim().Equals(prevision.ToString()))
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("43").Enabled = false;
            }
            else
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("43").Enabled = true;
            }
            #endregion


            #region habilitar campos AplicaVariosProveedores
            //FRC 20140425 Se instancia la matriz y se pone la columna editable
            oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("EdTipP").Specific;
            if (!oCombo.Value.Equals("1"))
            {
                if (serfun.AplicaVariosProveedores(oCombo.Value, sapCompany))
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item("EdECP").Visible = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("linkECP").Visible = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("mtx_4").Enabled = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item("EdECP").Enabled = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("EdECP").Visible = true;
                    oForm.Items.Item("linkECP").Visible = false;
                    oForm.Items.Item("mtx_4").Enabled = false;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("linkECP").Visible = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("EdECP").Visible = true;
                oForm.Items.Item("EdECP").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("mtx_4").Enabled = false;
            }
            #endregion

            #region habilitar campos bono
            if (((CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("KActiBono").Specific).Checked)
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("edBno").Enabled = true;
            }
            else
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("edBno").Enabled = false;
            }
            #endregion
            oForm.Items.Item("btnValCare").Enabled = false;


            #region Habilitar o Deshabilitar Campos según Estados
            serfun.HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposSF(oForm);
            oForm.Items.Item("43").Enabled = false;
            oForm.Items.Item("45").Enabled = false;
            #endregion

            // asignar permisos para generar documentos de orden de compra y de servicios
            serfun.PermisosUsuario(oForm);

            #region habilitar campos serie de cotizacion
            if (serfun.esSerieCotización(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("Series", 0).Trim()))
            {
                oForm.Items.Item("96").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("97").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("107").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("126").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("198").Enabled = false;
            }
            #endregion

            ((SAPbouiCOM.Button)oForm.Items.Item("122").Specific).Caption = "Actualizar SN";
            if (oForm.Items.Item("21").Enabled == true)
                oForm.Items.Item("21").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);


            serfun.CargarSaldosContrato(oForm);

            ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("405").Specific).Checked = false;

            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx;
            omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
            omtx.Columns.Item("col_tipOrd").Editable = true;

            #region  inhabilitar filas
            // inhabilitar filas facturadas.
            //ServicioFunerario.inhabilitarFilasFacturadas(oForm, sapCompany);
            //ServicioFunerario.inhabilitarCeldaFilasSalidaMercancia(oForm, sapCompany);
            //ServicioFunerario.inhabilitarCeldasOrdenesCS(oForm, sapCompany);
            ServicioFunerario.inhabilitarCeldasDocumentos(oForm, sapCompany);
            //serfun.calcularTotales(oForm);
            #endregion
            #region Habilitar Boton de impresion de reportes  siempre
            /*Habilitar Boton de impresion de reportes  siempre */
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "btnimp", true);
            OK1.SBO.Helpers.Habilitar_Deshabilitar_campo(oForm, "250", true);
            #endregion

        }
        public static bool existen_ElementosCedidosSF_UsoMarcado(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje)
        {
            bool error = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string NroContratoPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            string Facturada = string.Empty;
            string Uso = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !error)
                {
                    NroContratoPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", indice).Trim();
                    Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Uso))
                        Uso = "N";
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NroContratoPrenecesidad) && Uso.Equals("N"))
                    {
                        error = true;
                        mensaje = "en la linea " + Convert.ToString(indice + 1) + " no se le ha marcado el uso al elemento, debe marcar el uso de todos los elementos para hacer la factura prenecesidad.";
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }

            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_ElementosCedidosSF_UsoMarcado", ocmp);
            }
            return error;
        }

        public static bool existen_LineasPrenecesidadActualSinFactura(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, string NroContratoPrenecesidad)
        {
            bool existen = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string NroContratoPrenecesidadLinea = string.Empty;
            string Facturada = string.Empty;
            string Uso = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !existen)
                {
                    NroContratoPrenecesidadLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", indice).Trim();
                    Facturada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_LPagadaPrenec", indice).Trim();
                    if (NroContratoPrenecesidad.Equals(NroContratoPrenecesidadLinea) && !Facturada.Equals("Y"))
                        existen = true;

                    indice++;
                }
            }

            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_LineasPrenecesidadActualSinFactura", ocmp);
            }
            return existen;
        }

        public static bool existen_ElementosCedidosSFLineaSeleccionada(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string NroContratoPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            string Facturada = string.Empty;
            string Uso = string.Empty;
            bool seleccionada = false;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !existe)
                {
                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                    if (seleccionada)
                    {
                        NroContratoPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", indice).Trim();
                        Facturada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_LPagadaPrenec", indice).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NroContratoPrenecesidad) && (Facturada.Equals("N") || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Facturada)))
                            existe = true;
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_ElementosCedidosSFLineaSeleccionada", ocmp);
            }
            return existe;
        }


        public static bool existen_ArticulosNoSeleccionadoBasicos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref bool lineasSinArticulo, ref bool LineaSeleccionadaNoInventariable, ref int linea)
        {
            bool encontradoError = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string tipolinea = "";
            string itemcode = "";
            bool seleccionada = false;

            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {
                    tipolinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                    linea = indice + 1;
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipolinea))
                    {
                        if (tipolinea.Equals("B") || tipolinea.Equals("H"))
                        {
                            itemcode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemCode", indice).Trim();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemcode))
                            {
                                oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                                if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES))
                                {
                                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                                    if (!seleccionada)
                                    {
                                        encontradoError = true;
                                        salir = true;
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                                    if (seleccionada)
                                    {
                                        encontradoError = true;
                                        LineaSeleccionadaNoInventariable = true;
                                        salir = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                encontradoError = true;
                                lineasSinArticulo = true;
                                salir = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                        if (seleccionada)
                        {
                            itemcode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemCode", indice).Trim();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemcode))
                            {
                                oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                                if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                                {
                                    encontradoError = true;
                                    LineaSeleccionadaNoInventariable = true;
                                    salir = true;
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                encontradoError = true;
                                lineasSinArticulo = true;
                                salir = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existen_ArticulosNoSeleccionadoBasicos", ocmp);
            }
            return encontradoError;
        }

        public static bool marcarUsoArticuloPadre(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref int linea, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool Exito = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string tipolinea = "";
            string nContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(ocmp, sapApplication);
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {
                    tipolinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                    linea = indice + 1;
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipolinea))
                    {

                        if (tipolinea.Equals("B"))
                        {
                            string Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                            if (!Uso.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                #region marcar uso servicio funerario
                                omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(linea, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                salir = true;
                                string DocEntrySF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                double canti = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_9").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value);
                                string strcanti = canti.ToString().Trim();
                                serfun.CederElementosPrenecesidad
                                     (
                                     serfun.strPath,
                                     ocmp,
                                     "",
                                     ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_linPF").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                     ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                     ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                     ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                     strcanti,
                                     DocEntrySF
                                     );

                                serfun.AgregarHistoricoPrenecidad
                                    (
                                    ocmp,
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString(),
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                    "OK1_SF_LLAMADA",
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_linPF").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value
                                    , ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_9").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value
                                     , ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value
                                    );
                            }
                            #endregion

                        }
                    }

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "marcarUsoArticuloPadre", ocmp);
            }
            return Exito;
        }

        public static int RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizSF_old(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string articulo, ref string mensaje)
        {

            bool salir = false;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            int tope = 0;
            int indice = 0;
            int LineaPadre = -1;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {
                    string itemCode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemCode", indice).Trim();
                    string strLineId = oDBS1.GetValue("LineId", indice).Trim();
                    if (itemCode.Equals(articulo))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            LineaPadre = Convert.ToInt32(strLineId);
                        }
                        catch (Exception e) { }
                        salir = true;
                    }

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizSF", sapCompany);

            }
            return LineaPadre;
        }

        public static int RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizSF(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, int lineaPadre, ref string mensaje)
        {

            bool salir = false;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            int tope = 0;
            int indice = 0;
            int LineaPadre_lineid = -1;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {
                    string strLineId = oDBS1.GetValue("LineId", indice).Trim();
                    int U_IdLinea = Convert.ToInt32(oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLinea", indice).Trim());
                    if (U_IdLinea.Equals(lineaPadre))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            //LineaPadre_lineid = Convert.ToInt32(strLineId);
                            LineaPadre_lineid = indice + 1;
                        }
                        catch (Exception e) { }
                        salir = true;
                    }

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizSF", sapCompany);

            }
            return LineaPadre_lineid;
        }

        public static int RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizPN(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string lineaPadre, string DocEntryPN, string strPath, ref string mensaje)
        {

            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            int LineaPadre_lineid = 0;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizPN", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%DocEntryPN%", DocEntryPN);
                query = query.Replace("%lineaPadre%", lineaPadre);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    LineaPadre_lineid = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizPN", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return LineaPadre_lineid;
        }

        public static bool MarcarUsoElementosInventariablePorLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, int Fila, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string mystrpath, bool seleccionaLinea)
        {
            bool error = false;
            int tope = 0;
            string tipolinea = string.Empty;
            bool seleccionada = false;
            string itemcode = string.Empty;
            int indice = Fila;
            int lineaPadre = -1;
            int lineaPadrePN = -1;

            string Uso = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadre = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadreLinea = string.Empty;
            string lineaStr = string.Empty;

            string DocEntrySF = string.Empty;
            double canti = 0;
            string strcanti = string.Empty;


            string nContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(ocmp, sapApplication);
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            Fila++;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;


                if (seleccionaLinea)
                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(Fila);
                else
                    seleccionada = true;


                if (seleccionada)
                {
                    tipolinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipolinea) || tipolinea.Equals("N"))
                    {
                        #region la linea es un articulo no lista de materiales
                        itemcode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemCode", indice).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemcode))

                                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(lineaPadre).Specific).Value,
                                                    "OK1_SF_LLAMADA",

                                                     , ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(Fila).Specific).Value
                                                    );
                                                #endregion
                                            }
                                        }

                                        #endregion

                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        mensaje = "el uso de este elemento ya fue marcado.";
                                        error = true;
                                    }
                                    #endregion

                                    #endregion
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                mensaje = "el articulo no se le puede hacer uso porque es un articulo NO inventariable.";
                                error = true;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            mensaje = "el articulo no puede ser vacio.";
                            error = true;
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    mensaje = "debe seleccionar la fila para marcar el uso.";
                    error = true;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablePorLinea", ocmp);

        public static bool MarcarUsoElementosInventariablePorLineaOtrosServicios(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, int Fila, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string mystrpath, bool seleccionaLinea)
        {
            bool error = false;
            int tope = 0;
            string tipolinea = string.Empty;
            bool seleccionada = false;
            string itemcode = string.Empty;
            int indice = Fila;
            int lineaPadre = -1;
            int lineaPadrePN = -1;

            string Uso = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadre = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadreLinea = string.Empty;
            string lineaStr = string.Empty;

            string DocEntrySF = string.Empty;
            double canti = 0;
            string strcanti = string.Empty;


            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(ocmp, sapApplication);
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            Fila++;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;


                if (seleccionaLinea)
                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(Fila);
                else
                    seleccionada = true;


                if (seleccionada)
                {
                    tipolinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tipolinea) || tipolinea.Equals("N"))
                    {
                        #region la linea es un articulo no lista de materiales
                        itemcode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemCode", indice).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemcode))
                        {

                            oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                            oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                            if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES))
                            {
                                Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                                if (!Uso.Equals("Y"))
                                {
                                    #region marcar uso servicio funerario
                                    omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(Fila, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                    #endregion
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    mensaje = "el uso de este elemento ya fue marcado.";
                                    error = true;
                                }

                            }
                            else
                            {
                                mensaje = "el articulo no se le puede hacer uso porque es un articulo no inventariable.";
                                error = true;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            mensaje = "el articulo no puede ser vacio.";
                            error = true;
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        #region articulo padre o hijo (paquete o basico)
                        itemcode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemCode", indice).Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemcode))
                        {
                            oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                            oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                            if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES))
                            {
                                if (tipolinea.Equals("H"))
                                {
                                    #region linea hijo de un basico

                                    #region MARCAR USO HIJO PAQUETE O BASICO
                                    Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                                    if (!Uso.Equals("Y"))
                                    {
                                        #region marcar uso servicio funerario
                                        omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(Fila, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                        #endregion

                                        #region marcar la linea padre
                                        try
                                        {
                                            int intlineaPadre = Convert.ToInt32(oDBS1.GetValue("U_LineaPadre", indice).Trim()); // linea PADRE parque
                                            lineaPadre = RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizSF(oForm, ocmp, intlineaPadre, ref mensaje);
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception e) { }

                                        if (!lineaPadre.Equals(-1))
                                        {
                                            string DocEntrySFS = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                                            int cantidad = ServicioFunerario.retonar_CantidadUsosRenuncias(ocmp, DocEntrySFS, lineaPadre.ToString(), mystrpath);
                                            string UsoLineaPadre = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", lineaPadre - 1).Trim();

                                            if (cantidad == 0 && !UsoLineaPadre.Equals("Y"))
                                            {
                                                #region marcar uso servicio funerario
                                                omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(lineaPadre, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                                #endregion

                                            }
                                        }

                                        #endregion
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        mensaje = "el uso de este elemento ya fue marcado.";
                                        error = true;
                                    }
                                    #endregion

                                    #endregion
                                }
                                else
                                if (tipolinea.Equals("C"))
                                {
                                    #region linea hijo de un paquete

                                    #region MARCAR USO HIJO PAQUETE O BASICO
                                    Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                                    if (!Uso.Equals("Y"))
                                    {
                                        #region marcar uso servicio funerario
                                        omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(Fila, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                        #endregion


                                        #region marcar la linea padre

                                        try
                                        {
                                            int intlineaPadre = Convert.ToInt32(oDBS1.GetValue("U_LineaPadre", indice).Trim()); // linea PADRE parque
                                            lineaPadre = RetornarLineIdElementoMatrizSF(oForm, ocmp, intlineaPadre, ref mensaje);

                                            int intlineaPadrePN = Convert.ToInt32(oDBS1.GetValue("U_LineaPadrePN", indice).Trim()); // linea PADRE prenecesidad
                                            string strNumeroContratoPN = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(Fila).Specific).Value.Trim();
                                            lineaPadrePN = intlineaPadrePN;
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception e) { }

                                        if (!lineaPadre.Equals(-1))
                                        {

                                            string UsoLineaPadre = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", lineaPadre - 1).Trim();
                                            if (!UsoLineaPadre.Equals("Y"))
                                            {
                                                #region marcar uso servicio funerario
                                                omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(lineaPadre, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                                #endregion
                                            }
                                        }

                                        #endregion

                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        mensaje = "el uso de este elemento ya fue marcado.";
                                        error = true;
                                    }
                                    #endregion

                                    #endregion
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                mensaje = "el articulo no se le puede hacer uso porque es un articulo NO inventariable.";
                                error = true;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            mensaje = "el articulo no puede ser vacio.";
                            error = true;
                        }
                        #endregion
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    mensaje = "debe seleccionar la fila para marcar el uso.";
                    error = true;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablePorLinea", ocmp);
            }
            return error;
        }


        public static bool MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablePorLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, int Fila, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string mystrpath, bool seleccionaLinea, string consumoCofreCremacion = "N")
        {
            bool error = false;
            int tope = 0;
            string tipolinea = string.Empty;
            bool seleccionada = false;
            string itemcode = string.Empty;
            int indice = Fila;
            int lineaPadre = -1;
            int lineaPadrePN = -1;

            string Uso = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadre = string.Empty;
            string CodigoPadreLinea = string.Empty;
            string lineaStr = string.Empty;

            string DocEntrySF = string.Empty;
            double canti = 0;
            string strcanti = string.Empty;

            string nContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(ocmp, sapApplication);
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            Fila++;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;


                if (!seleccionaLinea)
                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(Fila);
                else
                    seleccionada = true;

                {

                                    #region marcar uso prenecesidad

                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(Fila).Specific).Value,

                                                    strcanti = canti.ToString().Trim();
                                                    serfun.CederElementosPrenecesidad
                                                        (
                                                        mystrpath,

                                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(Fila).Specific).Value,

                                                    error = true;
                                                }

                                                #endregion
