        public static bool MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariables(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref bool lineasSinArticulo, ref bool LineaSeleccionadaNoInventariable, ref int linea, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string mystrpath)
        {
            bool exito = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string nContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(ocmp, sapApplication);
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope)
                {
                    linea = indice + 1;
                    oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                    if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                    {
                        string Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                        if (!Uso.Equals("Y"))
                        {
                            #region marcar uso servicio funerario
                            omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(linea, "col_Uso", "Y");

                            string DocEntrySF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                            double canti = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_9").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value);
                            string strcanti = canti.ToString().Trim();
                            serfun.CederElementosPrenecesidad
                                (
                                mystrpath,
                                ocmp,
                                "",
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_linPF").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                strcanti,
                                DocEntrySF
                                );

                            serfun.AgregarHistoricoPrenecidad
                                (
                                ocmp,
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString(),
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value,
                                "OK1_SF_LLAMADA",
                                 ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_linPF").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value
                                 , ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_9").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value
                                 , ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Value
                                );
                        }

                        #endregion
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariables", ocmp);
            }
            return exito;
        }        //CAB // 26-11-2014-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        public static bool existen_DocumentosCreadosOS(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref int fila)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string OrdenGenerada = "";
            string DocumentoOrden = "";
            string Factura = "";
            string noFactura = "";
            string Documento = "";
            string NoDoc = "";
            string reciboCaja = "";
            string NoFacturaPrenec = "";
            string idLinea = "";
            string uso = "";
            string renuncia = "";


            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !existe)
                {
                    NoDoc = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", indice).Trim();
                    Documento = oDBS1.GetValue("U_DescDoc", indice).Trim();
                    DocumentoOrden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docOrd", indice).Trim();
                    OrdenGenerada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ordCom", indice).Trim();
                    Factura = oDBS1.GetValue("U_seFactu", indice).Trim();
                    noFactura = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoFactura", indice).Trim();
                    reciboCaja = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Pagado", indice).Trim();
                    idLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLinea", indice).Trim();
                    NoFacturaPrenec = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoFacturaPrenec", indice).Trim();
                    uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                    renuncia = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Renuncia", indice).Trim();

                    fila = Convert.ToInt32(idLinea);

                    if (!NoDoc.Equals(""))
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = NoDoc;
                    }
                    if (!Documento.Equals("") && !existe)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = Documento;
                    }
                    if (OrdenGenerada.Equals("SI") && !existe)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = DocumentoOrden;
                    }
                    if (!DocumentoOrden.Equals("") && !existe)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = DocumentoOrden;
                    }
                    if (Factura.Equals("SI") && !existe)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = noFactura;
                    }
                    if (!reciboCaja.Equals("") && !existe)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = reciboCaja;
                    }

                    if (!NoFacturaPrenec.Equals("") && !existe)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = NoFacturaPrenec + " Factura prenecesidad";
                    }
                    if (uso.Equals("Y") && !existe)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = "USO";
                    }

                    if (renuncia.Equals("Y") && !existe)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        mensaje = "RENUNCIA";
                    }

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch { }
            return existe;
        }

        public static string Retornar_TipoDocumentoCreadosSFLinea(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, int fila, ref string mensaje, string TipoDocumento)
        {
            bool existe = false;
            string OrdenGenerada = "";
            string DocumentoOrden = "";
            string Factura = "";
            string Documento = "";
            string NoDoc = "";
            string reciboCaja = "";
            string NombreDocumento = "";

            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();

                NoDoc = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Documento", fila).Trim();
                Documento = oDBS1.GetValue("U_DescDoc", fila).Trim();
                DocumentoOrden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docOrd", fila).Trim();
                OrdenGenerada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ordCom", fila).Trim();
                Factura = oDBS1.GetValue("U_seFactu", fila).Trim();
                reciboCaja = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Pagado", fila).Trim();

                switch (TipoDocumento)
                {
                    case "SM":
                        if (!NoDoc.Equals(""))
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            NombreDocumento = "SM";
                            mensaje = NoDoc;
                        }
                        if (!Documento.Equals("") && !existe)
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            NombreDocumento = "SM";
                            mensaje = Documento;
                        }
                        break;
                    case "OC":
                        if (!OrdenGenerada.Equals("NO"))
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            NombreDocumento = "OC";
                            mensaje = DocumentoOrden;
                        }
                        if (!DocumentoOrden.Equals("") && !existe)
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            NombreDocumento = "OC";
                        }
                        break;
                    case "FAC":
                        if (!Factura.Equals("NO"))
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            NombreDocumento = "FAC";
                            mensaje = Factura;
                        }
                        break;
                    case "RC":
                        if (!reciboCaja.Equals(""))
                        {
                            existe = true;
                            NombreDocumento = "RC";
                            mensaje = reciboCaja;
                        }
                        break;
                }
            }
            catch { }
            return NombreDocumento;
        }

        public void desmarcarColumnaFactura(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string docEntry, string tipoDoc, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string cardCode, ArrayList detalle, string strPath)
        {
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string Factura = "";
            string SocioLinea = "";
            string socioServicio = "", socioEmpresa = "", factConve = "";
            string query = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS1 = null;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS1 = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                socioServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdContra", 0).Trim();
                socioEmpresa = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_EntConCl", 0).Trim();
                string nContrato = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();
                string nOSF = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).Trim();

                if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                    factConve = DevolverItemEnTabla("OINV", "U_OK1_SF_FACTCONV", "DocEntry", docEntry, ocmp);
                if (tipoDoc.Equals("15"))
                    factConve = DevolverItemEnTabla("ODLN", "U_OK1_SF_FACTCONV", "DocEntry", docEntry, ocmp);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;

                if (factConve.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    foreach (ArrayList linea in detalle)
                    {
                        indice = 0;
                        while (indice < tope)
                        {
                            Factura = oDBS1.GetValue("U_seFactu", indice).Trim();
                            string noFact = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoFactura", indice).Trim();
                            if (Factura.Equals("SI"))
                            {
                                if (noFact.Equals(docEntry))
                                {
                                    oDBS1.SetValue("U_seFactu", indice, "NO");
                                    oDBS1.SetValue("U_NoFactura", indice, "");

                                }
                            }
                            indice++;
                        }
                    }

                }
                else
                {
                    foreach (ArrayList linea in detalle)
                    {
                        string lineId = linea[14].ToString();

                        indice = 0;
                        while (indice < tope)
                        {
                            Factura = oDBS1.GetValue("U_seFactu", indice).Trim();
                            SocioLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_CodSN", indice).Trim();
                            string LineaMatriz = oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLinea", indice).Trim();
                            if (Factura.Equals("SI"))
                            {
                                if (lineId.Equals(LineaMatriz))
                                {
                                    oDBS1.SetValue("U_seFactu", indice, "NO");
                                    oDBS1.SetValue("U_NoFactura", indice, "");


                                    #region Actualizar lineas en orden de parque
                                    query = "SELECT T1.\"DocEntry\",\"U_IdLinea\" FROM \"@OK1_PQC_OPARELM_LIN\"  T0 INNER JOIN \"@OK1_PQC_OPARQ_HEAD\"  T1  ON T0.\"DocEntry\" = T1.\"DocEntry\" WHERE T1.\"U_NoOSF\" = '" + nOSF + "' AND  T0.\"U_LineaSF\" = " + lineId + "";
                                    oRS1.DoQuery(query);

                                    if (oRS1.RecordCount > 0)
                                    {
                                        while (!oRS1.EoF)
                                        {
                                            query = "UPDATE \"@OK1_PQC_OPARELM_LIN\" SET \"U_seFactu\" = 'NO',\"U_NoFactura\" = '' WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + oRS1.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString() + " AND \"U_IdLinea\" = " + oRS1.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString() + "";
                                            oRS.DoQuery(query);
                                            oRS1.MoveNext();
                                        }
                                    }

                                    #endregion

                                }
                                //    if ((socioServicio.Equals(cardCode) || socioEmpresa.Equals(cardCode)) && SocioLinea.Equals(""))
                                //    {
                                //        oDBS1.SetValue("U_seFactu", indice, "NO");
                                //    }
                                //    if (SocioLinea.Equals(cardCode))
                                //    {
                                //        oDBS1.SetValue("U_seFactu", indice, "NO");
                                //    }

                                #region desmarcar socio de negocio responsable de la prenecesidad
                                string contratoPrenecesidadLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific).Value;

                                if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_CodSN").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific).Value.Equals("") && !((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific).Value.Equals("") && !contratoPrenecesidadLinea.Equals(nContrato))
                                {
                                    #region responsable de la linea cedida prenecesidad
                                    string ResponsableLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_CodSN").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific).Value;
                                    string contratoPrenecesidad = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)omtx.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific).Value;
                                    string noFactPrenec = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoFacturaPrenec", indice).Trim();

                                    if (ResponsableLinea.Equals("") && !contratoPrenecesidad.Equals(""))
                                    {
                                        string ResponsablePrenecesidadLinea = retonarReponsableContratoPrenecesidad(ocmp, contratoPrenecesidad, strPath);
                                        if (!ResponsablePrenecesidadLinea.Equals(""))
                                        {
                                            if (cardCode.Equals(ResponsablePrenecesidadLinea))
                                            {
                                                if (noFactPrenec.Equals(docEntry))
                                                {
                                                    oDBS1.SetValue("U_seFactu", indice, "NO");
                                                    oDBS1.SetValue("U_LPagadaPrenec", indice, "N");
                                                    oDBS1.SetValue("U_NoFacturaPrenec", indice, "");
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    #endregion
                                }

                                #endregion
                            }
                            indice++;
                        }
                    }
                }

                omtx.LoadFromDataSource();
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS1);
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Crea la nota crédito de factura de servicio funerario.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="detalle"></param>
        /// <param name="OCompany"></param>
        /// <param name="OApplication"></param>
        /// /// <param name="strPath"></param>
        /// <param name="strDocEntryNotaCredito"></param>
        /// <param name="cardCode"></param>
        /// 
        public bool CrearNotaCredito(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string docentryFac, ArrayList detalle, SAPbobsCOM.Company OCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application OApplication, string strPath, ref string strDocEntryNotaCredito, ref string cardCode, ref DateTime FecCont, ref DateTime fecDoc, int iBranch, string tipoNCFe, string tipoDoc, bool NCmanual)
        {
            #region Variables
            SAPbobsCOM.Documents oEntrega = null;
            Documents notaCredito = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset rSet = null;
            OK1.SBO.Helpers oHelperSDK = new OK1.SBO.Helpers();
            Recordset oRS = null;
            int exito = 0;
            bool creada = false;
            string strQuery = "";
            double totalVentaComision = 0;
            string numSolicitud = "", prenec = "", strTipoS = "";
            string idSerie = "";
            string sZona = "";
            string DocType = "";
            #endregion




            if (existePermisoUsuarioSede(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany.UserSignature.ToString()))
            {



                try
                {

                    Dictionary<string, string> LineasCondonacion = new Dictionary<string, string>();

                    Dictionary<string, string> LineasFacturacion = new Dictionary<string, string>();

                    Dictionary<string, string> LineasIntereses = new Dictionary<string, string>();

                    string DocEntryPrenecesidad = "";

                    oRS = (Recordset)OCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                    {
                        strQuery = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetEncabezadoFactura", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    }


                    if (tipoDoc.Equals("15"))
                        strQuery = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetEncabezadoEntrega", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docentry%", docentryFac);
                    oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                    if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        numSolicitud = oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        strTipoS = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD", "U_TipoSrv", "DocEntry", numSolicitud, OCompany);
                        prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", strTipoS, SBOCompany);

                        #region Cabecera y Gastos adicionales

                        if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                        {
                            notaCredito = (Documents)OCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oCreditNotes);
                            DocType = DevolverItemEnTabla("OINV", "DocType", "DocEntry", docentryFac, OCompany);
                        }

                        if (tipoDoc.Equals("15"))
                        {
                            notaCredito = (Documents)OCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oReturns);
                            DocType = DevolverItemEnTabla("ODLN", "DocType", "DocEntry", docentryFac, OCompany);
                        }


                        notaCredito.BPL_IDAssignedToInvoice = iBranch;

                        if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                        {
                            if (NCmanual)
                                idSerie = getSerieDocumento(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), "U_serieNCMn");
                            else
                                idSerie = getSerieDocumento(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), "U_serieNC");

                        }


                        if (tipoDoc.Equals("15"))
                            idSerie = getSerieDocumento(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim(), "U_serieNCEnt");

                        if (!idSerie.Equals(""))
                            notaCredito.Series = int.Parse(idSerie);
                        else
                            throw new System.ArgumentException("Para generar este documento, primero defina la serie de numeración en el módulo Gestión.");


                        cardCode = oRS.Fields.Item("CardCode").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        notaCredito.CardCode = oRS.Fields.Item("CardCode").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        notaCredito.TaxDate = fecDoc;
                        notaCredito.DocDate = FecCont; //oRS.Fields.Item("DocDate").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        notaCredito.DocDueDate = DateTime.Now;// oRS.Fields.Item("TaxDate").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        if (DocType.Equals("S"))
                            notaCredito.DocType = BoDocumentTypes.dDocument_Service;
                        else
                            notaCredito.DocType = BoDocumentTypes.dDocument_Items;
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value = oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value.ToString().Trim();//docentryFac;

                        if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
                            notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_PRENEC").Value = "Y";
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_TipoNota").Value = "A";
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_idFallec").Value = oRS.Fields.Item("U_idFallec").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_sucur").Value = oRS.Fields.Item("U_sucur").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_NomFallec").Value = oRS.Fields.Item("U_NomFallec").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_mun").Value = oRS.Fields.Item("U_mun").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("CtlAccount").Value = oRS.Fields.Item("CtlAccount").Value.ToString().Trim();

                        if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                            notaCredito.Comments = "Basado en la factura de clientes-" + oRS.Fields.Item("DocNum").Value.ToString().Trim();


                        if (tipoDoc.Equals("15"))
                            notaCredito.Comments = "Basado en la entrega-" + oRS.Fields.Item("DocNum").Value.ToString().Trim();

                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_FACTCONV").Value = oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_FACTCONV").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_tipo_NCV_FE").Value = tipoNCFe;

                        sZona = DevolverItemEnTabla("OCRD", "U_CSS_ZONA", "CardCode", cardCode, SBOCompany);
                        notaCredito.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_ZONA").Value = sZona;
                        #endregion

                        #region Detalle
                        int iLinea = 0;
                        //---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                        #endregion

                        if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                        {
                            DocEntryPrenecesidad = oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NPRENEC").Value.ToString().Trim();
                        }


                        foreach (ArrayList linea in detalle)
                        {
                            //if (!linea[1].ToString().Equals(""))
                            //{
                            //notaCredito.Lines.ItemCode = linea[0].ToString();
                            notaCredito.Lines.ItemDescription = linea[1].ToString();
                            notaCredito.Lines.Quantity = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(OCompany, linea[2]);
                            notaCredito.Lines.Price = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromEditText(linea[3].ToString());
                            notaCredito.Lines.TaxCode = linea[4].ToString();
                            notaCredito.Lines.LineTotal = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromEditText(linea[5].ToString());
                            if (!linea[13].ToString().Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                totalVentaComision += notaCredito.Lines.LineTotal;

                            }
                            notaCredito.Lines.WarehouseCode = linea[6].ToString();
                            notaCredito.Lines.UseBaseUnits = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;


                            #region cuenta devolución
                            //obtener item

                            string ctasTipoServicio = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_ctasTipoServicio", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);


                            if (ctasTipoServicio.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                string ctaDev = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_CUENFACT", "U_ctaDev", "U_tipServ", strTipoS, SBOCompany);
                                if (ctaDev.Equals(""))

                                    notaCredito.Lines.AccountCode = linea[7].ToString();
                                else

                                    notaCredito.Lines.AccountCode = ctaDev;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                string ctaDevParam = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_ctaDev", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany);

                                if (!ctaDevParam.Equals(""))
                                    notaCredito.Lines.AccountCode = ctaDevParam;
                                else
                                    notaCredito.Lines.AccountCode = linea[7].ToString();
                            }



                            #endregion

                            notaCredito.Lines.CostingCode = linea[8].ToString();
                            notaCredito.Lines.CostingCode2 = linea[9].ToString();
                            notaCredito.Lines.CostingCode3 = linea[10].ToString();
                            notaCredito.Lines.CostingCode4 = linea[11].ToString();

                            notaCredito.Lines.BaseEntry = Convert.ToInt32(docentryFac);
                            notaCredito.Lines.BaseLine = Convert.ToInt32(linea[12]);//numline; // line de la devolucion numero de la linea que correponde con linea en el documento
                            notaCredito.Lines.BaseType = int.Parse(tipoDoc); // basado en un documento tipo nota debito
                            notaCredito.Lines.Add();


                            if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                            {
                                if (!linea[18].ToString().Equals("0") && !String.IsNullOrEmpty(linea[18].ToString()))
                                {
                                    LineasFacturacion.Add(linea[18].ToString(), linea[15].ToString());
                                    LineasCondonacion.Add(linea[18].ToString(), linea[16].ToString());
                                    LineasIntereses.Add(linea[18].ToString(), linea[17].ToString());
                                }

                            }


                            iLinea++;
                        }



                        #region Retenciones aplicadas factura

                        if (Maneja_Retenciones(OCompany, strPath))
                        {
                            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSRetenciones = null;
                            try
                            {
                                oRSRetenciones = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)OCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                                strQuery = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "DetalleRetenciones", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%DocEntryFactura%", docentryFac);
                                oRSRetenciones.DoQuery(strQuery);
                                if (oRSRetenciones.RecordCount > 0)
                                {
                                    while (!oRSRetenciones.EoF)
                                    {
                                        notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.WTAmount = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oRSRetenciones.Fields.Item("U_Ret_ML").Value);
                                        notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.WTCode = oRSRetenciones.Fields.Item("CodigoRetencion").Value.ToString();
                                        notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Base_ML").Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oRSRetenciones.Fields.Item("U_Base_ML").Value); ;
                                        notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Tarifa").Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oRSRetenciones.Fields.Item("U_Tarifa").Value);
                                        notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Fuente").Value = oRSRetenciones.Fields.Item("U_Fuente").Value.ToString();
                                        notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Ret_ML").Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oRSRetenciones.Fields.Item("U_Ret_ML").Value);
                                        notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.Add();
                                        oRSRetenciones.MoveNext();
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            catch (Exception e)
                            {

                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ObtenerDetalleRetenciones", OCompany);
                            }
                            finally
                            {
                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRSRetenciones);
                            }
                        }

                        #endregion

                        #region Retenciones
                        //if (detalleRetenciones.Count > 0)
                        //{
                        //    foreach (ArrayList linea in detalleRetenciones)
                        //    {
                        //        if (!linea[0].ToString().Equals(""))
                        //        {
                        //            notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.WTCode = linea[0].ToString();
                        //            notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Base_ML").Value = Convert.ToDouble(linea[2]);
                        //            notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Tarifa").Value = Convert.ToDouble(linea[3]);
                        //            notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Fuente").Value = "A";
                        //            notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Ret_ML").Value = Convert.ToDouble(linea[1]);
                        //            notaCredito.WithholdingTaxData.Add();
                        //        }
                        //    }
                        //}
                        #endregion

                        exito = notaCredito.Add();
                        if (exito != 0)
                        {
                            OApplication.StatusBar.SetText(OCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            OApplication.MessageBox(OCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error("addInSrvFun", "NotaCredito", "Error DI al crear la nota credito. " + OCompany.GetLastErrorCode() + ": " + OCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), OCompany, false);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            #region AsientoReversionPago
                            creada = true;
                            strDocEntryNotaCredito = OCompany.GetNewObjectKey();
                            #endregion


                            if (oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_FACTCONV").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals("Y"))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_factConvPart", 0, "N");


                            if (oRS.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_FACTREC").Value.ToString().Trim().Equals("Y"))
                                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_factRecobro", 0, "N");

                            #region Cancelar Entrega
                            if (tipoDoc.Equals("15"))
                            {
                                oEntrega = (SAPbobsCOM.Documents)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oDeliveryNotes);
                                oEntrega.GetByKey(int.Parse(docentryFac));
                                int err = oEntrega.Close();
                                string msgErr = "";
                                if (!err.Equals(0))
                                    msgErr = OCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                            }
                            #endregion

                            if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                            {
                                #region Reversar historico factura lineas Prenecesidad

                                #region Actualiza historico de condonacion sobre los elementos de la prenecesidad

                                ActualizarHistoricoCondonacionPrenecesidad(OCompany, OApplication, strPath, LineasCondonacion, DocEntryPrenecesidad, true);

                                #endregion

                                #region Actualiza historico de facturacion sobre los elementos de la prenecesidad

                                ActualizarHistoricoFacturacionPrenecesidad(OCompany, OApplication, strPath, LineasFacturacion, DocEntryPrenecesidad, true);

                                #endregion

                                #region Actualiza historico de interes sobre los elementos de la prenecesidad

                                ActualizarHistoricoInteresesPrenecesidad(OCompany, OApplication, strPath, LineasIntereses, DocEntryPrenecesidad, true);

                                #endregion

                                #endregion
                            }





                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    creada = false;
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC-RetornarSerie", OCompany);
                    OApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrió una excepción al crear nota crédito. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                    OApplication.MessageBox("Ocurrió una excepción al crear nota crédito. " + e.Message, 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
                }
                finally
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(rSet);
                }
            }
            else
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El usuario actual no cuenta permisos para gestionar series de numeración de la sede: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSedeNom", 0).Trim() + "", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

            return creada;
        }

        public double ObtenerSumaPreciosArticulos(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            int fila = 0;
            double precio = 0;
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            ors.DoQuery("SELECT \"U_LstAdic\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_PARAM\" ");
            string strLstAdic = ors.Fields.Item("U_LstAdic").Value.ToString();


            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
            if (oItem.GetByKey(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_ItemCode", fila).Trim()))
            {

                for (int i = 0; i < oItem.PriceList.Count; i++)
                {
                    oItem.PriceList.SetCurrentLine(i);


                    if (oItem.PriceList.PriceList == Convert.ToInt32(strLstAdic))
                    {
                        precio += oItem.PriceList.Price;
                    }
                    else
                        precio += 0;

                }
                fila++;

            }
            else
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El artículo no existe. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
            }

            return precio;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Obtiene el detalle (líneas de artículos) de una devolución
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="docentry"></param>
        /// <param name="strPath"></param>
        public ArrayList ObtenerDetalleFactura(string docentry, string tipoDoc, string strPath, SAPbobsCOM.Company OCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application OApplication)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            string strQuery = "";
            ArrayList detalleFactura = new ArrayList();
            ArrayList lineaFactura;

            try
            {
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)OCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                if (tipoDoc.Equals("13"))
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetDetalleFactura", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                if (tipoDoc.Equals("15"))
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetDetalleEntrega", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%docentry%", docentry);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                if (oRS.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!oRS.EoF)
                    {
                        lineaFactura = new ArrayList();
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("itemcode").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("descripcion").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("cantidad").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("precio").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("codimpue").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("LineTotal").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("WarehouseCode").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("AccountCode").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("CostingCode").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("CostingCode2").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("CostingCode3").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("CostingCode4").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("LineNum").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("DestinoFinal").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("LineIdOSF").Value.ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oRS.Fields.Item("U_Facturacion").Value, false, "", -1).ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oRS.Fields.Item("U_Condonacion").Value, false, "", -1).ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, oRS.Fields.Item("U_Intereses").Value, false, "", -1).ToString());
                        lineaFactura.Add(oRS.Fields.Item("U_IdLinea").Value.ToString());
                        detalleFactura.Add(lineaFactura);
                        oRS.MoveNext();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC_ObtenerDetalleFactura", OCompany);
                OApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Ocurrio una excepcion al intentar obtener detalle de la devolución. " + e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OApplication.MessageBox("Ocurrio una excepcion al intentar obtener detalle de la devolución. " + e.Message, 1, "Aceptar", "", "");
            }
            finally
            { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS); }
            return detalleFactura;
        }
        public static bool CancelarDocumentosOrdenServicio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool cancelo = false;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication);
            string almacen = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string stQueryOC = "";
            string DocEntry = "";
            string DocNum = "";
            string TipoDocB1 = "";
            string Cant = "";
            string Documento = "";
            string AnulacionOC = "";
            string AnulacionSAL = "";
            string stQuery = "";
            string estadoOS = "";

            //sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Verificando estado de la orden de servicio funerario para su anulacion", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
            // estadoOS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).Trim();

            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("se inicia el proceso de anulacion de la orden de servicio. ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
            oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
            oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource odbds = null;

            ors = null;
            odbds = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                Documents oOrden = (Documents)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oPurchaseOrders); // orden de compra
                Documents oEntrada = (Documents)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oInventoryGenEntry); // entrada de mercancia
                Documents oSalida = (Documents)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oInventoryGenExit);  // salida mercancia
                for (int i = 0; i < odbds.Size; i++)
                {

                    DocEntry = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("DocEntry", i).Trim();
                    Cant = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Cant", i).Trim();
                    DocNum = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Documento", i).Trim();
                    TipoDocB1 = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_TipDocB1", i).Trim();
                    Documento = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_DescDoc", i).Trim();

                    stQueryOC = "SELECT \"U_Codigo\", \"U_Nombre\", \"U_Cant\", \"U_ItemCode\", \"U_ItemName\", \"U_CardCode\", \"U_CardName\", \"U_Valor\", \"U_Documento\", \"U_DescDoc\", T1.\"DfltWH\", \"InvntItem\", " +
                    "CASE WHEN \"U_TipDocB1\" = 22 THEN (SELECT \"U_Anul_SrvFun\" FROM OPOR WHERE U_OK1_SF_NSOL = T0.\"DocEntry\" AND \"DocEntry\" = T0.\"U_Documento\") ELSE 'X' END AS \"Orden\", CASE WHEN \"U_TipDocB1\" = 60 THEN (SELECT IFNULL(\"U_Anul_SrvFun\", 'X') " +
                    "FROM OIGE WHERE U_OK1_SF_NSOL = T0.\"DocEntry\" AND \"DocEntry\" = T0.\"U_Documento\") ELSE 'X' END AS \"Salida\", T0.\"DocEntry\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" T0 INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0.\"U_ItemCode\" = T1.\"ItemCode\" " +
                    "WHERE T0.\"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "' AND \"U_Documento\" IS NOT NULL AND \"U_TipDocB1\" = '22' GROUP BY \"U_Codigo\", \"U_Nombre\", \"U_Cant\", \"U_ItemCode\", \"U_ItemName\", \"U_CardCode\", \"U_CardName\", \"U_Valor\", \"U_DescDoc\", \"U_Documento\", \"U_TipDocB1\", T1.\"DfltWH\", \"InvntItem\", T0.\"DocEntry\" ORDER BY \"U_Documento\"";
                    ors.DoQuery(stQueryOC);

                    AnulacionOC = ors.Fields.Item(12).Value.ToString();

                    // Validamos  si Tipo de Documento es Órden de  Compra
                    if (TipoDocB1 == "22")
                    {
                        if (AnulacionOC == ("Y"))
                        {
                            oOrden.GetByKey(int.Parse(DocNum));
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Órden de  compra No. " + DocNum + " ya se encuentra cancelada", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                        }
                    }
                    if (TipoDocB1 == "22")
                    {
                        if (!AnulacionOC.Equals("Y"))
                        {
                            oOrden.GetByKey(int.Parse(DocNum));
                            oOrden.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Anul_SrvFun").Value = "Y";
                            oOrden.Update();
                            oOrden.Cancel();
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Órden de  compra No. " + DocNum + " cancelada correctamemte", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                        }
                    }

                    if (TipoDocB1 == "60")
                    {

                        oEntrada.DocDate = DateTime.Now;
                        oEntrada.DocDueDate = DateTime.Now;
                        oEntrada.Comments = "Entrada creada en base a Solicitud de Servicio Funerario No. " + DocEntry;

                        stQuery = "SELECT \"U_Codigo\", \"U_Nombre\", \"U_Cant\", \"U_ItemCode\", \"U_ItemName\", \"U_CardCode\", \"U_CardName\", \"U_Valor\", \"U_Documento\", \"U_DescDoc\", T1.\"DfltWH\", \"InvntItem\", " +
                        "CASE WHEN \"U_TipDocB1\" = 22 THEN (SELECT \"U_Anul_SrvFun\" FROM OPOR WHERE U_OK1_SF_NSOL = T0.\"U_Documento\" AND \"DocEntry\" = T0.\"U_Documento\") ELSE 'X' END AS \"Orden\", " +
                        "CASE WHEN \"U_TipDocB1\" = '60' THEN (SELECT IFNULL(\"U_Anul_SrvFun\", 'X') FROM OIGE WHERE U_OK1_SF_NSOL = T0.\"U_Documento\" AND \"DocEntry\" = T0.\"U_Documento\") ELSE 'X' END AS \"Salida\", T0.\"DocEntry\", " +
                        "(SELECT \"U_Anul_SrvFun\" FROM OIGE a WHERE U_OK1_SF_NSOL = T0.\"DocEntry\" AND a.\"DocEntry\" = T0.\"U_Documento\") AS \"doc\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN\" T0 INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0.\"U_ItemCode\" = T1.\"ItemCode\" " +
                        "WHERE T0.\"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "' AND \"U_Documento\" IS NOT NULL AND \"InvntItem\" = 'Y' AND \"U_TipDocB1\" = '60' GROUP BY \"U_Codigo\", \"U_Nombre\", \"U_Cant\", \"U_ItemCode\", \"U_ItemName\", \"U_CardCode\", \"U_CardName\", \"U_Valor\", \"U_DescDoc\", \"U_Documento\", \"U_TipDocB1\", T1.\"DfltWH\", \"InvntItem\", T0.\"DocEntry\" ORDER BY \"U_Documento\"";
                        ors.DoQuery(stQuery);

                        AnulacionSAL = ors.Fields.Item(15).Value.ToString();
                        //AnulacionSAL = ors.Fields.Item(14).Value.ToString();

                        if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                        {
                            if (AnulacionSAL == "Y")
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El documento " + DocNum + " ya tiene una devolución de mercancia", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            }
                            if (!AnulacionSAL.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                while (!ors.EoF)
                                {
                                    oSalida.GetByKey(int.Parse(DocNum));
                                    oSalida.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Anul_SrvFun").Value = "Y";
                                    oSalida.Update();
                                    oEntrada.Lines.ItemCode = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString();
                                    oEntrada.Lines.Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString());
                                    oEntrada.Lines.LineTotal = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(sapCompany, ors.Fields.Item(8).Value);
                                    almacen = ors.Fields.Item(10).Value.ToString();
                                    oEntrada.Lines.WarehouseCode = almacen;
                                    oEntrada.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_Anul_SrvFun").Value = "Y";
                                    oEntrada.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_OK1_SF_NSOL").Value = DocEntry;
                                    oEntrada.Update();
                                    oEntrada.Lines.Add();
                                    ors.MoveNext();
                                }
                            }
                            int retorno = oEntrada.Add();
                            if (retorno == 0)
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Devolución de Mercancia realizada éxitosamente para el documento " + DocNum, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error al crear Entrada:" + sapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                //oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");
                //oDBS1.SetValue("U_Estado", 0, "8");
                serfun.HabilitarDeshabilitarCamposSL(oForm);
                oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").SetValue("U_Estado", 0, "8");

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error :" + sapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

            }
            finally
            {
                // OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oOrden);
                serfun.reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Se realizo la  cancelación de  las ordenes de  compra y la devolución de Mercancia a almacen");
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" Operación Finalizada ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
            }

            return cancelo;
        }

        public void GenerarRegistroComision(Form oForm, string strDocEntry, string numSolicitud, string tipo)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("39").Specific;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            string strQuery = "";
            string strDocNum = "";
            string strArtDesc = "";


            if (tipo.Equals("1"))
            {
                strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"LineTotal\") FROM \"INV1\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + strDocEntry + "'  AND \"U_destFinal\" = 'N'";
                strDocNum = DevolverItemEnTabla("OINV", "DocNum", "DocEntry", strDocEntry, SBOCompany);
                strArtDesc = DescripcionArticulosFactura(strDocEntry, "INV1", SBOCompany);
            }
            else
            {
                strQuery = "SELECT SUM(\"LineTotal\") FROM \"RIN1\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + strDocEntry + "'  AND \"U_destFinal\" = 'N'";
                strDocNum = DevolverItemEnTabla("ORIN", "DocNum", "DocEntry", strDocEntry, SBOCompany);
                strArtDesc = DescripcionArticulosFactura(strDocEntry, "RIN1", SBOCompany);
            }

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);

                double totalVentaComision = Convert.ToDouble(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);

                #region RegistrarComision
                if (totalVentaComision > 0)
                {
                    addInExequial.ClaseComisiones oCo = null;
                    try
                    {

                        oCo = new addInExequial.ClaseComisiones(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
                        string conceptoComision = "";
                        string strTipoS = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD", "U_TipoSrv", "DocEntry", numSolicitud, SBOCompany);
                        if (strTipoS.Equals("2"))
                        {
                            if (tipo.Equals("1"))
                                conceptoComision = "SFServPart";
                            else
                                conceptoComision = "SFServPartNC";
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (tipo.Equals("1"))
                                conceptoComision = "SFExcedente";
                            else
                                conceptoComision = "SFExcedenteNC";
                        }

                        if (strArtDesc.Length > 180)
                            strArtDesc = strArtDesc.Substring(0, 150);
                        oCo.CargarTempComisionesSF(numSolicitud, conceptoComision, strDocNum, strArtDesc, SBOCompany, SBOApplication, totalVentaComision);
                    }
                    catch { }
                    finally
                    {
                        OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oCo);
                    }
                }
                #endregion


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInPuntoVenta", "MensajeArticulosExistenciaNegativa", SBOCompany);
            }
        }

        public string ConsultarEstadoFactura(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company oCmp, string numSolicitud)
        {
            Recordset oRs = null;
            string query = "", valor = "";
            oRs = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), oCmp);
                string PrenecFin = SETUP_RULE("PRENECFIN", oCmp);
                if (prenec.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    if (PrenecFin.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        query = "SELECT  \"U_facturado\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = (SELECT \"U_NumContr\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + numSolicitud + ")";
                    }
                    else
                    {

                        query = "SELECT  \"U_facturado\" FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRENE_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = (SELECT \"U_NumContr\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + numSolicitud + ")";
                    }
                }
                oRs.DoQuery(query);
                if (oRs.RecordCount > 0)
                    valor = oRs.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRs);
            }

            return valor;
        }


        public void ActualizarEstadoFactura(string numSolicitud, string valor)
        {
            Recordset oRs = null;
            string query = "";
            oRs = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                query = "UPDATE \"@OK1_EXE_PRENE_HEAD\" SET \"U_facturado\" = '" + valor + "' WHERE \"DocEntry\" = (SELECT \"U_NumContr\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + numSolicitud + ")";
                oRs.DoQuery(query);
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRs);
            }

        }

        public ReportDocument getReportDocument(string repFilePath)
        {
            // File Path for Crystal Report
            //string repFilePath = Server.MapPath("~/CrystalReport1.rpt");
            //string repFilePath = "C:\temp\CrystalReport1.rpt";
            // Declare a new Crystal Report Document object
            // and the report file into the report document
            ReportDocument repDoc = new ReportDocument();

            repDoc.Load(repFilePath);

            // Set the datasource by getting the dataset from business
            // layer and
            // In our case business layer is getCustomerData function
            return repDoc;
        }

        public string SETUP_RULE(string Rule, SAPbobsCOM.Company oCmp)
        {
            string item = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            try
            {
                string query = "SELECT \"Value\" FROM \"SETUP_RULES\" WHERE \"Cod\"  = '" + Rule + "'";
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)oCmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    item = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SER01", oCmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return item;
        }

        public bool RetroactivoFechaFallecimiento(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            bool exito = true;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication);
            try
            {
                string diasRetroactivo = serfun.DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_RetrFechFall", "Code", "SETUP", sapCompany).ToString();

                if (diasRetroactivo.Equals("0") || diasRetroactivo == null)
                {
                    string query = "UPDATE \"@OK1_SF_PARAM\"  SET \"U_RetrFechFall\"= 30 WHERE \"Code\"= 'SETUP'";
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                string error = sapCompany.GetLastErrorDescription();
                exito = false;

            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return exito;
        }

        public void cargarElementosCotizacion(Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            string nivelServicio = "";
            int fila = 1;
            oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("38").Specific;
            try
            {

                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                nivelServicio = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmbNivSer").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();


                string strPlanPart = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("txtPlan").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                cons.getElementos(ref oRSElementos, "", false, strPlanPart, nivelServicio, "");



                //mostrar elementos en matrix
                if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    oMatrixElementos.Clear();
                    while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                    {
                        oMatrixElementos.AddRow(1, oMatrixElementos.RowCount);
                        ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("U_OK1_SF_CODELEM").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Select(oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Code").Value.ToString(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Agregando elemento : " + oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Name").Value.ToString() + " " + Convert.ToString(fila) + " / " + Convert.ToString(oRSElementos.RecordCount), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                        oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                        fila++;
                    }
                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC005", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSElementos != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);
                //  oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();

                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }

        }

        public void setCondicionesCFLElementosCotizacion(Form oForm, ref SAPbouiCOM.ChooseFromList oCFL, string idElemento, string strPlanPart)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Conditions oConds = new Conditions();
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSProteccion = null;
            string minValue, maxValue;

            try
            {
                oRSProteccion = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                cons.getProteccion(ref oRSProteccion, "", strPlanPart);

                minValue = oRSProteccion.Fields.Item("U_min").Value.ToString();
                maxValue = oRSProteccion.Fields.Item("U_max").Value.ToString();

                if (minValue.Length == 1)
                    minValue = "0" + minValue;

                if (maxValue.Length == 1)
                    maxValue = "0" + maxValue;


                if (oConds.Count == 0)
                {
                    oConds.Add();
                }
                else
                {
                    for (int i = 1; i < oConds.Count; i++)
                    {
                        oConds.Item(i).Relationship = BoConditionRelationship.cr_NONE;
                    }
                }

                oConds.Item(0).BracketOpenNum = 1;
                oConds.Item(0).Alias = "U_OK1_SF_ELEM";
                oConds.Item(0).Operation = BoConditionOperation.co_EQUAL;
                oConds.Item(0).CondVal = idElemento;
                oConds.Item(0).BracketCloseNum = 1;


                oCFL.SetConditions(oConds);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "setCondicionesCFLElementos", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSProteccion != null)
                {
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSProteccion);
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oConds);
                }
            }
        }

        public void CamposUsuarioCotizacionCarga(Form oForm, string codSerie)
        {

        /// <summary>
        /// Llena un combobox en una matriz a partir de una consulta ingresada. 
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="ocl"></param>
        /// <param name="Query"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public void llenar_valoires_validos_columna(SAPbouiCOM.Column ocl, string Query, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, SAPbouiCOM.Application oapp)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool bandera = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(Query);
                int Count = ocl.ValidValues.Count;
                for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
                {
                    ocl.ValidValues.Remove(ocl.ValidValues.Count - 1, SAPbouiCOM.BoSearchKey.psk_Index);
                }
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        ocl.ValidValues.Add(ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString(), ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString());
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }
                    bandera = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "Exequial", "EXC0001", ocmp, oapp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

        }

        public void AnexoVisualizarSN(Form oForm, int indice)
        {
            Consultas cons = null;
            string ruta = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
            SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners oBp = (SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.oBusinessPartners);
            if (oBp.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value) == true)
            {
                string nombreArchivo = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_1").Cells.Item(indice).Specific).Value;
                cons = new Consultas(SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
                cons.ObtenerRutaAnexo(oBp.AttachmentEntry, nombreArchivo, ref ruta);
                Process p = new Process();
                p.StartInfo.FileName = ruta;
                p.Start();
            }
        }
