        public static string MensajeElementosComprometidosCedidosSF(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string IdElemento, string mystrPath, string NroPrenecesidad, string DocEntrySF)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string strQuery = string.Empty;
            string mensaje = string.Empty;
            string nroSolicitud = string.Empty;
            string Almacen = string.Empty;
            string CantSolicitada = string.Empty;
            string Elemento = string.Empty;
            string linea = string.Empty;

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(mystrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "RetornarElementosCedidosPendientesDeUsoFromSF", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%NroPrenecesidad%", NroPrenecesidad);
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%DocEntrySF%", DocEntrySF);
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%IdElemento%", IdElemento);

                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    mensaje = " Los siguientes ordenes de servicio tienen comprometido el Elemento: " + Elemento + " \n";
                    mensaje = mensaje + "                                                            " + " \n";
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        nroSolicitud = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        CantSolicitada = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        linea = ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString().Trim();
                        Elemento = ors.Fields.Item(3).Value.ToString().Trim();

                        mensaje = mensaje + " Servicio: " + nroSolicitud + " CantSolicitada: " + CantSolicitada + " linea: " + linea + "\n";
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }
                    mensaje = mensaje + "                                                            " + " \n";
                    mensaje = mensaje + " " + Elemento + ". \n";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "MensajeElementosComprometidosCedidosSF", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return mensaje;
        }

        public static bool ValidarCantidades_ElementosCedidosSFMatriz(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, ref string mensaje, string mystrPath)
        {
            bool ErrorValidarCantidad = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string NroContratoPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            string lineaPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            string elemento = string.Empty;
            string itemcode = string.Empty;
            string Facturada = string.Empty;
            string DocEntrySF = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            bool PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad = false;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication);
            double cantidadDisponible = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            double cantidadLinea = 0;
            string Desiste = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                DocEntrySF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString();
                while (indice < tope)
                {
                    oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                    if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES))
                    {
                        string Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                        if (!Uso.Equals("Y"))
                        {
                            bool eshijo = false;
                            string TipoLinea = string.Empty;

                            TipoLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                            eshijo = TipoLinea.Equals("H") || TipoLinea.Equals("C");

                            if (!eshijo)
                            {
                                NroContratoPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", indice).Trim();
                                Facturada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_LPagadaPrenec", indice).Trim();
                                lineaPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLineaPF", indice).Trim();
                                elemento = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Codigo", indice).Trim();
                                cantidadLinea = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(sapCompany, oDBS1.GetValue("U_Cant", indice));
                                Desiste = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Renuncia", indice).Trim();

                                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NroContratoPrenecesidad) && (Facturada.Equals("N") && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineaPrenecesidad)))
                                {
                                    if (!Desiste.Equals("Y"))
                                    {
                                        cantidadDisponible = 0;
                                        PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad = serfun.PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad(sapCompany, mystrPath, Convert.ToString(lineaPrenecesidad), NroContratoPrenecesidad, elemento, ref cantidadDisponible);
                                        if (cantidadLinea > cantidadDisponible)
                                        {
                                            mensaje = " La cantidad a cedida supera a la cantidad disponible del elemento: " + ".\n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + elemento + ". \n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + " Disponible :  " + Convert.ToString(cantidadDisponible) + "  en prenecesidad: " + NroContratoPrenecesidad + ".\n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + ServicioFunerario.MensajeElementosComprometidosCedidosSF(sapCompany, elemento, mystrPath, NroContratoPrenecesidad, DocEntrySF);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ValidarCantidades_ElementosCedidosSFMatriz", sapCompany);
            }
            return ErrorValidarCantidad;
        }

        public static bool ValidarCantidades_ElementosCedidosSFMatrizLineaSeleccionada(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, ref string mensaje, string mystrPath)
        {
            bool ErrorValidarCantidad = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string NroContratoPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            string lineaPrenecesidad = string.Empty;
            string elemento = string.Empty;
            string itemcode = string.Empty;
            string Facturada = string.Empty;
            string DocEntrySF = string.Empty;
            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItem = null;
            bool PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad = false;
            bool seleccionada = false;
            ServicioFunerario serfun = new ServicioFunerario(sapCompany, sapApplication);
            double cantidadDisponible = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            double cantidadLinea = 0;

            try
            {
                oItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);

                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                DocEntrySF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString();
                while (indice < tope)
                {

                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                    if (seleccionada)
                    {
                        oItem.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(omtx.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(indice + 1).Specific)).Value);
                        if ((oItem.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES))
                        {
                            string Uso = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Uso", indice).Trim();
                            if (!Uso.Equals("Y"))
                            {
                                bool eshijo = false;
                                string TipoLinea = string.Empty;
                                TipoLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                                eshijo = TipoLinea.Equals("H") || TipoLinea.Equals("C");

                                if (!eshijo)
                                {
                                    NroContratoPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", indice).Trim();
                                    Facturada = oDBS1.GetValue("U_LPagadaPrenec", indice).Trim();
                                    lineaPrenecesidad = oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLineaPF", indice).Trim();
                                    elemento = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Codigo", indice).Trim();
                                    cantidadLinea = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(sapCompany, oDBS1.GetValue("U_Cant", indice));

                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NroContratoPrenecesidad) && ((Facturada.Equals("N") || Facturada.Equals("")) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineaPrenecesidad)))
                                    {
                                        cantidadDisponible = 0;
                                        PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad = serfun.PuedeUsarElementoPrenecesidad(sapCompany, mystrPath, lineaPrenecesidad, NroContratoPrenecesidad, elemento, ref cantidadDisponible);
                                        if (cantidadLinea > cantidadDisponible)
                                        {
                                            mensaje = " La cantidad supera a la cantidad disponible del elemento: " + ".\n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + elemento + ". \n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + " Disponible :  " + Convert.ToString(cantidadDisponible) + "  en prenecesidad: " + NroContratoPrenecesidad + ".\n";
                                            mensaje = mensaje + ServicioFunerario.MensajeElementosComprometidosCedidosSF(sapCompany, elemento, mystrPath, NroContratoPrenecesidad, DocEntrySF);
                                            ErrorValidarCantidad = true;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ValidarCantidades_ElementosCedidosSFMatriz", sapCompany);
            }
            return ErrorValidarCantidad;
        }

        public double retornarTotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string NroPrenecesidad, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors1 = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            double TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad = 0;
            double RecaudointeresPagoTotal = 0;
            string NroPagoAddin = "", EntryNroPagoAddin = "";
            string NroFact = "";
            double vlrPagoTotal = 0;
            double interes = 0;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "retornarTotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%DocEntryPrenecesidad%", NroPrenecesidad);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        NroPagoAddin = ors.Fields.Item("U_NroPagoAddin").Value.ToString();

                        if (NroPagoAddin.Equals("") || NroPagoAddin.Equals("0"))
                        {
                            interes = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, ors.Fields.Item("U_Intereses").Value);
                            //TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad += OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, ors.Fields.Item("U_Intereses").Value);

                            TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad = TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad + interes;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            //  vlrPagoTotal = Convert.ToDouble(DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_FINAN_PAGO_HEAD", "U_VlrPgTot", "DocNum", NroPagoAddin, SBOCompany, SBOApplication));

                            vlrPagoTotal = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_FINAN_PAGO_HEAD", "U_VlrPgTot", "DocNum", NroPagoAddin, SBOCompany, SBOApplication));
                            // vlrPagoTotal = Convert.ToDouble(DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_FINAN_PAGO_HEAD", "U_VlrPgTot", "DocNum", NroPagoAddin, SBOCompany, SBOApplication));

                            if (vlrPagoTotal.Equals(0))
                            {
                                interes = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, ors.Fields.Item("U_Intereses").Value);
                                //TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad += OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, ors.Fields.Item("U_Intereses").Value);
                                TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad = TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad + interes;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                EntryNroPagoAddin = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_FINAN_PAGO_HEAD", "DocEntry", "DocNum", NroPagoAddin, SBOCompany, SBOApplication);
                                NroFact = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_FINAN_PAGO_LIN1", "U_EntrFact", "DocEntry", EntryNroPagoAddin, SBOCompany, SBOApplication);

                                ors1 = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                                ors1.DoQuery("SELECT \"LineTotal\" FROM INV1 WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + NroFact + " AND \"LineNum\" = 1");

                                if (ors1.RecordCount > 0)
                                {
                                    interes = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, ors1.Fields.Item("LineTotal").Value);
                                    //TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad += OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, ors1.Fields.Item("LineTotal").Value);
                                    TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad = TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad + interes;
                                }

                                break;
                            }

                        }

                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "retornarTotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return TotalRecaudointeresCreditoPrenecesidad;
        }

        public bool AgregarHistoricoPrenecidad
            (
            SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp,
            string NoOP,
            string NoPrenecesidad,
            string elemento,
            string articulo,
            string UDO,
            string LineaPF,
            string strcantidad,
            string tipolinea
            )
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool error = false;
            string query = "";
            double cantidad = 0;

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                string lineid = RetornarMaxLineIdPrenec(ocmp, NoPrenecesidad);
                string fecha = System.DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd");

                // query = "INSERT INTO \"@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST\"  VALUES(" + NoPrenecesidad + "," + lineid + "," + lineid + ",'OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST',0,'" + UDO + "'," + NoOP + ",'" + fecha + "'," + ocmp.UserSignature + ",'" + elemento + "','" + articulo + "','1" + "','" + LineaPF + "')";

                cantidad = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(ocmp, strcantidad);
                cantidad = Math.Round(cantidad);
                if (tipolinea.Equals(string.Empty))
                    tipolinea = "N";

                query = "INSERT INTO \"@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST\"  VALUES(" +

                    NoPrenecesidad + "," +
                    lineid + "," +
                    lineid + "," +
                    "'OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST'" + "," +
                    "'0'" + "," +
                    "'" + UDO + "'," +
                    NoOP + "," +
                     "'" + fecha + "'," +
                     "'" + ocmp.UserSignature + "'," +
                     "'" + elemento + "'," +
                     "'" + articulo + "'," +
                    cantidad.ToString() + "," +
                    LineaPF + "," +
                     "'" + tipolinea + "'" +

                    ")";

                ors.DoQuery(query);

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                error = true;
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "AgregarHistoricoPrenecidad", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return error;
        }

        public static string RetornarMaxLineIdPrenec(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntry)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = "";
            string LineId = "";
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            try
            {
                if (!DocEntry.Equals(string.Empty))
                {

                    query = "SELECT MAX(\"LineId\") +1 FROM \"@OK1_EXE_PRFIN_HIST\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + DocEntry + "'";
                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        LineId = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    }
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornarMaxLineIdPrenec", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return LineId;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Verifica si el elemento se le permite generar documento.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="idElem"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private bool elemPermiteGenerarDoc_old(string idElem)
        {
            bool permite = true;
            string strQuery = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

            try
            {
                ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetPermisoElemento", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idElemento%", idElem);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_destFinal").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_traslado").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_laboratorio").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                        permite = false;

                }



            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw e;
            }
            finally
            { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors); }


            return permite;
        }

        public bool elemPermiteGenerarDoc(string idElem)
        {
            bool permite = true;
            string strQuery = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;

            try
            {
                ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetPermisoElemento", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idElemento%", idElem);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {

                    //if (ors.Fields.Item("U_destFinal").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_traslado").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_laboratorio").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                    if (ors.Fields.Item("U_traslado").Value.ToString().Equals("Y") || ors.Fields.Item("U_laboratorio").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                        permite = false;

                    try
                    {

                        if (ors.Fields.Item("U_destFinal").Value.ToString().Equals("Y"))
                        {
                            string salidaDestinoFinalParque = ors.Fields.Item("U_SalDestFinSP").Value.ToString();

                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(salidaDestinoFinalParque))
                                permite = false;
                            else
                                if (salidaDestinoFinalParque.Equals("Parque"))
                                permite = false;
                        }

                    }
                    catch { permite = false; }
                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw e;
            }
            finally
            { OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors); }


            return permite;
        }

        public bool existeLineasSeleccionadas(Form oForm)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
            bool existenItemsSeleccionados = false;

            for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
            {
                //solo tomar en cuenta filas seleccionadas
                if (oMatrix.IsRowSelected(i) && ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_10").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value.Equals("NO"))
                {
                    existenItemsSeleccionados = true;
                    break;
                }

            }

            return existenItemsSeleccionados;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Verifica si el contrato cuenta con mora.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool validarMoraContrato(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string numContrato)
        {
            bool resultado = true;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string strQuery = "";
            try
            {

                string respon = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_respon", "DocEntry", numContrato, SBOCompany);

                if (respon.Equals("E"))
                {
                    string idConvenio = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_conve", "DocEntry", numContrato, SBOCompany);
                    ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetMoraConvenio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%numConve%", idConvenio);

                    ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        //alerta, proced autoriz
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Existen facturas abiertas con mora superior a la permitida en el convenio.");
                        resultado = false;
                    }
                }
                else if (respon.Equals("C"))
                {
                    ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "GetMoraContrato", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%numContrato%", numContrato);

                    ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        //alerta, proced autoriz
                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Existen facturas abiertas asociadas al contrato con mora superior a la permitida en el convenio.");
                        resultado = false;
                    }
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC025", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
            }
            return resultado;
        }



        /// <summary>
        /// Ver Disponibilidad de Salas
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oFormAct"></param>
        public void verDisponibilidadSalas(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Form oFormSF, int Tipo)
        {
            string strQuery = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oFormSF.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");
            try
            {
                switch (Tipo)
                {
                    case 1:
                        if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_VFecha", 0).Trim().Equals("") && !oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                        {
                            strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "VerDisponibilidadSalas", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSede%", oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Fecha%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFecha", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaExc%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFecha", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaRe%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFecha", 0).Trim());

                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaS", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaExcS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaS", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaReS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaS", 0).Trim());

                            oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_0").ExecuteQuery(strQuery);
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_1").Specific).DataTable = oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_0");
                            oForm.Items.Item("grid_1").Visible = true;
                            oForm.Items.Item("lbNov1").Visible = true;

                            strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "VerNovedadesSalas", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSede%", oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Fecha%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFecha", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaS", 0).Trim());
                            oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_3").ExecuteQuery(strQuery);
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_4").Specific).DataTable = oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_3");

                        }
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaExc", 0).Trim().Equals("") && !oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                        {
                            strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "VerDisponibilidadSalas", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSede%", oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Fecha%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaExc", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaExc%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaExc", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaRe%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaExc", 0).Trim());

                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaSalExc", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaExcS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaSalExc", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaReS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaSalExc", 0).Trim());


                            oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_0").ExecuteQuery(strQuery);
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_1").Specific).DataTable = oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_0");
                            oForm.Items.Item("grid_1").Visible = true;
                            oForm.Items.Item("lbNov1").Visible = true;

                            strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "VerNovedadesSalas", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSede%", oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Fecha%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaExc", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaSalExc", 0).Trim());
                            oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_3").ExecuteQuery(strQuery);
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_4").Specific).DataTable = oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_3");
                        }
                        break;
                    case 3:
                        if (!oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaR", 0).Trim().Equals("") && !oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim().Equals(""))
                        {
                            strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "VerDisponibilidadSalas", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSede%", oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Fecha%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaR", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaExc%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaR", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaRe%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaR", 0).Trim());

                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaSalR", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaExcS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaSalR", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaReS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaSalR", 0).Trim());

                            oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_2").ExecuteQuery(strQuery);
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_3").Specific).DataTable = oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_2");
                            oForm.Items.Item("grid_3").Visible = true;
                            oForm.Items.Item("lbNov3").Visible = true;

                            strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "VerNovedadesSalas", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%idSede%", oDBS.GetValue("U_sedeVel", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%Fecha%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaR", 0).Trim());
                            strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%FechaS%", oDBS.GetValue("U_VFechaSalR", 0).Trim());
                            oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_3").ExecuteQuery(strQuery);
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_4").Specific).DataTable = oForm.DataSources.DataTables.Item("DT_3");
                        }
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                throw e;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Registra la información del recurso asociado.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="nroDoc"></param>
        /// <param name="CodeRecurso"></param>
        /// <param name="ObjectType"></param>
        /// <param name="fechaIni"></param>
        /// <param name="horaIni"></param>
        /// <param name="fechaFin"></param>
        /// <param name="horaFin"></param>
        /// <param name="tipoRecurso"></param>
        /// <param name="consulta"></param>
        public void guardarDisponibilidadRecurso(string nroDoc, string CodeRecurso, string ObjectType, string fechaIni, string horaIni, string fechaFin, string horaFin, string tipoRecurso, string consulta)
        {
            string strQry = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            try
            {
                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "guardarDispoRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", nroDoc); //codigo del documento
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", CodeRecurso); //codigo del recurso
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", ObjectType); // Codigo del documento en sap
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", fechaIni); //Fecha inicial programada (fecha y hora)
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", horaIni); //hora inicial
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", fechaFin); //Fecha final programada (fecha y hora)
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", horaFin); // hora final
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", tipoRecurso); //Id del tipo de recurso
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", "N");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", "guardarDispoRecurso"); //nombre de la consulta que se va a ejecutar en el procedimiento almacenado
                ors.DoQuery(strQry);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "guardarDisponibilidadRecurso", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Verifica la disponibilidad del recurso ingresado.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="nroDoc"></param>
        /// <param name="CodeRecurso"></param>
        /// <param name="ObjectType"></param>
        /// <param name="fechaIni"></param>
        /// <param name="horaIni"></param>
        /// <param name="fechaFin"></param>
        /// <param name="horaFin"></param>
        /// <param name="tipoRecurso"></param>
        /// <param name="consulta"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private bool verificarDisponibilidadRecurso(string nroDoc, string CodeRecurso, string ObjectType, string fechaIni, string horaIni, string fechaFin, string horaFin, string tipoRecurso, string consulta, ref string docNum, ref string objectTypeDispo)
        {
            string strQry = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            bool existen = false;

            try
            {
                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "verificarDispoRecurso", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%nroDoc%", nroDoc);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%CodeRecurso%", CodeRecurso);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%ObjectType%", ObjectType);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaIni%", fechaIni);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaIni%", "");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%fechaFin%", fechaFin);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%horaFin%", "");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%tipoRecuros%", tipoRecurso);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%disponible%", "N");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%consulta%", consulta);
                ors.DoQuery(strQry);

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    existen = true;
                    docNum = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    objectTypeDispo = ors.Fields.Item(1).Value.ToString();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "guardarDisponibilidadRecurso", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return existen;
        }



        /// <summary>
        /// Ajusta el formato de la fecha y hora.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="fecha"></param>
        /// <param name="time"></param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public string fechaFormato(string fecha, int time, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            string hr, min, hora = "";
            DateTime dtFecha = new DateTime();
            if (!fecha.Equals(""))
            {

                min = Convert.ToString(time % 100);
                hr = Convert.ToString(time / 100);
                if (hr.Length == 1) hr = "0" + hr;
                if (min.Length == 1) min = "0" + min;
                hora = hr + ":" + min;
                dtFecha = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsDateTime(fecha, sapApplication);

            }
            return dtFecha.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd") + " " + hora;

        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Registra las novedades de sala como disponibilidad de recurso.  
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public void guardarNovedadesSalas(Form oForm)
        {
            string strQry = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            string fecIn = "", fecFin = "";

            try
            {
                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "verificarNovedadesSalas", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                ors.DoQuery(strQry);

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        fecIn = fechaFormato(OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(ors.Fields.Item("fecIn").Value.ToString()), SBOApplication), int.Parse(ors.Fields.Item("horIn").Value.ToString()), SBOApplication);
                        fecFin = fechaFormato(OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(ors.Fields.Item("fecFi").Value.ToString()), SBOApplication), int.Parse(ors.Fields.Item("horFi").Value.ToString()), SBOApplication);
                        guardarDisponibilidadRecurso(ors.Fields.Item("Sala").Value.ToString() + ors.Fields.Item("Line").Value.ToString(), ors.Fields.Item("Sala").Value.ToString(), "OK1_SALAVELACION", fecIn, ors.Fields.Item("horIn").Value.ToString(), fecFin, ors.Fields.Item("horFi").Value.ToString(), "6", "guardarDispoRecurso");
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "guardarNovedadesSalas", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }

        }

        public void guardarSalasMultiples(string numSolic, string fecIn, string horaIn, string fecFin, string horaFin, string tipo)
        {
            string strQry = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            try
            {
                switch (tipo)

                        break;
                    case "E":
                        strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "verificarSalasMultiplesExcedente", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        break;
                    case "R":
                        strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "verificarSalasMultiplesReencuentro", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                        break;
                }
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%numSolic%", numSolic);
                ors.DoQuery(strQry);

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        guardarDisponibilidadRecurso(numSolic, ors.Fields.Item("Sala").Value.ToString(), "OK1_SF_LLAMADA", fecIn, horaIn, fecFin, horaFin, "6", "guardarDispoRecurso");
                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }

                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "guardarNovedadesSalas", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }

        public bool ValidarCierre(string numSolic, string nivelServ, ref string doc)
        {
            string strQry = "";
            bool valido = true;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            try
            {
                if (nivelServ.Equals("2"))
                {

                    strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "BuscarOrdenesTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%numSolic%", numSolic);
                    ors.DoQuery(strQry);

                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        if (!ors.Fields.Item("Nº Orden").Value.ToString().Equals("Cerrada"))
                        {
                            doc = "Orden de Traslado: " + ors.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString();
                            valido = false;
                            break;
                        }

                        ors.MoveNext();
                    }


                }

                if (nivelServ.Equals("1") || nivelServ.Equals("3"))
                {
                    strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "BuscarOrdenesTraslado", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%numSolic%", numSolic);
                    ors.DoQuery(strQry);

                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        if (!ors.Fields.Item("Nº Orden").Value.ToString().Equals("Cerrada"))
                        {
                            doc = "Orden de Traslado: " + ors.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString();
                            valido = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "BuscarOrdenesLaboratorio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    strQry = strQry.Replace("%numSolic%", numSolic);
                    ors.DoQuery(strQry);

                    while (!ors.EoF)
                    {
                        if (!ors.Fields.Item("Nº Orden").Value.ToString().Equals("CERRADA"))
                        {
                            doc = "Orden de Laboratorio: " + ors.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString();
                            valido = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ValidarCierre", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return valido;
        }

                                case "E":

                            }

                            oDBS.SetValue("U_IDir", 0, ors1.Fields.Item("U_dir").Value.ToString().Trim());

        }

        public string crearListaChequeo(string doc, SAPbobsCOM.Company SBOCompany)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService oGS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData oGD = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCmpServ = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string lastDoc = "";
            try
            {
                oCmpServ = SBOCompany.GetCompanyService();
                oGS = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService)oCmpServ.GetGeneralService("OK1_SF_LISTCHEQ");
                oGD = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData)oGS.GetDataInterface(SAPbobsCOM.GeneralServiceDataInterfaces.gsGeneralData);
                oGS.Add(oGD);
                lastDoc = OK1.SBO.Helpers.GetLastDocEntry("@OK1_SF_LISCHEQ_HEAD", SBOCompany);

                string strQuery = "UPDATE ORDR SET \"U_nListCh\" = " + lastDoc + " WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + doc + "";



                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInExequial", "001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oGS);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oGD);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oCmpServ);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return lastDoc;
        }

        public static bool SetearNumeroFacturaPN(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string lineaFacturada, string numerofactura)
        {
            bool exito = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int linea = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;

            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {
                    linea = indice + 1;

                    string U_IdLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLinea", indice).Trim();
                    if (U_IdLinea.Equals(lineaFacturada))
                    {
                        omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(linea, "col_NFPN", numerofactura);
                        omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(linea, "col_LiqF", "Y");
                        salir = true;
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SetearNumeroFacturaPN", ocmp);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static bool SetearNumeroFacturaPNHijos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string numerofactura, string ContratoPrenecesidad)
        {
            bool exito = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int linea = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            bool aplicar = false;

            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {
                    linea = indice + 1;
                    string ContratoPrenecesidadlinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_NoContr_Prenec", indice).Trim();
                    string tipoLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                    if (ContratoPrenecesidadlinea.Equals(ContratoPrenecesidad))
                    {
                        aplicar = tipoLinea.Equals("C") || tipoLinea.Equals("H");
                        if (aplicar)
                        {
                            omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(linea, "col_NFPN", numerofactura);
                            omtx.SetCellWithoutValidation(linea, "col_LiqF", "Y");
                        }
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SetearNumeroFacturaPNHijos", ocmp);
            }
            return exito;
        }

        public static bool estipolineaPadre(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, ref int linea, ref string tipolinea, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string mystrpath)
        {
            bool Exito = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            bool seleccionada = false;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;

            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope && !salir)
                {
                    seleccionada = omtx.IsRowSelected(indice + 1);
                    if (seleccionada)
                    {
                        tipolinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                        linea = indice + 1;

                        if (tipolinea.Equals("P") || tipolinea.Equals("B"))
                        {
                            Exito = true;
                            salir = true;
                        }
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "estipolineaPadre", ocmp);
            }
            return Exito;
        }

            {
                ors = (Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "RetonarSedeSF", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%DocEntrySF%", DocEntrySF);

                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    sede = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SetearNumeroFacturaPN", sapCompany);
            }
            return sede;

        }

        public bool cargarElementosbasicos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, ref bool calcularPrecio)
        {

            bool error = false;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSItem = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            string idContrato = string.Empty;
            string almacen = string.Empty;
            string nArticulo = string.Empty;
            string articulo = string.Empty;
            string nomProveedor = string.Empty;
            string idConvenio = string.Empty;
            string idPlan = string.Empty;
            string idSede = string.Empty;
            string idTipoSer = string.Empty;
            string nivelServicio = string.Empty;
            int fila = 1, fila2 = 1;
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), ocmp);
            string aplicaVigenciaPreciosXElementos = SETUP_RULE("APLVIGPRECELEM", ocmp);
            bool esConvParticular = false;
            string mensaje = string.Empty;
            string name = string.Empty;
            int tope = 0;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRSItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                idTipoSer = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("80").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                nivelServicio = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("EdNivS").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                idSede = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("EdVSede").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();

                #region Elementos Convenio
                if (aplicaVigenciaPreciosXElementos.Equals("Y"))
                {
                    idContrato = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("35").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    idConvenio = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_conve", "DocEntry", idContrato, SBOCompany);
                    idPlan = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_plan", "DocEntry", idContrato, SBOCompany);
                    esConvParticular = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("ckConvPart").Specific).Checked;
                    calcularPrecio = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("ckConvPart").Specific).Checked;
                    string fecha = "";
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                        fecha = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("7").Specific).Value;
                    else
                        fecha = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD", "U_FechaSol", "DocEntry", ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value, SBOCompany)), SBOApplication);

                    #region Consultar Elemento Básicos
                    if (idTipoSer.Equals("1"))
                    {

                        // cons.getElementosBasicos(ref oRSElementos, idConvenio, idPlan, idSede, nivelServicio, "", strPath);
                        cons.getElementosBasicos(ref oRSElementos, idConvenio, idPlan, idSede, nivelServicio, prenec, esConvParticular, fecha, strPath);


                        if (oRSElementos.RecordCount > 0)
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("se inicia el proceso de eliminacion de las lineas elementos basicos ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                            // eliminar elementos basicos 
                            error = ServicioFunerario.EliminarElementosBasicos(oForm, ocmp, ref mensaje, sapApplication);

                            oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                            oDBS1.Clear();
                            //int size = oDBS1.Size;
                            //int capacidad = oMatrixElementos.RowCount;
                            if (!error)
                            {
                                tope = oRSElementos.RecordCount;
                                fila2 = oMatrixElementos.RowCount + tope + 1;
                                while (!oRSElementos.EoF)
                                {
                                    nArticulo = "";
                                    almacen = "";
                                    oMatrixElementos.AddRow(1, oMatrixElementos.RowCount);
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_f").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = fila2.ToString();
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = fila2.ToString();
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Code").Value.ToString();
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_1").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Name").Value.ToString();
                                    string tipoOrden = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("U_TipoOrden").Value.ToString();
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_tipOrd").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Select(tipoOrden, BoSearchKey.psk_ByDescription);
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_9").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Quantity").Value.ToString();

                                    if ((idTipoSer.Equals("2")))
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_AAdMe").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Select("A", BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                                    else
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_AAdMe").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Select("C", BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);

                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("BASICO").Value.ToString();

                                    articulo = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("ItemCode").Value.ToString();
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("ItemCode").Value.ToString();

                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_3").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = DevolverItemEnTabla("OITM", "ItemName", "ItemCode", oRSElementos.Fields.Item("ItemCode").Value.ToString(), SBOCompany);
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_alm").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_SERIESXSUCUR", "U_almacen", "U_sede", idSede, SBOCompany);
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_10").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = "NO";
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_11").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = "NO";

                                    if (!articulo.Equals(""))
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_disp").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = calcularCantidadDisponible(oForm, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("ItemCode").Value.ToString(), almacen, strPath);

                                    nomProveedor = "";
                                    string proveedor = ServicioFunerario.retorna_Proveedor(SBOCompany, oRSElementos.Fields.Item("ItemCode").Value.ToString(), ref nomProveedor);
                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_4").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = proveedor;

                                    ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_5").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = nomProveedor;

                                    oMatrixElementos.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(oMatrixElementos.RowCount, 15, true);

                                    if (oRSElementos.Fields.Item("BASICO").Value.ToString().Equals("P") && esConvParticular)
                                    {
                                        //double vlrFact = getPrecioBasicoConvenioSede(idConvenio, idPlan, idSede, articulo);
                                        double vlrFact = getPrecioBasicoConvenioSede(idConvenio, idPlan, idSede, articulo, esConvParticular, nivelServicio);
                                        double vlrIVA = CalcularIVALinea(vlrFact, articulo, ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_AAdMe").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value);
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_6").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrFact, false, "", -1);
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_VlrFac").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrFact, false, "", -1);
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_Iva").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrIVA, false, "", -1);
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_Tot").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, vlrFact + vlrIVA, false, "", -1);
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_EsFac").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Checked = true;
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_6").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, 0, false, "", -1);
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_VlrFac").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, 0, false, "", -1);
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_Iva").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, 0, false, "", -1);
                                        ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_Tot").Cells.Item(oMatrixElementos.RowCount).Specific).Value = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSource(SBOCompany, 0, false, "", -1);
                                    }
                                    name = oRSElementos.Fields.Item("Name").Value.ToString();

                                    SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Procesando Básicos : " + name + " " + Convert.ToString(fila) + " / " + Convert.ToString(tope), BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);
                                    oRSElementos.MoveNext();
                                    fila++;
                                    fila2++;
                                }
                                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" elementos basicos  en esa sede no  encontrados", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                        }
                    }
                    #endregion
                }
                #endregion

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC005", SBOCompany);
                error = true;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSElementos != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSElementos);

                oForm.Freeze(false);
                inhabilitarCeldasBasicos(oForm);
                calcularTotales(oForm, true, false);
                calcularPrecio = false;
            }
            return error;
        }


        public static bool EliminarElementosBasicos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, ref string mensaje, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            bool error = false;
            int indice = 1;
            int tope = 0;
            int fila = 0;
            string tipolinea = string.Empty;
            int lineas_borradas = 0;
            {
                try
                {
                    oForm.Freeze(true);
                    oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("se inicia el proceso de eliminacion de las lineas elementos basicos ", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                    tope = oMatrix.RowCount;
                    if (oMatrix.RowCount > 1)
                    {
                        while (indice <= oMatrix.RowCount && !error)
                        {
                            fila = indice - 1;
                            tipolinea = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_tipLinea", fila).Trim();
                            if (tipolinea.Equals("B") || tipolinea.Equals("H"))
                            {
                                oMatrix.DeleteRow(indice);
                                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                                lineas_borradas++;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" Procesando Fila " + indice + "/" + tope, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                                indice++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (oMatrix.RowCount == 1)
                        {
                            tipolinea = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_tipLinea", fila).Trim();
                            if (tipolinea.Equals("B") || tipolinea.Equals("H"))
                            {
                                oMatrix.DeleteRow(indice);
                                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                                lineas_borradas++;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (lineas_borradas > 0)
                    {
                        //  oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                        //  oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("se Finaliza el proceso de eliminacion de las lineas elementos basicos", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    }

                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EliminarElementosBasicos ", sapCompany);
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);
                    mensaje = e.Message;
                    error = true;
                }
                finally
                {
                    oForm.Freeze(false);
                }
            }
            return error;
        }


        public static bool ExistenDocumentosCreadosElementosBasicos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, ref string mensaje, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, string mystrpath)
        {
            bool error = false;
            bool salir = false;
            int indice = 0;
            string tipolinea = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            int linea = 0;
            int cuentalineasPYH = 0;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                while (indice <= omtx.RowCount && !salir)
                {
                    tipolinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_tipLinea", indice).Trim();
                    linea = indice + 1;
                    if (tipolinea.Equals("B") || tipolinea.Equals("H"))
                    {
                        if (ServicioFunerario.existen_DocumentosCreadosOSLinea(oForm, ocmp, ref mensaje, indice))
                        {
                            error = true;
                            salir = true;
                        }
                        cuentalineasPYH++;
                    }
                    indice++;
                }
                if (cuentalineasPYH == 0)
                    error = true;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "marcarUsoArticuloPadre", ocmp);
            }
            return error;
        }


        public bool enviarAlertaSolicitudAutorizacion(TipoAlerta tipoAlerta, string usuario, string comentario)
        {
            bool valido = true;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService oMS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Message oMsg = null;

            try
            {


                int i = 0;
                oCS = SBOCompany.GetCompanyService();
                oMS = (SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService)oCS.GetBusinessService(ServiceTypes.MessagesService);
                oMsg = (SAPbobsCOM.Message)oMS.GetDataInterface(MessagesServiceDataInterfaces.msdiMessage);
                oMsg.Subject = "Alerta Servicio Funerario - Solicitud de Autorización";
                if (!comentario.Equals(""))
                    oMsg.Text = "Se Solicita Autorización para Crear Orden de Servicio Funerario:" + " - " + comentario;
                else
                    oMsg.Text = "Se Solicita Autorización para Crear Orden de Servicio Funerario";

                oMsg.Priority = BoMsgPriorities.pr_High;


                oMsg.RecipientCollection.Add();
                oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).SendInternal = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).UserCode = DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", usuario, SBOCompany);
                i++;


                oMS.SendMessage(oMsg);

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC018", SBOCompany);
                valido = false;
            }

            return valido;
        }


        public void enviarAlertaFromDocumento(TipoAlerta tipoAlerta, string NroDocumento, string Formulario)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSUsuarios = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService oMS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Message oMsg = null;

            try
            {
                oRSUsuarios = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                switch (tipoAlerta)
                {
                    case TipoAlerta.CrearCementerio:
                        cons.getUsuariosDeAlerta("19", oRSUsuarios);
                        break;
                }

                if (oRSUsuarios.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    int i = 0;
                    oCS = SBOCompany.GetCompanyService();
                    oMS = (SAPbobsCOM.MessagesService)oCS.GetBusinessService(ServiceTypes.MessagesService);
                    oMsg = (SAPbobsCOM.Message)oMS.GetDataInterface(MessagesServiceDataInterfaces.msdiMessage);
                    oMsg.Subject = "Alerta Servicio Funerario - Creacion de Cementerio";
                    if (!NroDocumento.Equals(""))
                        oMsg.Text = " Validar : " + oRSUsuarios.Fields.Item("U_Mensaje").Value.ToString() + " Nro Documento: " + NroDocumento + " Formulario: " + Formulario;
                    oMsg.Priority = BoMsgPriorities.pr_High;

                    while (!oRSUsuarios.EoF)
                    {
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Add();
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).SendInternal = BoYesNoEnum.tYES;
                        oMsg.RecipientCollection.Item(i).UserCode = DevolverItemEnTabla("OUSR", "USER_CODE", "USERID", oRSUsuarios.Fields.Item("U_Usuario").Value.ToString(), SBOCompany);
                        i++;
                        oRSUsuarios.MoveNext();
                    }
                    oMS.SendMessage(oMsg);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC018", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (oRSUsuarios != null)
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oRSUsuarios);
            }
        }

            }

        }
