                                        string DocEntryAnterior = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.ToString();

                                        if (tiposolicitud.Equals("B"))
                                        {
                                            bool esCotización = esCotizaciónContratoOSFAnterior(sapCompany, sapApplication, DocEntryAnterior, strPath);
                                            if (!esCotización)
                                                docEntrysolicitudServicio = DocEntryAnterior;
                                        }
                                        #endregion

                                        string DocNumS = string.Empty;
                                        bool existe = existeCancelacionSalidaMercancia(sapCompany, docEntrysolicitudServicio, lineaS, itemCodeS, strPath, ref DocNumS, entrySalidaMercancia);
                                        if (!existe)
                                        {
                                            salidaInv.Lines.SetCurrentLine(i);
                                            //if (salidaInv.Lines.ItemCode.Equals(articulo))
                                            //{
                                            lineID = salidaInv.Lines.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_linea").Value.ToString().Trim();
                                            entradaInv.Lines.ItemCode = salidaInv.Lines.ItemCode;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.UserFields.Fields.Item("U_linea").Value = lineID;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.ItemDescription = salidaInv.Lines.ItemDescription;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.Quantity = salidaInv.Lines.Quantity;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.WarehouseCode = salidaInv.Lines.WarehouseCode;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.AccountCode = salidaInv.Lines.AccountCode;

                                            #region salida de articulos Manejados por serie
                                            Almacen = salidaInv.Lines.WarehouseCode;
                                            #endregion

                                            entradaInv.Lines.UnitPrice = ConsultarCostoArticuloSalida(SBOCompany, docSalida, salidaInv.Lines.ItemCode);
                                            entradaInv.Lines.ProjectCode = salidaInv.Lines.ProjectCode;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode = salidaInv.Lines.CostingCode;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode2 = salidaInv.Lines.CostingCode2;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode3 = salidaInv.Lines.CostingCode3;
                                            entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode4 = salidaInv.Lines.CostingCode4;

                                            entradaInv.Lines.Add();
                                            lineasOK++;

                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(" La cancelacion de la salida de inventario ya se realizo con la entrada Nro. " + DocNumS + "\n para el articulo " + itemCodeS + " en la linea :  " + lineaS);
                                            mensaje = " La cancelacion de la salida de inventario ya se realizo con la entrada Nro. " + DocNumS + " para el articulo " + itemCodeS + " en la linea :  " + lineaS;

                                            errores++;
                                        }

                                        #endregion
                                    }
                                }
                                #endregion

                                #region asignar el numero en comentarios
                                // retornar el DocNum de la salida que esta cancelando par que el usuario tenga la trazabilidad de los documentos
                                string DocNum = "";
                                if (!docSalida.Equals(""))
                                    DocNum = ServicioFunerario.RetornarDocNumSalidaMercancia(SBOCompany, docSalida);
                                if (!DocNum.Equals(""))
                                    entradaInv.Comments = "Cancelación de la salida de mercancía N°: " + DocNum + "";
                                else
                                    entradaInv.Comments = "Cancelación de la salida de mercancía N°: " + docSalida + "";
                                #endregion

                                #region add salida de inventario

                                if (lineasOK > 0)
                                {

                                    int valor = entradaInv.Add();
                                    // if (entradaInv.Add() != 0)
                                    if (valor != 0)
                                    {
                                        SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la salida de mercancía. Error: " + SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "OK", "", "");
                                        error = true;
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        #region  exito salida inventario
                                        string numdoc = SBOCompany.GetNewObjectKey();//obtengo el numero de entrada recien creada
                                        if (!sucursalInt.Equals(0))
                                            iBranch = sucursalInt;
                                        GenerarAsientoReversionCostoInventario(docSalida, entradaInv, entradaInv.Lines.ProjectCode, entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode, entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode2, entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode3, entradaInv.Lines.CostingCode4, strPath, SBOCompany, iBranch);

                                        oForm.Freeze(true);
                                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Editable = true;

                                        int indiceE = 1;
                                        for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                        {
                                            if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_docS").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value.Equals(docSalida))
                                            {
                                                //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_Documento", i - 1, "");
                                                //oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").SetValue("U_DescDoc", i - 1, "");
                                                ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_docS").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = string.Empty;
                                                ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Checked = false;

                                                indiceE++;
                                            }
                                        }


                                        oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

                                        try
                                        {
                                            oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Editable = false;
                                        }
                                        catch { }
                                        oForm.Freeze(false);

                                        oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                        oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);

                                        SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Se ha creado exitosamente la cancelación de salida de mercancía no. " + numdoc + ".", BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Success);

                                        #endregion
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (errores == 0)
                                        SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la salida de mercancía. no hay lineas para registrar", 1, "OK", "", "");

                                    else
                                        SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la salida de mercancía. Error: " + mensaje, 1, "OK", "", "");
                                }

                                #endregion

                                #endregion
                            }
                        }

                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC030", SBOCompany);

            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
            return error;

        }

        public static void inhabilitarCeldasDocumentosDerechos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            bool ordenCompra = false;
            bool salidaMercancia = false;
            bool cancel = false;
            int opcion = 0;
            string orden = "";
            string SalidaMercancia = "";
            string cancelado = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_AUXILIO");
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = omtx.CommonSetting;
                while (indice < tope)
                {
                    cancel = false;
                    orden = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docOrd", indice).Trim();
                    SalidaMercancia = oDBS1.GetValue("U_docSalInv", indice).Trim();
                    cancelado = oDBS1.GetValue("U_AuxCanc", indice).Trim();
                    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    if (!orden.Equals(""))
                        ordenCompra = true;
                    if (!SalidaMercancia.Equals(""))
                        salidaMercancia = true;
                    if (cancelado.Equals("Y"))
                        cancel = true;
                    //--------------------------------------------------------------------------

                    if (ordenCompra || salidaMercancia || cancel)
                    {
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 12, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 13, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 14, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 15, false);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 16, false);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 1, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 5, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 8, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 10, true);
                        omtx.CommonSetting.SetCellEditable(indice + 1, 11, true);

                    }



                    ordenCompra = false;
                    salidaMercancia = false;
                    opcion = 0;

                    indice++;
                }
            }
            catch { oForm.Freeze(false); }
            finally { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        public void cancelarOrdenDerechos(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, Form oForm, int fila)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_AUXILIO");
            SAPbobsCOM.Documents oOrden = null;
            oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
            try
            {
                if ((fila >= 0) && (fila <= oMatrix.RowCount))
                {
                    string docOrden = oDBS.GetValue("U_docOrd", fila - 1).Trim();
                    string docEntry = oDBS.GetValue("DocEntry", fila - 1).Trim();
                    if (docEntry.Equals(""))
                        docEntry = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString();



                    if (!docOrden.Equals(""))
                    {
                        oOrden = (Documents)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oPurchaseOrders);  // orden Compra
                        oOrden.GetByKey(int.Parse(docOrden));
                        string DocNumOC = oOrden.DocNum.ToString();
                        oOrden.Comments = "Se cancela la orden Nro." + DocNumOC + " [" + docOrden + "]. Cancelado por el servicio Funerario. N°: " + docEntry;

                        //string lineID = oDBS.GetValue("LineId", fila - 1).Trim();
                        string lineID = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim();
                        // if (lineID.Equals(""))
                        //     lineID = ServicioFunerario.RetornarLineIdMatrixElementos(SBOCompany, ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString(), fila);

                        if (!docEntry.Equals("") && !lineID.Equals(""))
                        {
                            string itemCode = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_item").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            string idsocio = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_prov").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;

                            #region solucion error basado en  contrato activo antyerior con documentos asociados a esa orden
                            string tiposolicitud = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("19").Specific).Value.ToString();
                            string DocEntryAnterior = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.ToString();

                            if (tiposolicitud.Equals("B"))
                            {
                                bool esCotización = esCotizaciónContratoOSFAnterior(sapCompany, sapApplication, DocEntryAnterior, strPath);
                                if (!esCotización)
                                    docEntry = DocEntryAnterior;
                            }
                            #endregion

                            string strDocNumOrdenCompra = "";
                            bool existeOrdenCompra = ExisteOrdenCompraDerecho(SBOCompany, docEntry, lineID, itemCode, idsocio, ref strDocNumOrdenCompra);

                            if (existeOrdenCompra && oMatrix.IsRowSelected(fila))
                            {
                                int exito = oOrden.Cancel();
                                if (exito != 0)
                                {
                                    SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la orden. Error: " + SBOCompany.GetLastErrorDescription(), 1, "OK", "", "");
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                                    oForm.Freeze(true);
                                    oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Editable = true;

                                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                                    {
                                        if (oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_AUXILIO").GetValue("U_docOrd", i - 1).Trim().Equals(docOrden))
                                        {
                                            lineID = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", i - 1).Trim();
                                            ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_docO").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value = "";
                                            ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Checked = false;

                                            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                                            string query = "UPDATE \"@OK1_SF_AUXILIO\" SET \"U_docOrd\" = '',\"U_AuxCanc\" = 'N' WHERE \"DocEntry\" = " + ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString() + " AND \"U_IdLinea\" = " + lineID + "";
                                            oRS.DoQuery(query);
                                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
                                        }
                                    }
                                    oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                                    try
                                    {
                                        oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Editable = false;
                                    }
                                    catch { }
                                    oForm.Freeze(false);

                                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                                    SBOApplication.MessageBox(" Se cancela la orden Nro. " + DocNumOC + " [ " + docOrden + " ]. ", 1, "OK", "", "");
                                }
                            }
                            else
                                SBOApplication.MessageBox("No se pudo cancelar la orden : " + DocNumOC);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC030", SBOCompany);

            }
            finally
            {
                //OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }

        public void enviarAlertaDerechosRegistrados(Form oForm, bool esCotiza)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            string alertaEnviada = "", LineId = "", series = "", docnum = "", der = "";
            oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_0").Specific;
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_AUXILIO");
            oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

            if (!esCotiza)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < oDBS.Size; i++)
                {
                    alertaEnviada = oDBS.GetValue("U_alertaEnv", i).Trim();
                    der = oDBS.GetValue("U_Codigo", i).Trim();
                    if (!alertaEnviada.Equals("Y") && !der.Equals(""))
                    {
                        LineId = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", i).Trim();

                        series = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("Series", 0);
                        docnum = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocNum", 0);
                        enviarAlerta(ServicioFunerario.TipoAlerta.RegistroDerecho, "", docnum, "Se registro el derecho: " + der + " en la línea " + LineId + "");
                        oDBS.SetValue("U_alertaEnv", i, "Y");
                        actualizarEnvioAlertaDerecho(oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0), LineId);

                    }
                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSourceEx();
            }
        }

        private void actualizarEnvioAlertaDerecho(string nOSF, string LineId)
        {
            string strQry = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            try
            {
                strQry = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "actualizarEnvioAlertaDerecho", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%nOSF%", nOSF);
                strQry = strQry.Replace("%LineId%", LineId);

                ors.DoQuery(strQry);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "actualizarEnvioAlertaDerecho", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }



        public string verificaArticulosNoRegistrados(Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication)
        {
            int indice = 0;
            int tope = 0;
            string itemCode = "";
            string elemCode = "";
            string idLinea = "";
            string renuncia = "";
            string mensaje = "";


            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix omtx = null;
            try
            {
                oDBS1 = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                omtx = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                omtx.FlushToDataSource();
                tope = omtx.RowCount;
                while (indice < tope)
                {
                    elemCode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Codigo", indice).Trim();
                    itemCode = oDBS1.GetValue("U_ItemCode", indice).Trim();
                    idLinea = oDBS1.GetValue("U_IdLinea", indice).Trim();
                    renuncia = oDBS1.GetValue("U_Renuncia", indice).Trim();

                    if (itemCode.Equals("") && !renuncia.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        mensaje = "Existen articulos pendientes de registrar. No se puede cambiar el estado del documento. Elemento: " + elemCode + ", Línea: " + idLinea + "";
                        break;
                    }
                    indice++;
                }

                if (!mensaje.Equals(string.Empty))
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText(mensaje, BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

            }
            catch { }
            return mensaje;
        }

        public void crearClienteServicioTitular(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string titular)
        {

            string documento = "", tipoDoc = "", pnombre = "", snombre = "", papellido = "", sapellido = "", departamento = "";
            string municipio = "", barrio = "", tipoVivienda = "", estrato = "", genero = "", fechaNac = "", telefono = "", celular = "";
            string estCivil = "", ocupacion = "", email = "", direccion1 = "", direccion2 = "", direccion3 = "", direccion4 = "", direccion5 = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners oBp = (SAPbobsCOM.BusinessPartners)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.oBusinessPartners);

            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox ocmb = null;
            string cardCode = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("5").Specific).Value;
            string[] nombre;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset orsTitu = null;

            titular = titular.Replace("C", "");
            orsTitu = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            orsTitu.DoQuery("SELECT * FROM \"@OK1_EXE_TITUBENF\" WHERE \"U_Contratante\" = 'Y' AND \"Code\" = '" + titular + "'");

            documento = orsTitu.Fields.Item("Code").Value.ToString();
            tipoDoc = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_tipoDoc").Value.ToString();
            pnombre = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_pnom").Value.ToString();
            snombre = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_snom").Value.ToString();
            papellido = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_papell").Value.ToString();
            sapellido = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_sapell").Value.ToString();
            departamento = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_codDept").Value.ToString();
            municipio = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_codMun").Value.ToString();
            barrio = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_barrio").Value.ToString();
            tipoVivienda = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_tipoViv").Value.ToString();
            estrato = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_estrat").Value.ToString();
            genero = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_gener").Value.ToString();
            fechaNac = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_fecNac").Value.ToString()), sapApplication);
            telefono = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_tel").Value.ToString();
            celular = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_cel").Value.ToString();
            estCivil = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_estCiv").Value.ToString();
            ocupacion = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_ocup").Value.ToString();
            email = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_email").Value.ToString();
            direccion1 = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_dir1").Value.ToString();
            direccion2 = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_dir2").Value.ToString();
            direccion3 = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_dir3").Value.ToString();
            direccion4 = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_dir4").Value.ToString();
            direccion5 = orsTitu.Fields.Item("U_dir5").Value.ToString();


            try
            {

                oForm.Freeze(true);
                SAPbouiCOM.EditText oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("6").Specific;
                oedt.Value = papellido;
                oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("22").Specific;
                oedt.Value = sapellido;
                oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("23").Specific;
                oedt.Value = pnombre;
                oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("24").Specific;
                oedt.Value = snombre;
                oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("18").Specific;
                oedt.Value = telefono;
                oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("36").Specific;
                oedt.Value = celular;
                oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("38").Specific;
                oedt.Value = email;
                oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("txBarrio").Specific;
                oedt.Value = barrio;
                oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("8").Specific;
                oedt.Value = fechaNac;

                if (!tipoDoc.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbTipDoc").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(tipoDoc.ToString(), BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!departamento.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbDepto").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(departamento, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!municipio.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbMunic").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(municipio, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!ocupacion.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbOcup").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(ocupacion, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!tipoVivienda.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("11").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(tipoVivienda, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }

                if (!estrato.Equals("") && !estrato.Equals("0"))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("7").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(estrato, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!estCivil.ToString().Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbEstCiv").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(estCivil, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!genero.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbGener").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(genero, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!direccion1.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbDir1").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(direccion1, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!direccion2.Equals(""))
                {
                    oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("27").Specific;
                    oedt.Value = direccion2;
                }
                if (!direccion3.Equals(""))
                {
                    oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("25").Specific;
                    oedt.Value = direccion3;
                }
                if (!direccion4.Equals(""))
                {
                    ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cbDir2").Specific;
                    ocmb.Select(direccion4, BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);
                }
                if (!direccion5.ToString().Equals(""))
                {
                    oedt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("17").Specific;
                    oedt.Value = direccion5;
                }

                ocmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("cmdTipClie").Specific;
                ocmb.Select("C", BoSearchKey.psk_ByValue);


                oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("D_DATE2").ValueEx = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(DateTime.Now, SBOApplication);



            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC001", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {

                oForm.Items.Item("6").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                oForm.Items.Item("cmdTipClie").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("5").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }

        }

        public static bool RetornaCantArticulosIgualesOL_OT(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string DocEntrySF, string DocEntrySM, string Linea, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string strCant = string.Empty;
            int cant = 0;
            bool existe = false;
            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "RetornaCantArticulosIgualesOL_OT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%DocEntrySF%", DocEntrySF);
                query = query.Replace("%DocEntrySM%", DocEntrySM);
                query = query.Replace("%Linea%", Linea);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    strCant = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    try
                    {
                        cant = Convert.ToInt32(strCant);
                        if (cant > 0)
                            existe = true;
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "RetornaCantArticulosIgualesOL_OT", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Agregar código de verificación en la creación de SN.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="CardCode"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private string AgregarDigitoDeVerificacion(string CardCode)
        {

            string strQry = "";
            string digito = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ors = (Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);


            try
            {
                strQry = "SELECT \"OK_RCMM8\" (" + CardCode + ") FROM DUMMY";
                ors.DoQuery(strQry);

                digito = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();

                CardCode = CardCode + "-" + digito;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "AgregarDigitoDeVerificacion", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return CardCode;
        }

        /// <summary>Valida si el tipo de servicio asignado permite duplicidad.</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="oForm">Form OSF</param>
        /// <param name="path">Ruta</param>
        /// <returns>True NO permite duplicidad</returns>
        public bool permiteDuplicidad(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string path)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;
            try
            {

                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(path + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "servicioPermiteDuplicidad", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("80").Specific;

                if (oCombo.Selected != null)
                {
                    string codeTipoServicio = oCombo.Selected.Value.ToString().Trim();

                    query = query.Replace("%Code%", codeTipoServicio);

                    oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                    if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                    {

                        if (oRecordSet.Fields.Item("U_PermDuplicidad").Value.ToString().Equals("N"))
                        {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }

                }
                else
                {
                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Debe diligenciar el campo 'Tipo servicio' para continuar con la verificacion de duplicidad", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                    sapApplication.MessageBox("Debe diligenciar el campo 'Tipo servicio' para continuar con la verificacion de duplicidad", 1, "Aceptar", "", "");

                }


                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error verificando duplicidad.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                sapApplication.MessageBox("Error verificando duplicidad.", 1, "Aceptar", "Cancelar", "");

                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }


        }


        /// <summary>Verifica existencia del usuario en una OSF </summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario SAP</param>
        /// <param name="path">Ruta</param>
        /// <returns>True en caso de existir un usuario</returns>
        public bool existeIdFallecidoOSF(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string path)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {
                if (validacionSerieOSF(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, path))
                {
                    oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                    string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(path + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "verificarDuplicidadIDFallecido", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    string ID = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("43").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                    query = query.Replace("%ID%", ID);
                    oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                    if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        //Valida si el tipo de servicio permite duplicidad.
                        if (permiteDuplicidad(sapCompany, sapApplication, oForm, path))
                        {
                            sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("El ser querido con numero de identificacion: " + ID + " ya se encuentra registrado en la OSF con No. interno: " + oRecordSet.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString()
                                                             + " y el tipo de servicio NO permite duplicidad.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Warning);

                            sapApplication.MessageBox("El ser querido con numero de identificacion: " + ID + " ya se encuentra registrado en la OSF con No. interno: " + oRecordSet.Fields.Item("DocEntry").Value.ToString()
                                                      + " y el tipo de servicio NO permite duplicidad.", 1, "Aceptar", "", "");

                            return true;

                        }
                    }
                }

                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Error verificando duplicidad.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                sapApplication.MessageBox("Error verificando duplicidad.", 1, "Aceptar", "Cancelar", "");

                return false;
            }
            finally
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);

            }

        }

        /// <summary>Valida que la serie del formulario sea de tipo OSF</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="sapApplication">Aplicacion SAP</param>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario SAP</param>
        /// <param name="path">Ruta</param>
        /// <returns>True si es de tipo OSF</returns>
        public bool validacionSerieOSF(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application sapApplication, SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string path)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {
                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(path + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "obtenerSerieOSF", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                string sede = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("EdVSede").Specific).Value.ToString();

                if (!sede.Equals(""))
                {
                    SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCombo = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("92").Specific;

                    if (!oCombo.Value.Equals(""))
                    {
                        string serie = oCombo.Value.ToString().Trim();

                        query = query.Replace("%Sede%", sede);

                        oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                        if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                        {

                            if (oRecordSet.Fields.Item("U_serieOrdenSF").Value.ToString().Equals(serie))
                            {
                                return true;
                            }

                        }

                    }
                    else
                    {

                        sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Debe seleccionar una serie para continuar.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                        sapApplication.MessageBox("Debe seleccionar una serie para continuar.", 1, "Aceptar", "Cancelar", "");

                    }
                }
                else
                {

                    sapApplication.StatusBar.SetText("Debe seleccionar una sede para continuar.", BoMessageTime.bmt_Short, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);

                    sapApplication.MessageBox("Debe seleccionar una sede para continuar.", 1, "Aceptar", "Cancelar", "");

                }
                return false;

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }



        /// <summary>
        /// Vincular Orden de Traslado
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public void vincularOrdenTraslado(Form oForm)
        {

            SAPbouiCOM.Grid oGrid = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Form oFormLlamada = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            int fila = 0;
            string nOT = "", strQuery = "", idLinea = "", mensaje = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;

            try
            {


                oGrid = (SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_1").Specific;
                fila = oGrid.Rows.SelectedRows.Item(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                nOT = oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Nº Orden").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString();

                oGrid = (SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_2").Specific;
                fila = oGrid.Rows.SelectedRows.Item(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                idLinea = oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Id Linea").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString();

                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "vincularOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nOSF%", ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("nroOSF").Specific).Value.ToString());
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nOT%", nOT);
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                string uniqueform = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("uniform").Specific).Value.ToString();
                oForm.Close();

                oFormLlamada = SBOApplication.Forms.Item(uniqueform);

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oFormLlamada.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

                for (fila = 1; fila <= oMatrix.RowCount; fila++)
                {
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value.Equals(idLinea))
                    {
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_ordTrs", nOT);
                        //oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(i, "col_Uso", "Y");
                        bool uso = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_Uso").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Checked;
                        if (!uso)
                        {
                            bool renuncia = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_Renun").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Checked;
                            if (!renuncia)
                            {
                                #region marcar el uso
                                string NrocontratoPrenecesidad = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NrocontratoPrenecesidad))
                                {

                                    bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = ServicioFunerario.MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablePorLinea(oFormLlamada, SBOCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, SBOApplication, strPath, true);
                                    if (!ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                    {
                                        SAPbobsCOM.Items oItemArt = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                                        oItemArt.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific)).Value);
                                        if ((oItemArt.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                                        {
                                            string tipoLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                            bool puedeMarcar = false;
                                            puedeMarcar = !tipoLinea.Equals('B') && !tipoLinea.Equals('P');

                                            if (puedeMarcar)
                                            {
                                                oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                                #region Agregar mensaje de Historico
                                                reportarInconsistencia(oFormLlamada, "Se marcó el uso de la línea: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");
                                                #endregion
                                            }

                                        }

                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    #region marcar uso en otros contratos
                                    SAPbobsCOM.Items oItemArt = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                                    oItemArt.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific)).Value);
                                    if ((oItemArt.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                                    {
                                        string tipoLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                        bool puedeMarcar = false;
                                        puedeMarcar = !tipoLinea.Equals('B') && !tipoLinea.Equals('P');

                                        if (puedeMarcar)
                                        {
                                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_Uso", "Y");

                                            #region Agregar mensaje de Historico
                                            reportarInconsistencia(oFormLlamada, "se Marca el uso de la línea: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");
                                            #endregion

                                        }

                                    }
                                    #endregion


                                }

                                #endregion
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (oFormLlamada.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                {
                    reportarInconsistencia(oFormLlamada, "Se ha vinculado la orden de traslado: " + nOT + ".");
                    oFormLlamada.Items.Item("tab_8").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                    oFormLlamada.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                    oFormLlamada.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC010", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
        }


        public void desvincularOrdenTraslado(Form oForm, string nOT, string strPath)
        {
            string strQuery = "", mensaje = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;

            try
            {
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

                for (int fila = 1; fila <= oMatrix.RowCount; fila++)
                {
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_ordTrs").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value.Equals(nOT))
                    {
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_ordTrs", "");

                        bool uso = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_Uso").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Checked;
                        if (uso)
                        {
                            string NrocontratoPrenecesidad = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NrocontratoPrenecesidad))
                            {

                                bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = ServicioFunerario.DES_MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablePorLinea(oForm, SBOCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, SBOApplication, strPath, true);
                                if (!ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                {
                                    #region Agregar mensaje de Historico
                                    reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Se desmarcó el uso de la línea: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");
                                    #endregion
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                SAPbobsCOM.Items oItemArt = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                                oItemArt.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific)).Value);
                                if ((oItemArt.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                                {
                                    string tipoLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                    bool puedeMarcar = false;
                                    puedeMarcar = !tipoLinea.Equals('B') && !tipoLinea.Equals('P');

                                    if (puedeMarcar)
                                    {
                                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_Uso", "N");
                                        #region Agregar mensaje de Historico
                                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Se desmarcó el uso de la línea: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");
                                        #endregion


                                    }

                                }

                            }
                        }


                    }

                }

                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "desvincularOT", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nOSF%", DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_PARAM", "U_NoSFTrasDirec", "Code", "SETUP", SBOCompany));
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nOT%", nOT);
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                {
                    reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Se ha desvinculado la orden de traslado: " + nOT + ".");
                    oForm.Items.Item("tab_8").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC010", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
        }



        /// <summary>
        /// Vincular Orden de Laboratorio
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public void vincularOrdenLaboratorio(Form oForm)
        {

            SAPbouiCOM.Grid oGrid = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.Form oFormLlamada = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;
            int fila = 0;
            string nOL = "", strQuery = "", mensaje = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            ArrayList listIdLine = new ArrayList();

            try
            {


                oGrid = (SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_1").Specific;
                fila = oGrid.Rows.SelectedRows.Item(0, BoOrderType.ot_SelectionOrder);
                nOL = oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Nº Orden").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString();

                oGrid = (SAPbouiCOM.Grid)oForm.Items.Item("grid_2").Specific;
                for (fila = 0; fila < oGrid.DataTable.Rows.Count; fila++)
                {
                    listIdLine.Add(oGrid.DataTable.Columns.Item("Id Linea").Cells.Item(fila).Value.ToString());
                }


                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "vincularOL", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nOSF%", ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("nroOSF").Specific).Value.ToString());
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nDocNumOSF%", DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD", "DocNum", "DocEntry", ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("nroOSF").Specific).Value.ToString(), SBOCompany));
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nOL%", nOL);
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                string uniqueform = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("uniform").Specific).Value.ToString();
                oForm.Close();

                oFormLlamada = SBOApplication.Forms.Item(uniqueform);
                oFormLlamada.Freeze(true);
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oFormLlamada.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

                foreach (string idLinea in listIdLine)
                {
                    for (fila = 1; fila <= oMatrix.RowCount; fila++)
                    {
                        if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value.Equals(idLinea))
                        {
                            oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_ordLab", nOL);
                            //oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(i, "col_Uso", "Y");
                            bool uso = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_Uso").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Checked;
                            if (!uso)
                            {
                                bool renuncia = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_Renun").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Checked;
                                if (!renuncia)
                                {
                                    string codArticulo = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;

                                    #region marcar el uso
                                    string NrocontratoPrenecesidad = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NrocontratoPrenecesidad))
                                    {

                                        bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = ServicioFunerario.MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablePorLinea(oFormLlamada, SBOCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, SBOApplication, strPath, true);
                                        if (!ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                        {
                                            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItemArt = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                                            oItemArt.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific)).Value);
                                            if ((oItemArt.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                                            {
                                                string tipoLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                                bool puedeMarcar = false;
                                                puedeMarcar = !tipoLinea.Equals('B') && !tipoLinea.Equals('P');

                                                if (puedeMarcar)
                                                {
                                                    oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                                    MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablesOL(SBOCompany, nOL, codArticulo, strPath);
                                                    #region Agregar mensaje de Historico
                                                    reportarInconsistencia(oFormLlamada, "Se marcó el uso de la línea: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");
                                                    #endregion
                                                }

                                            }

                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            SAPbobsCOM.Items oItemArt = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                                            oItemArt.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific)).Value);
                                            if (existe_ElementosUsadosOL(SBOCompany, nOL, codArticulo, strPath) && oItemArt.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tYES)
                                            {
                                                oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                                reportarInconsistencia(oFormLlamada, "Se marcó el uso de la línea: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");

                                            }

                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        #region marcar uso en otros contratos
                                        SAPbobsCOM.Items oItemArt = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                                        oItemArt.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific)).Value);
                                        if ((oItemArt.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                                        {
                                            string tipoLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                            bool puedeMarcar = false;
                                            puedeMarcar = !tipoLinea.Equals('B') && !tipoLinea.Equals('P');

                                            if (puedeMarcar)
                                            {
                                                oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                                MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablesOL(SBOCompany, nOL, codArticulo, strPath);
                                                #region Agregar mensaje de Historico
                                                reportarInconsistencia(oFormLlamada, "se Marca el uso de la línea: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");
                                                #endregion

                                            }

                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            if (existe_ElementosUsadosOL(SBOCompany, nOL, codArticulo, strPath)) ;
                                            {
                                                oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_Uso", "Y");
                                                reportarInconsistencia(oFormLlamada, "Se marcó el uso de la línea: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oFormLlamada.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");

                                            }

                                        }
                                        #endregion


                                    }
                                    #endregion
                                }
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }


                }


                if (oFormLlamada.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                {
                    reportarInconsistencia(oFormLlamada, "Se ha vinculado la orden de laboratorio: " + nOL + ".");
                    oFormLlamada.Items.Item("tab_8").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                    oFormLlamada.Items.Item("tab_8_4").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                    oFormLlamada.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                    oFormLlamada.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC010", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                oFormLlamada.Freeze(false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
        }


        public void desvincularOrdenLaboratorio(Form oForm, string nOL, string strPath)
        {
            string strQuery = "", mensaje = "";
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRS = null;

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();

                for (int fila = 1; fila <= oMatrix.RowCount; fila++)
                {
                    if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_ordLab").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value.Equals(nOL))
                    {
                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_ordLab", "");

                        bool uso = ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_Uso").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Checked;
                        if (uso)
                        {
                            string NrocontratoPrenecesidad = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_contr").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NrocontratoPrenecesidad))
                            {

                                bool ErroractualizarUsoLinea = ServicioFunerario.DES_MarcarUsoElementosNoInventariablePorLinea(oForm, SBOCompany, ref mensaje, fila - 1, SBOApplication, strPath, true);
                                if (!ErroractualizarUsoLinea)
                                {
                                    #region Agregar mensaje de Historico
                                    reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Se desmarcó el uso de la línea: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");
                                    #endregion
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                SAPbobsCOM.Items oItemArt = (SAPbobsCOM.Items)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.oItems);
                                oItemArt.GetByKey(((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)(oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_2").Cells.Item(fila).Specific)).Value);
                                if ((oItemArt.InventoryItem == BoYesNoEnum.tNO))
                                {
                                    string tipoLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("coltLinea").Cells.Item(fila).Specific).Value;
                                    bool puedeMarcar = false;
                                    puedeMarcar = !tipoLinea.Equals('B') && !tipoLinea.Equals('P');

                                    if (puedeMarcar)
                                    {
                                        oMatrix.SetCellWithoutValidation(fila, "col_Uso", "N");
                                        #region Agregar mensaje de Historico
                                        reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Se desmarcó el uso de la línea: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_IdLinea", fila - 1).Trim() + ".  Elemento: " + oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_Codigo", fila - 1).Trim() + "");
                                        #endregion


                                    }

                                }

                            }
                        }


                    }

                }

                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "desvincularOL", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%nOL%", nOL);
                oRS = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRS.DoQuery(strQuery);

                if (oForm.Mode == BoFormMode.fm_OK_MODE)
                {
                    reportarInconsistencia(oForm, "Se ha desvinculado la orden de laboratorio: " + nOL + ".");
                    oForm.Items.Item("tab_8").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                    oForm.Items.Item("tab_8_4").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                    oForm.Mode = BoFormMode.fm_UPDATE_MODE;
                    oForm.Items.Item("1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC010", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                oForm.Freeze(false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRS);
            }
        }



        public string devolverGestionPreciosPlan(Form oForm, string strpath)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD");
            string code = "";
            string idContrato = oDBS.GetValue("U_NumContr", 0).Trim();
            string idConvenio = oDBS.GetValue("U_conve", 0).Trim();
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), SBOCompany);

            if ((!idContrato.Equals("") || !idConvenio.Equals("")) && prenec.Equals("N"))
            {
                if (!idContrato.Equals(""))
                    idConvenio = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_CONTR_HEAD", "U_conve", "DocEntry", idContrato, SBOCompany);
                string idPlan = oDBS.GetValue("U_CodPlan", 0).Trim();

                string planBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_planBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
                if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                    idPlan = planBase;

                string esPlanBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_esPlanBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
                if (esPlanBase.Equals("Y"))
                    planBase = idPlan;

                string idPlanEqui = oDBS.GetValue("U_codPlanEquiv", 0).Trim();
                if (!idPlanEqui.Equals(""))
                {
                    idPlan = idPlanEqui;
                    planBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_planBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);

                    esPlanBase = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_PLAN_HEAD", "U_esPlanBase", "Code", idPlan, SBOCompany);
                    if (esPlanBase.Equals("Y"))
                        planBase = idPlan;

                    if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                        idPlan = planBase;
                }

                string fecha = "";
                if (((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value.Equals(""))
                    fecha = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("7").Specific).Value;
                else
                    fecha = OK1.SBO.Helpers.FechaFormateadaAsAAAAMMDD(Convert.ToDateTime(DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD", "U_FechaSol", "DocEntry", ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("71").Specific).Value, SBOCompany)), SBOApplication);


                if (!planBase.Equals(""))
                    idConvenio = "";

                string sLine = getLineaPrecioConvenio(idConvenio, idPlan, fecha, ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("EdNivS").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim(), ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oForm.Items.Item("ckConvPart").Specific).Checked, strpath);

                if (idConvenio.Equals(""))
                    code = idPlan.Trim() + "-" + sLine.Trim();
                else
                    code = idConvenio.Trim() + "-" + idPlan.Trim() + "-" + sLine.Trim();


            }

            return code;

        }



        public void cargarElementosCambioPlan(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string strPath, ref bool calcularPrecio)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrixElementos;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRSElementos = null, oRSItem = null, oRSElementosAd = null;
            string idContrato = "", almacen = "", nArticulo = "", articulo = "", nomProveedor = "", idConvenio = "", idPlan = "", idSede = "", nOSF = "";
            string idTipoSer;
            string nivelServicio = "";
            int fila = 1, fila2 = 1;
            oMatrixElementos = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
            string prenec = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_TIPOSERVICIO", "U_prenec", "Code", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0).Trim(), ocmp);
            string aplicaVigenciaPreciosXElementos = SETUP_RULE("APLVIGPRECELEM", ocmp);
            bool lineasExcMej = false;
            bool esConvParticular = false;
            ArrayList lineasEliminar = new ArrayList();
            ArrayList lineasAdicionales = new ArrayList();
            SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox oChk = null;

            try
            {

                oForm.Freeze(true);
                oForm.Items.Item("tab_1").Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS = (SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource)oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                oRSElementos = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRSItem = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                oRSElementosAd = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                idTipoSer = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("80").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                nivelServicio = ((SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oForm.Items.Item("EdNivS").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                idSede = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("EdVSede").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                nOSF = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("99").Specific).Value.ToString().Trim();
                oMatrixElementos.FlushToDataSource();

                #region Elementos Convenio
                if (aplicaVigenciaPreciosXElementos.Equals("Y"))
                {

                    #region Eliminar Basico y Componentes
                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrixElementos.RowCount; i++)
                    {
                        string lineID = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", i - 1).Trim();
                        string tipoLinea = oDBS.GetValue("U_tipLinea", i - 1).Trim();

                        if (tipoLinea.Equals("P") || tipoLinea.Equals("B") || tipoLinea.Equals("H"))
                            lineasEliminar.Add(lineID);

                    }

                    foreach (string linea in lineasEliminar)
                    {
                        for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrixElementos.RowCount; i++)
                        {

                            if (linea.Equals(oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", i - 1)))
                            {
                                oDBS.RemoveRecord(i - 1);
                                break;
                            }


                        }
                    }
                    oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();
                    #endregion



                    #region Validar líneas existentes.
                    string codPlan = devolverGestionPreciosPlan(oForm, strPath);

                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrixElementos.RowCount; i++)
                    {
                        string codigo = oDBS.GetValue("U_Codigo", i - 1).Trim();
                        string tipoArt = oDBS.GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", i - 1).Trim();


                        if (!validarElmentoExistentePlan(codigo, codPlan) && (tipoArt.Equals("C") || tipoArt.Equals("M") || tipoArt.Equals("E")))
                        {
                            oDBS.SetValue("U_ArtAdMe", i - 1, "A");
                            lineasAdicionales.Add(i);
                        }
                        else
                        {

                            if (tipoArt.Equals("E") || tipoArt.Equals("M"))
                                lineasExcMej = true;
                        }
                    }
                    oMatrixElementos.LoadFromDataSource();
                    #endregion

                    foreach (int linea in lineasAdicionales)
                    {
                        string codigo = oDBS.GetValue("U_ItemCode", linea - 1).Trim();
                        if (!codigo.Equals(""))
                        {
                            calcularPrecio = true;
                            oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_EsFac").Cells.Item(linea).Click(BoCellClickType.ct_Regular);
                            calcularPrecio = false;
                            oDBS.SetValue("U_EsFactu", linea - 1, "Y");
                            ((SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oMatrixElementos.Columns.Item("col_EsFac").Cells.Item(linea).Specific).Checked = true;
