        public bool validarFacturaPrenecesidad(string nDocFact, string strPath, ref string mensaje, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;
            string nroPrencesidad = "";
            bool valido = true;
            StringBuilder strTransacciones = new StringBuilder();

            try
            {
                nroPrencesidad = DevolverItemEnTabla("OINV", "U_OK1_SF_NPRENEC", "DocEntry", nDocFact, sapCompany);
                if (!nroPrencesidad.Equals(""))
                {
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                    query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "elementosPrencesidadFacturasPosteriores", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                    query = query.Replace("%DocEntryPrenec%", nroPrencesidad);
                    query = query.Replace("%DocEntryFact%", nDocFact);
                    ors.DoQuery(query);

                    if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        strTransacciones.AppendLine("No se puede generar la Nota Crédito. Excepción en la Facturación del Contrato, la Factura generada no es la última para sus elementos vinculados.");
                        while (!ors.EoF)
                        {
                            strTransacciones.AppendLine("Elemento: " + ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString() + ". ");
                            ors.MoveNext();
                        }
                        valido = false;
                        mensaje = strTransacciones.ToString();
                    }



                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "validarFacturaPrenecesidad", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }

            return valido;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Almacena un mensaje que indica alguna condición anormal o validación incorrecta al crear la solicitud de servicio
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Form solicitud de servicio</param>
        /// <param name="descripcion">Mensaje de inconsistencia</param>
        public void reportarInconsistenciaOP(string nOP, string descripcion, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            bool bandera = true;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            string Query = "";
            string lineId = "1";


            try
            {
                if (descripcion.Length > 100)
                    descripcion = descripcion.Substring(0, 100);
                string user = ocmp.UserName;
                lineId = ConsultarLineId(nOP, ocmp);
                // DateTime fecha = DateTime.Now; 
                if (lineId.Equals("1")) //|| lineId.Equals("2")
                {

                    Query = " UPDATE \"@OK1_PQC_OPARHIS_LIN\" SET ";
                    Query = Query + "\"DocEntry\" = '" + nOP + "', ";
                    Query = Query + "\"LineId\" = '" + lineId + "', ";
                    Query = Query + "\"Object\" = 'OK1_PQC_OPARQUE', ";
                    Query = Query + "\"U_Fecha\" =  NOW() , ";
                    Query = Query + "\"U_Hora\" =  CURRENT_TIME , ";
                    Query = Query + "\"U_Descrip\" = '" + descripcion + "', ";
                    Query = Query + "\"U_Usuario\" = '" + user + "' ";
                    Query = Query + " WHERE \"DocEntry\"= '" + nOP + "'  AND \"LineId\" = '" + lineId + "'";
                    ors.DoQuery(Query.ToString());

                }
                else
                {

                    if (lineId.Equals("0"))
                        lineId = "1";

                    Query = "INSERT INTO \"@OK1_PQC_OPARHIS_LIN\" (\"DocEntry\", \"LineId\", \"Object\", \"U_Fecha\",\"U_Hora\",\"U_Descrip\",\"U_Usuario\") VALUES ('" + nOP + "', '" + lineId + "', 'OK1_PQC_OPARQUE', NOW(),'" + DateTime.Now.ToString("HHmm") + "', '" + descripcion + "', '" + user + "')";
                    ors.DoQuery(Query.ToString());
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }


        public string ConsultarLineId(string docEntry, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            string Query = "";
            string lineId = "1";
            try
            {


                Query = "SELECT IFNULL(MAX(\"LineId\"), 1) AS \"Linea\" FROM \"@OK1_PQC_OPARHIS_LIN\" WHERE \"DocEntry\" = '" + docEntry + "'";
                ors.DoQuery(Query.ToString());

                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {

                    lineId = (Convert.ToInt32((ors.Fields.Item("Linea").Value.ToString())) + 1).ToString();
                }



            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return lineId;
        }
        /// <summary>
        ///Muestra en el formulario de contratos los campos creados en la clase de afiliaciones.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oFrm"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <param name="TableName"></param>
        /// <param name="iniciaCampo"></param>
        /// <param name="FromPane"></param>
        /// <param name="ToPane"></param>
        /// <param name="itop"></param>
        /// <param name="ileft1"></param>
        /// <param name="ileft2"></param>
        /// <param name="ileft3"></param>
        /// <param name="ileft4"></param>
        /// <param name="state"></param>
        public static void mostrar_campos_usuario(SAPbouiCOM.Form oFrm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string TableName, string iniciaCampo, int FromPane, int ToPane, int itop, int ileft1, int ileft2, int ileft3, int ileft4, bool state)
        {
            int left1 = 0;
            int left2 = 0;
            int top = 0;
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRs = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRs1 = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            oRs.DoQuery("SELECT \"FieldID\", \"Descr\", \"AliasID\" FROM CUFD WHERE \"TableID\" = '@" + TableName + "' AND SUBSTRING(\"AliasID\", 1, 2) = '" + iniciaCampo + "'");
            int i = 0;
            SAPbouiCOM.StaticText OEST1 = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox Ochk = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox oCmb = null;
            SAPbouiCOM.EditText oEdt = null;
            string bound = null;
            try
            {
                //oFrm.Freeze(true);
                while (oRs.EoF != true)
                {
                    if (i <= 9)
                    {
                        //left1 = 30;
                        //left2 = 160;
                        left1 = ileft1;
                        left2 = ileft2;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (top == 10)
                            top = 0;
                        //left1 = 260;
                        //left2 = 390;
                        left1 = ileft3;
                        left2 = ileft4;
                    }
                    //Validar si tiene valores definidos para ver si es un Checkbox o un combo
                    oFrm.Items.Add("rit_" + i.ToString(), BoFormItemTypes.it_STATIC);
                    oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).FromPane = FromPane;
                    oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).ToPane = ToPane;
                    oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).Top = itop + (top * 15);
                    oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).Left = left1;
                    oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).Visible = true;
                    oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).Width = 100;
                    OEST1 = (SAPbouiCOM.StaticText)oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).Specific;
                    OEST1.Caption = oRs.Fields.Item("Descr").Value.ToString();
                    oRs1.DoQuery("SELECT * FROM UFD1 WHERE \"TableID\" = '@" + TableName + "' AND \"FieldID\" = '" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString() + "'");
                    if (oRs1.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        //Tiene Valores Validos
                        if (oRs1.RecordCount == 2)
                        {
                            string a = null;
                            string b = null;
                            a = oRs1.Fields.Item("FldValue").Value.ToString();
                            oRs1.MoveNext();
                            b = oRs1.Fields.Item("FldValue").Value.ToString();
                            if ((a.Equals("Y") && (b.Equals("N"))) || (a.Equals("N") && (b.Equals("Y"))))
                            {
                                //CheckBox
                                oFrm.Items.Add("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString(), BoFormItemTypes.it_CHECK_BOX);
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).FromPane = FromPane;
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).ToPane = ToPane;
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Top = itop + (top * 15);
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Left = left2;
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Visible = true;
                                Ochk = (SAPbouiCOM.CheckBox)oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Specific;
                                bound = oRs.Fields.Item("AliasID").Value.ToString();
                                Ochk.DataBind.SetBound(true, "@" + TableName + "", "U_" + bound);
                                oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).LinkTo = "ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString();
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                oFrm.Items.Add("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString(), BoFormItemTypes.it_COMBO_BOX);
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).DisplayDesc = true;
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).FromPane = FromPane;
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).ToPane = ToPane;
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Top = itop + (top * 15);
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Left = left2;
                                oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Visible = true;
                                oCmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Specific;
                                bound = oRs.Fields.Item("AliasID").Value.ToString();
                                oCmb.DataBind.SetBound(true, "@" + TableName + "", "U_" + bound);
                                oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).LinkTo = "ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString();
                                //clearValidValues(oCmb);
                                OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(ocmp, oCmb, "SELECT \"FldValue\", \"Descr\" FROM UFD1 WHERE \"TableID\" = '@" + TableName + "' AND \"FieldID\" = '" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString() + "'");
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            oFrm.Items.Add("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString(), BoFormItemTypes.it_COMBO_BOX);
                            oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).DisplayDesc = true;
                            oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).FromPane = FromPane;
                            oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).ToPane = ToPane;
                            oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Top = itop + (top * 15);
                            oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Left = left2;
                            oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Visible = true;
                            oCmb = (SAPbouiCOM.ComboBox)oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Specific;
                            bound = oRs.Fields.Item("AliasID").Value.ToString();
                            oCmb.DataBind.SetBound(true, "@" + TableName + "", "U_" + bound);
                            oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).LinkTo = "ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString();
                            //clearValidValues(oCmb);
                            OK1.SBO.Helpers.addValidValues(ocmp, oCmb, "SELECT \"FldValue\", \"Descr\" FROM UFD1 WHERE \"TableID\" = '@" + TableName + "' AND \"FieldID\" = '" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString() + "'");
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        oFrm.Items.Add("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString(), BoFormItemTypes.it_EDIT);
                        oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).FromPane = FromPane;
                        oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).ToPane = ToPane;
                        oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Top = itop + (top * 15);
                        oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Left = left2;
                        oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Visible = true;
                        oEdt = (SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Specific;
                        bound = oRs.Fields.Item("AliasID").Value.ToString();
                        oEdt.DataBind.SetBound(true, "@" + TableName + "", "U_" + bound);
                        oFrm.Items.Item("rit_" + i.ToString()).LinkTo = "ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString();
                    }
                    oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Enabled = state;
                    oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Width = 150;
                    i++;
                    top++;
                    oRs.MoveNext();
                }
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRs);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRs1);
            }
            //oFrm.Freeze(false);
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Permite habilitar los campos parametrizados en la clase de servicio.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oFrm"></param>
        /// <param name="ocmp"></param>
        /// <param name="TableName"></param>
        /// <param name="iniciaCampo"></param>
        /// <param name="ClsCont"></param>
        public static void habilitarOtrosCampos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oFrm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string TableName, string iniciaCampo, string ClsCont)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRs = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRs1 = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
            string query = "";

            try
            {
                oFrm.Freeze(true);
                query = "SELECT \"FieldID\", \"Descr\", \"AliasID\" FROM CUFD WHERE \"TableID\"= '@" + TableName + "' AND SUBSTRING(\"AliasID\", 1, 2) ='" + iniciaCampo + "'";
                oRs.DoQuery(query);
                //oFrm.Freeze(true);
                while (oRs.EoF != true)
                {
                    string idCampo = "ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString();
                    oFrm.Items.Item(idCampo).Enabled = false;
                    oRs1.DoQuery("SELECT \"LineId\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_CLS_LINES\" WHERE \"U_Campo\" ='" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString() + "' AND  \"Code\"='" + ClsCont + "'");
                    if (oRs1.RecordCount > 0)
                    {
                        oFrm.Items.Item("ritc_" + oRs.Fields.Item("FieldID").Value.ToString()).Enabled = true;
                    }
                    oRs.MoveNext();
                }
                //oFrm.Freeze(false);
            }
            catch { }
            finally
            {
                oFrm.Freeze(false);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRs);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRs1);
            }
        }



        /// <summary>
        /// Según la configuración de clase de contrato realiza las respectivas validaciones.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="msj"></param>
        /// <param name="sapCompany"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public static string validarCamposClaseContrato(Form oForm, ref string msj, string tabla, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, SAPbouiCOM.Application oapp)
        {

            string codClase = "", campo = "";
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

            if (msj.Equals(""))
            {

                try
                {
                    codClase = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_clsOSF", 0).Trim();

                    if (!codClase.Equals(""))
                    {
                        string query = "SELECT \"U_Campo\",\"U_oblig\",\"Descr\" FROM \"@OK1_SF_CLS_LINES\" INNER JOIN CUFD ON \"U_Campo\" = \"FieldID\" WHERE \"TableID\" = '" + tabla + "' AND \"Code\" = '" + codClase + "' AND \"U_oblig\" = 'Y'";
                        ors.DoQuery(query);
                        if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                        {
                            while (!ors.EoF && msj == "")
                            {
                                campo = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oForm.Items.Item("ritc_" + ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString()).Specific).Value;
                                if (campo.Equals(""))
                                    msj = "El campo " + ors.Fields.Item(2).Value.ToString() + " en la pestaña Otros Campos es Obligatorio";

                                ors.MoveNext();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "Exequial", "EXC0001", sapCompany, oapp);
                }
                finally
                {
                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                }
            }
            return msj;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Desvincula información de la orden de servicio en el contrato.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        public void desvincularContratoPrevision(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, string strPath)
        {
            string query = "", idBeneficiario = "";
            string tipoServicio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_TipoSrv", 0);
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;


            if (tipoServicio.Equals("1"))
            {
                idBeneficiario = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdFallec", 0).Trim();
                try
                {
                    ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SBOCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                    ors.DoQuery(query);
                }
                catch { }
                finally
                {

                    OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
                }

            }

        }



        public double Retornar_DescuentoAutorizadoUsuario(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string UserId = string.Empty;
            string query = string.Empty;
            double DescuentoAutorizadoUsuario = 0;
            try
            {
                // usuario Actual
                UserId = sapCompany.UserSignature.ToString().Trim();

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(strPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "PermiteDescuentoUsuario", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%userid%", UserId);

                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    DescuentoAutorizadoUsuario = OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleFromDBDataSource(sapCompany, ors.Fields.Item(0).Value);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addSrvFun", "Retornar_DescuentoAutorizadoUsuario", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return DescuentoAutorizadoUsuario;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Valida el proveedor asociado con el nit de la iglesia en la programacin de exequias.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm"></param>
        /// <param name="sapCompany"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public bool proveedorExequiasCementerioValido(Form oForm, ArrayList elemObli, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, ref string elemento, ref string nitProveedorConfigurado)
        {
            string esExequias = string.Empty;
            string esCementerio = string.Empty;
            string Iglesia = string.Empty;
            string Cementerio = string.Empty;
            string nitProveedor = string.Empty;
            string proveedor = string.Empty;
            bool valido = true;
            string idLinea = "";

            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
            oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;

            for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
            {
                idLinea = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("colLinea").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                if (elemObli.Contains(idLinea))
                {
                    elemento = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_0").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;

                    esExequias = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_ELEPROTECC", "U_ofiRelig", "Code", elemento, sapCompany);
                    esCementerio = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_EXE_ELEPROTECC", "U_cement", "Code", elemento, sapCompany);

                    if (esExequias.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        proveedor = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_4").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                        nitProveedor = DevolverItemEnTabla("OCRD", "LicTradNum", "CardCode", proveedor, sapCompany);
                        Iglesia = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_ELugar", 0).Trim();
                        nitProveedorConfigurado = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_IGLESIAS", "U_Prov", "Code", Iglesia, sapCompany);

                        if (!nitProveedorConfigurado.Equals(""))
                        {
                            if (nitProveedor != nitProveedorConfigurado)
                            {
                                valido = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (esCementerio.Equals("Y"))
                    {
                        proveedor = ((SAPbouiCOM.EditText)oMatrix.Columns.Item("col_4").Cells.Item(i).Specific).Value;
                        nitProveedor = DevolverItemEnTabla("OCRD", "LicTradNum", "CardCode", proveedor, sapCompany);
                        Cementerio = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IUbic", 0).Trim();
                        nitProveedorConfigurado = DevolverItemEnTabla("@OK1_SF_CEMENTERIOS", "U_Nro_Nit", "Code", Cementerio, sapCompany);

                        if (!nitProveedorConfigurado.Equals(""))
                        {
                            if (nitProveedor != nitProveedorConfigurado)
                            {
                                valido = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                }
            }


            return valido;
        }



        public void validarIdLineaRepetidas(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string strPath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string query = string.Empty;

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                    NumerarIdLineasElementos(oForm, sapCompany);

            }

        }

        public static void NumerarIdLineasElementos(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany)
        {
            SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource dslineas;
            SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix;
            string msj = "";

            try
            {
                oForm.Freeze(true);
                dslineas = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");

                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                oMatrix.FlushToDataSource();
                for (int i = 0; i < dslineas.Size; i++)
                {
                    if (!existen_DocumentosCreadosOSLinea(oForm, sapCompany, ref msj, i))
                        dslineas.SetValue("U_IdLinea", i, Convert.ToString(i + 1));

                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            { throw e; }
            finally
            { oForm.Freeze(false); }
        }

        /// <summary>Verifica si la serie de la orden es de tipo Parque Cementerio</summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario OSF</param>
        /// <param name="SapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="Path">Ruta</param>
        /// <returns>True si es de tipo OP</returns>
        public bool SerieCotizacionParqueCementerio(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany, string Path)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {
                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)SapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(Path + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "SerieCotizacionParqueCementerio", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%Sede%", oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_VSede", 0).Trim());
                oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    return false;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "SerieCotizacionParqueCementerio", SapCompany);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Se bloquea o desbloquea la casilla de corregir beneficiario </summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario OSF</param>
        /// <param name="SapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        public static void BloqueoCasillaCorregirBeneficiario(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany)
        {
            try
            {
                List<string> EstadosBloqueo = new List<string> { "10", "11", "13", "3", "4", "6", "8" };

                string EstadoActual = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_Estado", 0).ToString();

                string CheckSolicitanteIgualContratante = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("U_IdemIDCont", 0).ToString();

                if (!EstadosBloqueo.Contains(EstadoActual))
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item("CorBenf").Enabled = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    oForm.Items.Item("CorBenf").Enabled = false;

                }

                oForm.Items.Item("EdIdSol").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("EdNoSol").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("EdTeSol").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("EdDirSol").Enabled = false;
                oForm.Items.Item("EdEmSol").Enabled = false;
                oForm.DataSources.UserDataSources.Item("CorrBenef").Value = "N";

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInExequial", "BloqueoCasillaCorregirBeneficiario", SapCompany);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Bloquea las celdas de la columna elemento que son de tipo cubierto y no adicionales</summary>
        /// <param name="oForm">Formulario OSF</param>
        /// <param name="oMatrix">Matriz lineas de elementos</param>
        /// <param name="SapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        public static void BloqueoCeldasElemento(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix, SAPbobsCOM.Company SapCompany)
        {

            try
            {

                SAPbouiCOM.CommonSetting setting = oMatrix.CommonSetting;

                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                {

                    string TipoArticulo = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_ArtAdMe", i - 1).ToString();
                    string AdicionalCubierto = oForm.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN").GetValue("U_EADCub", i - 1).ToString();

                    if (TipoArticulo.Equals("C") && string.IsNullOrEmpty(AdicionalCubierto))
                    {
                        setting.SetCellEditable(i, 1, false);
                    }

                }


            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "BloqueoCeldasElemento", SapCompany);

            }

        }


        public bool existe_UbicacionAsignadaOP(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string nOSF, string idLineaOSF, ref string documento, string Path)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRecordSet = null;

            try
            {
                oRecordSet = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(Path + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "UbicacionAsignadaOP", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%nOSF%", nOSF);
                query = query.Replace("%idLineaOSF%", idLineaOSF);
                oRecordSet.DoQuery(query);

                if (oRecordSet.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    documento = oRecordSet.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();
                    return true;
                }
                else
                {
                    return false;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existe_UbicacionAsignadaOP", sapCompany);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRecordSet);
            }
        }


        public bool permiteGestionarUbicacionesPorArticulo(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string ItemCode, string Strpath)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool permite = false;
            string strPermite = string.Empty;
            string strQuery = string.Empty;
            try
            {

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(Strpath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "permiteGestionarUbicacionesPorArticulo", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%ItemCode%", ItemCode);
                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    strPermite = ors.Fields.Item(0).Value.ToString();

                    if (strPermite.Equals("Y"))
                        permite = true;
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC0001", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return permite;
        }

        /// <summary>Verifica si el ID de linea esta disponible para ser asignado</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="IdLinea">Id de linea a verificar</param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public static bool ExisteEnLineasEliminadas(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string IdLinea, string DocEntry, string Ruta)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            string strQuery = string.Empty;
            try
            {

                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                strQuery = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(Ruta + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "ExisteEnLineas", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%IdLinea%", IdLinea);

                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%DocEntry%", DocEntry);

                ors.DoQuery(strQuery);

                int Cantidad = int.Parse(ors.Fields.Item("Cantidad").Value.ToString());

                return Cantidad > 0;

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteEnLineasEliminadas", sapCompany);
                return false;
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
        }





        /// <summary>Realiza el proceso de eliminacion o registro de Lineas eliminadas</summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="IdLinea">Numero de linea</param>
        /// <param name="DocEntry">DocEntry OSF</param>
        /// <param name="NombreConsulta">Nombre consulta para eliminacion o registro de lineas</param>
        /// <param name="Ruta">Ruta recursos</param>
        /// <param name="Lineas">Variable para guardar en ella el numero de lineas a eliminar</param>
        public static void EliminarLineasBasicoPaquete(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string IdLinea, string DocEntry, string NombreConsulta, string Ruta, ref string Lineas)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset oRs = null;
            string strQuery = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                oRs = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                strQuery = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(Ruta + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", NombreConsulta, "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%lineaPadre%", IdLinea);
                strQuery = strQuery.Replace("%numOSF%", DocEntry);
                oRs.DoQuery(strQuery);

                if (NombreConsulta.Equals("LineasAEliminar"))
                {
                    Lineas = oRs.Fields.Item("Lineas").Value.ToString();
                }

            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EliminarLineasBasicoPaquete", sapCompany);

            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(oRs);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Ordena la matriz delementos segun los ID de linea </summary>
        /// <param name="sapCompany">Compañia SAP</param>
        /// <param name="path">Ruta recursos</param>
        /// <param name="FormOSF">Formulario Orden de Servicio Funerario</param>
        public void ActualizarElementosOrdenados(SAPbobsCOM.Company sapCompany, string path, SAPbouiCOM.Form FormOSF)
        {
            Recordset recordset = null;

            try
            {
                string query = OK1.Generic.Helpers.configParteConsulta(path + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "OrganizarMatrizElementos", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");

                query = query.Replace("%DocEntry%", FormOSF.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_LLAMADA_HEAD").GetValue("DocEntry", 0).ToString());

                recordset = (Recordset)sapCompany.GetBusinessObject(BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);

                recordset.DoQuery(query);

                var dbDataSource = FormOSF.DataSources.DBDataSources.Item("@OK1_SF_ELEM_LIN");
                dbDataSource.Clear();

                string[] fieldNames = {
                    "U_Linea", "U_CantCu", "U_Renuncia", "LineId", "U_NombreSN", "U_almacen", "U_DescDoc", "U_ItemCodePB",
                    "U_LineaName", "U_confirmCofre", "U_docOrd", "U_cantDisp", "U_ItemCodeHC", "U_LineaPadrePN", "Object",
                    "U_ordenLabVinc", "U_VlrDto", "U_EADCub", "U_ArtAdMe", "U_ItemCodeP", "U_TipDocB1", "U_CardCode",
                    "U_permModArt", "U_porcDto", "U_tipOrden", "U_tipLinea", "U_ValorCom", "U_seFactu", "U_usuAdi",
                    "U_vlrComis", "U_vrserv", "U_ItemCode", "U_NoFacturaPrenec", "U_IdLinea", "U_CodSN", "U_CardName",
                    "U_VlrAux", "U_CantDispo", "VisOrder", "U_RotuloCofre", "U_Nombre", "U_cenCosto1", "U_cenCosto2",
                    "U_cenCosto3", "U_ordenTrasVinc", "U_NoFactura", "U_IVA", "DocEntry", "U_totalLinea", "LogInst",
                    "U_ordCom", "U_Pagado", "U_EsFactu", "U_AutTerc", "U_Comentario", "U_Conductor", "U_ValorFac",
                    "U_IdLineaPF", "U_noGenerSalInv", "U_cenCosto", "U_codIva", "U_Codigo", "U_Documento", "U_Uso",
                    "U_Valor", "U_ItemName", "U_Vehiculo", "U_NoContr_Prenec", "U_LPagadaPrenec", "U_nvend", "U_LineaPadre",
                    "U_Cant"
                    };

                var fieldsToConvert = new HashSet<string>
                        {
                            "U_VlrDto", "U_porcDto", "U_ValorCom", "U_IVA",
                            "U_totalLinea", "U_ValorFac", "U_Valor", "U_VlrAux"
                        };

                int index = 0;
                string valor = "";

                while (!recordset.EoF)
                {
                    dbDataSource.InsertRecord(index);

                    foreach (string fieldName in fieldNames)
                    {

                        var fieldValue = recordset.Fields.Item(fieldName).Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;


                        // Verificar si el campo necesita conversión
                        var valueToSet = fieldsToConvert.Contains(fieldName)
                            ? OK1.SBO.Helpers.DoubleToDBDataSourceImporte(sapCompany, Convert.ToDouble(fieldValue))
                            : fieldValue;

                        // Establecer el valor en dbDataSource
                        dbDataSource.SetValue(fieldName, index, valueToSet);
                    }

                    index++;
                    recordset.MoveNext();
                }

                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix matriz = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)FormOSF.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                matriz.LoadFromDataSource();
                matriz.AutoResizeColumns();



            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ActualizarElementosOrdenados", sapCompany);
            }
            finally
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(recordset);
            }

        }


        public bool existeUsoComponentesPadre(SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string mystrPath, string linea, string NoPrecenecidad)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.Recordset ors = null;
            bool existe = false;
            string query = "";

            try
            {
                ors = (SAPbobsCOM.Recordset)ocmp.GetBusinessObject(SAPbobsCOM.BoObjectTypes.BoRecordset);
                query = OK1.Generic.HelpersXML.configParteConsulta(mystrPath + @"AddInQueries\Queries.xml", "existeUsoComponentePadre", "/TQueries/Queries/Query");
                query = query.Replace("%NroPrenecesidad%", NoPrecenecidad);
                query = query.Replace("%NroLinea%", linea);
                ors.DoQuery(query);
                if (ors.RecordCount > 0)
                {
                    existe = true;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "existeUsoComponentesPadre", ocmp);
            }
            finally
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(ors);
            }
            return existe;
        }


        public void BorrarComponentesBasicoPaquete(SAPbouiCOM.Form oForm, SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix, SAPbouiCOM.DBDataSource oDBS, string lineaPadre)
        {
            ArrayList lineasEliminar = new ArrayList();

            try
            {

                oForm.Freeze(true);


                #region Elementos 


                #region Eliminar  Componentes
                for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                {
                    string lineID = oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", i - 1).Trim();
                    string tipoLinea = oDBS.GetValue("U_tipLinea", i - 1).Trim();
                    string lineaIDPadre = oDBS.GetValue("U_lineaPadre", i - 1).Trim();

                    if (lineaPadre.Equals(lineaIDPadre) && (tipoLinea.Equals("C") || tipoLinea.Equals("H")))
                        lineasEliminar.Add(lineID);

                }

                foreach (string linea in lineasEliminar)
                {
                    for (int i = 1; i <= oMatrix.RowCount; i++)
                    {

                        if (linea.Equals(oDBS.GetValue("U_IdLinea", i - 1)))
                        {
                            oDBS.RemoveRecord(i - 1);
                            break;
                        }


                    }
                }
                oMatrix.LoadFromDataSource();
                #endregion




                #endregion



            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                SBOApplication.StatusBar.SetText(e.Message, BoMessageTime.bmt_Medium, BoStatusBarMessageType.smt_Error);
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "EXC005", SBOCompany);
            }
            finally
            {

                OK1.SBO.Helpers.LiberarCOM(lineasEliminar);
                oForm.Freeze(false);
            }

        }




        public static bool ExisteLineIdForm(Form oForm, SAPbobsCOM.Company ocmp, string lineIdUlt)
        {
            XmlDocument xmlDoc = new XmlDocument();
            XmlNodeList xmlFilas = null;
            string strDTXML = string.Empty;
            Matrix netMatrix = null; ;
            StringReader strReader;
            string LineId = "";
            int intLineId = 0;
            int mayor = 0;
            int temporalMayor = 0;
            bool existe = false;

            try
            {
                SAPbouiCOM.Matrix oMatrix = null;
                oMatrix = (SAPbouiCOM.Matrix)oForm.Items.Item("mtx_2").Specific;
                strDTXML = oMatrix.SerializeAsXML(BoMatrixXmlSelect.mxs_All);
                xmlDoc.LoadXml(strDTXML);

                System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer xmlSerializer = new System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer(typeof(Matrix));
                xmlFilas = xmlDoc.GetElementsByTagName("Row");
                strReader = new StringReader(strDTXML);
                netMatrix = (Matrix)xmlSerializer.Deserialize(strReader);

                int fila = 0;

                foreach (XmlElement item in xmlFilas)
                {
                    LineId = netMatrix.Rows[fila].Columns[41].Value.ToString();  //36


                    if (lineIdUlt == LineId)
                    {
                        existe = true;
                        break;
                    }


                    fila++;
                }
                LineId = (mayor + 1).ToString();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                OK1.SBO.Helpers.reportar_error(e, "addInSrvFun", "ExisteLineIdForm", ocmp);
            }
            return existe;
        }

            }
            
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Obtiene los datos del documento.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="Entry"></param>
        public void getByKey(int Entry)
        {
            SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCmpServ = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService oGS = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralDataParams oGDP = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData oGD = null;
            SAPbobsCOM.GeneralDataCollection oGDCL = null;
            try
            {
                oCmpServ = this.ocmp.GetCompanyService();
                oGS = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService)oCmpServ.GetGeneralService("OK1_SF_LLAMADA");
                oGDP = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralDataParams)oGS.GetDataInterface(GeneralServiceDataInterfaces.gsGeneralDataParams);
                oGDP.SetProperty("DocEntry", Entry);

                oGD = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData)oGS.GetByParams(oGDP);
                this.Entry = Entry;
                this.totalIngresos = (double)oGD.GetProperty("U_TotIng");
                this.NumContrato = Convert.ToInt32(oGD.GetProperty("U_NumContr"));
                this.idFallecido = oGD.GetProperty("U_IdFallec").ToString();

                oGDCL = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralDataCollection)oGD.Child("OK1_SF_AUXILIO");
                this.lineasAuxilios = new LineasAuxilios[oGDCL.Count];
                for (int i = 0; i < oGDCL.Count; i++)
                {
                    this.lineasAuxilios[i] = new LineasAuxilios();
                    this.lineasAuxilios[i].idAuxilio = oGDCL.Item(i).GetProperty("U_Codigo").ToString();
                    this.lineasAuxilios[i].nomAuxilio = oGDCL.Item(i).GetProperty("U_Nombre").ToString();
                    this.lineasAuxilios[i].cancelado = oGDCL.Item(i).GetProperty("U_AuxCanc").ToString();
                }

            }
            catch
            {

            }
            finally
            {
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oCmpServ);
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oGS);
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oGDP);
                System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oGD);
                //System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(oGDCL);
            }
        }
        public void update()
        {
            try
            {
                SAPbobsCOM.CompanyService oCompService;
                SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService oDocGeneralService;
                SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData oDocGeneralData;
                SAPbobsCOM.GeneralDataCollection oDocLinesCollection;
                SAPbobsCOM.GeneralData oDocLineGeneralData;
                SAPbobsCOM.GeneralDataParams oGenralParameter;

                oCompService = this.ocmp.GetCompanyService();

                // Retrieve the relevant service
                oDocGeneralService = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralService)oCompService.GetGeneralService("OK1_SF_LLAMADA");
                // GetByKey
                oGenralParameter = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralDataParams)oDocGeneralService.GetDataInterface(SAPbobsCOM.GeneralServiceDataInterfaces.gsGeneralDataParams);
                oGenralParameter.SetProperty("DocEntry", this.Entry);

                oDocGeneralData = oDocGeneralService.GetByParams(oGenralParameter);

                // Update Header
                oDocGeneralData.SetProperty("U_TotIng", this.totalIngresos);
                // Update Lines
                oDocLinesCollection = (SAPbobsCOM.GeneralDataCollection)oDocGeneralData.Child("OK1_SF_AUXILIO");
                for (int i = 0; i < oDocLinesCollection.Count; i++)
                {
                    oDocLinesCollection.Item(i).SetProperty("U_AuxCanc", this.lineasAuxilios[i].cancelado);
                }

                // Update the Doc UDO
                oDocGeneralService.Update(oDocGeneralData);
            }
            catch
            {

            }
        }
    }

        public string nomAuxilio;
        public string cancelado;
    }
